#### 2.2.1 Feature: Access model (roles, permissions, module actions)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Defines the three layers every authorization decision uses. (1) Platform permissions for Caboodle staff (`ADMIN` identity role, `[MustHavePermission]`). (2) Organization permissions carried by a member's organization role (`[RequireOrgPermission]`). (3) Module actions per brand, granted by module assignments to the organization and narrowed per member by brand access (`[RequireModule]`). Other module sections reference this model when they cite an access rule.
- **User flow:** None found (model only; see 2.2.2 for resolution per request).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/OrgRoles.cs` | Four system roles with fixed IDs, `HasFullBrandAccess` flag and permission lists |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/OrgPermissions.cs` | The 13 organization permission strings (`OrgPermissions.All`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/ModuleSlugs.cs` | Module slug constants used by `[RequireModule]` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/OrganizationEnums.cs` | `ModuleActions` flags and all IAM enums |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/CaboodlePermissions.cs` | Platform permission catalog (`CaboodlePermissions.Admin`, `CaboodleResource.*`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs` | Decision methods: `HasOrgPermission`, `HasModule`, `BrandsWith`, `BrandsInScope`, `ModuleRefusal`, `OrganizationModuleRefusal`, `HasOrganizationModule`, `OwnsBrokerageRecord`, `ViewerBrokerageId` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextBuilder.cs` | Builds Full and Custom grants from assignments, brand access and dependencies |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Seeding/OrganizationRoleSeeder.cs` | Upserts system roles and their permissions at startup (`ICustomSeeder`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/access.interface.ts` | Web mirror: `ORG_PERMISSIONS`, `ROLE_KEYS`, `ROLE_LABELS`, `MODULE_ACTIONS` |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/organization.interface.ts` | `BUILT_IN_ROLES` with the same fixed role IDs |

- **Data:**
  - System roles (`OrgRoles.System`):

| Key | ID suffix | Org type | Full brand access | Permissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brand-admin` | `...2a01` | Brand | yes | all 13 |
| `brand-member` | `...2a02` | Brand | no | `organization.view`, `member.view`, `connection.view` |
| `brokerage-admin` | `...2a03` | Brokerage | yes | all 13 |
| `broker` | `...2a04` | Brokerage | no | `organization.view`, `member.view` |

  - Organization permissions: `organization.view`, `organization.update`, `member.view`, `member.invite`, `member.approve`, `member.update`, `member.suspend`, `member.remove`, `domain.view`, `domain.manage`, `connection.view`, `access.manage`, `files.private` (the last one is read by `FileRepositoryArea` in `Modules.FileRepository.Application/Helper/FileRepositoryArea.cs` to open the company's private folder).
  - Module actions (`ModuleActions` flags): View 1, Create 2, Update 4, Delete 8, Import 16, Export 32, All 63. A module's `AvailableActions` caps what can ever be granted on it.
- **APIs/interfaces:** Attributes: `[MustHavePermission(action, resource, module)]` (policy `Permissions.{module}.{resource}.{action}`), `[RequireOrgPermission(permission)]` (policy `org:{permission}`), `[RequireModule(brandSlug, brokerSlug, actions, CrossBrand=, OrganizationLevel=)]` (policy `module:{brand}|{broker}|{actions}|{crossBrand}|{organizationLevel}`), resolved by `PermissionPolicyProvider`. See 2.2.3.
- **Business rules:**
  - Organization permissions: `AccessContext.HasOrgPermission` is `IsPlatformAdmin || Permissions.Contains(permission)`.
  - Brands a context holds (`AccessContextBuilder.BuildOrganization`): a Brand organization's only brand is itself; a Brokerage's brands are the brands with an Active connection (Active brand organization only).
  - Modules per brand: a Brand organization uses its own enabled Brand-audience modules. A Brokerage on a connected brand gets its own enabled Broker-audience modules plus every module the brand has enabled (comment BROKER-BRAND-ACCESS-D1/D5); slugs present in both are merged.
  - Full vs Custom: a role with `HasFullBrandAccess`, or support access, gets Full on every brand (all enabled modules with their `AvailableActions`). Other members get a grant only for brands with a `BrandAccess` row; Full mode gives all enabled modules, Custom gives only listed modules, each with `View` forced on and capped by `AvailableActions`; a child module is dropped unless its parent is also granted; each Required dependency of a granted module is added with `View` (`AccessContextBuilder.CustomGrant`).
  - Company access (P2): for a Brokerage the context also has `Company`, the grant on the brokerage's own row, used by `OrganizationLevel` rules.
  - `ModuleRefusal` checks the brand slug for a Brand organization and the broker slug for a Brokerage, falling back to the brand slug when the rule has no broker slug; single-brand rules need a valid selected brand; CrossBrand rules without a brand pass when any brand grants the action.
  - Records owned by a brokerage (`BrokerageOrganizationID`) are visible only to that brokerage or a Platform Admin (`OwnsBrokerageRecord`, comment D6).
- **Dependencies:** `Configuration.Modules`, `ModuleAssignments`, `ModuleDependencies` (2.2.12); `Identity.UserRoles` for `ADMIN`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A member with no `BrandAccess` row for a brand gets no grant for it (brand absent from `Brands`). An empty `modules` map on a brand means no access (`caboodle.web/src/models/access.interface.ts` comment).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Access/AccessContextBuilderTests.cs`, `BrokerBrandAccessTests.cs`, `OrganizationLevelAccessTests.cs`, `ModuleAuthorizationTests.cs`, `AnyModuleWithBrokerSlugsTests.cs`, `CatalogModuleAccessTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Seeding/OrganizationRoleSeederTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The web comment on `IMyOrganization.brands` says a Brokerage lists brands "with broker modules only", but the backend merges the brand's modules too (`AccessContextBuilder.BuildOrganization`). The web comment in `filterMenuItemsByModule` ("a Brokerage never holds `promotion-planning`") is stale for the same reason.
  - The legacy roles in `CaboodleRoles` and `CaboodlePermissions.Broker/SubBroker` still exist and are still checked by `[MustHavePermission]` routes and `BrandValidationMiddleware`.
  - Built-in role IDs are duplicated in the web (`BUILT_IN_ROLES`) because no company-readable role endpoint exists.

#### 2.2.2 Feature: Session access resolution (`/me/access`, `IAccessContext`, headers)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Computes, once per request and cached per user, every organization the signed-in person belongs to with role, permissions, brands and module actions, then selects the organization the request acts in from the `OrganizationID` header and the brand from the `BrandID` header. `GET /api/v1/me/access` returns the whole snapshot to the web app, which uses it for every gating decision. Used by every signed-in user; the endpoint needs only `[Authorize]`.
- **User flow:**
  1. Web sends `GET /api/v1/me/access` with `Authorization` only (`skipOrganizationHeader: true` in `AccessService.getMyAccess`).
  2. Backend loads the snapshot (cache, else SQL) and returns organizations sorted by name.
  3. Web `useAccess` picks the stored company id if it is still listed, else the first organization, writes it back to `useAccessStore` (`cb-cmp-store-organization`), and the axios interceptor sends it as `OrganizationID` on later calls.
  4. On a company switch `selectOrganization` stores the new id and drops every cached React Query entry except `/me/access` (`dropCompanyScopedQueries`).
  5. Each API call: `CurrentUserMiddleware` reads `BrandID` and `OrganizationID`; `AccessContextService.GetCurrentAsync` selects the organization and the active brand.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Identity/MeController.cs` | `GET me/access` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Me/GetMyAccessRequest.cs` | Maps `AccessSnapshot` to `MyAccessDto` (string enums, action names) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessResolver.cs` | One multi-result Dapper query: user, organizations in scope, brands, enabled modules, brand access, grants, Required dependencies |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextBuilder.cs` | Snapshot builder (see 2.2.1 rules) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextService.cs` | Cache, organization selection, support context, `Demand*` methods |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessVersion.cs` | Per-organization version keys and per-user cache reset |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/CurrentUserMiddleware.cs` | Parses `BrandID` (invalid flag) and `OrganizationID` headers |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessRefusal.cs` | 400 `BrandID` vs 403 `Access` refusals |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/access.service.ts` | `getMyAccess`, `logout` |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/access.ts` | `useMyAccess`, `useAccess`, `invalidateMyAccess`, `dropCompanyScopedQueries` |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/access.helper.ts` | Pure decisions: `resolveSelectedOrganizationId`, `canModule`, `anyBrandCan`, `canCompany`, `resolveCurrentBrandId`, `isWaitingForSetup`, `resolveLandingRoute`, `findOrganizationForBrand` |
| `caboodle.web/src/store/accessStore.ts` | Persisted selected company id |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/apiHeaders.ts` | `authHeaders`, `withDefaultAuthHeaders`, `isGuid` (drops non-GUID `BrandID`/`OrganizationID`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/AxiosInterceptor.tsx` | `applyRequestHeaders` (adds `OrganizationID` unless `skipOrganizationHeader`), 401 refresh and retry |
| `caboodle.web/src/httpClient/fetchWithMock.ts` | Same headers for raw `fetch` calls |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/WorkspaceContainer.tsx` | Company switcher; selects the owner company of a brand in the URL via `findOrganizationForBrand` |

- **Data:** `MyAccessDto { isPlatformAdmin, organizations: MyOrganizationAccessDto[] }`; `MyOrganizationAccessDto { organizationId, name, type: "Brand"|"Brokerage", role, permissions[], brands: MyBrandAccessDto[], company: MyBrandAccessDto|null }`; `MyBrandAccessDto { brandId, name, accessMode: "Full"|"Custom", modules: { slug: ["view",...] } }` (`Modules.Organization.Application/DTOs/MyAccessDto.cs`; web `IMyAccess` in `caboodle.web/src/models/access.interface.ts`). Cache keys `iam:access:{userId}` (5 min) and `iam:access-version:{organizationId}` (1 day).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/me/access` | `Authorize` | none / `MyAccessDto` (web `IMyAccess`) | `GetMyAccessRequestHandler` |

  Headers read on every request: `OrganizationID` (GUID; unparsable values are ignored), `BrandID` (GUID; an invalid value sets `IsBrandIDInvalid`).
- **Business rules:**
  - Scope SQL includes only organizations with `Status = Active` and not deleted, where the user has an Active, non-deleted membership; an inactive user account gets an empty snapshot and loses platform admin (`AccessContextBuilder.Build`).
  - Organization selection (`AccessContextService.SelectOrganizationAsync`): header present and the user is a member, use it; header present, not a member, Platform Admin, load a support context; header present otherwise, 403 key `OrganizationID` "You are not a member of this organization."; no header and one membership, use it; no header and none, empty context; no header and several, use the Brand organization whose ID equals `BrandID`, else 400 key `OrganizationID` "Select an organization.".
  - Active brand: the `BrandID` header only when the selected context lists that brand; there is no fallback to a Brand company's own brand (comment P1). An unknown brand is 403 "You do not have access to this brand."; an unparsable one 400 "Invalid BrandID."; a single-brand rule without a brand 400 "Select a brand.".
  - `DemandBrandAsync` and `DemandOwnBrokerageRecordAsync` answer 404 "Record not found." so foreign IDs reveal nothing.
  - `DemandCatalogModuleAsync` always passes for a Platform Admin.
  - Web `canCompany` checks `company.modules` for a Brokerage and `brands[0]` for a Brand company; `resolveCurrentBrandId` uses the route `[brandID]` when listed, else a Brand company's own brand.
- **Dependencies:** `ICacheService` (`LocalCacheService` when `CacheSettings.UseDistributedCache` is false, which is the value in `appsettings.Development/Staging/Production.json`), Dapper, NextAuth session token (`caboodle.web/src/httpClient/sessionToken.ts`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Web `useMyAccess` uses `staleTime` 60 s, `refetchOnWindowFocus`, `retry: false`; `AccessRedirectGuard` does nothing while loading or on error. A deleted or suspended stored company is replaced by the first listed one.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Access/AccessContextServiceTests.cs`, `AccessPlumbingTests.cs`, `AccessStartupTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Me/GetMyAccessRequestTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/access.test.tsx`, `helper/access.helper.test.ts`, `helper/apiHeaders.test.ts`, `store/accessStore.test.ts`. `AccessResolver` is `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]` (SQL only).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The access and version caches use the in-process cache in every environment config, so a version bump on one API instance does not reach another; with more than one instance, changes can take up to 5 minutes to apply there.
  - Joining a new organization is not covered by version bumps; writers pass `RefreshUserIds` to delete the user's cache entry (`AccessVersion.ForgetUsersAsync`).
  - `/me/access` is the only IAM response with string enums; every other IAM route uses integers (`caboodle.web/src/models/access.interface.ts` comment, verified against DTOs).

##### 2.2.2.1 Sub-feature: Platform Admin support access

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A Platform Admin (identity role `ADMIN`) who sends `OrganizationID` of an organization they are not a member of gets a support context: all 13 permissions, Full access on every brand, `IsSupportAccess = true` (`AccessContextService.LoadSupportContextAsync`, `AccessContextBuilder.BuildOrganization`). caboodle.admin uses this for organization-scoped calls (`caboodle.admin/src/helper/organization.helper.ts` `organizationScopedHeaders`).
- **Business rules:** Without `OrganizationID` and with no memberships, the Platform Admin context is empty but `HasOrgPermission` is true, so list endpoints use `OrganizationGuard.ListScope` = null (all organizations) while writes that call `RequireOrganization` answer 400 "Select an organization.". Writes made in support mode are audited with `IsSupportAccess = true`. Quota limits are not enforced for support access; a bypass writes `quota.bypassed` (2.2.13.1).
- **Errors & edge cases:** A suspended or deleted organization is not in the support scope, so the call answers 404 key `OrganizationID` "Organization not found.".

##### 2.2.2.2 Sub-feature: Access cache versioning

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `AccessContextService.GetUserAccessAsync` caches the snapshot per user with the version of each organization in it; `IsFreshAsync` rejects the entry when older than 5 minutes or when any organization's version changed. `AccessVersion.BumpAsync` sets a new version (UTC ticks) for the changed organizations and every brokerage connected to them; a missing version is seeded with current ticks, never 0.
- **Business rules:** Writers bump: `IamWriter.WriteAsync` (`BumpOrganizationIds`), `ApplyModuleAssignmentsRequestHandler`, `BackfillAllModuleAssignmentsRequestHandler`, `BackfillRetailAplModuleRequestHandler`. Not bumped: module catalog create/update/delete (`CreateConfigurationModuleRequest`, `UpdateConfigurationModuleRequest`, `DeleteConfigurationModulesRequest`), so a changed `AvailableActions` or a deleted module applies after the 5-minute cache lifetime.

#### 2.2.3 Feature: Endpoint authorization model

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Every controller action carries exactly one authorization rule. ASP.NET policies are created on demand by `PermissionPolicyProvider` from the attribute's policy name and evaluated by three handlers; refusals become the standard error envelope. A reflection test keeps the rule set complete. All controllers are also mapped with `RequireAuthorization()` (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Startup.cs` `MapEndpoints`).
- **User flow:** None found (request pipeline).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Permissions/MustHavePermissionAttribute.cs` | Platform permission attribute |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Permissions/PermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs` | `IUserService.HasPermissionAsync` check |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Permissions/PermissionPolicyProvider.cs` | Builds `Permissions.*`, `org:*` and `module:*` policies |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/OrgPermissions/RequireOrgPermissionAttribute.cs`, `OrgPermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs` | Organization permission rule |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Modules/RequireModuleAttribute.cs`, `ModuleAuthorizationHandler.cs`, `AccessFailureReason.cs` | Module rule; `OrganizationLevel` uses `OrganizationModuleRefusal`, else `ModuleRefusal` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/AccessForbiddenResultHandler.cs` | Writes 400 (bad `BrandID`) or 403 `Access` JSON envelope instead of an empty 403 |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/Startup.cs` | DI registration of handlers and result handler |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/API.Test/Authorization/EndpointAuthorizationCoverageTests.cs` | Reflection test |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/API.Test/Authorization/bare-endpoints-baseline.txt` | Actions still without a rule |

- **Data:** None found.
- **APIs/interfaces:** Rule kinds and counts in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers` (grep at time of writing): 348 `RequireModule(` usages, 64 with `CrossBrand = true`, 44 with `OrganizationLevel = true` (`BrokersController` 10, `PromotionalManagementNotesController` 16, `DirectoryController` 10, `FilesController` 8). `RequireOrgPermission` appears in the Organizations controllers, `ModuleSettingsController` and `BrandsController`.
- **Business rules:**
  - `RequireModule(brand, broker, actions)`: brand slug for Brand organizations, broker slug for Brokerages (brand slug fallback when no broker slug); a single-brand rule requires a valid `BrandID`; `CrossBrand = true` makes the brand optional (checked when sent, else any brand); `OrganizationLevel = true` checks the brokerage's company access (Brand organizations: their own brand) and never falls back to the brand slug.
  - Refusal codes: `AccessRefusal.BadBrand` 400 key `BrandID`; everything else 403 key `Access`. Org permission failure: 403 "You do not have permission to do this in this organization.".
  - Handlers can also call `IAccessContext.Demand*` directly (most Organization handlers re-check their permission with `DemandOrgPermissionAsync`).
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.2 access context; Identity `IUserService` for platform permissions.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `PermissionAuthorizationHandler` throws 401 when the user id claim is empty.
- **Tests:** `EndpointAuthorizationCoverageTests` facts: every action declares a rule or is in the baseline; the baseline lists only still-bare actions; `[AllowAnonymous]` carries no policy; at most one rule per action; platform and management controllers never use `[RequireModule]`; `CrossBrand` and `OrganizationLevel` never combined; platform controllers need `[MustHavePermission]`; admin tools keep their permissions; every slug exists in `ModuleCatalogSeedData`. Infrastructure: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Access/ModuleAuthorizationTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `ModuleSettingsController` is in neither `PlatformControllers` nor `ManagementControllers` of the test, so the "platform actions need `[MustHavePermission]`" fact does not cover it (it currently passes because its platform actions do carry it).
  - On `origin/master`, `SubBrokerParentRepairController` (`POST api/v1/admin/sub-broker-parent-repair`, permission `Permissions.Admin.SubBrokerParentRepair.Execute`) was added; it is not in `PlatformControllers` either.

##### 2.2.3.1 Sub-feature: Bare-endpoint baseline

- **Status:** Partial (four actions still have no explicit rule; the file says the list must be empty before launch)
- **What it does:** `bare-endpoints-baseline.txt` lists `BannersController.DeleteRetailerPromoRulesAsync DELETE promorules`, `ExportRetailerPromoRulesAsync POST promorules/export`, `ImportRetailerPromoRulesAsync POST promorules/import`, `UpsertRetailerPromoRulesAsync POST promorules/upsert`. They are still authenticated through `RequireAuthorization()` but carry no module or permission rule.
- **Business rules:** The list "only shrinks": a test fails when a listed action gains a rule and is not removed.

##### 2.2.3.2 Sub-feature: Legacy `BrandValidationMiddleware`

- **Status:** Active (legacy path kept alongside the access engine)
- **What it does:** For any authenticated request with a `BrandID` header, checks the brand against legacy tables by identity role (`Brand.BrandBrokers` for `BROKER`/`BROKERSUBUSER`, `Brand.BrandSubUsers` for `BRANDSUBUSER`, `Brand.Brands.UserID` otherwise; `ADMIN` skips), and otherwise accepts it when the access engine lists the brand (`IsBrandOfCurrentOrganizationAsync`). Refuses with 403 `PermisionDeniedException` or 400 "Invalid BrandID." (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/BrandValidationMiddleware.cs`).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Runs after `UseAuthorization` (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Startup.cs` `UseInfrastructure`), so endpoint rules are already evaluated. It still depends on legacy role tables that the IAM model replaced.

#### 2.2.4 Feature: Organizations

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Companies are created by a Platform Admin (Brand or Brokerage, optional domain) or by a signed-in person for themselves (2.2.15). Platform Admins list, view, rename, change membership policy, suspend or restore organizations in caboodle.admin. A company's own admins read and update their current organization (name, membership policy, logo) in the web Company area. Creating a Brand organization also creates its `Brand.Brands` row with the same ID.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/organizations`: list with filters (type, status, name), Add Organization (name, type, domain), Edit (name, policy), Suspend/Restore.
  2. Admin `/organizations/[organizationId]`: tabs Modules, Connections, Members, Invitations, Access Requests, Domains, Activity (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Organization/OrganizationDetail.tsx`).
  3. Web `/company`: overview with identity row, stats, "Company settings" form (name, "Who can join"), logo upload/remove (`caboodle.web/src/components/company/CompanyOverview.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/OrganizationsController.cs` | All organization routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Organizations/*.cs` | Create, list, get, current, update, status, logo, discover, self, brand profile handlers |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/OrganizationWriter.cs` | Insert organization, brand row, first domain |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/OrganizationSql.cs` | `OrganizationDtoSelect` (primary domain, member and connection counts) |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Organization/{OrganizationsTable,AddOrganization,EditOrganization,OrganizationStatusButton,OrganizationDetail,OrganizationTags,OrganizationSelect,OrganizationUnavailableNotice}.tsx` | Admin UI |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/organization.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/organizations.ts` | Admin calls (no `OrganizationID` header) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/CompanyOverview.tsx` | Web current organization page |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/organization.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/organization.ts` | `getCurrentOrganization`, `updateCurrentOrganization`, logo upload/remove; `invalidateAfterOrganizationChange` |

- **Data:** `Organization.Organizations`; `OrganizationDto { id, name, type, status, membershipPolicy, logoURL, primaryDomain, members, connections, createdOn }` (`Modules.Organization.Application/DTOs/OrganizationDtos.cs`; web `IOrganization`, admin `IOrganization`). Logos in S3 under `Organizations/{organizationId}/Logo/{guid}.{ext}`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/organizations` | `MustHavePermission(View, Organizations, Platform)` | `GetOrganizationsRequest { type?, status?, name?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<OrganizationDto>` | `GetOrganizationsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/organizations/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(View, Organizations, Platform)` | / `OrganizationDto` | `GetOrganizationRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/organizations` | `MustHavePermission(Create, Organizations, Platform)` | `CreateOrganizationRequest { name, type, domain? }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateOrganizationRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizations/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, Organizations, Platform)` | `UpdateOrganizationRequest { name, membershipPolicy? }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateOrganizationRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizations/{id}/status` | `MustHavePermission(Update, Organizations, Platform)` | `UpdateOrganizationStatusRequest { status }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateOrganizationStatusRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizations/{id}/logo` | `MustHavePermission(Update, Organizations, Platform)` | multipart `UploadOrganizationLogoRequest { logo }` / `OrganizationDto` | `UploadOrganizationLogoRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/organizations/{id}/logo` | `MustHavePermission(Update, Organizations, Platform)` | / `OrganizationDto` | `RemoveOrganizationLogoRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/organizations/current` | `RequireOrgPermission(organization.view)` | / `OrganizationDto` | `GetCurrentOrganizationRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizations/current` | `RequireOrgPermission(organization.update)` | `UpdateCurrentOrganizationRequest { name, membershipPolicy }` (web `IUpdateCurrentOrganizationRequest`) / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateCurrentOrganizationRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizations/current/logo` | `RequireOrgPermission(organization.update)` | multipart `{ logo }` / `OrganizationDto` | `UploadOrganizationLogoRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/organizations/current/logo` | `RequireOrgPermission(organization.update)` | / `OrganizationDto` | `RemoveOrganizationLogoRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/organizations/discover` | `Authorize` | / `List<DiscoveredOrganizationDto>` | `DiscoverOrganizationsRequestHandler` (2.2.15) |
| POST | `/api/v1/organizations/self` | `Authorize` | `CreateOwnOrganizationRequest { name, type }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateOwnOrganizationRequestHandler` (2.2.15) |

  Audit actions: `organization.created`, `organization.updated`, `organization.status_changed`.
- **Business rules:**
  - New organizations start Active, policy DomainMatch, with no modules (`OrganizationWriter.CreateAsync`, comment D4).
  - Platform create: name up to 200, domain optional; the domain must be normalizable and not public or reserved (`OrganizationGuard.RequireClaimableDomain`), but need not match the admin's email; a taken domain is 409.
  - Rename of a Brand organization also renames `Brand.Brands.Name` (`UpdateOrganizationRequestHandler.UpdateProfileAsync`). Platform update keeps the current policy when `membershipPolicy` is null; the current-organization update requires it.
  - Status change bumps the organization and its connected organizations, and resets every member's cache entry (suspended organizations drop out of access).
  - Logo: PNG or JPEG by extension and magic bytes, at most 2 MB; uploaded before the DB write and removed again if the write fails; the previous logo is deleted only when its S3 key is under this organization's logo folder.
- **Dependencies:** S3 `IFileStorageService`, `OrganizationSettings` (public and reserved domains in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/appsettings.json`), Brand module tables.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 404 `Organization` "Organization not found."; validation messages for logo ("Choose an image to upload.", "The image must be 2 MB or smaller.", "Upload a PNG or JPEG image."); `GetOrganization` returns a suspended organization too.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Organizations/OrganizationRequestTests.cs`, `OrganizationLogoRequestTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/API.Test/Organizations/OrganizationLogoBindingTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/CompanyOverview.test.tsx`, `service/organization.service.test.ts`. No admin tests exist (caboodle.admin has no test files or test script).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** caboodle.admin has no UI for the platform logo routes (`caboodle.admin/src/services/organization.service.ts` wraps list, get, create, update, status only). Suspending a company does not end its connections; the access query simply excludes non-active organizations.

##### 2.2.4.1 Sub-feature: Brand profile update through `POST /brands`

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `BrandsController.CreateAsync` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs`, rule `RequireOrgPermission(organization.update)`) sends `UpdateBrandProfileRequest` when the body has an ID. The handler (`Modules.Organization.Application/Organizations/UpdateBrandProfileRequest.cs`) allows a Platform Admin or a caller whose current organization is that brand; it merges fields (omitted keeps, `""` clears), updates `Brand.Brands`, and renames the organization when the name changed. Audit `organization.updated`.

#### 2.2.5 Feature: Organization roles

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Platform Admins list the built-in roles and create, edit and delete custom roles (name, organization type, full brand access flag, permission set). Companies cannot read or create roles; the web offers only the built-in roles of the company's type plus a member's current custom role.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/organization-roles`: table of roles with member counts; Add/Edit opens `RoleForm`; Delete for unused custom roles.
  2. Web Members/Invitations: `RoleSelect` shows `builtInRolesFor(type)`; a member holding a custom role keeps it as "(custom)".
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/OrganizationRolesController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/OrganizationRoles/*.cs` | Get, create, update, delete |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Organization/{OrganizationRolesPage,OrganizationRolesTable,RoleForm}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/organizationRole.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/organizationRoles.ts` | Admin UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/RoleSelect.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/organization.helper.ts` (`builtInRolesFor`, `findBuiltInRole`, `roleNeedsBrandIds`) | Web role choice |

- **Data:** `Organization.Roles`, `Organization.RolePermissions`. `OrganizationRoleDto { id, key, name, organizationType, hasFullBrandAccess, isSystem, permissions[], members }`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/organizationroles` | `MustHavePermission(View, OrganizationRoles, Platform)` | `GetOrganizationRolesRequest { organizationType? }` / `List<OrganizationRoleDto>` | `GetOrganizationRolesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/organizationroles` | `MustHavePermission(Update, OrganizationRoles, Platform)` | `CreateOrganizationRoleRequest { name, organizationType, hasFullBrandAccess, permissions[] }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateOrganizationRoleRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/organizationroles/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, OrganizationRoles, Platform)` | `UpdateOrganizationRoleRequest { name, hasFullBrandAccess, permissions[] }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateOrganizationRoleRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/organizationroles/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, OrganizationRoles, Platform)` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `DeleteOrganizationRoleRequestHandler` |

  Audit actions: `role.created`, `role.updated`, `role.deleted` (no organization id).
- **Business rules:**
  - Key derived from the name (lowercase, non-alphanumerics to `-`), unique among non-deleted roles; duplicate is 409 "A role named X already exists.".
  - Permissions must be in `OrgPermissions.All`.
  - Built-in roles (`IsSystem`) cannot be updated or deleted (400 "Built-in roles can't be changed.").
  - Update replaces the permission set; removing `member.update` is refused when an organization would be left with no active member manager (lists up to 5 names).
  - Turning `HasFullBrandAccess` off inserts explicit Full `BrandAccess` rows for every holder (own organization row plus every non-ended connected brand), so holders keep what they saw.
  - Update bumps the access version of every organization with a holder. Organization type cannot be changed after creation (not in the update request).
  - Delete is refused (409) while any membership or pending invitation uses the role; soft delete.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.6 (memberships), 2.2.1 seeder.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 404 "Role not found.".
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/OrganizationRoles/OrganizationRoleRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Renaming a custom role does not change its key. There is no company-readable roles endpoint, so web role IDs are hard-coded in `BUILT_IN_ROLES`. Creating a custom role grants nothing until a Platform Admin or company admin assigns it, and companies can only assign it indirectly (approve/invite take a `roleId`, but the web UI lists built-in roles only).

#### 2.2.6 Feature: Members

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Lists the people in an organization and lets holders of the matching permission change a member's role, suspend or reactivate, and remove them from the organization (the account stays). Platform Admins see every organization's memberships, or one person's memberships across organizations.
- **User flow:**
  1. Web `/company/members` (`member.view`): search, status and role filters, paged list; row kebab offers Change role (`member.update`), Suspend/Reactivate (`member.suspend`), Remove (`member.remove`), Brand access (`access.manage`); the caller's own row has no actions (`memberActions` in `caboodle.web/src/components/company/memberAccess.helpers.ts`).
  2. Change role: a brokerage moving someone to the restricted `broker` role must choose brands (`ChangeRoleModal`, `buildRoleChangeBody`; `[]` means company access only).
  3. Suspend and Remove confirm in a modal; the server's "last manager" refusal is shown verbatim (`isLastManagerRefusal`).
  4. Admin `/members` lists all memberships; `/members/[userId]` shows one person with tabs Brand access, Invitations, Activity (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Membership/MemberDetail.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/MembersController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Members/{GetMembersRequest,UpdateMemberRoleRequest,UpdateMemberStatusRequest,RemoveMemberRequest}.cs` | Handlers |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/MembershipWriter.cs` | `AddAsync` (insert or reactivate), `SetBrandsAsync`, `RemoveAsync`, `RequireAnotherManagerAsync`, `RequireConnectedBrandsAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/OrganizationGuard.cs` | `RequireMemberOf`, `RequireNotSelf`, `RequireRoleFor`, `ListScope` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/{MembersTable,ChangeRoleModal,PersonCell,BrandChecklist}.tsx` | Web UI |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Membership/{MembersTable,MemberDetail,ChangeMemberRole,ConnectedBrandsSelect,MembershipTags}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/member.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/members.ts` | Admin UI |

- **Data:** `Organization.Memberships`, `Organization.BrandAccess`. `MemberDto { id, organizationId, organizationName, userId, firstName, lastName, email, roleId, roleKey, roleName, hasFullBrandAccess, status, source, brands, createdOn }` (`brands` counts non-company access rows).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/members` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.view)` | `GetMembersRequest { search?, status?, roleId?, userId? (platform only), pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<MemberDto>` | `GetMembersRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/members/{id}/role` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.update)` | `UpdateMemberRoleRequest { roleId, brandIds? }` (web `IUpdateMemberRoleRequest`) / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateMemberRoleRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/members/{id}/status` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.suspend)` | `UpdateMemberStatusRequest { status }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateMemberStatusRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/members/{id}` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.remove)` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `RemoveMemberRequestHandler` |

  `{id}` is the membership ID. Audit: `member.role_changed`, `member.status_changed`, `member.removed`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Writes act only on memberships of the selected organization (404 "Member not found." otherwise) and never on the caller ("You can't ... yourself.").
  - "Q7": the organization must keep at least one other Active member whose role has `member.update`; checked when moving a manager to a role without it, suspending a manager, or removing a manager. Rows are locked `FOR UPDATE`.
  - Role must belong to the organization's type. Moving to a restricted role: Brand organizations get their own brand; Brokerages must send `brandIds` (all connected, non-ended), which replaces the member's brand rows. Moving to a full-access role leaves brand rows untouched.
  - Suspension resets the member's cache; removal soft-deletes the membership and all its `BrandAccess` rows.
  - Platform list without `OrganizationID` returns every organization, and `userId` filters by person; with an organization selected `userId` is ignored.
- **Dependencies:** Identity users (names, emails), 2.2.11 brand access, 2.2.10 connections.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 400 `BrandIds` "Choose the brands this person can work on." for a brokerage restricted role without brands; 400 "Every brand must be connected to this brokerage.".
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Members/MemberRequestTests.cs`, `Helper/WriterTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/MembersTable.test.tsx`, `ChangeRoleModal.test.tsx`, `memberAccess.helpers.test.ts`, `PersonCell.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Brand rows that survive a role change keep their mode and module grants (`OrganizationSql.GrantBrands` uses `ON CONFLICT ... DO NOTHING`), so a Custom setting made earlier applies again when a member returns to a restricted role. Moving to a full-access role never deletes brand rows.

##### 2.2.6.1 Sub-feature: Platform brand membership routes (legacy URLs)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `PUT /api/v1/brands/assign-user-to-brand` (`MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)`, `AddBrandMemberRequest { parentBrokerID?, userID, brandID, roleID? }`) makes a person a member of the brand's organization; `DELETE /api/v1/brands/remove-owner-from-brand` (`RemoveBrandMemberRequest { brandID, userID }`) removes them with the same rules as `DELETE /members/{id}`. Handlers live in `Modules.Organization.Application/Members/AddBrandMemberRequest.cs` and `RemoveBrandMemberRequest.cs`; routes are in `BrandsController`.
- **Business rules:** The user must exist, be active and have a confirmed email; anyone with a brokerage membership, or a request with `parentBrokerID`, is refused ("This person can't be added to a brand."). Without `roleID` the first member becomes Brand Admin and later ones Brand Member. Source `PlatformAdmin`, audit `member.added` / `member.removed` with support access.

##### 2.2.6.2 Sub-feature: Account deletion guard

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `UserAccountDeletion` (`Modules.Organization.Application/Users/UserAccountDeletion.cs`, registered as `IUserAccountDeletion`) deletes accounts only when they belong to no organization; it cancels pending access requests, deletes verification codes, clears legacy links and deletes the accounts in one transaction with a `user.deleted` audit event per account. Used by `RemoveUnassignedUsersRequest` (`DELETE /api/v1/users/delete`) and `UserService`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 409 when deleting yourself, a Platform Admin, or someone still in a company ("Remove X from Y first (Members)."); 404 when any ID is unknown; the whole batch is refused if one account is.

#### 2.2.7 Feature: Invitations

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Holders of `member.invite` invite a person by email with a role (and, for a brokerage restricted role, brands). The person receives an email with a link valid for 7 days; an existing account accepts it while signed in, a new person registers through the sign-up page with the token as verification code. Pending invitations can be resent (new token) or cancelled.
- **User flow:**
  1. Web `/company/invitations` or the Members screen: Invite member (email, role, brands for a brokerage `broker` role) (`InviteMemberModal`, `buildInvitationBody`).
  2. Server stores the invitation and sends the email after commit; the response says whether the email was sent (`emailSent`).
  3. Email link: `{AppUrls:BaseUrl}/signup?code={token}&email={email}` (`InvitationMailer.Link`).
  4. Signed-out person: sign-up form registers with `hasInvited` and `verificationCode` (2.2.7.1). Signed-in person: `caboodle.web/src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx` redirects `/signup?code=<guid>` to `/invitations/[token]`, which shows the anonymous preview and an Accept button (`AcceptInvitation.tsx`).
  5. Accept joins the organization, selects it and lands on its home route.
  6. Invitations list: Resend and Cancel are offered only for status Pending (`canActOnInvitation`); an expired pending one shows as expired (`isExpired`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/InvitationsController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Invitations/*.cs` | Create, list, resend, cancel, preview, accept, invited registration |

| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/{InvitationsTable,InviteMemberModal}.tsx`, `invitationFlows.helpers.ts` | Web company UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/onboarding/AcceptInvitation.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/Auth/InvitationPreviewCard.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(onboarding)/invitations/[token]/page.tsx` | Acceptance UI |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Membership/{InvitationsTable,InviteMember}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/invitation.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/invitations.ts` | Admin UI (support mode, `OrganizationID` header) |

- **Data:** `Organization.Invitations`. `InvitationDto { id, organizationId, organizationName, email, roleId, roleName, status, isExpired, expiresOn, brandOrganizationIds[], invitedByEmail, createdOn }`; `InvitationSentDto { id, expiresOn, emailSent }`; `InvitationPreviewDto { organizationName, organizationType, roleName, maskedEmail, expiresOn }` (web `IInvitation`, `IInvitationSent`, `IInvitationPreview`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.invite)` | `GetInvitationsRequest { status?, email?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<InvitationDto>` | `GetInvitationsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.invite)` | `CreateInvitationRequest { email, roleId, brandIds[] }` (web `ICreateInvitationRequest`) / `InvitationSentDto` | `CreateInvitationRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations/{id}/resend` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.invite)` | / `InvitationSentDto` | `ResendInvitationRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/invitations/{id}` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.invite)` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CancelInvitationRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/invitations/{token}` | `AllowAnonymous` | / `InvitationPreviewDto` | `GetInvitationByTokenRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/invitations/{token}/accept` | `Authorize` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` (`id` = organization joined) | `AcceptInvitationRequestHandler` |

  Audit: `invitation.created` (masked email in metadata), `invitation.resent`, `invitation.cancelled`, `invitation.accepted`. Email: organization invitation, sent after commit.
- **Business rules:**
  - Email trimmed and lowercased; role must match the organization's type; brand IDs must be connected (non-ended) brokerage brands, and a Brand organization may not send any.
  - 409 when the email already belongs to a member (active or suspended) or has a live pending invitation ("Resend it instead."); an expired pending invitation is closed as Expired and replaced.
  - Token: random GUID, stored as SHA-256 hex; lifetime 7 days. Resend issues a new token and expiry (old link stops working). Resend and cancel need status Pending (400 "This invitation is ...").
  - Preview answers 404 for unknown, expired, cancelled, accepted or suspended-organization invitations and masks the email (`a***@domain`).
  - Accept requires the signed-in email to equal the invitation email; specific 400 messages for accepted, cancelled, expired, suspended organization, other email. It creates or reactivates the membership with the invitation's role; brokerage brands are filtered to those still connected; a Brand organization member gets the brand at Full. The invitation becomes Accepted and the user's cache is reset.
  - "Invited by" in the email is the inviter's name and company, or "Caboodle" for support access (create); resend always uses the organization name.
- **Dependencies:** SMTP mail, `AppUrls:BaseUrl` config, 2.2.6 `MembershipWriter`, Auth sign-up page and registration endpoint.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A mail failure never rolls back; `emailSent: false` is returned and logged. A role in use by a pending invitation cannot be deleted (2.2.5).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Invitations/InvitationRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/InvitationsTable.test.tsx`, `InviteMemberModal.test.tsx`, `invitationFlows.helpers.test.ts`, `components/onboarding/AcceptInvitation.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The status column stays Pending after `ExpiresOn`; only `IsExpired` (computed) and a replacement invitation mark expiry. Resending an expired pending invitation revives it.
  - The two 409s share one message key and are told apart by text in the web (`describeInvitationConflict`).
  - Accepting can reactivate a suspended membership if the invitation was created before the suspension (create refuses existing members, accept does not re-check suspension, `MembershipWriter.AddAsync` reactivates).

##### 2.2.7.1 Sub-feature: Invited registration

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `POST /api/v1/registration` (`RegistrationController`, `AllowAnonymous`) with `hasInvited` and `verificationCode` first tries `RegisterInvitedUserRequest`: the code is looked up by token hash in `Organization.Invitations` (new invitations and legacy codes migrated by the backfill). If found and usable for that email, the account is created verified (`IUserService.CreateVerifiedUserAsync`) and the invitation is accepted in a transaction that also deletes the legacy `Identity.InvitedUsers` row. If not found, the controller falls back to the legacy `CreateInvitedUserAsync`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** The account is created before the join; if the join fails the person can log in and accept with `POST /invitations/{token}/accept`.

#### 2.2.8 Feature: Access requests

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A signed-in person whose email domain belongs to a company (found through discover, 2.2.15) asks to join it; holders of `member.approve` approve with a role (and brands for a brokerage restricted role) or reject. Approval creates or reactivates the membership.
- **User flow:**
  1. Onboarding hub "Ask to join" calls `POST /accessrequests` without `OrganizationID`.
  2. Company admins see a pending count badge on the "Access requests" tab and the list at `/company/access-requests` (`AccessRequestsTable`).
  3. Approve opens `ApproveRequestModal` (role, brands when needed; `buildApprovalBody` always sends `roleId`); Reject confirms.
  4. The requester is not notified; they learn the outcome by re-reading discover and `/me/access` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/onboarding.ts` comment).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/AccessRequestsController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/AccessRequests/*.cs` | Create, list, decide |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/{AccessRequestsTable,ApproveRequestModal}.tsx` | Web company UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/onboarding.service.ts` (`requestAccess`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/onboarding.ts` (`useRequestAccess`) | Web request |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Membership/{AccessRequestsTable,ApproveAccessRequest}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/accessRequest.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/accessRequests.ts` | Admin UI |

- **Data:** `Organization.AccessRequests`. `AccessRequestDto { id, organizationId, organizationName, userId, firstName, lastName, email, status, roleName, createdOn, decidedOn }` (web `IAccessRequest`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/accessrequests` | `Authorize` | `CreateAccessRequestRequest { organizationId }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateAccessRequestRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/accessrequests` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.approve)` | `GetAccessRequestsRequest { status?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<AccessRequestDto>` | `GetAccessRequestsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/accessrequests/{id}/approve` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.approve)` | `DecideAccessRequestRequest { roleId, brandIds[] }` (web `IDecideAccessRequestRequest`) / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `DecideAccessRequestRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/accessrequests/{id}/reject` | `RequireOrgPermission(member.approve)` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `DecideAccessRequestRequestHandler` (`Approve = false`) |

  Audit: `access_request.created`, `access_request.approved`, `access_request.rejected`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Policy gate (`RequireAllowedAsync`): organization must be Active (400); already a member (any status) is 409; `InviteOnly` is 403 "This organization only accepts people by invitation."; `DomainMatch` requires the caller's email domain to be one of the organization's domains (403); `Anyone` allows any caller.
  - One pending request per (organization, user) by a filtered unique index; a second is 409.
  - Approve requires `roleId` (validator), a role of the organization's type, and connected brands; the user's cache is reset and the organization version bumped. Decisions only on Pending requests of the selected organization (404 "Pending request not found.").
  - List order: status, then newest first; a Platform Admin without `OrganizationID` sees all organizations.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.9 domains (DomainMatch), 2.2.6 `MembershipWriter`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Rejection stores no role. Request creation sends no email to admins (no mail call in `CreateAccessRequestRequestHandler`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/AccessRequests/AccessRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/AccessRequestsTable.test.tsx`, `ApproveRequestModal.test.tsx`, `service/onboarding.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Pending requests of a user are cancelled only when the account is deleted (`UserAccountSql.CancelPendingAccessRequests`); there is no way for the requester to withdraw a request.

#### 2.2.9 Feature: Email domains

- **Status:** Partial (domain verification values are generated and stored, but no endpoint checks DNS and `VerifiedOn` is never written; comment in `AddDomainRequestHandler`: "No DNS lookup yet")
- **What it does:** An organization owns one or more email domains, one of them primary. Domains drive discovery (2.2.15) and the DomainMatch membership policy (2.2.8). Company admins can add only their own email domain; Platform Admins can add any claimable domain.
- **User flow:**

#### 2.2.10 Feature: Brand connections (brokerage to brand)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A connection links one Brokerage to one Brand; a brand may connect to several brokerages. Only Platform Admins create, suspend, resume, change the region of, or end connections. An Active connection lets the brokerage's members work on the brand (subject to their brand access) and lends the brokerage the brand's modules on that brand. Companies see their connections read-only (2.2.10.1).
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/brand-connections`: filter by brokerage, brand, status; Connect brand (brokerage, brand, optional region); Change region; Suspend/Resume; End.
  2. Admin organization detail, tab Connections, shows the same table for one organization.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/BrandConnectionsController.cs` | Platform routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/BrandConnections/{Get,Create,Update,End}BrandConnection*.cs` | Handlers; `UpdateBrandConnectionRequestHandler.ChangeAsync` shared by update and end |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Organization/{BrandConnectionsTable,ConnectBrand,ChangeConnectionRegion}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/brandConnection.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brandConnections.ts` | Admin UI |

- **Data:** `Organization.BrandConnections`. `BrandConnectionDto { id, brokerageOrganizationId, brokerageName, brandOrganizationId, brandName, status, source, regionId, regionName, createdOn, endedOn }` (region from `CRM.Regions`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brandconnections` | `MustHavePermission(View, BrandConnections, Platform)` | `GetBrandConnectionsRequest { brokerageId?, brandId?, status?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<BrandConnectionDto>` | `GetBrandConnectionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brandconnections` | `MustHavePermission(Update, BrandConnections, Platform)` | `CreateBrandConnectionRequest { brokerageOrganizationId, brandOrganizationId, regionId? }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateBrandConnectionRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/brandconnections/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, BrandConnections, Platform)` | `UpdateBrandConnectionRequest { status (Active or Suspended), regionId? }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateBrandConnectionRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brandconnections/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, BrandConnections, Platform)` | / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `EndBrandConnectionRequestHandler` |

  Audit: `connection.created`, `connection.status_changed`, `connection.region_changed` (organization id = the brand). Both organizations' access versions are bumped.
- **Business rules:**
  - Types are checked (brokerage must be Brokerage, brand must be Brand); region must exist; only one non-ended connection per pair (409 "These organizations are already connected."). Source is `PlatformAdmin` (5 Backfill and 10 Inferred come from the backfill).
  - PUT writes both fields: an omitted `regionId` clears the region. Status 15 (Ended) is refused on PUT ("To end a connection, delete it.").
  - Ending sets `EndedOn`, keeps the region, and soft-deletes every `BrandAccess` row of the brokerage's members for that brand; an ended connection cannot be changed (400, "Create a new connection instead.").
  - Only Active connections grant access (`AccessResolver`); Suspended connections still count as "connected" for brand pickers and validation (`OrganizationSql.ConnectedBrandIds` excludes only Ended), so suspended brands keep their brand access rows.
- **Dependencies:** CRM regions; 2.2.11 brand access; legacy records stamped by `StampBrokerageOwner` use Active connections to pick the owning brokerage.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 404 "Connection not found.".
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/BrandConnections/BrandConnectionRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Ending a connection does not touch brokerage-owned records (`BrokerageOrganizationID`) of that brand; it only removes access.

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `GET /api/v1/connections` (`RequireOrgPermission(connection.view)`, `GetConnectionsRequestHandler`, response `List<ConnectedOrganizationDto>`) returns the other side of every non-ended connection of the selected organization with `connectionStatus`. For a Brand organization each brokerage also lists its Active members who can work on this brand (full-access role, or a brand access row on it) as `ConnectedMemberDto { userId, firstName, lastName, email, roleName }` (comment D5).

#### 2.2.11 Feature: Brand access (per-member brands and module actions)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Holders of `access.manage` choose which connected brands a restricted member (role without full brand access) can work on, and for each brand row, plus a brokerage member's company access row, set Full access or Custom access with a module by action matrix. Admin roles cannot be restricted.

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brandaccess?membershipId=` | `RequireOrgPermission(access.manage)` | `GetBrandAccessRequest { membershipId }` / `List<BrandAccessDto>` (company row first) | `GetBrandAccessRequestHandler` |

  - `PUT .../brands` is the full list: brands not sent are soft-deleted, brands kept keep their mode and modules, new brands start at Full; the company access row is never removed by this call. A Brand organization may send only its own brand; a Brokerage only connected (non-ended) brands. Admin roles answer 400 "This role always has access to every brand and module, so it can't be restricted.".
  - `PUT .../modules`: `{id}` is the access row ID (not the membership). Full takes no module list (validator). Custom: each slug once, actions among view, create, update, delete, import, export; each slug must be a module the organization has enabled (Brand audience for a Brand company, Broker audience for a Brokerage); a brokerage member's row on a connected brand may also take that brand's enabled Brand-audience modules, with the brokerage's own module winning on a shared slug; actions outside `AvailableActions` are refused. Module rows are deleted and re-inserted.

- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The web editor's module ceiling is the editing admin's own access, one map for all rows: `company.modules` for a Brokerage, `brands[0].modules` for a Brand company (`moduleCeiling`, comment "no company-facing catalog endpoint"). So brand modules a brokerage inherits on a connected brand (allowed by the backend) cannot be granted from the web editor.
  - Suspended connections stay in the brand list the web sends, because the PUT removes every brand not sent (`buildBrandChoices` comment, owner decision D7).

#### 2.2.12 Feature: Module catalog and assignments

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Platform Admins maintain the module catalog (two audiences, Brand and Broker, as trees with dependencies and available actions) and switch modules on or off per organization. A module enabled for an organization (a `ModuleAssignment` with `IsEnabled`) is what every member's access is built from (2.2.1). caboodle.web never calls these routes (`caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts` header comment).
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/module-configuration` tab Module Catalog (`ModuleCatalog.tsx`, `AddModule.tsx`): tree per audience, add, rename, change available actions, delete (with force).
  2. Tab Module Assignments (`ModuleAssignment.tsx`): pick an organization, tick modules, Preview shows auto-enabled modules and conflicts (`AssignmentPreviewModal.tsx`), Apply shows per-organization success or failure (`AssignmentResultModal.tsx`). The same component is the Modules tab of the organization detail page.
  3. Tab Platform Operations (`PlatformOperations.tsx`): seed catalog, Retail APL backfill, organization backfill runs (2.2.17).
