| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Configuration/{ModuleConfiguration,ModuleCatalog,AddModule,ModuleAssignment,AssignmentPreviewModal,AssignmentResultModal,PlatformOperations}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/configuration.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/configuration.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/interface/configuration.interface.ts` | Admin UI |

- **Data:** `Configuration.Modules`, `ModuleDependencies`, `ModuleAssignments` (`OrganizationID` generated from `BrandId`/`BrokerId`), `ModuleAssignmentHistories`. Seed catalog: Brand roots `dashboard`, `product-spec`, `distributors`, `retailers`, `regions`, `contacts`, `pipelines`, `promotion-planning`, `files`, `reports`, `enhanced-reporting`, `data-upload-reporting`, `ai` with children; Broker roots `market-overview`, `promotional-management` (`-notes`, `-events`), `category-review-group` (`category-review`, `category-review-calendar`, `brand-report`), `distributor-apl`, `files`, `retail-apl`, `ask-caboodle`, and Broker copies of `product-spec`, `regions`, `retailers`, `distributors`, `approved-promotions`, `trade-spend-sandbox` (`ModuleCatalogSeedData`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/configurations/modules?audience=` | `MustHavePermission(View, Modules, Configuration)` | / `List<ConfigurationModuleDto>` | `GetConfigurationModulesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/modules` | `MustHavePermission(Create, Modules, Configuration)` | `CreateConfigurationModuleRequest { slug, displayName, description?, parentModuleId?, audience, sortOrder, isActive, availableActions }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `CreateConfigurationModuleRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/configurations/modules/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, Modules, Configuration)` | `UpdateConfigurationModuleRequest { displayName, description?, availableActions? }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `UpdateConfigurationModuleRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/configurations/modules` | `MustHavePermission(Delete, Modules, Configuration)` | `DeleteConfigurationModulesRequest { moduleIds[], forceDelete }` (body) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteConfigurationModulesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/modules/seed` | `MustHavePermission(Execute, Modules, Configuration)` | / `SeedModulesResponseDto` | `SeedConfigurationModulesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/module-assignments/preview` | `MustHavePermission(View, ModuleAssignments, Configuration)` | `PreviewModuleAssignmentsRequest { organizationId? or brandIds?/brokerIds?, modules: [{ slug, enabled }] }` / `PreviewModuleAssignmentsResponseDto` | `PreviewModuleAssignmentsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/module-assignments/apply` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, ModuleAssignments, Configuration)` | `ApplyModuleAssignmentsRequest` (same shape) / `ApplyModuleAssignmentsResponseDto { modules, succeeded[], failed[] }` | `ApplyModuleAssignmentsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/module-assignments/details` | `MustHavePermission(View, ModuleAssignments, Configuration)` | `GetModuleAssignmentDetailsRequest { organizationId? or brandIds?/brokerIds?, audience? }` / `ModuleAssignmentDetailsResponseDto` | `GetModuleAssignmentDetailsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/module-assignments/backfill-all` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, ModuleAssignments, Configuration)` | / `BackfillAllModuleAssignmentsResponseDto` | `BackfillAllModuleAssignmentsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/configurations/module-assignments/backfill-retail-apl` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, ModuleAssignments, Configuration)` | / `BackfillRetailAplModuleResponseDto` | `BackfillRetailAplModuleRequestHandler` |

  Audit: `entitlement.updated` per organization (enabled, disabled, auto-enabled slugs) for apply and both backfills.
- **Business rules:**
  - Create: slug lowercased and unique per audience; parent must exist and share the audience; depth = parent depth + 1; `availableActions` must be a non-empty subset of All. Update changes only display name, description and available actions.
  - Delete: children and modules that depend on a deleted module must be in the delete set; modules with assignments are blocked unless `forceDelete`, which soft-deletes the assignments (with history rows) first; dependencies and modules are then soft-deleted in one transaction.
  - Seed: idempotent upsert of the seed tree and dependencies; never overwrites display name or description of an existing module.
  - Targets: either `organizationId` alone, or `brandIds` or `brokerIds` (not both, not neither); legacy brand and broker IDs are organization IDs of that type.
  - Apply per target, each in its own transaction (partial success): enabling expands AutoEnable dependencies; Required and OptionalDataSource dependencies must already be enabled or in the set (`MissingDependency`); inactive modules or dependencies conflict; disabling is blocked while an enabled module depends on it or a child is still enabled (`DependentStillEnabled`). Writes insert or flip `IsEnabled` and add history rows; succeeded organizations get their access version bumped.
  - Retail APL backfill: every brokerage with Distributor APL gets Retail APL and Custom members keep the same actions; a brokerage with any Retail APL assignment is skipped (file comment).
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.2 access versioning, IAM audit.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Apply failures carry codes `InvalidTarget`, `DependencyConflict` (with details), `ApplyFailed`. Unknown or wrong-audience slugs are 400 for the whole request.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Admin.Application.Test/Configuration/*.cs` (apply, backfill-all, backfill-retail-apl, delete, get, dependency, organization targets, validators, service, seed data, update); `EndpointAuthorizationCoverageTests.EveryModuleSlugExistsInTheCatalog`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `backfill-all` gives every organization every active module of its audience; caboodle.admin deliberately does not wrap it ("must never be called (launch runbook)" in `caboodle.admin/src/services/configuration.service.ts`). It is reachable through the API only.
  - Catalog create, update and delete do not bump access versions (2.2.2.2).
  - `ModuleAssignmentHistory` still records `BrandId`/`BrokerId`, not `OrganizationID`.

#### 2.2.13 Feature: Module settings and limits

- **Status:** Partial (all platform setting endpoints exist but caboodle.admin has no screen for them: no `modulesettings` reference under `caboodle.admin/src`; the web Company area shows the organization's settings read-only)
- **What it does:** Each module can declare settings (limits and options) with a default; Platform Admins can change a setting's rules for everyone or set values per organization. Feature modules read the value that applies through `IModuleSettings` and refuse requests that exceed it; quota-type limits answer 409 `LimitReachedException`. Company admins (`organization.update`) see what applies to them as sentences with a tone.
- **User flow:**
  1. Platform: `POST /modulesettings/definitions/backfill` inserts definitions from `ModuleSettingCatalogSeedData`.
  2. Platform: edit a definition, or save values for one organization or several at once; history per organization.
  3. Web `/company/module-settings`: `ModuleSettingsPanel` lists enabled modules (child shown as "Parent > Child") with each setting's sentence and tone label (open, limited, blocked); `modules: []` shows "None of your enabled modules has settings.".
  4. Users of the limited modules see a 409 toast "Limit reached" (`showErrorNotification`, `isLimitReached`) or a 400 validation message.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Admin/ModuleSettingsController.cs` | Routes (`api/v1/modulesettings`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/Configuration/ModuleSettings/{Definitions,Organizations,MyOrganization,Seeding,Helper}/*.cs` | Handlers, queries, checks, writer, views, seed catalog |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Settings/ModuleSettingsService.cs`, `ModuleSettingsVersion.cs` | Value that applies; cache keyed by settings versions |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Settings/{IModuleSettings,SettingSentenceBuilder}.cs` | Read API; sentence and tone (`SettingTone`: open, limited, blocked) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Settings/ModuleSettingKeys.cs` | Setting key constants |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Settings/QuotaGuard.cs`, `PromotionPoolCounter.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Settings/{IQuotaGuard,PromotionQuota}.cs` | Quota enforcement |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Error/ErrorHelper.cs` (`ThrowLimitReachedException`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/ExceptionMiddleware.cs` | 409 with type `LimitReachedException`, key `Limit` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/ModuleSettingsPanel.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/service/organization.service.ts` (`getMyOrganizationModuleSettings`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/organization.ts` (`useMyOrganizationModuleSettings`) | Web read-only page |

- **Data:** `Configuration.ModuleSettingDefinitions`, `Configuration.ModuleSettingValues` (JSON values; `Note`). Seeded settings (key, module, default):

| Module (audience) | Key | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `promotion-planning` (Brand) | `max-promotions-per-user`, `max-promotions-per-brand` | no limit |
| `trade-spend-sandbox` (Brand) | `max-versions-per-family` | 5 (1 to 20) |
| `data-upload-reporting` (Brand) | `max-file-size-mb` | no limit |
| `promotional-management-notes` (Broker) | `max-columns-per-tab` | 20 (12 to 100) |
| `files` (Brand and Broker, separate copies) | `allow-never-expiring-links` (true), `default-share-link-expiry` ("never"), `share-link-max-expiry-days` (3650), `max-upload-size-mb` (no limit), `allowed-file-types` (no limit), `storage-quota-gb` (no limit) | as listed |

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/modulesettings/definitions` | `MustHavePermission(View, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | `GetModuleSettingDefinitionsRequest { moduleId?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<ModuleSettingDefinitionDto>` | `GetModuleSettingDefinitionsRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/modulesettings/definitions/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | `UpdateModuleSettingDefinitionRequest { label?, description?, summary?, summaryWhenOff?, defaultValue, minValue?, maxValue?, unit?, options? }` / `ModuleSettingSaveResponseDto` | `UpdateModuleSettingDefinitionRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/modulesettings/definitions/{id}/organizations` | `MustHavePermission(Update, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | `SetModuleSettingForOrganizationsRequest { organizationIds[], value, useDefault }` / `ModuleSettingSaveResponseDto` | `SetModuleSettingForOrganizationsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/modulesettings/definitions/backfill` | `MustHavePermission(Execute, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | / `BackfillModuleSettingsResponseDto` | `BackfillModuleSettingDefinitionsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/modulesettings/my-organization` | `RequireOrgPermission(organization.update)` | / `MyOrganizationModuleSettingsDto { organizationId, organizationName, modules: [{ slug, displayName, parentSlug, parentDisplayName, settings: [{ key, label, sentence, tone }] }] }` (web `IMyOrganizationModuleSettings`) | `GetMyOrganizationModuleSettingsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/modulesettings/organizations/{organizationId}` | `MustHavePermission(View, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | / `OrganizationModuleSettingsDto` | `GetOrganizationModuleSettingsRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/modulesettings/organizations/{organizationId}` | `MustHavePermission(Update, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | `SaveOrganizationModuleSettingsRequest { settings: [{ definitionId, value, useDefault, note? }] }` / `ModuleSettingSaveResponseDto` | `SaveOrganizationModuleSettingsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/modulesettings/organizations/{organizationId}/history` | `MustHavePermission(View, ModuleSettings, Configuration)` | `GetOrganizationModuleSettingHistoryRequest { definitionId?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<ModuleSettingHistoryDto>` | `GetOrganizationModuleSettingHistoryRequestHandler` |

  Audit: `setting.updated`, `setting.reset`, `setting.definition_updated`, `quota.bypassed`. History reads these events from `Auditing.AuditEvents`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Value that applies = the organization's value, else the definition default, else unset; definitions of inactive modules or modules the organization has not enabled count as unset, and saved values are kept for later (`ModuleSettingsService` comment). A group module counts as enabled when one of its children is.
  - A brokerage's my-organization page shows only its own Broker-audience modules (handler comment); Promotion and Sandbox limits are read on the brand's organization ID, so they also apply to brokers working on that brand (`PromotionQuota` comment).
  - Saves are all or nothing; errors keyed `moduleSlug.key`; a value equal to the saved one, or a reset of a setting already at default, writes nothing; locks are taken in a fixed order to avoid deadlocks; the settings version is bumped only after commit (`ModuleSettingWriter`).
  - A definition edit is refused while any organization's saved value would break the new rules.
  - Backfill is insert-only: existing definitions are never changed, and a setting whose module is not in the catalog is skipped and listed.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.12 module assignments (enabled modules), IAM audit, cache.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `useDefault` removes the organization's value. A setting not applicable to the organization answers 400 "This setting doesn't apply to this organization." (`ModuleSettingValueCheck.DoesNotApply`); notes are limited to 500 characters.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Admin.Application.Test/Configuration/ModuleSettings/*.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Settings/{ModuleSettingsServiceTests,ModuleSettingsVersionTests,QuotaGuardTests}.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/ModuleSettingsPanel.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The platform half has no UI yet; `caboodle.web/module-settings-fe-guide/` describes the planned admin screens.

##### 2.2.13.1 Sub-feature: Quota limits (409 `LimitReachedException`)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `QuotaGuard.EnsureWithinLimitsAsync` answers early from cached limits; `RunAsync` takes a PostgreSQL advisory transaction lock per (pool, organization), re-reads the limits from the database, counts, and runs the create in the same transaction. Pools: `promotions` (`PromotionQuota`: per brand and per person, counted by `PromotionPoolCounter`; used by the TradeSpend and TradeSpendSandbox upsert, EDLP upsert and duplicate handlers and by `CreateSimplePromotionRequest`) and `file-storage` (`FileStorageQuota`, bytes, counted by `FileStorageCounter`, used by `FileUploadGuard`). With no limit set the original code path runs unchanged.
- **Business rules:** Reached when `count + amount > limit * unitSize`. Support access is never limited; going over writes one `quota.bypassed` audit event with the limits and counts.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Message examples: "This brand has reached its limit of N promotions. Contact Caboodle to raise it.", "There isn't enough storage space left for this file. ...".

##### 2.2.13.2 Sub-feature: Validation-type limits (400)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Other settings are read directly and refused with a 400 validation error: `max-versions-per-family` (`PromotionVersionLimit`, sandbox versions), `max-columns-per-tab` (`PromoTabColumnLimit`, broker Promo Tabs), `max-file-size-mb` (`DataUploadSizeGuard`/`DataUploadSizeLimit`, KeHE, UNFI, SPINS, Distributor Sales uploads), `max-upload-size-mb` and `allowed-file-types` (`FileUploadRules`), share link expiry rules (`FileShareLinkRules`). Owners of those modules document the call sites.

#### 2.2.14 Feature: Audit events and company activity

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Every IAM write, entitlement change, setting change, quota bypass, login, logout, account deletion and sign-up verification step is appended to `Auditing.AuditEvents` in the same transaction as the change. Platform Admins read the full log with filters; every member of a company sees the latest 20 events of their own company.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/audit-log` (`AuditLogTable.tsx`): filters by organization, actor, action, date range; the same table is the Activity tab on organization and member detail pages.
  2. Web `/company/activity` (`ActivityFeed.tsx`): events grouped by day with readable action labels (`AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS`, `humanizeAuditAction`, `humanizeTargetType` in `caboodle.web/src/helper/organization.helper.ts`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Identity/AuditEventsController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Audit/{GetAuditEventsRequest,GetOrganizationActivityFeedRequest}.cs` | Handlers |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auditing/IamAuditService.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Auditing/IIamAuditService.cs` | Writer (single and batch insert, metadata serialized camelCase) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Auditing/IamAuditActions.cs` | Action names |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/IamWriter.cs` | Audits each IAM change inside its transaction |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Audit/AuditLogTable.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/auditEvent.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/auditEvents.ts` | Admin UI (no `OrganizationID` header; organization is a filter) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/ActivityFeed.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/service/organization.service.ts` (`getActivityFeed`) | Web feed |

- **Data:** `Auditing.AuditEvents` (indexes on `(Action, OccurredOn)` and `(ActorUserId, OccurredOn)`). `AuditEventDto { id, occurredOn, actorUserId, actorEmail, action, organizationId, organizationName, targetType, targetId, isSupportAccess, ipAddress, metadata }`. Actions: `auth.login_succeeded|login_failed|logout`, `organization.created|updated|status_changed`, `connection.created|status_changed|region_changed`, `member.role_changed|status_changed|removed|added`, `invitation.created|resent|cancelled|accepted`, `brand_access.updated`, `role.created|updated|deleted`, `access_request.created|approved|rejected`, `domain.added|removed|primary_changed`, `entitlement.updated`, `setting.updated|reset|definition_updated`, `quota.bypassed`, `user.deleted`, `verification.sent|succeeded|failed|locked`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/auditevents` | `MustHavePermission(View, AuditEvents, Admin)` | `GetAuditEventsRequest { organizationId?, actorUserId?, action?, from?, to?, pageSize, currentPage }` / `PagedData<AuditEventDto>` | `GetAuditEventsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/auditevents/feed` | `Authorize` | / `List<AuditEventDto>` (latest 20, no `ipAddress`/`metadata`) | `GetOrganizationActivityFeedRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - The platform log is newest first; `action` is an exact match.
  - The feed needs a selected organization (403 "You are not a member of any organization." otherwise) and excludes `setting.*` and `quota.bypassed`, which stay platform-only (handler comment).
  - Writes through `IamWriter` take the actor from the current user unless the change names one (registration).
- **Dependencies:** Identity (actor emails), Organization names.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Events of deleted organizations still list (LEFT JOIN).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Audit/AuditEventRequestsTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Auditing/AuditLogServiceTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/ActivityFeed.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `IamWriter` never sets `IpAddress`, so organization events carry none; only `TokenService` login events pass an IP. The web gates the Activity tab on `organization.view` although the backend only needs a membership. A separate legacy audit trail (`Auditing.AuditTrails`, `AuditLogService`) exists for other modules.

#### 2.2.15 Feature: Onboarding (web)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A signed-in person with no company is sent to `/onboarding`, which finds the company owning their email domain and offers to ask to join it, or to create their own Brand or Brokerage company; signed-in people opening an invitation link accept it at `/invitations/[token]`; a Platform Admin with no company is sent to `/use-admin-app`.
- **User flow:**
  1. `AccessRedirectGuard` (in `AppContainer`) redirects a person whose `/me/access` lists no organization to `/onboarding`, and a Platform Admin with none to `/use-admin-app`.
  2. `OnboardingHub` redirects away when `/me/access` already resolves a landing route; otherwise calls discover and shows one state (`resolveOnboardingState`): `member` (Go to company), `suspended` (discover says member but `/me/access` does not list it), `pending`, `can-request` (Ask to join), `invite-only`, `personal-email`, `nothing-found`.
  3. Create company (`/onboarding/create-company`, `CreateCompanyForm`): name and type; on success selects the new company and goes to `/{id}/dashboard` (Brand) or `/dashboard` (Brokerage). A new company has no modules, so the app shows a waiting-for-setup state (`isWaitingForSetup`).
  4. Accept invitation (`AcceptInvitation`): preview, then Accept; on success selects the joined company and goes to its landing route.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(onboarding)/layout.tsx` | Client layout: redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`, own `QueryClient`, `OnboardingShell`, no app chrome |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(onboarding)/onboarding/page.tsx`, `onboarding/create-company/page.tsx`, `use-admin-app/page.tsx`, `invitations/[token]/page.tsx` | Routes |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/onboarding/{OnboardingHub,CreateCompanyForm,AcceptInvitation,UseAdminAppNotice,OnboardingShell}.tsx` | Screens |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/onboarding.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/onboarding.ts` | `discoverOrganizations`, `requestAccess`, `createOwnOrganization`, `getInvitationPreview`, `acceptInvitation` (all with `skipOrganizationHeader`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/onboarding.helper.ts` | `resolveOnboardingState`, `PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAINS`, `isPublicEmailDomain` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/AccessRedirectGuard.tsx` | Redirect to onboarding or admin notice |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/login.helper.ts` (`resolvePostLoginRoute`) | Route a signed-in invitation link to `/invitations/[token]` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Organizations/{DiscoverOrganizationsRequest,CreateOwnOrganizationRequest}.cs` | Backend discover and self-create |

- **Data:** `DiscoveredOrganizationDto { id, name, type, membershipPolicy, canRequestAccess, isMember, hasPendingRequest }` (web `IDiscoveredOrganization`); `CreateOwnOrganizationRequest { name, type }` (web `ICreateOwnOrganizationRequest`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** `GET /api/v1/organizations/discover` and `POST /api/v1/organizations/self` (listed in 2.2.4), `POST /api/v1/accessrequests` (2.2.8), `GET /api/v1/invitations/{token}` and `POST /api/v1/invitations/{token}/accept` (2.2.7).
- **Business rules:**
  - Discover matches only the caller's own email domain (no parameter, so other domains cannot be probed); public or reserved domains return `[]`; only Active organizations; `canRequestAccess` is false for InviteOnly; `isMember` counts suspended memberships too.
  - Self-create: the caller becomes Brand Admin or Brokerage Admin (source SelfService); the primary domain is the caller's email domain unless public or reserved (then none); a domain owned by another organization makes the whole call 409; audit metadata `SelfService = true`; the caller's cache is reset.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.2 `/me/access`, 2.2.4, 2.2.7, 2.2.8; NextAuth session.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Failed `/me/access` reads never trigger redirects. Request access failures surface the server text (403 invite-only or domain mismatch, 409 duplicate).
- **Tests:** web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/onboarding/{OnboardingHub,CreateCompanyForm,AcceptInvitation}.test.tsx`, `components/AccessRedirectGuard.test.tsx`, `helper/onboarding.helper.test.ts`, `service/onboarding.service.test.ts`; backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Organizations/OrganizationRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The backend invitation email links to `/signup?code=...&email=...`; `/invitations/[token]` is reached only through the auth layout redirect for a signed-in person or `?invite=` after login. Self-created companies start with no modules until a Platform Admin assigns them.

#### 2.2.16 Feature: Company area (web)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The `/company/*` routes let a company's own people manage it: overview and settings, members, invitations, access requests, domains, connections, activity and module settings. Each tab is shown only when the person holds its permission in the selected company; calls are scoped by `OrganizationID` only (no `BrandID`).
- **User flow:**
  1. The header and side rail show a Company link gated on `organization.view` (`caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts` `permission: ORG_PERMISSIONS.organizationView`).
  2. `CompanySectionLayout` renders the title band and tabs (`visibleCompanyTabs`), with pending counts on Invitations (`member.invite`) and Access requests (`member.approve`) read with `pageSize: 1`; without `organization.view` it redirects to the company's landing route.
  3. Each panel checks its own permission and renders an access-denied notice or skips its query when missing.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(company)/layout.tsx` | Server layout: `serverSessionCheck`, `AppContainer`, `AxiosInterceptor` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(company)/company/layout.tsx` | Wraps pages in `CompanySectionLayout` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(company)/company/{page,members/page,invitations/page,access-requests/page,domains/page,connections/page,activity/page,module-settings/page}.tsx` | Routes |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/company/*` | Panels, modals, drawer, `CompanyPanelHeader`, `PersonCell` |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/organization.helper.ts` | `COMPANY_TABS`, `visibleCompanyTabs`, `activeCompanyTabKey`, status labels and tones, `buildBrandChoices`, `moduleCeiling` |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/organization.ts` | Queries and named invalidation sets: `invalidateAfterMemberChange`, `invalidateAfterInvitationChange`, `invalidateAfterAccessRequestChange`, `invalidateAfterDomainChange`, `invalidateAfterOrganizationChange` |

- **Data:** Web types in `caboodle.web/src/models/organization.interface.ts` (integer enums matching the backend).
- **APIs/interfaces:** Tab to permission: Overview `organization.view` (2.2.4), Members `member.view` (2.2.6), Invitations `member.invite` (2.2.7), Access requests `member.approve` (2.2.8), Domains `domain.view` (2.2.9), Connections `connection.view` (2.2.10.1), Activity `organization.view` (2.2.14), Module settings `organization.update` (2.2.13).
- **Business rules:** Member and organization writes also invalidate `/me/access`; invitation, access request and domain writes refresh the activity feed.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.2 `useAccess`; shared UI (`SectionTabs`, `HeaderWithBack`, `StatusBadge`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Server 403s are shown as access-denied notices (`isAccessDenied`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/company/*.test.tsx`, `helper/organization.helper.test.ts`, `service/organization.service.test.ts`. No dedicated suite for `CompanySectionLayout`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Sub-pages are reachable by URL even when their tab is hidden; protection relies on each panel's own permission check and the server.

#### 2.2.17 Feature: Organization backfill

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A Platform Admin queues a Hangfire job that converts the legacy user, brand, broker and sub-user data into organizations, memberships, brand access, connections, domains and invitations (one SQL transaction), either as a dry run (ReportOnly, rolled back) or for real (Apply), or compares legacy access with the new engine (CompareAccess). Each run stores a JSON report.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/module-configuration`, tab Platform Operations, section organization backfill (`OrganizationBackfillRuns.tsx`): choose mode, confirm (Apply uses a danger button), queue.
  2. Runs list (newest first); open a run in `OrganizationBackfillRunDrawer.tsx` to read the report.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Admin/OrganizationBackfillController.cs` | Routes (`api/v1/organizationbackfill/runs`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Backfill/{TriggerOrganizationBackfillRequest,GetOrganizationBackfillRunRequest,GetOrganizationBackfillRunsRequest,OrganizationBackfillJobExecutor}.cs` | Trigger, read, Hangfire executor |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/OrganizationBackfillSql.cs`, `OrganizationBackfillReportSql.cs` | Ordered SQL steps (rules R1 to R10, P2, 3.4) and report queries |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Verification/AccessComparisonService.cs` | CompareAccess report (legacy vs engine, per user) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Settings/OrganizationBackfillSettings.cs` | `BrokerageMerges` (config `OrganizationBackfillSettings`) |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Configuration/{OrganizationBackfillRuns,OrganizationBackfillRunDrawer}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/organizationBackfill.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/organizationBackfill.ts` | Admin UI |

- **Data:** `DataLifecycle.OrganizationBackfillRuns`; `OrganizationBackfillRunDto { id, mode, status (Queued 5, Running 10, Completed 15, Failed 20), triggeredBy, createdOn, startedOn, completedOn, errorSummary, report (JSON) }`. Report (`OrganizationBackfillReport`): steps with rows affected and duration, totals, inferred connections, resolved bosses, orphans, brand organizations without admin, brokerage name suggestions, domains, record labels, unlabelled records, legacy invitations, organization ID collisions, duplicate brand-broker rows.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/organizationbackfill/runs` | `MustHavePermission(Execute, OrganizationBackfill, Admin)` | `TriggerOrganizationBackfillRequest { mode (5, 10, 15) }` / `ResponseMessageDTO` | `TriggerOrganizationBackfillRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/organizationbackfill/runs/{id}` | `MustHavePermission(View, OrganizationBackfill, Admin)` | / `OrganizationBackfillRunDto` (with report) | `GetOrganizationBackfillRunRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/organizationbackfill/runs` | `MustHavePermission(View, OrganizationBackfill, Admin)` | `GetOrganizationBackfillRunsRequest` (paged) / `PagedData<OrganizationBackfillRunDto>` (no reports) | `GetOrganizationBackfillRunsRequestHandler` |

  Background job: `IOrganizationBackfillJobExecutor.ExecuteAsync(runId)` enqueued through `IJobService.Enqueue`, `[DisableConcurrentExecution(3600)]`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Refused (400) while another run is Queued or Running and was created less than 2 hours ago.
  - Steps in order (`OrganizationBackfillSql.Steps` names): map broker accounts to brokerages; brand organizations; brokerage organizations; brand owners to Brand Admin; brand team members to Brand Member and their brand access; brokers to Brokerage Admin; broker team rows, team email domains, resolve the real boss; broker team members to Broker; brand connections; inferred connections; broker access to brands; brokerage company access (P2); brokerage domain candidates and domains; creators' brokerages; pending legacy invitations (R9, hashed codes); validate the brand to organization foreign key.
  - Apply commits the whole run; ReportOnly rolls it back so the report shows what Apply would do. A failure marks the run Failed with the exception message.
  - CompareAccess skips the SQL steps and reports differences such as `BrandMissing`, `BrandExtraViaInferredConnection`, `ModuleMissing`, `ModuleExtraLegacyMenuHadNoBrokerModules` per user (non-admin accounts).
- **Dependencies:** Hangfire, legacy Brand and Identity tables (`Brand.BrandBrokers` including `ParentBrokerID`, `Identity.InvitedUsers`; `AccessComparisonService` also reads `UserHierarchy`), `OrganizationSettings.ExcludedEmailDomains`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A run picked up in any status other than Queued is ignored by the executor.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Backfill/{TriggerOrganizationBackfillRequestTests,GetOrganizationBackfillRunsRequestTests,OrganizationBackfillJobExecutorTests,OrganizationBackfillSqlTests}.cs`, `Verification/AccessComparisonServiceTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The controller description mentions only ReportOnly and Apply; `CompareAccess = 15` is also accepted (`OrganizationBackfillMode`).
  - `appsettings.json` hard-codes one brokerage merge (two broker user IDs into "Yin Yang Naturals").
  - `origin/master` adds a sub-broker parent repair (`RepairSubBrokerParentsRequest`, CS-1791 and CS-XXXX) that re-points `Brand.BrandBrokers.ParentBrokerID` rows, which this backfill reads when it resolves the real boss (R6); this branch does not have it.

#### 2.2.18 Feature: Web-side gating

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The web predicts what the server will allow from the cached `/me/access` payload and hides or blocks what it would refuse: navigation entries, routes, buttons and sub-features. Gating is presentational only; the server enforces every rule again (2.2.3).
- **User flow:**
  1. `useModuleAccess` answers `hasModule`, `can(slug, action)`, `hasCompanyModule`, `anyBrandCan`; 53 non-test files use it (grep at time of writing).
  2. Navigation: `filterMenuItemsByModule` drops entries whose `moduleSlug` is not granted (a group survives when any child does); `companyLevel` entries use company access; `permission` entries (Company link) use org permissions (`HeaderComponent.tsx`, `AppSidebar.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts`).
  3. Routes: `ModuleRouteGuard` (around page content in `AppContainer`) maps the path to a gate and silently redirects to `/{brandID}/dashboard` or `/dashboard` when denied; when the landing route itself is denied it shows "This section is not available for your account.".
  4. JSX: `<ModuleGate slug=...>` renders the fallback while loading or when denied (2 non-test usages).
  5. Brand list: `useAccessibleBrands` maps `currentOrg.brands` to `IBrand`; `useAppBootstrap` seeds `useGlobalStore.brand` from the selected company.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/moduleAccess.ts` | `useModuleAccess` |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/moduleAccess.helper.ts` | `resolveModuleVisibility`, `resolveRouteModuleGate`, `filterMenuItemsByModule`, `resolveSelectedBrandId` |
| `caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts` | `MODULE_SLUGS`, `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`, `BROKER_ROUTE_MODULES`, `BROKER_COMPANY_LEVEL_ROUTES`, `DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS = false`, `ALLOW_ALL_WHEN_NO_MODULES = false` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/ModuleRouteGuard.tsx` | Route gate |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/ModuleGate.tsx` | JSX gate |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/brand.ts` | `useAccessibleBrands` (replaces `useGetAllBrandsForBroker`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useAppBootstrap.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/components/AppBootstrap.tsx` | Brand store seeding |
| `caboodle.web/src/helper/apiError.helper.ts` | Error envelope readers and predicates |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useApiErrorHandler.ts` | Stale company and no-company handling (no importer, see 2.2.18.1) |

- **Data:** `MODULE_SLUGS` mirrors `ModuleSlugs` (backend). Route maps: brand routes by first segment after `/[brandID]` (e.g. `promo-planning` and `simple-entries` to `approved-promotions`, `banner-report` to `trade-spend-roll-up`, `product-report` to `enhanced-reporting`); broker routes (e.g. `market-overview-report` to `market-overview`); company-level routes `file-repository` (`files`) and `category-review` (`category-review`). Ungated: `/profile`, `/apl-report`, `/apl-activity`, broker `/dashboard`, `/company/*`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** Reads only `GET /api/v1/me/access` (2.2.2).
- **Business rules:**
  - `resolveModuleVisibility`: a Brand company checks its own brand; a Brokerage on a brand route checks that brand; a Brokerage off a brand route passes when any brand grants it or company access does.
  - Every gate waits for `isLoading === false`; unknown slugs are denied (`DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS`); an empty module map is authoritative (no allow-all fallback).
  - Error predicates: `isUnauthorized` 401, `isAccessDenied` 403, `isOrganizationSelectionRequired` 400 key `OrganizationID`, `isStaleOrganization` 403 key `OrganizationID`, `isNoOrganization` 403 `Access` with the no-organization text, `isLimitReached` 409 key `Limit`, `isNotFound` 404; branch on status plus key, never on `type`.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2.2, NextAuth session.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A failed `/me/access` read leaves gates closed but triggers no redirect.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/moduleAccess.test.tsx`, `helper/moduleAccess.test.ts`, `helper/apiError.helper.test.ts`, `components/AccessRedirectGuard.test.tsx`. None found for `ModuleRouteGuard`, `ModuleGate` or `useApiErrorHandler`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The `MODULE_SLUGS` header comment still describes the old `/brands/me` slug-twin problem, which `/me/access` (per-brand modules) no longer has. Several brand route segments share a parent or sibling gate by convention rather than by catalog module (comments in `moduleConstants.ts`).

##### 2.2.18.1 Sub-feature: `useApiErrorHandler`

- **Status:** Deprecated (unreachable: no file outside the hook itself imports it, verified by grep in `caboodle.web/src`)
- **What it does:** Routes a 403 `OrganizationID` (stale company) to a `/me/access` refetch plus toast, a 403 no-organization to `/onboarding`, and everything else to `showErrorNotification` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/useApiErrorHandler.ts`).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Mutations call `showErrorNotification` directly, so a stale stored company recovers only through `useAccess` re-validating against the next `/me/access` read.

### 2.3 Module: Brands & Brokers

- **Purpose:** Owns the brand catalog (`Brand.Brands`), the platform-admin views of brand owners, brokers and legacy sub-users, the legacy brand-to-broker links (`Brand.BrandBrokers`), brand CSV import/export, and the brand recipient lookup used by broker email pickers. Since CS-1770 the organization model (2.2) is the source of truth for who belongs to a brand and which brokerage works on it; most of this module's link and sub-user endpoints are now legacy, admin-only, or unused.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs` (all actions except the six `apl*` actions, owned by 2.9), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` (only `GetBrokersAsync` and `GetBannersAsync`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/SubUsers/SubUsersController.cs`.
  - Backend modules: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/` (`Requests/Brands`, `Requests/BrokerBrand`, `Requests/CRUD`, `Requests/User-SubUsers`, `Specifications`, `DTOs`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Domain/`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Broker/` (broker list, plus two lookups owned elsewhere), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/SubUser/` (legacy sub-broker management), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Brand/` (brand import/export requests), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/MasterDataUpload/MasterDataUploadService.cs` (`ImportBrandsAsync`, `ExportBrandsAsync`).
  - Handlers in 2.2 served from `BrandsController`: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Organizations/UpdateBrandProfileRequest.cs`, `.../Members/AddBrandMemberRequest.cs`, `.../Members/RemoveBrandMemberRequest.cs`.
  - Web: `caboodle.web/src/service/brandReport.service.ts` (`getBrandUsers`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/brand-report.service.ts` (`useGetBrandUsers`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/brand.ts` (`useAccessibleBrands`, reads `/me/access`, not this module), `caboodle.web/src/models/brand.interface.ts` (`IBrand`).
  - Admin: routes `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/brands`, `brokers`, `brand-owners`, `broker-subusers`, `(brands)/brand-subusers`; components `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/{BrandTable,BrokerTable,BrandOwnerTable,BrokerSubUserTable,BrandSubUserTable}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Brand/AddBrand.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/*`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/User/AddUserToBrand.tsx`; services `caboodle.admin/src/services/brand.service.ts`, `broker.service.ts`, `subUsers.service.ts`; hooks `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brands.ts`, `brokers.ts`, `subUser.ts`.
- **Shared data models:**
  - `Brand.Brands` (`Brand`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Domain/Brand/Brand.cs`): `ID`, `UserID` (legacy owner, ignored since CS-1770), `Name`, `Description`, `LogoURL`, `WebURL`, `BannerURL`, `Slug`, `Vendor`, `IsPartner`, audit and soft-delete columns. A Brand organization (`Organization.Organizations`, `OrganizationType.Brand`) shares the brand's `ID` (`UpsertBrandRequestHandler.AddBrandWithOrganizationAsync`).
  - `Brand.BrandBrokers` (`BrandBroker`, `.../Modules.Brand.Domain/BrandBroker/BrandBroker.cs`): `BrokerID` (Identity user id of a broker or sub-broker), `BrandID`, `ParentBrokerID` (set for sub-broker rows). Legacy link table.
  - `Brand.BrandSubUsers` (`BrandSubUser`, `.../Modules.Brand.Domain/Brand/BrandSubUser.cs`): `BrandID`, `UserID`. Legacy.
  - `Identity.UsersHierarchy` (`UserHierarchy`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Identity`): `UserID`, `ParentUserID`. Links a sub-user or sub-broker to its parent user.
  - Read through raw SQL: `Organization.Memberships`, `Organization.Roles`, `Identity.Users`, `Identity.UserRoles`, `CRM.Contacts`.
- **Shared services:** `IDapperRepository` raw SQL reads; `IBulkRepository` bulk insert/update; `IAccessContext` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs`) for platform-admin and module checks; `IamWriter` (2.2) for audited membership and brand profile writes; `IMasterDataUploadService` for CSV import/export; `FileExportHelper` for CSV conversion.
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - 2.2 Organizations & Access: brand organizations are created with every brand; brand members, brand profile updates and brand connections live there. `GET /me/access` replaced `GET /brands/me` as the web's brand source.

#### 2.3.1 Feature: Brand catalog (list, create, update)

- **Status:** Active (admin `/brands` left the sidebar on 2026-10-26 and is aliased onto Organizations, but the route still renders and `GET /brands` is the admin's brand picker source; `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx`)
- **What it does:** Lists every non-deleted brand and lets the Platform Admin create a brand (with its Brand organization) or edit a brand profile. Used by the Platform Admin in caboodle.admin; brand pickers on about 30 admin screens call `GET /brands` (`useGetAllBrands`). The customer web app does not call these endpoints; it reads brands from `/me/access` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/brand.ts` `useAccessibleBrands`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin opens `/brands` (by URL). `BrandTable` calls `GET /api/v1/brands?brandName=&pageSize=&currentPage=&sortingOrder=` and shows name with logo, ID with a copy button, description, and an Edit action.
  2. Add Brand opens `AddBrand` (name required, web URL, logo URL, description) and posts `POST /api/v1/brands` without `id`. The backend refuses anyone who is not Platform Admin, creates `Organization.Organizations` (type Brand, same ID) first, then `Brand.Brands`; if the brand insert fails the organization is deleted again.
  3. Edit posts the same endpoint with `id`. The controller maps it to `UpdateBrandProfileRequest` (2.2): fields left out keep their value, `""` clears them, the organization is renamed when the name changes, and an `organization.updated` audit entry is written.
  4. Edge: create ignores `UserID` (owners are organization members now) and does not copy `IsPartner`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs` (`GetBrandsAsync`, `CreateAsync`) | Routes; `CreateAsync` dispatches create vs update by `request.ID.HasValue` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/Brands/GetAllBrandsRequest.cs` | Paged Dapper list, `Name ILIKE` filter |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/CRUD/UpsertBrandRequest.cs` | Create brand + organization, Platform Admin check |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Organizations/UpdateBrandProfileRequest.cs` | Update path (2.2), merge rules, audit, org rename |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/DTOs/BrandDTOs.cs` | `BrandDTO` and related DTOs |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BrandTable.tsx` | Admin list, add, edit, upload, export, filter drawer |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Brand/AddBrand.tsx` | Add/edit form |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/brand.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brands.ts` | `getAllBrands`, `addBrands`; `useGetAllBrands`, `useAddBrand` |

- **Data:** `Brand.Brands`; `Organization.Organizations` row with the same `ID` and `OrganizationType.Brand`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brands` | `MustHavePermission(View, Brands, Brand)` (Admin role only, see Business rules) | query `brandName`, `PageSize`, `CurrentPage`, `sortingOrder` / `PagedData<BrandDTO>` (`ID`, `UserID`, `Name`, `Description`, `LogoURL`, `WebURL`, `BannerURL`, `Slug`, `Vendor`, `IsPartner`); admin TS `IBrandResponse` | `GetAllBrandsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brands` | `RequireOrgPermission(OrganizationUpdate)`; create additionally requires `access.IsPlatformAdmin` in the handler | `UpsertBrandRequest` (`ID?`, `Name`, `Description`, `LogoURL`, `WebURL`, `BannerURL`, `Slug`, `Vendor`) / `BrandDTO`; admin TS `IBrandBody` | create: `UpsertBrandRequestHandler`; update: `UpdateBrandProfileRequestHandler` (2.2) |

- **Business rules:**
  - `MustHavePermission` checks role claims (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Permissions/PermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs`). Claims are seeded from `CaboodlePermissions` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/CaboodlePermissions.cs`): only the Admin role gets `Brand`-module permissions; the Broker and SubBroker sets keep only `CaboodleModule.Broker` entries.
  - `RequireOrgPermission(OrganizationUpdate)` passes for a Platform Admin or a member holding `organization.update` (`AccessContext.HasOrgPermission`). A non-admin member can therefore reach `CreateAsync`, but create throws access denied and update returns 404 unless `access.OrganizationId == request.ID`.
  - Validation: `Name` required (`UpsertBrandRequestValidator`); update also limits `Name` to 200 chars.
  - List always orders by `Name ASC`; `sortingOrder` is normalised but not used in `ORDER BY` (`GetAllBrandsRequest.GetQuery`).
- **Dependencies:** 2.2 (organization creation and update, `IamWriter` audit). No feature flags.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Non-admin create: 403 `AccessRefusal.AccessKey` "You do not have permission to do this." Update of a brand that is not a Brand organization or is deleted: 404 "Brand not found." If the brand insert throws after the organization insert, the organization is deleted and the exception rethrown (`AddBrandWithOrganizationAsync`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Brand.Application.Test/Requests/CRUD/UpsertBrandRequestTests.cs` (name required, org created with same id, owner ignored, admin only, rollback). `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Organizations/UpdateBrandProfileRequestTests.cs` (update path). No test for `GetAllBrandsRequest`. Admin has no Jest tests.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `IsPartner` cannot be set through `POST /brands` (create omits it, update keeps the stored value).
  - Admin `useGetAllBrands` keys its query on `QueryKeys.getBrokers` (shared with the broker list), and `BrandTable.invalidate` after an upload invalidates `QueryKeys.getBrands`, which nothing uses, so the list does not refresh after an import (`caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brands.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BrandTable.tsx`).
  - Dead handler: `DeleteBrandRequest` (`.../Requests/CRUD/DeleteBrandRequest.cs`) has no controller action.

##### 2.3.1.1 Sub-feature: Brand import and export

- **Status:** Active (admin `/brands` page, hidden from sidebar)
- **What it does:** Platform Admin uploads a brand CSV that creates or updates brands matched by name, and downloads all brands as CSV.
- **User flow:**
  1. Upload Brands opens `UploadComponent` posting the file to `POST /api/v1/brands/import`; a sample comes from `GET /api/v1/masterdataupload/sample-file?fileCategory=` (`FileCategory.Brand`, Data Upload module).
  2. Each row: blank `Name` is a failed row ("Brand Name is required!"); a name matching an existing brand (case-insensitive) updates `Description`, `LogoURL`, `BannerURL`, `Slug`, `Vendor`, `WebURL`; otherwise a new brand is queued. Duplicate names inside the file keep the last row.
  3. New brands are bulk inserted after their organizations (`InsertBrandsWithOrganizationsAsync`); if the brand insert fails the organizations are bulk deleted. Response carries a CSV of failed rows.
  4. Export Brands calls `GET /api/v1/brands/export?pageSize=&currentPage=&sortingOrder=`; "all" passes `pageSize = meta.totalCount`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Brand/BrandsImportRequst.cs` | `ImportBrandsRequest`, parses CSV into `BrandImportDTO` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Brand/BrandsExportRequest.cs` | `BrandsExportRequest` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/MasterDataUpload/MasterDataUploadService.cs` (`ImportBrandsAsync`, `InsertBrandsWithOrganizationsAsync`, `ExportBrandsAsync`) | Upsert logic and export SQL |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/MasterDataUploadDTOs.cs` (`BrandImportDTO`, `BrandImportFailedDTO`) | CSV columns: `[*] Name`, `Description`, `Logo URL`, `Banner URL`, `Slug`, `Vendor`, `Web URL` |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BrandTable.tsx` (`handleExport`, Upload modal) | UI |

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brands/import` | `MustHavePermission(Import, MasterDataUpload, DataUpload)` | multipart `file` / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO` (`Success`, `Message`, `File` of failed rows) | `ImportBrandsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/brands/export` | `MustHavePermission(Export, MasterDataUpload, DataUpload)` | query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder` / CSV file "Brands Exported Data" (`BrandImportDTO` columns) | `BrandsExportRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** An empty file is a validation error "No record(s) to upload!". Updates overwrite fields with the CSV values, so a blank column clears the stored value.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Failed rows are reported as `[Row = n] message` in the returned CSV; the HTTP status stays 200.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/MasterDataUpload/MasterDataUploadServiceTests.cs` mocks the brand repository (scope of brand-import cases not verified).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `ExportBrandsAsync` interpolates `sortingOrder` straight into `ORDER BY` without validation (SQL injection surface, admin-only).
  - Import updates go through `BulkUpdateAsync`, which bypasses the EF audit trail, and do not touch the organization (the name is the match key, so it never changes).

#### 2.3.2 Feature: Brand owners and brand users

- **Status:** Active (admin `/brand-owners` is hidden from the sidebar and aliased onto Members, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx`; the lookup and member endpoints are live)
- **What it does:** Answers "who are a brand's people" from organization memberships: a paged list of brand owners for the Platform Admin, a grouped owner/sub-user/contact lookup for broker email pickers, and admin endpoints that add a person to or remove a person from a brand's organization. Owners are the brand organization's active Brand Admins; `Brands.UserID` is no longer read here.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/brand-owners` (`BrandOwnerTable`) calls `GET /api/v1/brands/owners`; each row shows the user and one brand. "Assign Brand" opens `ShowBrands` (`userType = BrandOwner`) where the brand can be removed (`DELETE /brands/remove-owner-from-brand`). The add control there is disabled whenever the row already has a brand, which every owner row has.
  2. Admin `/users-unassigned` ("Accounts Without a Company", in the sidebar) and the hidden `/all-users` use `UsersTable` > "Add to a brand" (`AddUserToBrand`), which calls `PUT /api/v1/brands/assign-user-to-brand` with `userID`, `brandID` and an optional `roleID`.
  3. In the web app, broker modals (Category Review "Notify Brands", Brand Report "Email Brands") call `POST /api/v1/brands/users` with `{ brandIds }` and render owner, sub-users and CRM contacts per brand.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs` (`GetBrandsOwnersAsync`, `GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersAsync`, `AssignUserToBrandAsync`, `RemoveBrandFromUserAsync`) | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/Brands/GetAllBrandsOwnersRequest.cs` | Owners = active memberships with role key `OrgRoles.BrandAdmin`, joined to `Brand.Brands` and `Identity.Users` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/Brands/GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequest.cs` | Grouped lookup, brand scoping, contacts |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Members/AddBrandMemberRequest.cs`, `RemoveBrandMemberRequest.cs` | Membership writes (2.2 handlers) |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BrandOwnerTable.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/ShowBrands.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/AddBrandToBroker.tsx` | Admin owner list and remove |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/User/AddUserToBrand.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/User/UsersTable.tsx` | Admin "Add to a brand" |
| `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brands.ts` (`useGetBrandOwners`, `useAssignUserToBrand`), `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brokers.ts` (`useAddBrandToBrokerOwner`, `useRemoveBrandOwnerFromBrand`), `caboodle.admin/src/services/brand.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/broker.service.ts` | Admin calls |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/brandReport.service.ts` (`getBrandUsers`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/brand-report.service.ts` (`useGetBrandUsers`) | Web lookup |

- **Data:** `Organization.Memberships` (`OrganizationID` = brand ID, `UserID`, `RoleID`, `Status`, `CreatedOn`), `Organization.Roles` (`Key`), `Identity.Users`, `CRM.Contacts` (`BrandID`, `FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`), `Brand.Brands`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brands/owners` | `MustHavePermission(View, Brands, Brand)` | query `userName`, `email`, `brandID`, `PageSize`, `CurrentPage`, `sortingOrder` / `PagedData<BrandOwnerDTO>` (`UserDetailsDto` fields + `BrandID`, `BrandName`) | `GetAllBrandsOwnersRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brands/users` | `RequireModule(null, category-review, View, CrossBrand)` | body `GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequest` (`BrandIds`), query `includeInactive` / `List<BrandUsersGroupDTO>` (`BrandId`, `BrandName`, `Owner`, `SubUsers`, `Contacts`); web TS `IBrandUsersGroup` | `GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/brands/assign-user-to-brand` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | `AddBrandMemberRequest` (`UserID`, `BrandID`, `RoleID?`, `ParentBrokerID?`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` "Brand successfully assigned to the User"; admin TS `IAssignUserToBrandRequest` | `AddBrandMemberRequestHandler` (2.2) |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brands/remove-owner-from-brand` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | body `RemoveBrandMemberRequest` (`BrandID`, `UserID`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `RemoveBrandMemberRequestHandler` (2.2) |

- **Business rules:**
  - `brands/users`: requested ids are de-duplicated and empty ids dropped; a Platform Admin gets every requested brand, anyone else only brands in `access.BrandsInScope(category-review, View)`. No allowed brand returns `[]` without querying. The owner is the earliest (by `membership.CreatedOn`) active Brand Admin; every other member is a sub-user. Inactive members (suspended membership or disabled account) are excluded unless `includeInactive=true`. Contacts are non-deleted `CRM.Contacts` with a non-empty email.
  - `brands/owners`: only active memberships (`MembershipStatus.Active`) with the Brand Admin role; `brandID`, `email`, name (first, last or user name) filters; `PageSize` must be at least -1. Ordered by first name.
  - `assign-user-to-brand`: refuses `ParentBrokerID`, inactive accounts, unconfirmed emails, and anyone who belongs to a Brokerage organization (400 "This person can't be added to a brand."). With no `RoleID` the first member becomes Brand Admin, later ones Brand Member. Audited as `member.added` with `IsSupportAccess = true`.
  - `remove-owner-from-brand`: 404 when the user is not a member; refuses removing oneself and removing the last manager (`MembershipWriter.RequireAnotherManagerAsync`). Audited as `member.removed`.
- **Dependencies:** 2.2 membership model and `IamWriter`; 2.4 CRM contacts; consumers in Category Review and Brand Report.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Unknown or deleted brand ids are omitted from the `brands/users` answer with no error (`GetBrandsAsync` filters `Deleted = FALSE`); the web modals diff request against response. 409 on assign when already a member is documented only in the admin service comment (`caboodle.admin/src/services/brand.service.ts`); not verified in the handler path.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Brand.Application.Test/Requests/Brands/GetAllBrandsOwnersRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Brand.Application.Test/Requests/Brands/GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Organization.Application.Test/Members/AddBrandMemberRequestTests.cs`, `.../Members/RemoveBrandMemberRequestTests.cs`. Web: the email modals are covered by `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/NotifyBrandsModal.test.tsx` and Brand Report modal suites (lookup mocked).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Admin `useAddBrandToBrokerOwner` reads `data.name` / `data.id` from the response, but the endpoint returns `{ message }`, so the modal shows an empty brand after a successful assign (`caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brokers.ts`).
  - Admin `AddBrandToBroker` disables a brand option for owners when `brand.userID` is set; `UserID` is never written for new brands, so this guard is inert (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/AddBrandToBroker.tsx`).
  - Dead handlers kept in the Brand module: `AssignBrandToUserRequest`, `RemoveUserFromBrandRequest` (legacy `Brands.UserID` / `BrandSubUsers` writers, no controller action).
  - `brands/users` is `RequireModule(null, category-review, ...)`: with no brand slug, a Brand organization caller is refused ("This module is not available to your organization.", `AccessContext.AudienceRefusal`), so only brokerages and the Platform Admin can use it.
  - `brands/users` uses the `category-review` broker module as its gate, so a brokerage without Category Review cannot use Brand Report email pickers either (comment in the handler states Brand Report requires Category Review).

#### 2.3.3 Feature: Broker records and legacy brand-to-broker links

- **Status:** Deprecated (superseded by brand connections in 2.2, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/BrandConnectionsController.cs`; admin `/brokers` is hidden from the sidebar and aliased onto Members, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx`). The route still renders and the endpoints still write `Brand.BrandBrokers`, which some legacy readers still consult.
- **What it does:** Lists Identity users holding the BROKER role with the brands linked to them through `Brand.BrandBrokers`, and lets the Platform Admin link brands to a broker or unlink one. Linking to a broker also links the same brands to every sub-broker that already has a row under that broker.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin opens `/brokers` (by URL). `BrokerTable` calls `GET /api/v1/brokers?brokerName=&brokerEmail=&brandID=&pageSize=&currentPage=&sortingOrder=`; each row shows id, names, user name, email, phone and a Brands action.
  2. The Brands action opens `ShowBrands` (`userType = Broker`): a multi-select of all brands (`GET /brands`, `pageSize=-1`) with already linked brands disabled. Add sends `PATCH /api/v1/brands/assign-brand-to-broker` with `{ brokerID, brandIDs }` after a confirm; the response replaces the modal's brand list.
  3. The delete icon on a brand chip asks "Are you sure to remove this brand?" and sends `DELETE /api/v1/brands/remove-brand-from-broker` with `{ brokerID, brandID }`.
  4. Admin `/broker-subusers` (`BrokerSubUserTable`) shows the same `ShowBrands` read-only.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` (`GetBrokersAsync`) | `GET /brokers` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Broker/GetBrokersRequest.cs` | Broker list SQL, brands aggregated as a JSON string |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/DTOs/BrokerDTOs.cs` | `BrokerDataModel`, `BrokerDTO`, sub-broker DTOs |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs` (`AssignBrandsToBrokerAsync`, `RemoveBrandFromBrokerAsync`) | Link routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/BrokerBrand/AssignBrandToBrokerRequest.cs` | Insert links, propagate to sub-brokers |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/BrokerBrand/RemoveBrandFromBrokerRequest.cs` | Remove link, cascade to sub-broker rows |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Specifications/GetBrokerByIDAndBrandSpec.cs` | Link lookup |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BrokerTable.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/ShowBrands.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Broker/AddBrandToBroker.tsx` | Admin UI |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/broker.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brokers.ts` | `getAllBrokers`, `addBrandToBroker`, `removeBrandFromBroker` |

- **Data:** `Brand.BrandBrokers` (`BrokerID`, `BrandID`, `ParentBrokerID`); `Identity.Users`, `Identity.UserRoles`, `Identity.Roles` (role `BROKER`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers` | `MustHavePermission(View, Brokers, Broker)` (Admin role only: the Broker and SubBroker sets exclude `CaboodleResource.Brokers`) | query `brokerName`, `brokerEmail`, `brandID`, `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder` / `PagedData<BrokerDTO>` (`BrokerID`, `FirstName`, `LastName`, `UserName`, `Email`, `PhoneNumber`, `Brands[{ID, Name}]`); admin TS `IAllBrokerParams` | `GetBrokersRequestHandler` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/brands/assign-brand-to-broker` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | `AssignBrandsToBrokerRequest` (`BrandIDs[]`, `BrokerID`) / `List<BrandDTO>` (the broker's brands after the write) | `AssignBrandToBrokerRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brands/remove-brand-from-broker` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | body `RemoveBrandFromBrokerRequest` (`BrandID`, `BrokerID`) / `List<BrandDTO>` | `RemoveBrandFromBrokerRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Assign: at least one brand; the target user must exist and hold BROKER or BROKERSUBUSER; every brand id must exist and not be deleted, else 400 "We couldn't find some of the brands you've chosen." Already linked brands are skipped. If the target is a sub-broker, new rows get `ParentBrokerID = current user`. If the target is a broker, the same brands are also inserted for each distinct `BrokerID` found in rows whose `ParentBrokerID` is that broker.
  - Remove: target must exist and be broker or sub-broker; the link must exist ("The selected Brand is not assigned to the Broker"). For a broker, the row is deleted through the repository (soft delete via `BaseDbContext`) and the matching sub-broker rows are marked deleted. For a sub-broker, its row is marked deleted.
  - Broker list: filters on brand id, email and name; ordered by first name.
- **Dependencies:** ASP.NET Identity `UserManager` and roles; `IBulkRepository`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Unknown broker: 404 "Broker not found". Wrong role: 400 "User is not assigned as Broker or Sub Broker".
- **Tests:** None found for `GetBrokersRequest`, `AssignBrandToBrokerRequest` or `RemoveBrandFromBrokerRequest` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests`. Admin has no Jest tests.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Sub-broker propagation in assign does not check for existing sub-broker rows, so re-linking can create duplicate `BrandBrokers` rows for sub-brokers; a sub-broker with no rows yet never receives propagated brands (sub-brokers are discovered only through existing `ParentBrokerID` rows).
  - Remove soft-deletes sub-broker rows by overwriting `BrandID` with `Guid.Empty`, and sets `DeletedBy`/`DeletedOn` on the parent entity instead of the sub-broker rows (`RemoveBrandFromBrokerRequestHandler.Handle`). The sub-broker branch also overwrites `BrandID` with `Guid.Empty`.
  - `GetBrokersRequest` left-joins `BrandBrokers` without `bb.Deleted = FALSE`, so soft-deleted links of the parent-broker path (which keep `BrandID`) still appear in the list; it builds the brands JSON by string concatenation, so a brand name containing `"` breaks deserialization.
  - Brand IDs are string-interpolated into SQL (`GetBrandsQuery`); they are typed `Guid`, so not injectable, but the pattern recurs across this module.
  - Legacy readers still trust these rows: `BrandValidationMiddleware` grants a `BrandID` header if the broker has a `BrandBrokers` row (before asking the access engine), and `CategoryReviewAccessHelper` resolves broker brands from it.
  - `origin/master` differs (CS-1791 and CS-XXXX): `AssignBrandToBrokerRequest` and `AssignBrandsToSubBrokersRequest` resolve the sub-broker's real parent through `BrandBrokerParentResolver` instead of using the caller's id, `BrandBroker` gains `OriginalParentBrokerID`, and `POST /api/v1/admin/sub-broker-parent-repair` (`SubBrokerParentRepairController`, `RepairSubBrokerParentsRequest` with `reverse` and `dryRun`) repairs rows whose parent is not a broker. None of this is on the working branch.

##### 2.3.3.1 Sub-feature: Sub-broker brand assignment

- **Status:** Deprecated (no caller in `caboodle.web/src` or `caboodle.admin/src`; gated to the Admin role while the handlers act on the caller's own broker links, so a Platform Admin call cannot succeed as written)
- **What it does:** Intended for a broker to give sub-brokers some of its brands, and to take brands back.
- **User flow:** None (no UI).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/BrokerBrand/AssignBrandsToSubBrokersRequest.cs` | Validates sub-brokers (active, BROKERSUBUSER role) and brands (linked to the caller), inserts missing rows with `ParentBrokerID = caller` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/BrokerBrand/RemoveBrandsFromBrokersRequest.cs` | Raw `UPDATE "Brand"."BrandBrokers" SET "Deleted" = TRUE ...` for the given sub-brokers and brands |

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brands/assign-brands-to-sub-brokers` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | `AssignBrandsToSubBrokersRequest` (`BrandIDs`, `SubBrokerUserIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `AssignBrandsToSubBrokersRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brands/remove-brands-from-broker` | `MustHavePermission(Assign, BrandAssign, Brand)` | body `RemoveBrandsFromBrokersRequest` (`BrandIDs`, `SubBrokerUserIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` "Brands removed successfully" | `RemoveBrandsFromBrokersRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Assign throws "No valid Brand ID found" unless the brands are linked to the current user in `BrandBrokers`; it does not check that the sub-brokers belong to the caller. Remove does not scope to the caller at all.
- **Tests:** None found.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `RemoveBrandsFromBrokersRequest.GetQuery` references the alias `bb` in the `WHERE` clause of an `UPDATE` that declares no alias, which PostgreSQL rejects ("missing FROM-clause entry"); the endpoint appears to fail on every call (not executed during this review).
  - SQL is built by joining ids and the sub-broker role id into the query text.

#### 2.3.5 Feature: Legacy sub-users (brand sub-users and sub-brokers)

- **Status:** Deprecated (sub-user management is replaced by company members and invitations in 2.2; admin `/brand-subusers`, `/broker-subusers` and `/invited-users` are hidden from the sidebar and aliased onto Members / Invitations in `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx`; the brand-owner and broker endpoints are gated on `CaboodleModule.SubUser` / `User` permissions that only the Admin role holds, and the web app calls none of them, only `caboodle.web/src/mocks/mockApi.ts` mocks them)
