| DELETE | `/api/v1/subusers/cancel-invitation` | `MustHavePermission(Delete, Users, User)` | body `DeleteSubUsersInvitationRequest` (`IDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteSubUsersInvitationRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Brand-scoped handlers read `ICurrentUser.GetBrandID()` (raw header) rather than the access engine. Broker-scoped handlers act on the caller as the parent broker. Broker sub-user remove deactivates the account (`IsActive = false`), hard-deletes (`DELETE FROM`) its `BrandBrokers` rows whose `ParentBrokerID` is the caller, and sets `UsersHierarchy.ParentUserID` to null; brand sub-user remove also deactivates the account (`RemoveBrandSubUserRequestHandler`).
- **Dependencies:** ASP.NET Identity `UserManager`; 2.2 invitations and members replace these screens.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Wrong role: 400 "Selected user is not a broker sub user." / "Selected User is not a Brand Sub User"; unknown user: 404.
- **Tests:** None found for these handlers.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The broker endpoints are named for brokers but only the Admin role can pass their gates, so an admin call operates on the admin's own (empty) hierarchy. The legacy tables they manage still feed `BrandValidationMiddleware`. Admin `/invited-users` and `cancel-invitation` overlap with 2.2 invitations (the admin `InvitationsTable` comment notes the legacy list is different).

##### 2.3.5.1 Sub-feature: Unused broker lookups

- **Status:** Deprecated (gated by `MustHavePermission(Execute, UnusedEndpoints, Admin)`, the marker for retired endpoints; no caller in web or admin)
- **What it does:** `GET /api/v1/brokers/banner` returns a paged list of banners that have a retailer and region ("Get all Banners for MO log").
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/banner` | `MustHavePermission(Execute, UnusedEndpoints, Admin)` | query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder` / `PagedData<BannerDTO>` | `GetAllBannersRequestHandler` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Broker/GetAllBannersRequest.cs`) |

- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The same `Broker/` folder holds `GetRegionRetailersRequest.cs`, which serves `GET /brokers/{regionID}/get-retailers` and `GET /brokers/{retailerID}/regions/{regionID}/banners` (Market Overview cascade, documented in 2.9). Web `caboodle.web/src/service/caboodle.service.ts` calls `GET /api/v1/brokers/get-retailers`, a path with no matching route.

### 2.4 Module: CRM

- **Purpose:** Owns the retail master data every other module joins against (retailers, banners, regions, distributors and their delivery methods, distribution centers, stores) plus the brand-scoped relationship data built on top of it (which distributor serves which banner for a brand and at what markup, which products a brand has on which banner, contacts, banner activities, sales pipeline). Platform admins curate the shared catalog in the admin app; brands and connected brokerages link to it and add their own records in the customer app.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/` (`BannersController`, `ContactsController`, `DistributionCenterController`, `DistributorsController`, `PipeLinesController` (class `PipelinesController`), `RegionsController`, `RetailersController`, `StoresController`); admin deal-stage routes in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Admin/AdminController.cs`.
  - Backend handlers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/` (folders `BannerActivity`, `Banners`, `Contacts`, `Distributors` (+`Dc`), `PipeLines` (`Plan`, `PipeLine`, `Activity`, `DealStage`), `Region`, `RetailerPromoRules`, `Retailers`, `SKUs`, `Store`, `Specifications`, `Helper`, `DTOs`); `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/PipeLine/`.
  - Domain: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Domain/` (`Banner`, `Contact`, `Dc`, `Distributor`, `Pipeline`, `Region`, `Retailer`, `Store`); unused duplicate `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Store/Modules.Store.Domain/Store/Store.cs`.
  - EF mapping: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs` (all CRM tables in schema `CRM`).
  - Rename jobs: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Propagation/`.
  - Tests: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/`.
  - Web: `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/` (`banners`, `contacts`, `distributors`, `pipeline`, `regions`, `retailers`); components `caboodle.web/src/components/{retailers,distributor,contacts,Regions,pipeline,activities}`; services `caboodle.web/src/service/{caboodle,dcs,store,sku,pipeline,promo-rule}.service.ts`; hooks `caboodle.web/src/hooks/{banner,contact,dcs,distributors,pipeline,promo-rule,retailer,sku,stores,activity}.ts`.
  - Admin: `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/(crm)/{banner-skus,banners,contacts,dcs,distributor-dc,distributors,regions,regions-retailer,retailers,stores,sub-distributors}/page.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/pipeline-config/page.tsx`; tables `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/*`; forms `caboodle.admin/src/component/{Banners,BannerSkus,Contacts,DCs,DestributorDC,Region,RetailerRegion,Retailers,Store,Pipeline}`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Distributor.tsx`; services `caboodle.admin/src/services/{Banner,BannerSkus,contact,dcs,distributor,pipeline-config,regions,retailerRegion,retailers,store}.service.ts`.
- **Shared data models:** (all `AuditableEntity`: `ID`, `CreatedBy/On`, `LastModifiedBy/On`, `Deleted`, `DeletedBy/On`; schema `CRM`)

  | Table (entity) | Scope | Key fields | Path |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `Retailers` (`Retailer`) | Global catalog | `CorporateName`, `ImageURL` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Domain/Retailer/Retailer.cs` |
  | `Banners` (`Banner`) | Global catalog | `RetailerID`, `RegionID?` (never written by `UpsertBannerRequest`), `BannerName`, `DoorCount` | `.../Banner/Banner.cs` |
  | `Regions` (`Region`) | Global catalog | `RegionName`, `Address` (rendered as "States" in web) | `.../Region/Region.cs` |
  | `RetailerRegions` (`RetailerRegion`) | Global link | `RetailerID`, `RegionID`, `BannerID?` | `.../Retailer/RetailerRegion.cs` |
  | `Distributors` (`Distributor`) | Global catalog; `ParentID` null = distributor, set = delivery method (sub-distributor) | `DistributorName`, `ImageURL`, `ParentID?` | `.../Distributor/Distributor.cs` |
  | `DistributorBrands` (`DistributorBrand`) | Brand link | `BrandID`, `DistributorID`, `DistributorParentID?` | `.../Distributor/DistributorBrand.cs` |
  | `DistributorBanners` (`DistributorBanner`) | Brand link (defines a brand's banners and retailers) | `BrandID`, `DistributorID`, `BannerID`, `DistributorMarkup` (float) | `.../Distributor/DistributorBanner.cs` |
  | `DistributorRetailers` (`DistributorRetailer`) | Brand link, legacy | `BrandID`, `DistributorID`, `RetailerID`, `DistributorMarkup` | `.../Distributor/DistributorRetailer.cs` |
  | `DistributorDcs` (`DistributorDc`) | Global | `DistributorID`, `RegionID`, `Warehouse` | `.../Distributor/DistributorDc.cs` |
  | `DistributionCenters` (`DistributionCenter`) | Global | `Warehouse` | `.../Dc/DistributionCenter.cs` |
  | `BannerSKUs` (`BannerSKU`) | Brand | `BrandID`, `BannerID`, `ProductID`, `ActiveDate?`, `DiscoDate?`, `Slotting?`, `Status?` (int `SkuStatus`) | `.../Banner/BannerSKU.cs` |
  | `BannerActivities` (`BannerActivity`) | Brand | `BannerID`, `BrandID`, `ContactID?`, `BannerActivityTypeID?`, `ActivityDate?`, `Notes` | `.../Banner/BannerActivity.cs` |
  | `BannerActivityTypes` | Global, no endpoint | `ActivityType` | `.../Banner/BannerActivityType.cs` |
  | `RetailerPromoRules` (`RetailerPromoRule`) | Global (no brand column) | `RetailerID`, `BannerID`, `RegionID`, policy strings, `OI/MCB/Scan` (bool?) | `.../Banner/RetailerPromoRules.cs` |
  | `Contacts` (`Contact`) | Brand | `BrandID`, names, `Email`, `PhoneNumber`, `BusinessName`, `ContactNotes`, `Title` | `.../Contact/Contact.cs` |
  | `PipelinePlans`, `Pipelines`, `PipelineDealStages`, `PipelineActivities`, `PipelineActivityFiles` | Brand (deal stages: global when `BrandID` null) | see 2.4.7 | `.../Pipeline/*.cs` |
  | `Stores` (`Store`, CRM) | Global, legacy (no live endpoint) | `RegionID`, `RetailerID`, `BannerID`, `Name` | `.../Store/Store.cs` |

  `SkuStatus` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/Enums.cs`): 1 Active, 2 Pending, 3 NotActive, 4 Declined, 5 Discontinued, 6 Approved, 7 Commit.
- **How CRM master data is modelled (global vs brand-scoped):**
  - Retailers, banners, regions, distributors, delivery methods, DCs and the retailer-region links are **global**: one row per real-world entity, no `BrandID`, written only by platform admins (`MustHavePermission`) through the admin app or Master Data Upload (2.10).
  - A brand "has" a distributor through `DistributorBrands` (a row with `DistributorParentID` null for the parent distributor, one row per connected delivery method with `DistributorParentID` = parent), created by `connect-brand` / `sub-distributors/connect` (2.4.3).
  - A brand "has" a banner (and through it the banner's retailer) only through `DistributorBanners`: `GetBannersRequest`, `GetRetailersOfCurrentBrandRequest`, `GetBannerSKUsForPromoRequest` and `GetRetailersForPromoRequest` all start from `DistributorBanners WHERE BrandID = @BrandID` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Retailers/GetRetailersOfCurrentBrandRequest.cs`). "My Retailers" is therefore derived, not stored.
  - Single-brand data (`BannerSKUs`, `BannerActivities`, `Contacts`, pipeline tables) carries `BrandID`, always taken from the access context (`IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync` / `DemandAnyModuleAsync(...).ActiveBrandId`), never from the raw header (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextService.cs`). Records of another brand answer 404 like missing ones (comments "D-H" in handlers, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Helper/PipelineRecords.cs`).
  - A brokerage reaches brand data through its connected brands: `RequireModule(slug, null, ...)` is checked on the brand slug for a brokerage too (`AccessContext.ModuleRefusal`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs`).
- **Shared services:**
  - `IAccessContext` (`DemandAnyModuleAsync`, `DemandCatalogModuleAsync`, `DemandModuleAsync`, `GetActiveBrandIdAsync`, `DemandBrandAsync`): handler-level module checks; slug groups in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Helper/CrmModules.cs` (`BannerTabs` = distributors/retailers; `RetailerBanners` = retailers/distributors/retail-reports; `PromoLookups` = approved-promotions/trade-spend-sandbox; `ContactLookup`; `LeafDistributors`; `Regions`; `GlobalRetailers`; `GlobalDistributors`; `MarketOverview`).
  - `QueryHelper` sort-key allow-lists (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Helper/QueryHelper.cs`); `ValidateSortKey` / `ValidateSortingOrder` guard every dynamic `ORDER BY`.
  - Admin filter-option pattern: `*FilterConditionBuilder` + `Get*FilterOptionsRequest` with a `PropertyName` facet and self-exclusion (a facet never narrows itself), e.g. `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Banners/Filters/GetFilterOptionsRequest.cs`.
  - `BrandMentionSql` (mentionable users of a brand: active members of the brand org plus members of connected brokerages with full-brand access or a `BrandAccess` row), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Helper/BrandMentionSql.cs`.
  - Name-change propagation services (2.4.9), `IMailService` (mention emails), `IFileStorageService` (pipeline files), `ISharedDataService` (price list and market overview reads, banner SKU writers).
  - Web: `useModuleAccess().can(slug, action)` hides controls; `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES` gates routes (`banners` uses the `distributors` slug), `caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts`; nav "CRM" group in `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts` (`buildBrandNavItems`).
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - 2.2 Organizations and access: `RequireModule`, `IAccessContext`, brokerage-to-brand connections, `MustHavePermission` for platform admins.
  - ProductSpecs: `BannerSKUs.ProductID` references `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications`; product create/import enqueues banner SKU creation (2.4.2.1); price list feeds SKU pricing.
  - 2.6 Trade promotion planning: `banners/skus/for-promo`, `retailers/for-promo`, `distributors/leaf`; banner SKU deletion is blocked by sandbox events; banner unlink blocked by approved promo events.
  - Broker market overview: `GET /banners/skus`, DC search, `GET /regions`; market overview updates write banner SKU status (`SharedDataService.PushMarketOverviewUpdatesIntoCRM`).
  - DataUpload / DataHub: KeHE and UNFI imports write banner SKUs (`SaveBannerSKUsDataFromProvider`); store list (2.14) holds `RetailerId` / `BannerId` / `RegionId`; rename jobs rewrite DataUpload, DataHub and monthly report tables.
  - 2.10 Master Data Upload: bulk import and export of every CRM catalog table (`api/v1/masterdataupload/*`).

#### 2.4.1 Feature: Retailers

- **Status:** Active (`GET /retailers/global/filter-options` and `DELETE /retailers` have no caller in web or admin; web components `AddRetailers`, `EditRetailerDistributorMarkup` are unreachable, see Gotchas)
- **What it does:** Platform admins maintain the global retailer catalog (corporate name, logo). Brand users and connected brokerage users browse "My Retailers" (retailers whose banners are linked to the brand through a distributor, 2.4.3.1) and "All Retailers" (whole catalog), open a retailer to see its banners, and export either list as CSV. Gated by module `retailers` (View, Export).
- **User flow:**
  1. Web nav CRM > Retailers opens `/{brandID}/retailers` ("My Retailers" tab); tab "All Retailers" opens `/{brandID}/retailers/all` (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/retailers/(retailer-list)/layout.tsx`).
  2. Search box (debounced `SearchField`) sets `searchKeyword`; toolbar sorts by `RetailerSortKeys`; pager pageSize 10 (`RetailerListing.tsx`).
  3. Export button (shown when `can(retailers, export)`) always exports all rows (`ActionButtons.handleExport("all")` sends `pageSize -1`): "My Retailers" calls `GET /retailers/export/current-brand`, "All Retailers" calls `GET /retailers/export/all`.
  4. Clicking a row opens `/{brandID}/retailers/{retailerID}/banners` or `/{brandID}/retailers/all/{retailerID}/banners`: header from `GET /retailers/{id}`, body is the shared `BannerListing` (2.4.2) filtered to that retailer, using `banners/for-retailer` (mine) or `banners/for-retailer/global` (all, chosen by `pathName.includes("all")`).
  5. Admin: `/retailers` page (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/RetailersTable.tsx`) lists `GET /retailers/global`, add/edit form `caboodle.admin/src/component/Retailers/AddRetailers.tsx` posts `POST /retailers`; import/export go through Master Data Upload (2.10).

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/RetailersController.cs` | 9 endpoints |

  Job: rename enqueues `IRetailerNameChangePropagationService.PropagateAsync` (2.4.9).
- **Business rules:**
  - Name is required ("Corporate Name can not be null or empty!"); names and image URL are trimmed (`UpsertRetailerRequestValidator`).
  - Delete skips retailers that still own a non-deleted banner; if none are deletable it returns 400, and if some were skipped it soft-deletes the rest and still returns 400 ("Selected Retailers can not be deleted...") (`DeleteRetailerRequestHandler`).
  - "My Retailers" counts distinct banners linked through the brand's `DistributorBanners`; search matches retailer name, any banner name of the retailer, or a region of a linked banner.
  - `GetRetailersForPromo` groups banners per retailer and regions per banner, sorted by name.
- **Dependencies:** `DistributorBanners` (2.4.3.1) for brand scope; `RetailerRegions` (2.4.5); 2.6 promotion creation (`retailers/for-promo` from `caboodle.web/src/service/promo.service.ts`); 2.4.9 rename job; Hangfire via `IJobService`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** unknown retailer on `GET /{id}` or upsert returns 404; a retailer with no `RetailerRegions` row still appears in lists (LEFT JOIN) but is absent from `/export/all` (INNER JOIN on `RetailerRegions` and `Banners`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/Retailers/GetAllRetailersRequestTests.cs`, `GetRetailerFilterOptionsRequestTests.cs`, `UpsertRetailerRequestTests.cs`; access in `.../Access/CrmModuleChecksTests.cs`, `.../ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs`. No tests for brand list, exports, delete, for-promo. Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/crm/RetailerListingGating.test.tsx` (export button gating). The admin app has no Jest tests.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - "All Retailers" export ignores the on-screen search: the list sends `searchKeyword`, but `ExportRetailersRequest` only reads `retailerName`, `bannerName`, `bannerID`, `regionIDs` (`caboodle.web/src/service/caboodle.service.ts` `exportRetailers`).
  - Partial delete then 400 (above) means the caller sees an error although some rows were deleted.
  - `GetRetailerRequest` returns the legacy `DistributorRetailers` link (2.4.3.1), which no reachable screen writes any more.
  - Unreachable web code: `caboodle.web/src/components/retailers/AddRetailers.tsx` and `EditRetailerDistributorMarkup.tsx` have no importer; `useDeleteRetailers`, `useGetAllRetailers` (calls `GET /brokers/get-retailers`) are unused (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/retailer.ts`). `useRetailer` and `useUpsertRetailers` are declared twice (`hooks/retailer.ts` and `hooks/pipeline.ts`).

#### 2.4.2 Feature: Banners

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A banner is a store chain format of a retailer with a door count. Platform admins maintain the global banner catalog in the admin app. In the customer app a banner is always viewed inside a split panel (banner list on the left, selected banner on the right with tabs Products, Activities, Rules), reached from a retailer, from a distributor's delivery method, or directly at `/{brandID}/banners/{bannerID}`. Route gate: module `distributors` (`BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES.banners`); data endpoints accept `retailers`, `distributors` or `retail-reports` View.
- **User flow:**
  1. Open a retailer (2.4.1) or a delivery method (2.4.3) to render `BannerListing` (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/banners/BannerListing.tsx`). Retailer mode calls `POST /banners/for-retailer` (My Retailers) or `POST /banners/for-retailer/global` (All Retailers) with `retailers: [retailerID]`; delivery-method mode calls `POST /distributors/{distributorID}/banners` (2.4.3.1).
  2. Search (`searchKeyword`: banner, retailer or product name), sort (`DistributorBannerSortKeys`), page (pageSize 10, template pager). The first banner is auto-selected; selection is kept across refetches by `bannerID`.
  3. Right panel `BannerDataLayout` shows banner name, retailer, distributor, delivery method, markup, regions and a not-connected flag (`isNotConnected`), and the tab switcher (`products` default, `activities`, `rules`).
  4. In delivery-method mode with `can(distributors, update)`: row menu "Edit" opens `DistributorBannerBind` to change markup; the unlink icon removes the banner from the delivery method (2.4.3.1).
  5. Direct route `/{brandID}/banners/{bannerID}?tab=activities` (`[bannerID]/page.tsx`) loads the banner through `POST /banners/for-retailer/global` with `banners: [bannerID]`, `pageSize -1`; this is the link target of the banner-activity mention email.
  6. Admin `/banners` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/BannerTable.tsx`): list `GET /banners/for-admin` with facets from `POST /banners/for-admin/filter-options`, add/edit `caboodle.admin/src/component/Banners/AddBanners.tsx` (`POST /banners`), remove (`DELETE /banners`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/BannersController.cs` | Banners, SKUs, activities, promo rules (25 endpoints) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Banners/GetBannersRequest.cs` | Brand banners (through `DistributorBanners`) |
| `.../Banners/GetGlobalBannersRequest.cs` | All banners, flagged `IsNotConnected` when the brand has no `DistributorBanners` row |

##### 2.4.2.1 Sub-feature: Banner SKUs (products on a banner)

- **Status:** Active (`DELETE /banners/sku/duplicates` is a one-off cleanup and `GET /banners/skus/for-promo/filter-properties` has no caller; `GET /banners/skus` ignores its `bannerID` parameter)
- **What it does:** Records, per brand, which products are carried on which banner and their status (`SkuStatus`), active date, discontinue date and slotting. Brand and brokerage users manage them on the banner Products tab (module `distributors` or `retailers`, actions Create/Update/Delete); platform admins manage them on admin `/banner-skus`. Feeds promotion product selection, market overview, APL reports and the Simple Promotion grid.
- **User flow:**
  1. Products tab (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/banners/products/BannerProductListPage.tsx`) loads `POST /banners/{bannerID}/get-skus` with status and category filters; rows show product, UPC, category, status, dates, per-unit price and DCs.
  2. Add (shown when `can(distributors|retailers, create)`): `BannerSKUAddOrEdit` lists the brand's products from `GET /productspecs/for-bannersku/{bannerID}` (ProductSpecs), multi-select, status, and one date (sent as `activeDate` for Active, `discoDate` for Discontinued); `POST /banners/{bannerID}/skus`.
  3. Edit one row: `PATCH /banners/{bannerID}/skus`. Delete selected: `DELETE /banners/skus/delete`.
  4. Admin `/banner-skus` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/SkusTable.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/BannerSkus/AddBannerSku.tsx`): `POST /banners/skus/for-admin` with facets from `POST /banners/skus/filter-options`; create/update send `BrandID` + `OrganizationID` = brand (`brandSupportHeaders`, `caboodle.admin/src/helper/crmDataUpload.helper.ts`); the banner picker uses `POST /banners/for-retailer`.

DTOs in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/DTOs/BannerSkuDTO.cs` (`BannerSKUDTOForBrand` with `PerUnitPrice`, `DCs`; `BannerSKUPromoDTO`; `BannerSkuPagingListDTO`).

| GET | `/skus` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `bannerID?` (ignored), paging / `PagedData<BannerSKUDTO>` (brand's products) | `GetSKUsRequest` |

  Related: `POST /api/v1/admin/data-cleanup/bannersku` (`AdminController`, `BannerSKUDataCleanupRequest`) calls `ISharedDataService.SyncMarketOverviewWithCRM`. Background job: `IBackgroundJobDispatcher.CreateBannerSkus` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/BackgroundJob/BackgroundJobDispatcher.cs`) enqueues `ISharedDataService.CreateBannerSkusAsync` from ProductSpecs `UpsertProductSpecRequest` (new product) and `ImportProductsRequest`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Create: only products of the active brand are accepted (400 if none valid); a `(banner, product)` pair the brand already has is skipped; all skipped returns 400 "No new record has been added due to duplicate information."; partial result message "N out of M record(s) have been created...". `ActiveDate` kept only for Active, `DiscoDate` only for Discontinued (also on update). `Status` required on create.
  - Update: the SKU must belong to the active brand and to the banner in the route, else 404.
  - Delete: SKUs of another brand are ignored; SKUs whose `(BannerID, ProductID)` appears in a live `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionalEvents` row of the brand are not deleted; all blocked returns 400.
  - Products tab price = latest `PriceList` row (by `ValidFrom`) for the product and the banner's distributor (`DistributorBanners`); DCs = DCs referenced by the brand's market overview logs for that product and banner.
  - New product job: one `NotActive` SKU per non-deleted banner in the whole catalog for each new product (`SharedDataService.CreateBannerSkusAsync`).
  - Market overview update sets SKU status/dates with precedence rules (Active and Discontinued are not overwritten by Pending/Commit/Approved; `SharedDataService.PushMarketOverviewUpdatesIntoCRM`).
- **Dependencies:** ProductSpecs (products, categories, price list, `productspecs/for-bannersku`), TradeSpendSandbox (delete guard), Broker market overview (status sync, DCs), DataUpload KeHE/UNFI imports (`SaveBannerSKUsDataFromProvider`), 2.6 (`for-promo`), Simple Promotions (`caboodle.web/src/service/simpleEntry.service.ts`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** unknown or other-brand SKU IDs in delete are silently counted as deleted in the success message; update returns 404 for a SKU of another banner.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/SKUs/CreateBannerSKURequestTests.cs`, `GetBannerSkusForAdminRequestTests.cs`, `GetSkuFilterOptionsRequestTests.cs`; `.../Access/BrandScopedWritesTests.cs`. No tests for delete, list, for-promo, duplicates cleanup. Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/crm/BannerProductListGating.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The new-product job creates a SKU on every banner in the catalog, not only the brand's banners, so `BannerSKUs` grows with banners x products.
  - `GetBannerSKUsOfCurrentBrandRequest` INNER JOINs `Identity.Users` on `LastModifiedBy`, so a SKU last modified by a missing user (for example `Guid.Empty`) disappears from the list; the name is built as `FirstName || '' || LastName` (no space).
  - `DeleteBannerSKUDuplicatesRequest` declares `foundOnce` inside the loop, so it resets each item and the "keep one" logic keeps or deletes every item of a status rather than one.
  - `GET /banners/skus` has `bannerID` in its signature but `GetSKUsRequest` never filters by it.
  - Unreachable web code: `caboodle.web/src/components/retailers/SKUTable.tsx` and `AddSKU.tsx` (only reachable from the unimported `RetailerBannerSkusActivitesTable.tsx`).

No `can()` gating on these buttons.

- **Business rules:** upsert requires `RetailerID`, `BannerID`, `RegionID` (existence not checked); import matches retailer, banner and region by name case-insensitively against the whole catalog, accepts `Yes/Y/No/N` for OI/MCB/Scan, inserts valid rows and returns a CSV of failed rows ("[Row = n] message"); delete hard-deletes by ID, or `TRUNCATE`s the table when `DeleteAll` is true.
- **Tests:** None found.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Security: export, import, upsert and delete have no `[Authorize]` or module attribute and the handlers do no access check; the authorization fallback policy is null (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Permissions/PermissionPolicyProvider.cs`), so these routes accept anonymous calls, including `DeleteAll` (TRUNCATE).
  - `PromoRuleService.getPromoRules` sends no `BrandID` header (`caboodle.web/src/service/promo-rule.service.ts`) and `withDefaultAuthHeaders` adds none (`caboodle.web/src/helper/apiHeaders.ts`), while the handler requires a selected brand (`AccessContext.BrandRefusal`, "P1: no fallback"); the Rules tab list is expected to answer 400 "Select a brand." Not verified at runtime.
  - Rules are global (no brand column): every brand sees and can edit or delete the same rows.
  - Import matches banner by name without checking it belongs to the matched retailer, appends duplicates, and names the failed-rows file "Category Review Failed Records".

#### 2.4.3 Feature: Distributors and delivery methods

- **Status:** Active (no live caller for `GET /distributors/leaf/broker`, `GET /distributors/{id}/dcs`, `GET /distributors/{id}/retailers`, `POST /distributors/connect-retailer`, `DELETE /distributors`, `POST /distributors/sub-distributors/filter-options`; see Gotchas)
- **What it does:** Distributors are global companies; each can have delivery methods (sub-distributors, `Distributors.ParentID` = parent). Platform admins maintain both in the admin app. A brand (or a brokerage working on a connected brand) picks which distributors and which of their delivery methods it uses; those links drive banner linking (2.4.3.1), pricing (price list per distributor) and promotion distributor selection. Module `distributors` (View, Create, Delete) on the brand.
- **User flow:**
  1. Web CRM > Distributors (`/{brandID}/distributors`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/distributors/(distributor-list)/DistributorListPage.tsx`): grid or table of the brand's parent distributors (`GET /distributors`, search by name, sort `DistributorName`), each showing its connected delivery methods as text.
  2. Add (`can(distributors, create)`): `DistributorAdd` dialog lists the global catalog (`GET /distributors/global`) and connects the picked ones (`POST /distributors/connect-brand`).
  3. Delete (`can(distributors, delete)`) on a distributor: confirm, `DELETE /distributors/brand-distributor-connection/{ID}`.
  4. Open a distributor: `/{brandID}/distributors/{distributorID}` lists its delivery methods connected for the brand (`GET /distributors/sub-distributors/{parentID}`, with banner counts); Add lists `GET /distributors/sub-distributors/global/{parentID}` and connects with `POST /distributors/sub-distributors/connect`; delete calls `DELETE /distributors/sub-distributors/remove`.
  5. Open a delivery method: `/{brandID}/distributors/{deliveryMethodID}/banners` (header from `GET /distributors/{id}`) shows its banners (2.4.3.1).
  6. Admin `/distributors` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/DistributorsTable.tsx`, form `caboodle.admin/src/component/Distributor.tsx`): `GET /distributors/global`, `POST /distributors`. Admin `/sub-distributors` (`SubDistributorsTable.tsx`): `POST /distributors/sub-distributors/for-admin`, `POST /distributors/sub-distributors`. Admin price-list form uses `GET /distributors/leaf` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/PriceList/AddPriceList.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/DistributorsController.cs` | 24 endpoints |

- **Business rules:**
  - Connect to brand: IDs already linked to the brand are skipped; all already linked returns 400. IDs are not checked to exist or to be parents.
  - Connect delivery methods: the parent must be linked to the brand (400 otherwise); already-linked children skipped; empty list 400.
  - Remove distributor from brand: refused (400) when the brand has a live `ProductSpecs.PriceList` row or `DistributorRetailers` row for it, or a connected delivery method under it; otherwise hard `DELETE` of the `DistributorBrands` row(s) for that distributor and brand. The market-overview check is commented out.
  - Remove delivery method: parent must be a parent, child must belong to it and be linked to the brand; refused when referenced by `DistributorRetailers` or the brand's price list; removal uses EF `DeleteAsync`.
  - Admin delete: skips distributors linked to any brand (`DistributorBrands`); all linked returns 400; partial result returns 200 with "Unable to delete some Distributor(s)...".
  - Sub-distributor upsert: parent must exist and have no parent; an edited child must belong to the given parent.
  - Leaf list: brand-linked distributors that are delivery methods or have no children.
- **Dependencies:** ProductSpecs price list (delete guard, leaf picker in pricing screens `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/pricing/PricingAddOrEdit.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/productSpecs/AddPricingList.tsx`), 2.6 (leaf distributors), 2.4.3.1.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `GET /{id}` 404 when the distributor is not linked to the active brand; leaf broker list 400 when the user has no `BrandBroker` rows.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/Distributors/GetSubDistributorsForAdminRequestTests.cs`, `GetSubDistributorFilterOptionsRequestTests.cs`; `.../ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs`. No tests for connect/remove or brand lists. Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/crm/DistributorListGating.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Soft-delete mismatch: `RemoveSubDistributorFromBrandRequest` uses EF `DeleteAsync`, which `BaseDbContext` turns into setting `DeletedOn`/`DeletedBy` only; the `Deleted` bool stays false (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Context/BaseDbContext.cs`). Dapper reads filter on `Deleted = FALSE` (for example `GetDistributorsRequest`, `GetDistributorDeliveryMethodsRequest`), so a removed delivery method may still be listed. Needs runtime confirmation.
  - `GET /leaf/broker` is platform-admin only and resolves brands from the legacy `BrandBroker` table by user ID; its only web hook (`useLeafDistributorsForBroker`) is imported but never called in `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/AddOrEditCategoryReview.tsx`. `useDcsByDistributorId` is in the same state.
  - Web `useDeleteDistributor` (calls admin-only `DELETE /distributors`) is used only by `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor/DistributorPageHeader.tsx`, which has no importer; `DistributorsPageHeader.tsx`, `SubDistributorPageHeader.tsx` (and `AddDistributor`, `AddSubDistributor` behind them) and `LinkedRetailerTable.tsx` are unimported too.
  - `useDeleteRetailerFromDistributor` calls `DELETE /api/v1/distributors/retailers/remove`, which no controller defines.

##### 2.4.3.1 Sub-feature: Distributor banner links and markup

- **Status:** Active (`connect-banner` single link has no reachable caller; `connect-retailer` is legacy with no caller)
- **What it does:** For the active brand, links a banner to exactly one delivery method (or distributor) with a distributor markup percentage. These `DistributorBanners` rows are what make a banner and its retailer part of the brand's CRM ("My Retailers", banner lists, promotion pickers).
- **User flow:**
  1. On `/{brandID}/distributors/{deliveryMethodID}/banners` (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/distributors/[distributorID]/banners/page.tsx`) the banner list comes from `POST /distributors/{id}/banners`.
  2. "Add banners" opens `DistributorMultipleBannerBind`: banner options from `GET /banners/with-distributor-connection` (already connected ones disabled and labelled "(already connected)"), markup input, `POST /distributors/connect-banners`.
  3. Row menu "Edit" (`can(distributors, update)`) opens `DistributorBannerBind` in edit mode: `PATCH /distributors/update-markup`.
  4. Unlink icon: confirm "Unlink Banner", `DELETE /distributors/banners/remove`, then a dialog pointing to the Distributors page to reconnect elsewhere.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Distributors/{ConnectDistributorWithBannerRequest,ConnectDistributorWithBannersRequest,UpdateMarkupRequest,RemoveBannersFromDistributorRequest,GetDistributorBannersRequest,ConnectRetailerToDistributorRequest}.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/banners/{DistributorBannerBind,DistributorMultipleBannerBind}.tsx`.
- **Data:** `CRM.DistributorBanners` (index `(BrandID, BannerID, DistributorID)`); legacy `CRM.DistributorRetailers`. `DistributorBannerDTO`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/distributors`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/{distributorID}/banners` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | body `GetDistributorBannerPayload` (`searchKeyword`, `regions`), query paging, `sortKey` (`BannerName|RetailerName|DistributorMarkup|DoorCount`) / `PagedData<DistributorBannerDTO>` | `GetDistributorBannersRequest` |
| POST | `/connect-banner` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `ConnectDistributorWithBannerRequest` (`DistributorID`, `BannerID`, `DistributorMarkup >= 0`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `ConnectDistributorWithBannerRequest` |
| POST | `/connect-banners` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `ConnectDistributorWithBannersRequest` (`DistributorID`, `BannerIDs`, `DistributorMarkup >= 0`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `ConnectDistributorWithBannersRequest` |
| PATCH | `/update-markup` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, Update)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `UpdateMarkupRequest` (`DistributorID`, `BannerID`, `DistributorMarkup`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdateMarkupRequest` |
| DELETE | `/banners/remove` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, Delete)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `RemoveBannersFromDistributorRequest` (`DistributorID`, `BannerIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `RemoveBannersFromDistributorRequest` |
| POST | `/connect-retailer` | `RequireModule(distributors, null, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `ConnectRetailerToDistributorRequest` (`DistributorID`, `RetailerID`, `DistributorMarkup`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (declared `DistributorDetailsDTO`) | `ConnectRetailerToDistributorRequest` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Single link: distributor and banner must exist; a banner already linked to any distributor for the brand is refused (with a 404 status and message "Banner is already connected with another Distributor!").
  - Bulk link: every banner must exist (404 otherwise); refused only when a banner is already linked to the same distributor.
  - Markup update requires an existing `(brand, distributor, banner)` row (404).
  - Unlink: distributor must be linked to the brand; banners referenced by a live `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents` row for that brand and distributor are kept; others are hard-`DELETE`d; all referenced returns 400; partial returns 400 after deleting the rest.
  - Retailer link (legacy): retailer exists, distributor linked to brand, one retailer link per brand.
- **Dependencies:** TradeSpend approved promo events (unlink guard), `GET /banners/with-distributor-connection` (2.4.2), price list lookups (markup and distributor feed pricing in 2.4.2.1 and 2.6).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/Access/BrandScopedWritesTests.cs` (brand scoping). No dedicated link tests.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The bulk endpoint only checks duplicates against the same distributor, so through the API a banner can be linked to two distributors for one brand; the web multi-bind dialog prevents it by disabling connected banners. Brand banner lists then show `MAX(...)` of two rows (`GetBannersRequest` groups by banner).
  - Unlink checks only approved promo events, not sandbox events.
  - `PopulateDistributorBannerDataAsync` (commented-out call) is the old migration from `DistributorRetailers` to `DistributorBanners`; `DistributorRetailers` is still read by `GET /retailers/{id}` and the remove-distributor guards but has no live writer.

#### 2.4.4 Feature: Distribution centers (warehouses)

- **Status:** Active (web hooks `useGetDCs`, `useAddDistributorCenter`, `useUpsertDistributorDC` in `caboodle.web/src/hooks/dcs.ts` have no caller)
- **What it does:** Two global warehouse lists maintained by platform admins: `DistributionCenters` (a bare warehouse name list) and `DistributorDcs` (a warehouse of a distributor in a region). `DistributorDcs` is what broker market overview logs and the banner SKU DC column reference. Brokerage users search it when logging a market overview (module `market-overview`, broker side).
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin `/dcs` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/DCsTable.tsx`, form `caboodle.admin/src/component/DCs/AddDistributorCenter.tsx`): `GET /distributioncenter/dcs`, `POST /distributioncenter/dcs`.
  2. Admin `/distributor-dc` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/DistributionDcTable.tsx`, form `caboodle.admin/src/component/DestributorDC/AddDistributorDC.tsx`): `POST /distributioncenter/distributor/dcs/search` with facets from `POST /distributioncenter/for-admin/filter-options` (`Region`, `Warehouses`, `Distributors`); create/edit `POST /distributioncenter/distributor/dcs` (distributor and region pickers).
  3. Web broker Add Market Overview Log uses the same search endpoint (`useGetDistributorDC` in `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/AddMarketOverview.tsx`, service `caboodle.web/src/service/dcs.service.ts` `getDistributorDCs`), mapping `dcName` to `warehouse` and `regionID` to `regionIds`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/DistributionCenterController.cs` | 5 endpoints, route `/api/v1/distributioncenter` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Distributors/Dc/GetDistributorsDcsRequest.cs`, `DistributorDcFilterConditionBuilder.cs`, `Filters/GetDcFilterOptionsRequest.cs` | Search and facets |
| `.../Distributors/Dc/GetDcsRequest.cs`, `UpsertDcRequest.cs` | `DistributionCenters` list and upsert |
| `.../Distributors/Dc/UpsertDistributorDCRequest.cs` | `DistributorDcs` upsert |
| `.../Distributors/Dc/GetDistributorDcsRequest.cs` | Brand-scoped DCs of one distributor (`GET /distributors/{id}/dcs`, 2.4.3) |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/dcs.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/dcs.service.ts` | Clients |

- **Data:** `CRM.DistributionCenters` (`Warehouse`); `CRM.DistributorDcs` (`DistributorID`, `RegionID`, `Warehouse`). `DCDTO`, `DistributorDcDTO` (`ID`, `DistributorID`, `DistributorName`, `Warehouse`, `RegionID`, `RegionName`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/distributioncenter`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/distributor/dcs/search` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandCatalogModuleAsync(None, MarketOverview, View)` (platform admin always) | `GetDistributorsDcsRequest` (`Query, Warehouse, Warehouses, DistributorName, DistributorIds, RegionIds`, paging) / `PagedData<DistributorDcDTO>` | `GetDistributorsDcsRequest` |
| POST | `/for-admin/filter-options` | `MustHavePermission(View, Distributors, Distributor)` | filters + `PropertyName` (`Region|Warehouses|Distributors`) / `DcFilterOptionsResult` | `GetDcFilterOptionsRequest` |

| POST | `/dcs` | `MustHavePermission(Upsert, Distributors, Distributor)` | `UpsertDCRequest` (`ID?`, `Warehouse`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (declared `DCDTO`) | `UpsertDCRequest` |
| POST | `/distributor/dcs` | `MustHavePermission(Upsert, Distributors, Distributor)` | `UpsertDistributorDCRequest` (`ID?`, `DistributorID`, `RegionID`, `Warehouse`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertDistributorDCRequest` |

- **Business rules:** distributor and region must exist (404); warehouse required and trimmed; search orders by distributor name ASC regardless of `SortingOrder`; brand view (`GET /distributors/{id}/dcs`) requires the distributor to be linked to the brand.
- **Dependencies:** Broker market overview (DC on log, `DCID` optional since migration `20260916105755_MarketOverviewDCIDMadeOptional`), 2.4.2.1 (DC column from market overview), 2.4.5 regions, 2.10 exports (`/masterdataupload/distribution-centers`, `/masterdataupload/distributor-dc`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** no delete endpoint for either table.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/Distributors/Dc/GetDistributorsDcsRequestTests.cs`, `GetDcFilterOptionsRequestTests.cs`.

#### 2.4.5 Feature: Regions and retailer-region links

- **Status:** Partial (customer-app map uses a hardcoded region-to-state list, not API data; `caboodle.web/src/components/Regions/RegionsTable.tsx` is unused)
- **What it does:** Regions are global named areas (`Address` holds the states, shown as "States"). `RetailerRegions` says a retailer (optionally a specific banner) operates in a region; banner and retailer lists, promotion pickers, promo rules and exports read regions through these links. Platform admins maintain both; brand users view the region list and a US map. Web route gate: module `regions`.
- **User flow:**
  1. Web CRM > Regions (`/{brandID}/regions`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/regions/page.tsx`): search by name, map `RegionsHitmap.tsx` (Mapbox, colours US states by a hardcoded list of 11 regions and fetches `/us-states.geojson`), table `RegionsTable.tsx` (region, states) from `GET /regions` with `pageSize -1`.
  2. Admin `/regions` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/RegionsTable.tsx`, form `caboodle.admin/src/component/Region/AddRegion.tsx`): `GET /regions`, `POST /regions`.
  3. Admin `/regions-retailer` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/RetailerRegionTable.tsx`, form `caboodle.admin/src/component/RetailerRegion/AddRetailerRegion.tsx`): `POST /regions/retailers` with facets from `POST /regions/retailers/filter-options`; create/edit `POST /regions/retailer-region`; the form's pickers use the admin hooks `useRetailers` (`GET /retailers/global`), `useGetRegions` (`GET /regions`) and `useGetBanners` (`GET /banners/for-admin`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/RegionsController.cs` | 5 endpoints |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Region/GetRegionsRequest.cs` | Region list (catalog check) |
| `.../Region/UpsertRegionRequest.cs` | Region upsert and rename job |
| `.../Region/GetRetailerRegionsRequest.cs`, `RetailerRegionFilterConditionBuilder.cs`, `GetRetailerRegionsFilterOptionsRequest.cs` | Admin link list and facets (`Banner`, `Retailer`, `Region`) |
| `.../Region/UpsertRetailerRegionRequest.cs` | Link upsert |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/market-overview.ts` (`useGetRegions`), `caboodle.web/src/service/market-overview.service.ts` (`GET /regions`) | Web region list client |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/regions.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/retailerRegion.service.ts` | Admin clients |

- **Data:** `CRM.Regions`; `CRM.RetailerRegions` (index `(RetailerID, BannerID)`). `RegionDTO`, `RetailerRegionDTO` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/DTOs/RegionDTO.cs`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/regions`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| POST | `/retailers` | `MustHavePermission(View, RetailerRegions, Retailer)` | `GetRetailerRegionsRequest` (`Query, BannerIDs, RetailerIDs, RegionIDs`, paging) / `PagedData<RetailerRegionDTO>` | `GetRetailerRegionsRequest` |
| POST | `/retailers/filter-options` | `MustHavePermission(View, RetailerRegions, Retailer)` | filters + `PropertyName` / `Dictionary<string, List<FilterItemDTO>>` | `GetRetailerRegionsFilterOptionsRequest` |

| POST | `/retailer-region` | `MustHavePermission(Upsert, RetailerRegions, Retailer)` | `UpsertRetailerRegionRequest` (`ID?`, `RetailerID`, `RegionID`, `BannerID?`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertRetailerRegionRequest` |

  Job: region rename enqueues `IRegionNameChangePropagationService.PropagateAsync` (2.4.9).
- **Business rules:** region name required and trimmed; link requires existing retailer and region, and a banner (when given) that belongs to that retailer; the `(retailer, region, banner)` combination must be unique among live links (400); editing a link that is not found is 404.
- **Dependencies:** every brand banner/retailer query (2.4.1, 2.4.2, 2.4.3.1), promo rules (2.4.2.3), store list `RegionId` (2.14), market overview (region on log), Sales Tracker (catalog slug). The admin `retailerRegion.service.ts` also wraps the 2.9 Broker helper routes (`GET /brokers/{regionID}/get-retailers`, `GET /brokers/{retailerID}/regions/{regionID}/banners`), used by `caboodle.admin/src/component/DataMapComponent/EditMappedData.tsx` (2.14), not by the region screens.

- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The upsert allows a link with no banner, but the admin list and facets INNER JOIN `Banners`, so banner-less links never show in the admin screen; brand banner queries also match links on `BannerID`, so a retailer-level link without a banner gives no region to any banner.
  - `UpsertRetailerRegionRequest` loads every link into memory to check duplicates.
  - The customer map hardcodes region names, IDs and states and a Mapbox public token in `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/regions/RegionsHitmap.tsx`; new or renamed regions are not reflected.

#### 2.4.6 Feature: Contacts

- **Status:** Active (`POST /contacts/for-admin/filter-options` has no caller)
- **What it does:** Brand-scoped address book (first and last name, email, phone, business name, title, notes). Contacts are picked on banner and pipeline activities. Brand and brokerage users manage them under CRM > Contacts (module `contacts`: View, Create, Update, Delete, Export); platform admins can list all brands' contacts and add or edit one for a chosen brand.
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/contacts` (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/contacts/page.tsx`): grid of `ContactCard` or table, search (`searchKeyword` over names, email, phone, business name, notes, title), sort by `ContactColumns`, pager; `GET /contacts`.
  2. Add (`can(contacts, create)`) / Edit (row menu, `can(contacts, update)`): `ContactAddOrEdit.tsx` requires first name, last name and a valid email client-side, phone optional (7+ chars); `POST /contacts`.
  3. Delete selected (`can(contacts, delete)`): `DELETE /contacts` `{ids}`. Export (`can(contacts, export)`): all rows CSV via `GET /contacts/export`.
  4. Admin `/contacts` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/ContactsTable.tsx`): `GET /contacts/for-admin` (brands, names, email, phone, business names filters); add/edit `caboodle.admin/src/component/Contacts/AddContact.tsx` sends `POST /contacts` with `BrandID` and `OrganizationID` = chosen brand (support access, `caboodle.admin/src/services/contact.service.ts`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/ContactsController.cs` | 6 endpoints |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Contacts/UpsertContactRequest.cs` | Create/update with duplicate checks |
| `.../Contacts/GetContactsRequest.cs`, `ExportContactsRequest.cs`, `DeleteContactsRequest.cs` | Brand list, CSV, delete |
| `.../Contacts/GetContactsForAdminRequest.cs`, `ContactFilterConditionBuilder.cs`, `GetContactFilterOptionsRequest.cs` | Admin list and facets (`Brands`, `BusinessNames`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/contacts/*`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/contact.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/caboodle.service.ts` (`getAllContacts`, `exportContacts`, `upsertContact`, `deleteContacts`) | Web |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/contact.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/ContactsTable.tsx` | Admin |

- **Data:** `CRM.Contacts` (`BrandID` + contact fields); `ContactDTO` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/DTOs/ContactDTO.cs`). Referenced by `BannerActivities.ContactID` and `PipelineActivities.ContactID`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/contacts`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/` | `RequireModule(contacts, null, View)` + `BrandIDHeader`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(contacts, Create or Update)` | `UpsertContactRequest` (`ID?`, `FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`, `PhoneNumber`, `BusinessName`, `ContactNotes`, `Title`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (declared `ContactDTO`) | `UpsertContactRequest` |
| DELETE | `/` | `RequireModule(contacts, null, Delete)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `DeleteContactsRequest` (`IDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteContactsRequest` |
| GET | `/` | `Authorize` + `BrandIDHeader`; handler `DemandAnyModuleAsync(ContactLookup: contacts, pipelines, distributors, retailers; View)` | `searchKeyword`, paging, `sortKey` (`FirstName|LastName|Email|PhoneNumber`) / `PagedData<ContactDTO>` | `GetContactsRequest` |
| GET | `/export` | `RequireModule(contacts, null, Export)` + `BrandIDHeader` | same query / CSV | `ExportContactsRequest` |
| GET | `/for-admin` | `MustHavePermission(View, Contacts, Contact)` | `searchKey, brandIDs[], firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, businessNames[]`, paging / `PagedData<ContactDTO>` | `GetContactsForAdminRequest` |
| POST | `/for-admin/filter-options` | `MustHavePermission(View, Contacts, Contact)` | filters + `PropertyName` / `ContactFilterOptionsResult` | `GetContactFilterOptionsRequest` |

- **Business rules:**
  - No FluentValidator: the backend accepts a contact with every field blank; all fields are trimmed to empty string.
  - Email and phone must be unique within the brand among live contacts (email case-insensitive, phone exact), 400 otherwise.
  - Edit only finds contacts of the active brand (404 otherwise).
  - Delete soft-deletes only the brand's contacts not referenced by a live banner activity; nothing deleted returns 400; partial returns 400 after deleting the rest.
- **Dependencies:** banner activities (2.4.2.2) and pipeline activities (2.4.7.2) as consumers; 2.10 Master Data Upload (`/masterdataupload/contacts`) for admin import/export.
- **Errors & edge cases:** pipeline activity references are not checked on delete, so a contact used only by pipeline activities can be deleted (the activity then shows no contact name).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/Contacts/GetContactsForAdminRequestTests.cs`, `GetContactFilterOptionsRequestTests.cs`; `.../Access/BrandScopedWritesTests.cs`. No tests for the duplicate rules or delete. Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/crm/ContactsPageGating.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Blank values collide: a missing phone is stored as `""`, and the duplicate check compares `""` to `""`, so a brand can have only one contact without a phone number (and one without an email); the second save returns "A contact with the same Phone Number already exists." (`UpsertContactRequestHandler.ValidateDuplicateContact`).
  - `UpsertContactRequestHandler` loads every contact of every brand into memory and filters in C#.
  - The POST route attribute requires only View; the real Create/Update check is inside the handler.
  - Admin list falls back to `QueryHelper.RetailerColumns[0]` (`Name`) as default sort key, which `ValidateSortKey` then replaces with the first contact column.
  - Unreachable web modal `caboodle.web/src/components/contacts/AddContactModal.tsx` (only imported by the unimported `BannerTable.tsx`).

#### 2.4.7 Feature: Pipeline (plans and tasks)

- **Status:** Active (`POST /pipelines/plans/add-default` is a one-off platform-admin migration)
- **What it does:** A brand-scoped kanban for sales work. A plan (`PipelinePlans`) holds tasks (`Pipelines`, optionally tied to a retailer); tasks sit in deal-stage columns and can be dragged to reorder or move stage. Each task has an activity log (2.4.7.2). Module `pipelines` (View, Create, Update, Delete) on the brand.
- **User flow:**
  1. CRM > Pipeline (`/{brandID}/pipeline`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/pipeline/page.tsx`): plans table (title, task count, stages used, created by) from `GET /pipelines/plans`; search by title; Add/Edit plan (`PlanAddOrEdit.tsx`, `POST /pipelines/plans`); delete selected plans (`DELETE /pipelines/plans`). The selected plan, page, size, sort and search persist in the URL (`selectedPlanId` etc.); `pipelineSelection.ts` `resolveSelectedPlan` restores the selection by ID.
  2. Selecting a plan shows `PipelineTasks.tsx`: columns = deal stages, cards = tasks from `GET /pipelines/{planID}/tasks` (`pageSize -1`).
  3. Add task (`can(pipelines, create)`): title only, created in the first stage (`POST /pipelines`, `pipelineDealStageID` = first column, `planID`).
  4. Drag a card (`can(pipelines, update)`): same column calls `PUT /pipelines/reorder` (`order` = new index + 1); other column calls `PUT /pipelines/change-deal-stage-state`; the board updates optimistically then refetches.
  5. Click a card: `/{brandID}/pipeline/{taskID}` shows the task (`GET /pipelines/{id}`), edit title/retailer (`ActivitiesPageHeader`, `POST /pipelines` with ID), delete task (`DELETE /pipelines`, then back to the board), and the activity log.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/PipeLinesController.cs` | 18 endpoints, route `/api/v1/pipelines` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/PipeLines/Plan/{GetPlansRequest,UpsertPlanRequest,DeletePlansRequest,CreateDefaultPlanRequest}.cs` | Plans |
| `.../PipeLines/PipeLine/{GetPipeLinesRequest,GetPipeLineRequest,UpsertPipeLineRequest,ReOrderPipeLineRequest,UpdatePipeLineDealStageStateRequest,DeletePipeLineRequest}.cs` | Tasks |
| `.../Helper/PipelineRecords.cs` | Brand ownership checks (other brand = 404) |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/pipeline/*`, `caboodle.web/src/components/pipeline/AddPipeline.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/activities/ActivitiesPageHeader.tsx` | Web board and task page |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/pipeline.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/pipeline.service.ts` | Web data layer |

- **Data:** `CRM.PipelinePlans` (`BrandID`, `Title`); `CRM.Pipelines` (`Name`, `PlanID?`, `BrandID`, `PipelineDealStageID`, `RetailerID?`, `DisplayOrder`); `CRM.PipelineDealStages` (2.4.7.1). DTOs in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/DTOs/PipeLineDTOs.cs` (`PipelinePlanListDTO`, `PipeLineListDTO` per stage, `PipeLineDTO`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/pipelines`; activity, file, mention and deal-stage routes in sub-features)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/plans` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `title`, paging, `sortKey` (`Title`) / `PagedData<PipelinePlanListDTO>` (declared as list) | `GetPlansRequest` |
| POST | `/plans` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(pipelines, Create or Update)` | `UpsertPlanRequest` (`ID?`, `Title`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertPlanRequest` |
| POST | `/plans/add-default` | `MustHavePermission(Clean, DataCleanup, Admin)` | empty / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `CreateDefaultPlanRequest` |
| DELETE | `/plans` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Delete)` | `DeletePlansRequest` (`PlanIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePlansRequest` |
| GET | `/{planID}/tasks` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)` | `name`, paging / `List<PipeLineListDTO>` (one entry per visible deal stage) | `GetPipeLinesRequest` |
| GET | `/{id}` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)` | / `PipeLineDTO` | `GetPipeLineRequest` |
| POST | `/` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)`; handler Create or Update | `UpsertPipeLineRequest` (`ID?`, `Title`, `PipelineDealStageID`, `RetailerID?`, `PlanID`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertPipeLineRequest` |
| PUT | `/reorder` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Update)` | `ReOrderPipeLineRequest` (`PipelineID`, `PipelineDealStageID`, `Order`) / `PipeLineDTO` | `ReOrderPipeLineRequest` |
| PUT | `/change-deal-stage-state` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Update)` | `UpdatePipeLineDealStageStateRequest` (`PipelineID`, `PreviousDealStageID`, `NewDealStageID`, `Order`) / `PipeLineDTO` | `UpdatePipeLineDealStageStateRequest` |
| DELETE | `/` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Delete)` | `DeletePipeLineRequest` (`PipelineID`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePipeLineRequest` |

  All routes except `add-default` also carry `BrandIDHeader`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Plan title required; plan edit or task create needs a plan of the active brand (404).
  - Plan delete soft-deletes only the brand's plans with no live task; all selected having tasks returns 400; otherwise 200 with a "Some of the plans could not be deleted" message when partial.
  - Task create: deal stage must be global or the brand's own; retailer (optional) must exist; `DisplayOrder` = last order in that stage for the brand + 1. Update changes only title and retailer.
  - Reorder: order must be > 0 and different, task must already be in the given stage; one UPDATE shifts the neighbours between old and new positions.
  - Stage move: both stages must be visible to the brand and differ; order is clamped to last + 1; three statements close the gap in the old stage, open a slot in the new stage and move the task.
  - Delete task: closes the gap in its stage, soft-deletes the task (order set to -1) and soft-deletes its activities.
  - `add-default`: for every brand that has pipelines, creates a "Default Plan" and assigns every pipeline of the brand to it.
- **Dependencies:** 2.4.1 (retailer on task), 2.4.7.1 deal stages, 2.2 access.
- **Errors & edge cases:** other-brand task or activity IDs answer 404 (`PipelineRecords`); `GET /{planID}/tasks` pages tasks across all stages, so the web asks for `pageSize -1`.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/PipeLines/PipelineRecordAccessTests.cs`, `PipelineUpsertAccessTests.cs`, `PipelineActivityUpsertTests.cs`; `.../Access/BrandFlowTests.cs`. Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/pipeline/pipelineSelection.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/crm/PipelinePageGating.test.tsx`, `PipelineTasksGating.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `DisplayOrder` is kept per brand and stage across all plans, but the board sends `order` = index within the current plan's column (`PipelineTasks.tsx` `onDragEnd`). With tasks of two plans in one stage the stored order and the drop position disagree.
  - `UpdatePipeLineDealStageStateRequest` does not check the task is in `PreviousDealStageID`; the stage-move and task-delete statements run through `QueryMultipleAsync` with no explicit transaction.
  - `GetPlansRequest` INNER JOINs `Identity.Users` on `CreatedBy` (plans created by a missing user vanish) and builds `PipelineStages` JSON by string concatenation (a quote in a stage name breaks parsing).
  - `CreateDefaultPlanRequest` does not skip pipelines that already have a plan, so a second run reassigns everything to a new "Default Plan".
  - The create/edit routes are gated on View at the attribute; the real Create/Update check is inside the handlers.

##### 2.4.7.1 Sub-feature: Pipeline deal stages (configuration)

- **Status:** Active (admin rename); brand-specific stage creation is Partial (hidden from Swagger, no UI)
- **What it does:** Deal stages are the board columns. Global stages (`BrandID` null) are seeded by migration `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrations/20230814061003_BusinessTablesCreation.cs` and can only be renamed by platform admins (admin `/pipeline-config`). A brand can also own extra stages (`BrandID` set) through a hidden endpoint.
- **User flow:** Admin `/pipeline-config` (`caboodle.admin/src/component/Pipeline/PipelineStages.tsx`) lists global stages in order and renames one inline (Enter to save). No add, delete or reorder.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/PipeLine/{GetAllPipeLineDealStagesRequest,UpdatePipeLineDealStageRequest}.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/PipeLines/DealStage/{CreatePipeLineDealStageRequest,GetPipeLineDealStagesRequest}.cs`; `caboodle.admin/src/services/pipeline-config.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/pipeline.ts`.
- **Data:** `CRM.PipelineDealStages` (`BrandID?`, `DealStage`, `DisplayOrder`); `PipeLineDealStageDTO`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/pipelines/dealstages` | `MustHavePermission(View, PipeLineDealStage, PipeLine)` | paging / `PagedData<PipeLineDealStageDTO>` (global stages only) | `GetAllPipeLineDealStagesRequest` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/admin/pipelines/dealstages` | `MustHavePermission(Update, PipeLineDealStage, PipeLine)` | `UpdatePipeLineDealStageRequest` (`ID`, `Name`) / `PipeLineDealStageDTO` | `UpdatePipeLineDealStageRequest` |
| POST | `/api/v1/pipelines/dealstages` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader`, `ApiExplorerSettings(IgnoreApi)` | `CreatePipeLineDealStageRequest` (`Name`) / `PipeLineDealStageDTO` | `CreatePipeLineDealStageRequest` |
| GET | `/api/v1/pipelines/dealstages` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)` + `BrandIDHeader`, `IgnoreApi` | paging / `PagedData<PipeLineDealStageDTO>` | `GetPipeLineDealStagesRequest` |

- **Business rules:** admin edits only global stages (a brand-owned stage is 404); brand stage create appends after the highest order of global plus brand stages.
- **Tests:** None found for deal stages.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** stages can only be renamed, never added or removed globally; the brand-specific stage endpoints have no web caller.

##### 2.4.7.2 Sub-feature: Pipeline activities, attachments and mentions

- **Status:** Active (banner mirroring is backend-only: the web form never sends `BannerID`)
- **What it does:** A task's timeline: entries with date/time, optional contact, rich-text description, @mentions (emailed) and file attachments stored in S3. An entry may be mirrored into the banner activity log when created with a `BannerID`.
- **User flow:** On `/{brandID}/pipeline/{taskID}` (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(crm)/pipeline/[taskID]/page.tsx`) the list comes from `GET /pipelines/{pipelineID}/activities`; Add/Edit (`can(pipelines, create|update)`) opens `AddActivityModal` with date, contact (`GET /contacts`), notes editor with mention picker (`GET /pipelines/mentions?brandId=`), and file drop (`DraggerFileActivities`, chunked `POST /pipelines/file-upload` against the saved activity ID); removing a file calls `DELETE /pipelines/file`; delete entry calls `DELETE /pipelines/{pipelineID}/activities/{activityID}/delete`.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/PipeLines/Activity/{UpsertPipeLineActivityRequest,GetPipeLineActivitiesRequest,DeletePipeLineActivityRequest,UploadActivityFileRequest,DeleteActivityFileRequest,GetUsersToMentionInActivityRequest}.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/components/retailers/AddActivityModal.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/activities/{Activities,ActivityFiles}.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/DraggerFileActivities.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/activity.ts`.
- **Data:** `CRM.PipelineActivities` (`PipelineID`, `BannerActivityID?`, `ContactID?`, `DateTimeAt`, `Description`); `CRM.PipelineActivityFiles` (`PipelineActivityID`, `Name`, `Extension`, `Size`, `URL`). S3 prefix `CaboodleFiles/PipelineActivity/` (`Constants.CABOODLEPIPELINEACTIVITYFILES`); stored URL is the object URL with the query string stripped (`AwsS3StorageService.GetFileUrl`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageService.cs`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/pipelines`; all with `BrandIDHeader` except `mentions`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/{pipelineID}/activities` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)` | paging / `PagedData<PipeLineActivityDTO>` (with `Files`) | `GetPipeLineActivitiesRequest` |
| POST | `/{pipelineID}/activities` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, View)`; handler Create or Update | `PipeLineActivityPayload` (`ID?`, `BannerID?`, `BannerActivityID?`, `DateTimeAT`, `ContactID?`, `Description`, `MentionedUserIDs?`) / `ResponseMessageDTO` (`ID`, `Message`) | `UpsertPipeLineActivityRequest` |
| DELETE | `/{pipelineID}/activities/{activityID}/delete` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Delete)` | query `bannerActivityID` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePipeLineActivityRequest` |
| POST | `/file-upload` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Update)`, `DisableRequestSizeLimit` | query `fileName, pipelineActivityID, chunkIndex, chunkMax, uploadId, prevETags, key`, raw body chunk / `ChunkObjectDto` | `UploadActivityFileRequest` |
| DELETE | `/file` | `RequireModule(pipelines, null, Update)` | `DeleteActivityFileRequest` (`ID`, `URL`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteActivityFileRequest` |
| GET | `/mentions` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandBrandAsync(brandID)` | query `brandID`, `name` / `IList<UserDTO>` | `GetUsersToMentionInActivityRequest` |

  Email: `IMailService.SendMailToMentionedUsersInPipelineActivityAsync`, link `{AppUrls:BaseUrl}/{brandID}/pipeline/{pipelineID}`, recipients limited to `BrandMentionSql.EmailsOfUsers`.
- **Business rules:** `DateTimeAT` required; task and contact must belong to the active brand; on create with `BannerID` a `BannerActivity` is created and linked; on update the linked banner activity is updated, replaced or removed to follow `BannerID`; file names need an extension; the file row is written only when the last chunk completes.
- **Dependencies:** `IFileStorageService` (S3 multipart), `IMailService` (SES, `AppUrls:BaseUrl` config), 2.4.6 contacts, 2.4.2.2 banner activities, 2.2 membership tables for mentions.
- **Errors & edge cases:** a failed S3 delete returns 200 with "Sorry, we couldn't delete the file" and keeps the row.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/PipeLines/PipelineActivityUpsertTests.cs`, `PipelineRecordAccessTests.cs`. No upload or mention tests.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Soft-delete mismatch again: file removal and banner-activity unlinking use EF `DeleteAsync` (sets `DeletedOn` only), while `GetPipeLineActivitiesRequest` and `GetBannerActivitiesRequest` filter on `Deleted = FALSE`, so removed files and unlinked banner activities may keep appearing. Needs runtime confirmation.
  - The web delete call never sends `bannerActivityID` (`caboodle.web/src/service/pipeline.service.ts` `deletePipelineActivity`), so a mirrored banner activity would survive its pipeline entry.
  - Stored file URL is the bare S3 object URL; access depends on bucket policy, not on a signed link.
  - The mention list takes `brandID` from the query string (not the header) and is checked with `DemandBrandAsync`.

#### 2.4.9 Feature: CRM rename propagation (background jobs)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** CRM names are copied as text into many reporting tables. When a platform admin renames a retailer, banner or region, the upsert handler enqueues a Hangfire job that rewrites the old name in those tables so reports keep grouping correctly.
- **User flow:** Admin edits a retailer, banner or region name; the save returns at once; the job runs in the background and logs the row counts per table.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Retailers/UpsertRetailerRequest.cs` | Enqueues `IRetailerNameChangePropagationService` on rename |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Banners/UpsertBannerRequest.cs` | Enqueues `IBannerNameChangePropagationService` with the scoping retailer name (old retailer if the banner moved) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Region/UpsertRegionRequest.cs` | Enqueues `IRegionNameChangePropagationService` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Propagation/*.cs` | Services and `NameChangePropagationServiceBase` (trim, case-insensitive match, per-table counts) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/NameChangePropagationDTOs.cs` | `RetailerNameChange`, `BannerNameChange`, `RegionNameChange`, result |

- **Data (tables rewritten):**
  - Retailer: `DataHub.StoreListEntries.RetailerName` (by `RetailerId`, or by old name where `RetailerId` is null), `DataUpload.KeHeMappedRecords.RetailerName`, `DataUpload.UNFIMappedRecords.ChainName` and `Chain`, `DataUpload.DistributorSalesRecords.RetailerName`, `TradeSpend.BrandApprovedMonthlyReport.Retailer`, `TradeSpendSandbox.SandboxMonthlyReport.Retailer`, `DataHub.UnifiedEntities.DisplayName` (retailer entity by `CrmRetailerId` or name).
  - Banner: `DataHub.StoreListEntries.BannerName` (by `BannerId`, or name plus retailer name), `Banner` column of `KeHeMappedRecords`, `UNFIMappedRecords`, `DistributorSalesRecords` (by linked store or name plus retailer), `Banner` of both monthly report tables.
  - Region: `Region` column of `DataHub.StoreListEntries`, `DataUpload.UNFIMappedRecords`, `DataUpload.DistributorSalesRecords`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** no endpoint; jobs enqueued through `IJobService.Enqueue<T>` (Hangfire) with `CancellationToken.None`.
- **Business rules:** a job is enqueued only on update and only when the trimmed name changed (ordinal compare); the service itself skips when old or new name is blank or they are equal ignoring case; matching is `LOWER(TRIM(...))`. When a retailer rename starts outside CRM (DataHub unified entity, no `RetailerID`), the service instead renames the CRM retailer whose name matches, only if exactly one matches.
- **Dependencies:** Hangfire, DataHub (2.14), DataUpload (KeHE, UNFI, Distributor Sales), TradeSpend and TradeSpendSandbox monthly reports; DataHub `UnifiedEntityRenamePropagation` calls the retailer service (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Application/EntityResolution/Services/UnifiedEntityRenamePropagation.cs`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** a case-only rename enqueues a job that does nothing; name matching can touch rows of a different entity with the same text (mitigated by ID matching where IDs exist).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Propagation/{Retailer,Banner,Region,Store}NameChangePropagationServiceTests.cs`; enqueue checks in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/{Retailers/UpsertRetailerRequestTests,Banners/UpsertBannerRequestTests,Region/UpsertRegionRequestTests}.cs` (helper `.../Propagation/PropagationJobCapture.cs`).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** names stored as text in reporting tables mean any rename path that bypasses these handlers (Master Data Upload, direct SQL) leaves reports stale; the Master Data Upload code (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/MasterDataUpload/`) does not reference any propagation service, so a rename done by bulk import (if imports update names, see 2.10) is not propagated.
