### 2.5 Module: Product Specifications

- **Purpose:** Owns a brand's product master data: categories, product specifications (SKU attributes, UPCs, pack and pallet data, distributor item codes) and the price list (per-unit price per product, distributor or delivery method, and start date). Products and prices feed trade promotions, banner SKUs, reports and data-ingestion matching.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/ProductSpecs/CategoriesController.cs`, `PriceListsController.cs`, `ProductSpecsController.cs`; admin bulk routes in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataUpload/MasterDataUploadController.cs` (`categories`, `price-list`, `productspecs` actions); `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Admin/AdminController.cs` (`SyncPerUnitPriceAsync`).
  - Backend module: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/` (`Categories/`, `ProductSpecifications/`, `PriceList/`, `ExportImport/`, `Specifications/`, `Helpers/QueryHelper.cs`, `Helpers/ProductSpecModules.cs`, `DTOs/`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Domain/` (`Category`, `ProductSpecification`, `PriceList`).
  - Shared services used: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs` (`UpdatePromoEventsPerUnitPrice`, `SyncPerUnitPriceAsync`, `CreateBannerSkusAsync`), `.../SharedDataService/SharedDataHubService.cs` (`PropagateProductNameChangeByUpcAsync`, `PropagateCasePackChangeByUpcAsync`), `.../Services/BackgroundJob/BackgroundJobDispatcher.cs`, `.../Services/MasterDataUpload/MasterDataUploadService.cs` (admin imports/exports), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/ProductSpec/` (admin import/export requests).
  - Web: routes `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/` (`categories`, `categories/[categoryID]`, `products`, `products/add`, `products/[productID]`, `products/[productID]/edit`, `pricing`, shared `ProductSpecsLayout.tsx`, `ProductListing.tsx`); services `caboodle.web/src/service/category.service.ts`, `product.service.ts`, `priceList.service.ts`, `sampleFile.service.ts`; hooks `caboodle.web/src/hooks/product-spec/{category,product,priceList}.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/sampleFilesHook.ts`; components `caboodle.web/src/components/productSpecs/` (only `AddPricingList.tsx` is live); models `caboodle.web/src/models/category.interface.ts`, `priceList.interface.ts`; sort keys `caboodle.web/src/sort-keys/product-specs.ts`.
  - Admin: routes `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/(crm)/category`, `(crm)/price-lists`, `(crm)/product-spec`; components `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/{CategoryTable,PriceListsTable,ProductSpecTable}.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Category/AddCategory.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/PriceList/AddPriceList.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/ProductSpec/AddProductSpec.tsx`; services `caboodle.admin/src/services/{category,priceList,productSpec}.service.ts`; hooks `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/{category,priceList,productSpec}.ts`; header helper `caboodle.admin/src/helper/crmDataUpload.helper.ts` (`brandSupportHeaders`).
- **Shared data models:**
  - `ProductSpecs.Categories` (`Category`, `.../Modules.ProductSpecs.Domain/Category/Category.cs`): `ID`, `BrandID`, `Name`, `ImageURL`, audit and soft-delete columns. Name unique per brand by handler check only (index on `Name`, not unique).
  - `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications` (`ProductSpecification`, `.../ProductSpec/ProductSpec.cs`): `ID`, `BrandID`, `CategoryID?`, `Name`, `BrandCode`, `Description`, `CaseUPC` (long), `UPCNumber` (string), `Size`, `UOM`, `CasePack`, `MasterPack`, item and case dimensions, `PalletTie`, `PalletHigh`, `PalletCount`, `GrossWeight`, `NetWeight`, `KeHECode`, `UNFICode`, `UNFIEastCode`, `UNFIWestCode`, `Miscellaneous`, `ImageURL`.
  - `ProductSpecs.PriceList` (`PriceList`, `.../PriceList/PriceList.cs`): `ID`, `BrandID`, `ProductID`, `Name` (product name copy), `DistributorID?` (a leaf distributor or delivery method, `CRM.Distributors`), `CategoryID?`, `CasePrice?`, `PerUnitPrice?`, `ValidFrom?`. Several rows per product and distributor form a price history by `ValidFrom`.
  - Read from other modules: `CRM.Distributors` (`ParentID` hierarchy), `CRM.DistributorBrands` (brand to distributor link), `CRM.BannerSKUs`, `CRM.Banners`, `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents`, `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionalEvents`, `Brand.Brands`.
- **Shared services:**
  - `IAccessContext` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs`): every brand handler resolves the brand from the validated `BrandID` header (`GetActiveBrandIdAsync`, `DemandModuleAsync`, `DemandAnyModuleAsync`), never from the raw header.
  - `ProductSpecModules` (`.../Helpers/ProductSpecModules.cs`): slug sets `ProductAndCategoryLookup` (`categories-products-pricing`, `approved-promotions`, `trade-spend-sandbox`, `retail-reports`), `PriceCreation` (first three), `BrokerPromotionPlanning` (`approved-promotions`, `trade-spend-sandbox`), `BannerProducts` (`distributors`, `retailers`), `SampleFileModules`.
  - `QueryHelper` (`.../Helpers/QueryHelper.cs`): sort-key allow lists (`ProductSpecColumns`, `PriceListColumns`, `PriceListGroupedByDistributorColumns`, `CategoryColumns`), search-condition builders, `BrandSoftDeleteQuery`.
  - `FileExportHelper.GetRecords` / `ConvertToCsvFile` for CSV in and out; `IBulkRepository`; `IMainDbTransaction`; `IJobService` (Hangfire, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/HangfireService.cs`).
  - Web `ActionButtons` (`caboodle.web/src/components/data-table-utils/ActionButtons.tsx`): add, delete, upload, export, template buttons; `useModuleAccess().can("categories-products-pricing", action)` decides which render.
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - 2.2 Organizations & Access: module slug `categories-products-pricing` and the access engine decide every brand endpoint; admin calls use support access (`OrganizationID` = brand ID).
  - 2.4 CRM: price rows point at `CRM.Distributors` linked to the brand through `CRM.DistributorBrands`; product create inserts `CRM.BannerSKUs` for every banner; product delete is blocked by banner SKUs; CRM banner screens use `GET /productspecs/for-bannerSku/{bannerID}`.
  - 2.6 Trade Promotion Planning: product and category lookups feed promo creation; price writes reprice `TradeSpendPromoEvents` and sandbox `PromotionalEvents`; the promo product step creates prices (`PricingAddOrEdit`); Simple Entries "Set price" uses `AddPricingList`; force delete removes promo events.
  - 2.9 Market Overview & APL: force delete removes `Broker.MarketOverviews` and `Broker.DistributorAPLs` rows; Retail Reports filter uses product and category lookups.
  - Data ingestion (KeHE, UNFI, Distributor Sales): product name and case pack changes are pushed into `DataUpload` tables by UPC.

#### 2.5.1 Feature: Categories

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A brand groups its products into named categories with an optional image. Brand users and brokerages with `categories-products-pricing` manage them on `/{brandID}/categories`; other modules read the category list as a lookup (promo creation, Retail Reports filter, trade spend detail).
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/categories` (tab "Categories" in `ProductSpecsLayout`) loads `GET /api/v1/categories` with `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` (`Name` or `NumberOfProducts`) and optional `searchKeyword`; grid or table view, select-all, pagination. Initial paging, sort and view mode are read from URL search params.
  2. Add opens `CategoryAddOrEdit` (name, image URL) and posts `POST /api/v1/categories`; Edit (row menu, only with `update`) posts the same with `id`.
  3. Delete (with `delete`) sends `DELETE /api/v1/categories` `{ iDs }`. Categories with prices or products are skipped; a partial delete returns a 400 naming how many were deleted.
  4. Clicking a category opens `/{brandID}/categories/{categoryID}`: header with name, image and product count (`GET /api/v1/categories/{id}`), an edit pencil (with `update`), and `ProductListing` filtered to the category, where "Link Product" and "Remove" manage membership (2.5.1.2).
  5. Upload (with `import`) posts the CSV to `POST /api/v1/categories/import` (2.5.1.1). Export is hidden on this page (`showExport={false}`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/ProductSpecs/CategoriesController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/Categories/GetCategoriesRequest.cs` | Paged list with product counts, search on category or product name, `Products` name filter |
| `.../Categories/GetCategoryRequest.cs` | One category with product count, scoped to the active brand |
| `.../Categories/UpsertCategoryRequest.cs` | Create or update, duplicate name check |
| `.../Categories/DeleteCategoriesRequest.cs` | Soft delete when not referenced |
| `.../ExportImport/ExportCategoriesRequest.cs` | CSV export (no web caller) |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/categories/(category-list)/page.tsx`, `CategoriesTable.tsx`, `CategoryCard.tsx`, `CategoryRowBodyTemplate.tsx`, `CategoryAddOrEdit.tsx` | List page and form |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/categories/[categoryID]/page.tsx` | Detail page |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/category.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/product-spec/category.ts` | `useGetCategories`, `useGetCategoryById`, `useCreateCategory`, `useDeleteCategories` |

- **Data:** `ProductSpecs.Categories`; counts from `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications.CategoryID`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/categories` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandAnyModuleAsync(ProductAndCategoryLookup, BrokerPromotionPlanning, View)`; `BrandID` header required | query `searchKeyword`, `products[]`, `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `PagedData<CategoryDTO>` (`ID`, `Name`, `ImageURL`, `NumberOfProducts`); web `ICategoryResponse` | `GetCategoriesRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/categories/{id}` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)`; `BrandID` header | path `id` / `CategoryDTO` | `GetCategoryRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/categories` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)` | `UpsertCategoryRequest` (`ID?`, `Name`, `ImageURL`) / `ResponseMetaDTO`; web `ICategory` | `UpsertCategoryRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/categories` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Delete)` | body `DeleteCategoriesRequest` (`IDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteCategoriesRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/categories/export` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Export)` | query `searchKeyword`, paging, `sortKey` / CSV "Categories Data" (`CategoryExportDTO`: `Name`, `ImageURL`, `Number Of Products`) | `ExportCategoriesRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - The controller attribute on `POST /categories` checks only `View`; the handler then requires `Create` (no `ID`) or `Update` (with `ID`). The same pattern applies to price list upsert and product upsert.
  - Names compare case-insensitively within the brand; a duplicate returns 404 with key `Name` "Category with same name already exists!" (the admin service notes the unusual status, `caboodle.admin/src/services/category.service.ts`).
  - Delete: categories referenced by a non-deleted price row or product are not deleted; if none can be deleted, 400 "Selected Categories can not be deleted. They are linked to item(s)."; if some are, 400 "{n} category(s) deleted successfully. Others couldn't be deleted ...". Deletion is a brand-scoped soft delete (`QueryHelper.BrandSoftDeleteQuery`).
  - Sort keys and sort order are validated against allow lists before being placed in SQL.
- **Dependencies:** Access engine; web `useModuleAccess`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** No `BrandID` or a brand outside the caller's access: 400 "Select a brand." or 403 "You do not have access to this brand." (`AccessContext.BrandRefusal`). Unknown id: 404 "Category not found!".
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/Categories/CategoryLookupAccessTests.cs`, `CategoryUpsertAccessTests.cs`, `DeleteCategoriesRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs` (every handler asks the access engine and binds the engine brand). Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/product-specs/CategoriesPageGating.test.tsx`. Gap: no test for `GetCategoriesRequest` SQL or `ExportCategoriesRequest`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Upsert and import load every category in the table (`ListAsync`) and filter in memory.
  - Web `useGetCategories` keys on `[getCategories, params]` without `brandId`, so after a brand switch the previous brand's list can show until the refetch returns (`keepPreviousData: true`).
  - Category export exists on the backend but no UI calls it; the admin uses `POST /masterdataupload/categories/export` instead.

- **What it does:** Upload a CSV of category names and image URLs for the selected brand; existing names update the image URL, new names create categories.

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/categories/import` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Import)` | multipart `file` (`CategoryImportDTO`: `[*] Category Name`, `ImageURL`) / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO` (declared as `ResponseMetaDTO` on the action) | `ImportProductSpecRequestHandler` in `.../ExportImport/ImportCategoryRequest.cs` |

##### 2.5.1.2 Sub-feature: Link and unlink products

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** On a category detail page, attach uncategorised products to the category or remove products from it.
- **User flow:**
  1. "Link Product" opens `ProductLink`, which loads every brand product (`POST /productspecs`, `pageSize=-1`) and shows each product's current category; submit calls `PATCH /api/v1/categories/{id}/link-product` with `{ productIDs }`.
  2. "Remove" in the category's product list calls `PATCH /api/v1/categories/{id}/remove-product`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/Categories/AddProductsWithCategoryRequest.cs` | Link |
| `.../Categories/RemoveProductsFromCategoryRequest.cs` | Unlink and price cleanup |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/categories/[categoryID]/ProductLink.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/ProductListing.tsx` (`onDelete` with `categoryID`) | UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/product-spec/category.ts` (`useLinkProductToCategory`, `useUnlinkProductToCategory`) | Mutations; invalidate products, categories, category |

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PATCH | `/api/v1/categories/{id}/link-product` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Update)` | `AddProductsWithCategoryPayload` (`ProductIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `AddProductWithCategoryRequestHandler` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/categories/{id}/remove-product` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Update)` | `AddProductsWithCategoryPayload` (`ProductIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `RemoveProductsFromCategoryRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Link only takes products of the active brand that have no category (`GetProductsByIDSpec`: `CategoryID == null`); if none qualify, 404 "Either product(s) not found, or they already belong to some Category(ies)!". The link writes `CategoryID` only; it does not create price rows.
  - Remove sets `CategoryID = null` on the products and soft-deletes their price rows for that category (`GetPriceListsByCategoryAndProductsSpec`), so the products lose their prices.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/Categories/AddProductsWithCategoryRequestTests.cs`, `RemoveProductsFromCategoryRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Removing a product from its category deletes its pricing without a warning in the UI copy. `ProductLink` lists products that already have a category, but the backend silently skips them.

#### 2.5.2 Feature: Products (product specifications)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A brand maintains its product catalog: name, category, UPC, case UPC, pack sizes, dimensions, pallet data and KeHE / UNFI codes. Brand users and brokerages with `categories-products-pricing` manage products on `/{brandID}/products`; the product list is also the product picker for promotions, banner SKUs and Retail Reports (lookup gate covers `approved-promotions`, `trade-spend-sandbox`, `retail-reports`).
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/products` renders `ProductListing`: search by name or UPC, filters by case pack and category from `GET /api/v1/productspecs/filters`, sort by `Name`, `UPCNumber`, `CategoryName`, `CasePack`; grid or table; the list is `POST /api/v1/productspecs` with filters in the body and paging in the query.
  2. Add (with `create`) goes to `/{brandID}/products/add`; Edit (row menu or detail page, with `update`) goes to `/{brandID}/products/{productID}/edit`. Both render `ProductForm`, which loads categories (`GET /categories`, `pageSize=-1`) and submits `POST /api/v1/productspecs/upsert`, then navigates back.
  3. `/{brandID}/products/{productID}` (`GET /api/v1/productspecs/{productID}`) shows basic and other info, a per-unit-price-by-distributor chart from `pricingDetails`, and a link to `/{brandID}/retail-report?productID=`.
  4. Delete and Force Delete (with `delete`), Upload (with `import`) and Export (with `export`) are described in the sub-features.

| GET | `/api/v1/productspecs/{productID}` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)` | path / `ProductDetailsWithPricingDTO` (`ProductInfo`, `PricingDetails[{DistributorName, PerUnitPrice, ValidFrom}]`) | `GetProductSpecRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/productspecs/upsert` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)` | `UpsertProductSpecRequest` (`ID?`, `CategoryID`, `Name`, `UPCNumber`, `CasePack` required; all other attributes optional) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (action declares `ProductSpecsDTO`); web `IProduct` | `CreateProductSpecRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Required on upsert: `Name`, `CasePack`, `CategoryID`, `UPCNumber` (`CreateProductSpecRequestValidation`); the category must belong to the active brand.
  - UPC must be unique within the brand among non-deleted products (exact string match). On save the UPC is trimmed and `$`, `,`, `%`, `-` are removed (`ValidateUPCNumber`).
  - Text fields are trimmed and blank values stored as empty strings.
- **Dependencies:** 2.4 CRM (banner SKUs, distributors), Hangfire, DataUpload tables (2.5.2.1).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Product of another brand or deleted: 404 "Product not found to update!". Duplicate UPC: 400 key `UPC` "Product with same UPC already exists!".
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ProductSpecifications/UpsertProductSpecRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `ProductSpecUpsertAccessTests.cs`, `ProductSpecLookupAccessTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/product-specs/ProductListingGating.test.tsx`, `ProductFormGating.test.tsx`, `ProductOtherInfo.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The UPC duplicate check compares the raw request value before normalisation, so `123-456` passes even when `123456` exists (`GetProductSpecificationAsync` runs before `MapProductSpecFromRequest`).
  - Web `useGetProductFilters` keys on `[getProductFilters]` only, so a brand switch can show the previous brand's filter options until refetch.
  - Dead web code: `caboodle.web/src/components/productSpecs/{AddProduct,ProductTable,CategoryTable,AddCategory,PriceListTable}.tsx` have no live importer; `ProductService.updateProduct` calls `PUT /api/v1/productspecs`, a route that does not exist, and is used only by the dead `AddProduct.tsx`.

##### 2.5.2.1 Sub-feature: Product save side effects

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Saving a product also maintains price placeholders, banner SKUs and data-ingestion copies of the product name and case pack.
- **User flow:**
  1. In one `IMainDbTransaction`: the product is inserted or updated; when the product is new or its category changed, one blank `PriceList` row (no price, no date) is inserted for each leaf distributor linked to the brand that has no row yet for this product and category; on a category change, all existing price rows of the product under other categories are soft-deleted.
  2. After commit: a new product enqueues `CreateBannerSkus` (Hangfire), which inserts a `CRM.BannerSKUs` row with status `NotActive` for every non-deleted banner in the platform. An update enqueues `PropagateProductNameChangeByUpcAsync` when the name changed and `PropagateCasePackChangeByUpcAsync` when the case pack changed.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/ProductSpecifications/UpsertProductSpecRequest.cs` (`SyncPriceListsAsync`, `GeneratePriceListsAsync`, `GetDistributorsQuery`, `EnqueueFollowUpJobs`) | Orchestration |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/BackgroundJob/BackgroundJobDispatcher.cs` | `CreateBannerSkus` enqueue |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs` (`CreateBannerSkusAsync`) | Banner SKU insert |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataHubService.cs` (`PropagateProductNameChangeByUpcAsync`, `PropagateCasePackChangeByUpcAsync`) | Updates `DataUpload.KeHeMappedRecords.ProductDescription`, `DataUpload.UNFIMappedRecords.Description`, `DataUpload.DistributorSalesRecords.ProductDescription` by UPC; recalculates `Pack` and `CasesShipped = Units / pack` on KeHE-source `DistributorSalesRecords` for the brand and UPC |

- **APIs/interfaces:** Hangfire jobs: `ISharedDataService.CreateBannerSkusAsync`, `ISharedDataHubService.PropagateProductNameChangeByUpcAsync`, `ISharedDataHubService.PropagateCasePackChangeByUpcAsync` (fire-and-forget via `IJobService.Enqueue`).
- **Business rules:** Leaf distributors are those with a parent or with no child (`d.ParentID IS NOT NULL OR child.ParentID IS NULL`), non-deleted, linked by `CRM.DistributorBrands`. Jobs are queued only after the transaction commits.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ProductSpecifications/UpsertProductSpecRequestHandlerTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Changing a product's category soft-deletes all its priced rows under the old category and replaces them with blank rows, so real prices are lost; the UI gives no warning.
  - The name propagation updates KeHE, UNFI and Distributor Sales rows for that UPC across all brands (no brand filter in `PropagateProductNameChangeByUpcAsync`).
  - Banner SKU creation inserts one row per platform banner for each new product, which is why ordinary product delete is almost always blocked (2.5.2.2).
  - In `GetDistributorsQuery` the self join checks `d."Deleted"` instead of `child."Deleted"`, so deleted child distributors still make their parent count as non-leaf.

##### 2.5.2.2 Sub-feature: Delete and force delete

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Soft delete for products not used anywhere, and a permanent cascading delete for products already in use.
- **User flow:**
  1. Delete (`ActionButtons`) sends `DELETE /api/v1/productspecs` `{ iDs }`. Products with a non-deleted `CRM.BannerSKUs` row are skipped; the response is 400 when any were skipped.
  2. Force Delete (separate `ActionButtons` with `confirmationTagKey="force-delete-products"`, only on the products page, not on a category page) sends `DELETE /api/v1/productspecs/force-delete` `{ productIDs }` after a confirmation.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DELETE | `/api/v1/productspecs` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Delete)` | body `DeleteProductsSpecRequest` (`IDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteProductsSpecRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/productspecs/force-delete` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Delete)` | body `ForceDeleteProductSpecRequest` (`ProductIDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `ForceDeleteProductSpecRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Force delete runs one transaction of hard `DELETE`s for the brand's matching products: `Broker.DistributorAPLs` by UPC (only when no other brand has a live product with that UPC), `Broker.MarketOverviews` by `SKUID`, `CRM.BannerSKUs`, `ProductSpecs.PriceList`, `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents`, `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionalEvents` by product id, then the products. No product of the brand found: 200 "No products found to delete."
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ProductSpecifications/DeleteProductsSpecRequestTests.cs`, `ForceDeleteProductSpecRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Force delete is irreversible and removes promotion events and market overview logs owned by other modules; it writes no audit entry. The `TradeSpendPromoEvents` / `PromotionalEvents` / `MarketOverviews` deletes are not brand-filtered, but product ids are brand-validated first.

##### 2.5.2.3 Sub-feature: Product import, export and template

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** CSV upsert of products keyed by UPC, CSV export of products with their price rows, and an empty template.
- **User flow:**
  1. Upload posts to `POST /api/v1/productspecs/import`; template comes from `GET /api/v1/productspecs/export-sample-file?fileCategory=` (default `FileCategory.ProductSpec` in `ActionButtons`).
  2. Export calls `POST /api/v1/productspecs/export` with paging and sort in the query and body `{}` (`ProductService.exportProducts`), so the file ignores the page's filters.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/productspecs/import` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Import)` | multipart `file` (`ProductSpecImportDTO`: `[*] Product Name`, `[*] Category Name`, `[*] Unit UPC`, `[*] Case Pack`, `Case UPC`, dimensions, codes, ...) / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO` | `ImportProductsRequestHandler` (`.../ExportImport/ImportProductsRequest.cs`) |
| POST | `/api/v1/productspecs/export` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Export)` | body `ProductSpecPayload`, query paging, `sortKey` / CSV "Products Specification" (`BrandProductSpecExportDTO`, one row per price row) | `ExportProductsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/productspecs/export-sample-file` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandAnyModuleAsync(SampleFileModules(fileCategory), Import)` | query `fileCategory` (`Category`, `ProductSpec`, `RetailerPromoRules`) / CSV template | `ExportProductSpecSampleFileRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Import requires UPC, product name (taken from the `Product Name` column into both `Name` and `Description`), an existing category name, and case pack greater than 0; numeric columns are type-checked. UPCs lose dashes and leading zeros before matching existing products. New products get blank price rows for each leaf distributor and a `CreateBannerSkus` job; updated products are bulk updated with no price-row or propagation side effects.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ExportImport/ImportProductsRequestTests.cs`. No export test.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - UPC normalisation differs between import (dash and leading zeros removed) and the form (dash, `$`, `,`, `%` removed, zeros kept), so the same product can be stored or matched under two UPCs.
  - Import validates case pack with a cleaned string but then calls `int.Parse` on the raw value, so a value such as `1,200` passes validation and throws (`ImportProductsRequestHandler`).
  - Import does not map `UNFICode`.
  - Export: `WHERE ... AND pl."BrandID" = @BrandID` turns the price join into an inner join, so products without price rows are not exported; and `QueryHelper.GetSearchCondition` returns a fragment ending in `AND` that the export query appends after another condition without a leading `AND`, which yields invalid SQL when any filter is sent (the web never sends filters).
  - The template endpoint also serves `RetailerPromoRules` (owned by CRM promo rules).

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** For a banner, lists every product of the brand with `ShouldBeDisabled = true` when it already has a banner SKU on that banner. Used by the CRM banner SKU add dialog (web `BannerSKUAddOrEdit.tsx`, admin `caboodle.admin/src/component/BannerSkus/AddBannerSku.tsx`).

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/productspecs/for-bannerSku/{bannerID}` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandAnyModuleAsync(BannerProducts = distributors, retailers, View)` | path `bannerID` / `ProductForBannerSKUDTO` (`Products[{ID, Name, ShouldBeDisabled}]`) | `GetProductsForBannerSkuRequestHandler` |

- **Tests:** Covered by `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs` (access engine use).

#### 2.5.3 Feature: Price lists (pricing)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Stores the per-unit price a brand charges each distributor or delivery method for each product, with a start date (`ValidFrom`), and keeps promotion events priced from it. Managed on `/{brandID}/pricing` with `categories-products-pricing`; prices are also created from the promo product step (`ProductRow` > `PricingAddOrEdit`) and from Simple Entries "Set price" (`AddPricingList`), gated by `PriceCreation` / `BrokerPromotionPlanning` slugs.
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/pricing` loads `POST /api/v1/pricelists` with filters in the body (`searchKeyword`) and `pageSize` (default `-1`, all rows), `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` in the query. Columns include product, category, distributor, per-unit price, case cost (`CasePack x PerUnitPrice`) and valid-from. Pagination is commented out on this page.
  2. Add opens `PricingAddOrEdit` (distributor from `useLeafDistributors`, product, per-unit price, valid-from, all required in the UI) and posts `POST /api/v1/pricelists/create` with `{ distributorID, productIDs: [id], perUnitPrice, validFrom: "YYYY-MM-DD" }`. Edit posts `POST /api/v1/pricelists/upsert` with `id`.
  3. Delete (with `delete`) sends `DELETE /api/v1/pricelists` `{ iDs }`.
  4. Upload, template and export are in 2.5.3.2.
  5. From a promo product row with no price, `PricingAddOrEdit` opens pre-filled with that product and distributor; after a successful create it invalidates `[getPromoBannerSkus, brandID]` so the row updates (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/pricing/PricingAddOrEdit.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/ProductSpecs/PriceListsController.cs` | Routes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/PriceList/GetPriceListsRequest.cs` | Paged list; `GetPriceListPayload` |
| `.../PriceList/GetPriceListRequest.cs` | One price row |
| `.../PriceList/UpsertPriceListRequest.cs` | Single create or update, history rule, event repricing |
| `.../PriceList/CreatePriceListRequest.cs` | Multi-product create |
| `.../PriceList/DeletePriceListsRequest.cs` | Brand-scoped soft delete |
| `.../Specifications/GetDistributorByBrandAndDistributorIDSpec.cs` | Distributor must be linked to the brand |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/pricing/page.tsx`, `PriceListTable.tsx`, `PricingAddOrEdit.tsx` | Page, table, form (form also used by `.../promo-create/product-stepper/ProductRow.tsx`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/productSpecs/AddPricingList.tsx` | Create form used by Simple Entries (`caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/SimpleEntryCreate.tsx`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/priceList.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/product-spec/priceList.ts` | `useGetPricingLists`, `useCreatePricingList`, `useUpsertPricingList`, `useDeletePricingLists`, `useGetSinglePricingList` |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/priceList.interface.ts` | `ICreatePriceListRequest`, `ICreatePriceListResponse`, `IPriceList`, `IGetPriceList`, `IPricingListResponse` |

- **Data:** `ProductSpecs.PriceList`; joins `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications` (name, image, category, case pack), `ProductSpecs.Categories`, `CRM.Distributors`; `CRM.DistributorBrands` for validation.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/pricelists` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)` | body `GetPriceListPayload` (`SearchKeyword`, `ProductIDs`, `DistributorIDs`, `MinPerUnitPrice`, `MaxPerUnitPrice`, `StartDate`), query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `PagedData<PriceListDTO>` | `GetPriceListsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/pricelists/{id}` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)` | path / `PriceListDTO` | `GetPriceListRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/pricelists/upsert` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)` | `UpsertPriceListRequest` (`ID?`, `DistributorID`, `ProductID`, `PerUnitPrice?`, `ValidFrom?`) / `ResponseMetaDTO`; web `IPriceList` | `UpsertPriceListRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/pricelists/create` | `Authorize`; handler `DemandAnyModuleAsync(PriceCreation, BrokerPromotionPlanning, Create)` | `CreatePriceListRequest` (`DistributorID`, `ProductIDs[]`, `PerUnitPrice?`, `ValidFrom?`) / `ResponseMetaDTO`; web `ICreatePriceListRequest` | `CreatePriceListRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/pricelists` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Delete)` | body `DeletePriceListsRequest` (`IDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePriceListsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - `PerUnitPrice` may be null but not negative. The product must belong to the brand and the distributor must be linked to the brand (`CRM.DistributorBrands`), else 404.
  - Uniqueness: one row per (product, distributor, `ValidFrom` date), with "no date" counted as a value. Create skips duplicates per product; if every product was skipped, 400 "No new pricing has been added ..."; a partial success message names how many were created.
  - Upsert with an `ID` whose `ValidFrom` date changed does not edit the row: it inserts a new row (after the duplicate check) and keeps the old one, which builds price history. Upsert with the same date edits the price in place and keeps `ValidFrom`.
  - `upsert` takes a singular `productID`; `create` takes `productIDs` (an array). A singular key sent to `create` is ignored by model binding and answered with 400 "Please select at least one product." (`CreatePriceListRequestValidator`).
  - List filters: `DistributorIDs`, `ProductIDs`, keyword over product, category and distributor names; the price range applies only when both min and max are sent. `StartDate` and `CategoryIDs` are accepted but not applied (the controller does not pass `CategoryIDs`; no `StartDate` condition exists in `QueryHelper.GetSearchConditionForPriceList`).
- **Dependencies:** 2.4 CRM distributors; 2.6 promotion events (2.5.3.1); web `useLeafDistributors` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/distributors.ts`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Updating a row of another brand or a deleted row: 404 "Pricing info not found to update!". Deletes are brand-scoped, so foreign ids are silently ignored.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/PriceList/PriceListUpsertAccessTests.cs`, `PriceListCreateAccessTests.cs`, `GetPriceListRequestTests.cs`, `DeletePriceListsRequestTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/priceList.service.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/productSpecs/PricingAddOrEdit.test.tsx`, `AddPricingList.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/product-specs/PricingPageGating.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/tradeSpend/ProductListPricingRefresh.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The web form requires a non-zero price (`!formData.perUnitPrice`), so a price of 0 cannot be entered although the API allows it (`PricingAddOrEdit.validateForm`).
  - `CheckAlreadyExistsAsync`, `CreatePriceListRequestHandler` and the import load every price row in the database and filter in memory.
  - Deleting a price does not reprice events that used it.

##### 2.5.3.1 Sub-feature: Event repricing on price change

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** When a price is created or its value changes, approved promotion events (`TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents`) and sandbox events (`TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionalEvents`) of that brand, product and distributor that start on or after the price's `ValidFrom` take the price in force at their start date.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs` (`UpdatePromoEventsPerUnitPrice`) | Picks the latest row with `ValidFrom <= event start`; falls back to the new price for events on or after the new start date; bulk updates changed events |
| `.../PriceList/UpsertPriceListRequest.cs`, `.../PriceList/CreatePriceListRequest.cs` | Callers |

- **Business rules:** Only rows with both `ValidFrom` and `PerUnitPrice` count; with no such row the call does nothing. Upsert calls it after saving; a row without `ValidFrom` passes `DateTime.MaxValue`, so no event is touched.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/SharedDataServicePromoEventPriceTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `CreatePriceListRequestHandler` calls the repricing inside the product loop before `BulkInsertAsync` writes the new rows, so the service reads price rows that do not yet include the new price: events get the older price when one exists, and nothing changes when none exists.
  - Price import (brand and admin) never reprices events; the admin sync below is the catch-up.

##### 2.5.3.2 Sub-feature: Price import, export and template

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** CSV import of new price rows matched by product name and distributor name, CSV export of the filtered list, and an empty template.

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/pricelists/import` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Import)` | multipart `file` (`PriceListImportDTO`: `[*] Product Name`, `[*] Distributor Name`, `Per Unit Price ($)`, `Valid From (MM/DD/YYYY)`) / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO` | `ImportPriceListRequestHandler` (`.../ExportImport/ImportPriceListRequest.cs`) |
| POST | `/api/v1/pricelists/export` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Export)` | body `GetPriceListPayload`, query paging and `sortKey` / CSV (`PriceListExportDTO`: product, category, distributor, per-unit price, case cost, valid from) | `ExportPricingListRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/pricelists/export-sample-file` | `RequireModule(categories-products-pricing, null, Import)` | none / CSV "Price List Format" | `GetPriceListSampleFileRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Import only inserts; a row matching an existing (product, distributor, date) fails with "Record with the same value already exists!". Price accepts a leading `$`; dates accept `M/d/yyyy` and two-digit-year variants.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ExportImport/ImportPriceListRequestTests.cs`. No export test.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Distributor matching strips non-alphanumeric characters from the stored names but not from the CSV value, so a name such as "KeHE Distributors, LLC" in the file never matches (`GetSystemDistributorsAsync`).
  - Imported rows get no `CategoryID` (computed but not assigned), so they are invisible to category-scoped logic such as the category delete check and the remove-from-category cleanup.
  - Products are matched by exact name (case-insensitive), not UPC.

#### 2.5.4 Feature: Admin cross-brand product data

- **Status:** Active (admin sidebar "CRM Data Upload" > Categories, Price Lists, Product Specs, `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx`)
- **What it does:** The Platform Admin browses categories, prices and products across all brands with faceted filters, creates or edits them for a chosen brand, and bulk imports or exports them through the Data Upload controller.
- **User flow:**
  1. `/category` (`CategoryTable`): `POST /api/v1/categories/for-admin` with brand ids, query, category and brand name filters; Add / Edit (`AddCategory`) calls `POST /api/v1/categories` with `BrandID` and `OrganizationID` headers set to the chosen brand (`brandSupportHeaders`); Upload posts to `POST /api/v1/masterdataupload/categories`; Export posts `POST /api/v1/masterdataupload/categories/export`.
  2. `/price-lists` (`PriceListsTable`): `POST /api/v1/pricelists/for-admin` and `POST /api/v1/pricelists/filter-options`; Add (`AddPriceList`) loads the brand's products (`POST /productspecs`) and leaf distributors and calls `POST /pricelists/create` (new) or `POST /pricelists/upsert` (edit) with support headers; Upload `POST /api/v1/masterdataupload/price-list`; Export `POST /api/v1/masterdataupload/price-list/export`.
  3. `/product-spec` (`ProductSpecTable`): `POST /api/v1/productspecs/for-admin` and `POST /api/v1/productspecs/filter-options`; Add (`AddProductSpec`) loads the brand's categories (`GET /categories`) and calls `POST /productspecs/upsert`; Upload `POST /api/v1/masterdataupload/productspecs`; Export `GET /api/v1/masterdataupload/productspecs?brandID=` (only when exactly one brand is filtered). There is no edit action on this table.
  4. Templates come from `GET /api/v1/masterdataupload/sample-file?fileCategory=` (Data Upload module).
- **Code map:**

Facet endpoints compute each facet ignoring its own selection. Admin product import matches brands by name and products by raw UPC, allows a missing category, and creates blank price rows but no banner SKUs.

Admin has no Jest tests.

  - Products created by admin import get no banner SKUs, unlike brand-side create and import.

### 2.6 Module: Trade Promotion Planning

- **Purpose:** Lets a Brand (and brokers working on a brand route) plan trade promotions: model them in a Trade Spend Sandbox (promotion families with up to N versions, revenue and spend calculations, promotion fees), push one version to Brand Approved (the copy brokers, calendars and reports read), maintain Brand Approved promotions directly, and record calendar-only "Simple Promotions" from a spreadsheet grid. It owns the promotion write paths, the trade spend calculation engine and the promotion quota as applied to create paths.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/TradeSpend/TradeSpendsController.cs` (route `api/v1/tradespends`, regions "TradeSpend" and "Simple Promo Entry"; the `promos-at-a-glance*` and `monthly-report*` regions belong to 2.7 and 2.11), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/TradeSpendsSandboxController.cs` (route `api/v1/tradespendssandbox`).
  - Backend modules: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/{TradeSpend,SimplePromo,DTOBuilder,Payload,Services,Specifications}`, `.../Modules.TradeSpend.Domain/TradeSpend`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/{Requests,DTOBuilder,Helper,Payloads,Specifications}`, `.../Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Domain/{Promotion,PromotionFamily,PromotionalEvent,PromotionFee}`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/TradeSpendCalculation/*`, quota: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Settings/PromotionQuota.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Settings/{QuotaGuard,PromotionPoolCounter}.cs`; cross-module writes in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs`.
  - Backend tests: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Settings/{QuotaGuardTests,PromotionPoolCounterTests}.cs`.
  - Web routes: `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/` (`promo-planning/{(list),[promoID],create}`, `trade-spend-sandbox/{(list),[promoID],create}`, `simple-entries/{page,[promoID],create}`, shared screens `PromoListing.tsx`, `TradeSpendDetails.tsx`, `PushPromo.tsx`, `RemovePromo.tsx`, `DuplicatePromo.tsx`, `promo-create/*`).

#### 2.6.1 Feature: Sandbox promotions

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The Trade Spend Sandbox is a brand's modelling space: each promotion is a family whose reporting version is listed, opened, edited and deleted here, with full revenue and spend calculations. Used by Brand companies and by brokerages on a brand route; gated by module `trade-spend-sandbox` (View to read; Create, Update, Delete per action), and deleting a family that has a Brand Approved copy also needs `approved-promotions` Delete.
- **User flow:**
  1. Nav "Promotional Planning > Trade Spend Sandbox" opens `/{brandID}/trade-spend-sandbox` (`trade-spend-sandbox/(list)/page.tsx` renders `PromoListing isSandbox`).
  2. List shows one row per family (reporting version's figures): name, year, banner count, categories, created date, plus "Figures from" / "Brokers see ... pushed on" when the row has version metadata (`PromosRowTemplate.tsx`, `hasVersionMeta`). Search and year filter write URL params (`search-promo-year`, `currentPage`, `pageSize`).
  3. Row kebab: Versions (opens `VersionsDrawer`), Duplicate (create permission), Push to Approved (see 2.6.3); toolbar: Add New Promotion (opens `PromoName` dialog, then the create stepper 2.6.5), Resume (reopens a localStorage draft), Delete selected.
  4. Clicking a row opens `/{brandID}/trade-spend-sandbox/{reportingVersionID}?family={familyID}` (`resolvePromoRowHref`).
  5. Detail (`TradeSpendDetails isSandBox`): header with family name in bold and `v{n} · {version name}` pill, summary tables, rates chart, promotion fees panel, Promo Events grid (2.6.6), Select Promo Options filter drawer, Versions, Push, rename pencils.
  6. Delete from list: selected families are hard-deleted with all versions, events and fees; if any family was pushed, its Brand Approved copy, events and fees are hard-deleted too.
  - Edge: a family whose reporting version has no live events, or whose events reference a deleted product or banner, does not appear in the list (inner joins in `GetPromotionsRequest`).
  - Edge: a detail URL without a usable `family` param still loads the version but the versions panel is unavailable (`resolveFamilyID`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/GetPromotionsRequest.cs` | Paged list keyed by family, joined to reporting version events; version count, reporting and pushed names |
| `.../Requests/GetPromotionDetailsRequest.cs` | Loads one version, builds `PromotionDTO` via `PromotionDTOBuilder.GetPromotionDTO` |
| `.../Requests/GetFilterPropertiesRequest.cs` | Filter options for one version's detail drawer (`FilterDTO`) |
| `.../Requests/GetFilterOptionsForPromotionListRequest.cs` | "Created by" options for the list (no web caller) |
| `.../Requests/DeletePromotionsRequest.cs` | Cascade hard delete of families, versions, events, fees and Brand Approved copies, then Monthly Report refresh |
| `.../Requests/CheckPromotionNameAlreadyExistRequest.cs` | Family name (or version name when `familyId` given) uniqueness |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/PromoListing.tsx` | Shared list for sandbox and Brand Approved |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/PromosRowTemplate.tsx`, `PromosTable.tsx` | Row card, selection |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/TradeSpendDetails.tsx` | Shared detail screen for sandbox and Brand Approved |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/TradeSpendDetailsContents/{PromoRates,PromoFilters,EditPromoName}.tsx` | Summary tables and charts, options drawer, rename dialog |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`useGetTradeSpendSandbox`, `useTradeSpendSandBox`, `useTradeSpendSandBoxFilters`, `useDeleteTradeSpendsSandbox`) | React Query wrappers |

- **Data:** `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionFamilies`, `Promotions`, `PromotionalEvents`, `PromotionFees`; list DTO `PromotionsDTO` (ID = family ID, `VersionCount`, `ReportingVersionID`, `ReportingVersionName`, `PushedVersionID`, `PushedVersionName`, `PushedOn`); detail DTO `PromotionDTO` (ID and Name are the version's, `Events`, `SKUStatistics`, `EventNamesStatictics`, `POD`, `MaxStore`, `PromotionFees`). Web `PromoData`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/all` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, View)` | `PromotionsGetPayload` {searchKeyword, products, years, createdBy} + query paging and `sortKey` (Name, Year, ...) / `PagedData<PromotionsDTO>` | `GetPromotionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{id}` | same, View | `PromotionDetailsQueryProperties` {months, skuIDs, categoryIDs, bannerIDs, status, eventNames, addFees, excludeAllAddFees, eventStatus, promotionFees, excludeAllPromotionFees} / `PromotionDTO` | `GetPromotionDetailsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{id}/filter-properties` | same, View | / `FilterDTO` (months, skus, categories, banners, status, eventNames, addFees, eventStatus, promotionFees) | `GetFilterPropertiesRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/filter-properties` | same, View | / `FilterOptionsForPromotionsDTO` (createdBy) | `GetFilterOptionsForPromotionListRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/name-exist?name=&familyId=` | same, View | / `bool` | `CheckPromotionNameAlreadyExistRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox` | same, Delete; handler also demands `approved-promotions` Delete when a selected family has a Brand Approved copy | `DeletePromotionsRequest` {iDs: family IDs} / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePromotionsRequestHandler` |

  Side effects: `IMonthlyReportRefreshJobService.ExecuteRefreshAsync(brand, TradeSpendSandbox)` and, when Brand Approved copies were removed, `(brand, TradeSpend)`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Family names are unique per brand, case-insensitive (`PromotionDTOBuilder.IsFamilyNameExistAsync`).
  - The list year is the earliest event start year of the reporting version; the year filter matches any event start year.
  - Detail calculations include only events in status Active, Pending, RetailerApproved or Completed; other statuses are listed without figures (`PromotionDTOBuilder.GetPromotionDTO`).
  - Delete is brand-scoped (`GetFamiliesOfBrandSpec`) and runs inside `IMainDbTransaction`.
  - Web: list actions are hidden unless `can(trade-spend-sandbox, create|delete)`; delete of a selection that includes a pushed family also needs `approved-promotions` delete (`canDeleteSandboxPromotions`).
- **Dependencies:** CRM banners and products (joins), Product Specs categories, Report module Monthly Report refresh, 2.6.2 versions, 2.6.3 push, 2.6.11 calculations.
- **Errors & edge cases:** empty `iDs` 400 "Please select at least one promotion..."; unknown version 404 "Promotion not found!"; name-exist with blank name 400; name-exist with a family of another brand 404.
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Delete/DeletePromotionsRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `Names/CheckPromotionNameAlreadyExistRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `Access/ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/tradeSpend/{PromoListingGating,PromoListingSearchParams,TradeSpendDetailsFamilyParam}.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/TradeSpendDetailsSummaryTables.test.tsx`. Gap: no backend tests for `GetPromotionsRequest`, `GetPromotionDetailsRequest`, `PromotionDTOBuilder`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Deleting a sandbox family hard-deletes its Brand Approved copy (calendar and broker views lose it) with no extra confirmation beyond the permission check.
  - Deletes are hard deletes (`BulkDeleteAsync` from EFCore.BulkExtensions), unlike event deletes which are soft.
  - `GetPromotionDTO` calls `promoDTO.Events.OrderBy(...)` and discards the result (no effect).
  - `TradeSpendDetails.tsx` still has a `console.log("promoId", promoId)`; `PromoListing.tsx` logs filters on every change.
  - The sandbox list filter defaults to the current year, so a promotion planned for another year is not visible after creation until the year filter changes.

##### 2.6.1.1 Sub-feature: Sandbox list filter options

- **Status:** Partial (`GET tradespendssandbox/filter-properties` has no web caller; grep of `caboodle.web/src/service/promo.service.ts` finds only the per-promotion `{id}/filter-properties`).
- **What it does:** Returns the distinct creators of sandbox events for a "Created by" list filter that the UI does not render.

#### 2.6.2 Feature: Promotion families and versions

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A sandbox promotion is a family holding several versions (default cap 5, brand setting `trade-spend-sandbox.max-versions-per-family`, 1 to 20). Users copy a version into a new one, pick which version feeds reporting, delete versions, and rename either the family or a single version. Gated by `trade-spend-sandbox` View / Create / Update / Delete.
- **User flow:**
  1. From a list row ("Versions") or the detail header, `VersionsDrawer` opens for the family (`useGetTradeSpendVersions(familyID)`).
  2. Each version card shows number, name, parent ("copied from"), event count, created by/on, and badges for reporting, pushed and out of date; the version on screen is marked "On screen".
  3. Actions per card: Open (navigates to `/{brandID}/trade-spend-sandbox/{versionID}?family={familyID}`), Set as reporting, Push / Re-push (2.6.3), Delete (disabled with a reason for the pushed or reporting version).
  4. "Add Version" opens `CreateVersionModal`: pick a source version and a name (checked against sibling names), then `POST {familyId}/versions`; disabled with "N of M versions" when no slots remain.
  5. Rename: the pencil beside the bold family name opens `EditPromoName mode="family"` (`PATCH {familyId}`); the pencil on the version pill opens `mode="version"` (`PUT tradespendssandbox`).
  6. If the version on screen is deleted (here or elsewhere), the detail screen leaves it: to the reporting version, else the highest version number, else the list (`resolveVersionExit`, `resolveFallbackVersion`), with `router.replace`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/GetPromotionVersionsRequest.cs` | Version list, `IsOutOfDate`, `RemainingVersionSlots` |
| `.../Requests/CreatePromotionVersionRequest.cs` | Copy a version (events and fees) into a new numbered version |
| `.../Requests/SetReportingVersionRequest.cs` | Set `PromotionFamily.ReportingVersionID` |
| `.../Requests/DeletePromotionVersionRequest.cs` | Guarded hard delete of one version |
| `.../Requests/UpdatePromotionFamilyNameRequest.cs` | Rename the family, stamp `ContentModifiedOn` |
| `.../Requests/UpdatePromotionRequest.cs` | Rename one version |
| `.../Helper/{PromotionVersionCloner,PromotionFamilyHelper,PromotionVersionLimit}.cs` | Clone events and fees with ID remap; sibling name check and child `ParentVersionName` sync; cap lookup |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Domain/PromotionFamily/{PromotionFamily,PromotionFamilyFactory}.cs` | Family entity; every first version gets its family here |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/versions/{VersionsDrawer,CreateVersionModal}.tsx` | Drawer and create dialog |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/versions/tradeSpendVersions.helpers.ts` | `resolveFamilyID`, `resolvePromoRowHref`, `resolveVersionHref`, `resolveCreatedSandboxHref`, caps, block reasons, header names, `resolveVersionExit` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/TradeSpendDetailsContents/EditPromoName.tsx` | Family and version rename dialog (`PROMO_RENAME_COPY`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`useGetTradeSpendVersions`, `useCreateTradeSpendVersion`, `useSetReportingTradeSpendVersion`, `useDeleteTradeSpendVersion`, `useRenameTradeSpendFamily`, `useRenamePromoSandbox`) | Mutations and `invalidateAfterVersionChange` |

- **Data:** `PromotionFamily` (`PushedVersionID`, `ReportingVersionID`, `PushedOn`, `ContentModifiedOn`); `Promotion` (`FamilyID`, `VersionNumber`, `ParentVersionID`, `ParentVersionName`). DTOs `PromotionVersionListDTO` {familyID, familyName, pushedVersionID, reportingVersionID, pushedOn, remainingVersionSlots, versions[]} and `PromotionVersionDTO` {id, familyID, name, versionNumber, parentVersionID, parentVersionName, eventCount, isPushed, isReportingVersion, isOutOfDate, createdOn, createdByName, lastModifiedOn}. Web `ITradeSpendVersionListResponse`, `ITradeSpendVersion`, `IRenameTradeSpendFamilyPayload`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{familyId}/versions` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, View)` | / `PromotionVersionListDTO` | `GetPromotionVersionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{familyId}/versions` | same, Create | `CreatePromotionVersionPayload` {sourceVersionID, name} / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` {id, familyID, message} | `CreatePromotionVersionRequestHandler` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{familyId}/versions/{id}/reporting` | same, Update | / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `SetReportingVersionRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{familyId}/versions/{id}` | same, Delete | / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePromotionVersionRequestHandler` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{familyId}` | same, Update | `UpdatePromotionFamilyNameRequestPayload` {promoName} / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdatePromotionFamilyNameRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox` | same, Update | `UpdatePromotionRequest` {id: version ID, promoName} / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdatePromotionRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Cap: live versions counted against `PromotionVersionLimit.GetAsync` (setting, fallback `CreatePromotionVersionRequest.MaxVersionsPerFamily = 5`); at the cap the create is 400 "This promotion already has N versions...".
  - New version number = max existing + 1; numbers are never reused, so gaps are normal.
  - Version names are unique within a family; the family name is unique per brand; the two never rename each other (`PromotionFamilyHelper.IsRenameTargetTakenAsync`, `UpdatePromotionFamilyNameRequestHandler`).
  - Renaming a version updates `ParentVersionName` on its direct children without touching their `LastModifiedOn` (`SyncChildrenParentVersionNameAsync`).
  - The pushed version and the reporting version cannot be deleted (400 with the reason); delete removes fees, events and the version row by raw SQL.
  - `IsOutOfDate` is true only for the pushed version when the latest of version row, event (including soft-deleted) and fee `LastModifiedOn`, and family `ContentModifiedOn`, is after `PushedOn`.
  - Setting the reporting version or pushing does not move `ContentModifiedOn`, so neither marks the family stale.
  - Web: the cap shown is `versions.length + remainingVersionSlots` (`resolveVersionCap`); delete and push buttons carry tooltips from `describeDeleteBlock` / `describePushBlock`; family rename is offered only with a usable family ID and a successful versions read.
- **Dependencies:** module settings (`IModuleSettings`), 2.6.3 push, 2.6.8 fees (cloned), Report module (reads `ReportingVersionID`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** family or version of another brand 404; source version not in the family 404; duplicate version name 400 "This promotion already has a version with that name"; setting the current reporting version returns 200 with "already the reporting version"; versions read 404 when the family ID is wrong (the web shows "Versions are unavailable here").
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Versions/*` (create, delete, get, set reporting, family rename, version rename, cloner, factory, family helper), `Helper/VersionLimitSetting.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/tradeSpend/{VersionsDrawer,VersionsDrawerGating,TradeSpendDetailsVersionExit,EditPromoName,tradeSpendVersions.helpers}.test.*`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/{tradeSpendRename,tradeSpendSandboxVersionInvalidation}.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Family ID vs version ID: families created by the 2026-09-13 migration reuse the promotion ID (`PromotionVersioningAdded.cs` inserts `p."ID"` as the family ID), while families created later get a new GUID (`PromotionFamily()` constructor). Code comments in `PushPromotionToTradeSpendRequest` and the push controller still say "version 1 and its family share an ID"; that holds only for legacy rows. The web treats them as always different and never falls back from one to the other (`resolveFamilyID`).
  - The detail response carries no family ID; the web keeps it in the `family` URL param, so a deep link to a v2 without it cannot show versions.
  - `CreatePromotionVersionRequestHandler` adds the version and then clones content without a transaction; a failure mid-clone leaves a version with partial content. Fees are cloned only when the source has events (early return).
  - The cap check is not under a lock, so two parallel creates can exceed the cap by one.
  - Sandbox event status changes (`UpdateEventsStatusRequestHandler`) do not touch `LastModifiedOn`, so a status change after a push does not mark the pushed version out of date although push copies `Status`.
  - A price-list change rewrites sandbox event prices with a new `LastModifiedOn` (`SharedDataService.UpdatePromoEventsPerUnitPrice`), which can flag the pushed version as out of date even though the Brand Approved events were updated by the same call.
  - `Promotion.Name` XML doc still says renaming version 1 renames the family; the handlers no longer do this.

#### 2.6.3 Feature: Push to Brand Approved

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Copies one sandbox version (its events and fees) into Brand Approved, creating the family's single Brand Approved promotion on the first push and replacing it in place on later pushes. Brokers, calendars and Brand Approved reports then read that copy. Needs `trade-spend-sandbox` Update plus `approved-promotions` Create (first push) or Update (re-push).
- **User flow:**
  1. Push is offered from the list row (pushes the row's reporting version), the detail header (pushes the version on screen), the amber "out of date" banner, and each card in `VersionsDrawer` (labelled "Re-push" when that version is already pushed).
  2. `PushPromo` dialog states which version is pushed and, when a different version is live, that it replaces that one.
  3. Disabled with a tooltip when the version has no events (`describePushBlock` reads `eventCount` from the versions list, not the filtered detail events).
  4. On success: toast with the server message ("Version N (name) pushed into BAP successfully."), sandbox list, Brand Approved detail and the family's versions are refetched.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/PushPromotionToTradeSpendRequest.cs` | Access check, event presence check, transaction, push steps |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs` (`CreateTradeSpendPromotionAsync`, `CreateTradeSpendPromotionEventsAsync`, `CreateTradeSpendPromotionFeesAsync`, `MarkFamilyAsPushedAsync`) | Upsert promo, replace events and fees, stamp family |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/PushPromo.tsx` | Confirmation dialog |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`usePushTradeSpendSandbox`) | Mutation and invalidation |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/tradeSpendAccess.helpers.ts` (`canPushToApproved`) | Two-module gate |

- **Data:** writes `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromos` (`SandboxPromotionFamilyID`, `PromoName` = family name, `VersionName` = pushed version name, `CategoryIDs`), `TradeSpendPromoEvents` (new rows with `SandboxEventID`), `BrandApprovedPromotionFees` (event IDs translated through `SandboxEventID`), `PromotionFamilies.PushedVersionID/PushedOn`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{id}/push-to-tradespend` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, Update)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(approved-promotions, Create or Update)` | route `id` = version ID / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `PushPromotionToTradeSpendRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - The version must have at least one live event, else 400 "No promotional events found for the specified promotion...".
  - Brand Approved copy is looked up by `SandboxPromotionFamilyID`; existing copy is updated in place (same Brand Approved ID).
  - Every push hard-deletes all existing Brand Approved events and fees of that copy and inserts fresh ones; `DistributorID` comes from the brand's `CRM.DistributorBanners` row for the banner, `Guid.Empty` if none.
  - Event `Status`, `IsSubmitted`, deleted flags and audit fields are copied from the sandbox events.
  - Prime fee `EventIDs` are translated to the new Brand Approved event IDs; IDs without a match are dropped.
  - The whole push runs in `IMainDbTransaction.RunAsync`.
  - A pushed copy does not count against the promotion quota (`PromotionPoolCounter` excludes rows with `SandboxPromotionFamilyID`).
- **Dependencies:** CRM `DistributorBanners`; 2.6.2 (family state), 2.6.4 (Brand Approved copy), 2.7 calendars (read the copy).
- **Errors & edge cases:** version or family of another brand 404 "Promotion not found or does not belong to the current brand."; missing `approved-promotions` action 403.
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Push/PushPromotionToTradeSpendRequestHandlerTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/tradeSpendAccess.helpers.test.ts`, `VersionsDrawer.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Re-push discards anything edited directly in Brand Approved on that copy: event edits, deletions, submission and event status changes (events are recreated with new IDs), and a Brand Approved rename (`PromoName` is reset to the family name).
  - Recreated event IDs change on every push, so anything holding a Brand Approved event ID (for example a calendar drill-down selection) goes stale.
  - The push does not check Brand Approved name uniqueness; a direct Brand Approved promotion with the family's name can coexist with the pushed copy.
  - No Monthly Report refresh is triggered by a push (only deletes trigger one); see questions.

#### 2.6.4 Feature: Brand Approved promotions

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Brand Approved ("Approved Promotions", route `promo-planning`) holds the promotions brokers and calendars see: pushed sandbox copies, promotions created directly in Brand Approved, and Simple Promotions. Users list, open, rename, edit events of, and remove them. Gated by `approved-promotions` (View, Update, Delete; Create for the "Add Simple Promotion" entry).
- **User flow:**
  1. Nav "Promotional Planning > Approved Promotions" opens `/{brandID}/promo-planning` (`PromoListing`, `isSandbox=false`).
  2. Rows show name, year, banner count, categories, created date; Simple Promotions carry a "Simple promotion" chip and open `/{brandID}/simple-entries/{id}`; standard rows open `/{brandID}/promo-planning/{id}` (`resolvePromoRowHref`).
  3. Toolbar (right of search and year): "Remove (N)" bulk button and "Add Simple Promotion" (`AddSimplePromotionButton`, to 2.6.10). Row kebab: Remove. Rows are selectable only with `approved-promotions` delete; the selection is page-scoped and cleared on page, size, sort, search or year change (`buildSelectionScopeKey`).
  4. Remove dialog (`RemovePromo` with `BRAND_APPROVED_LIST_REMOVE_COPY`) sends one `DELETE api/v1/tradespends` with all IDs, then re-reads the page to report what actually went (`resolveBrandApprovedRemovalOutcome`): removed, partial (warning), already gone (info on 404), or failure (dialog stays open).
  5. Detail (`TradeSpendDetails isSandBox=false`): bold promotion name, an unnumbered pill with the pushed version's name when present (`resolveApprovedHeaderNames`), Remove button, rename pencil, read-only promotion fees, Promo Events grid with edit, add and delete (2.6.6).
  6. Remove from detail: same endpoint with one ID; on success or 404 the screen removes its own cache entries and `router.replace`s to the list.

  - Names are unique per brand among Brand Approved promotions, case-insensitive (`TradeSpendDTOBuilder.IsExistPromoName`).

- **Errors & edge cases:** empty `iDs` 400; detail of another brand's promotion 404; rename to an existing name 400 "Promotion name you've entered already exists!".

- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The list inner-joins events, products and banners, so a promotion with no live events is invisible in the list.
  - The list response carries no version fields; only the detail returns `VersionName` (no version number).
  - Removing a pushed copy leaves its sandbox family in place but unpushed; the sandbox list then shows "Not pushed".
  - `GET name-exist` is built by string interpolation on the web (`PromoService.getIfTradeSpendNameExist`), so a name containing `&` or `#` is truncated.
  - Rename here is overwritten by the next push from the sandbox (2.6.3).

#### 2.6.5 Feature: Standard promotion create stepper

- **Status:** Active for the sandbox; Partial for Brand Approved (the `/{brandID}/promo-planning/create` route works but no UI control links to it: the Brand Approved list offers only "Add Simple Promotion", and the "Resume" button is rendered only on the sandbox list, `PromoListing.tsx`).
- **What it does:** A four-step wizard (Retailers and Banners, Products, Events, Metrics) that builds a Standard promotion as the cartesian product of selected banner SKUs and events, then submits it in one request (regular or EDLP-only). Sandbox create needs `trade-spend-sandbox` Create; Brand Approved create needs `approved-promotions` Create; both count against the promotion quota (2.6.12).
- **User flow:**
  1. Sandbox list "Add New Promotion" opens `PromoName` (title + Plan year select 2000 to 2100); the title is checked with `name-exist` as the user types; then the stepper page opens with the name.
  2. Step 1 Retailers and Banners: `RetailerListingForPromo` (`POST api/v1/retailers/for-promo`), choose banners per retailer. Next is disabled until a banner is selected.
  3. Step 2 Products: `ProductList` / `BannerSKUs` load `POST api/v1/banners/skus/for-promo`; each SKU row needs average unit velocity and number of stores, prefilled from `POST api/v1/distributorsalesreports/velocity-per-store-for-promotion`; SKUs without a price are locked with "No Pricing Found" and a "Set price" dialog (`PricingAddOrEdit`) that refetches the step after a create.
  4. Step 3 Events: `EventList` / `EventForm` rows with name, lift, start and end dates; date pickers open on the plan year (`resolvePickerViewDate`); an EDLP toggle switches to all-year events (defaults to Jan 1 to Dec 31 of the plan year, `buildEdlpDefaultRange`).
  5. Step 4 Metrics: `PromoMetrics` / `PromoMetricsTable` / `MultipleEdit` set per row allowances (OI %, MCB %, scan, EDA, SRP, lump sum, comments); EDLP requires EDA > 0.
  6. Submit (step 5): `POST api/v1/tradespendssandbox` or `/edlp` (sandbox) or `POST api/v1/tradespends` or `/edlp`; on success `router.replace` to the new detail (`resolveCreatedSandboxHref` adds `?family=`), the localStorage draft is cleared; on error the wizard returns to step 4.
  - Draft: the whole wizard state is mirrored to `localStorage` key `${brandID}-sandboxData` (or `-promoData`) and restored on reload; "Resume" on the sandbox list reopens it.

| `.../promo-create/planYear.helpers.ts` | Plan year options, initial year from draft, picker view date, EDLP default range, out-of-year hint |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/UpsertPromotionRequest.cs` | Sandbox create or append/update events |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/TradeSpend/UpsertTradeSpendPromoRequest.cs` | Brand Approved create or append/update events |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`useCreateTradeSpend`, `useCreateTradeSpendSandbox`, `usePromoRetailer`, `usePromoBannerSkus`, `useGetIfTradeSpendNameExist[Sandbox]`) | Data layer |

- **Data:** request `UpsertPromotionRequest` / `UpsertTradeSpendPromoRequest` {id?, promoName, categoryIDs, events[]}; event payload `PromotionalEventPayload` (sandbox) or `PromoEvent` (Brand Approved): month, eventName, eventLift, startDate, endDate, retailerID, distributorID, bannerID, productID, categoryID, bannerACV, numberOfStores, allowances, averageUnitVelocity, actualLift, everyDayAllowance, isSubmitted, comments, scanPercentage, promotionType. Response `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` {id, familyID (sandbox only), message}.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(trade-spend-sandbox, Create or Update)` | `UpsertPromotionRequest` / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` | `UpsertPromotionRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends` | `RequireModule(approved-promotions, approved-promotions, View)`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(approved-promotions, Create or Update)` | `UpsertTradeSpendPromoRequest` / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` | `UpsertTradeSpendPromoRequestHandler` |

  EDLP variants in 2.6.7.
- **Business rules:**
  - Validators: name, categories and events required.
  - Brand Approved create also requires month, event name, start and end dates, retailer, banner, product and category on each event (`ValidateEventsPayload`); sandbox payload has non-nullable IDs.
  - Number of stores may not exceed the banner's `DoorCount` (`ValidateStoresCountAsync`).
  - `PerUnitPrice` is not taken from the client: it is the latest price list row for (category, distributor, product) valid on the event start date, or 0 (`GetPerUnitPriceForEvent`).
  - When ID is sent, existing events (by ID) are updated and events without ID are appended; new regular events on a banner and product that already has an EDLP event inherit its EDA.
  - The plan year is client-side only: not sent to the API; the saved year is derived from event dates.
  - Quota: `EnsureWithinLimitsAsync` before validation and `RunAsync` around the insert of the family (sandbox) or promotion (Brand Approved).
- **Dependencies:** CRM (`retailers/for-promo`, `banners/skus/for-promo`), Data Upload (`distributorsalesreports/velocity-per-store-for-promotion`), Product Specs (`PricingAddOrEdit`, price list), 2.6.12 quota.
- **Errors & edge cases:** duplicate name 400 "A promotion with this name already exists!"; store count over door count 400 naming the event; quota 409 `LimitReachedException` (message in `messages.Limit`); update of another brand's promotion 404.
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Upsert/UpsertPromotionRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `Access/PromotionQuotaHandlersTests.cs`, `TradeSpend.Application.Test/TradeSpend/{TradeSpendUpsertAccessTests,PromotionCreateBrandTests,PromotionQuotaCreatePathsTests}.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/tradeSpend/{PromoNamePlanYear,EventFormPlanYear,ProductListPricingRefresh,planYear.helpers}.test.*`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/productSpecs/PricingAddOrEdit.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The controller's `RequireModule` is View while the handler demands Create or Update; the real gate is in the handler.
  - Store-count validation builds an `IN (...)` list by string interpolation of GUIDs (`ValidateStoresCountAsync`).
  - The wizard submit fires from a `useEffect` on `activeStep == 5`; `PromoCreate.tsx` and `PromoName.tsx` contain several `console.log` calls.
  - Dead code: `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/TradeSpendCreateContainer.tsx`, `add-sku/AddSKUModal_old.tsx`, `TradeSpendCreateContents/{PromoSkuList_old,PromoMetrics_old}.tsx` have no importers.
  - The sandbox list year filter defaults to the current year, hiding a newly created promotion for another plan year.

#### 2.6.6 Feature: Promo events

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The "Promo Events Details" AG Grid on a Standard promotion's detail screen lists every event with its calculated figures and lets users edit a row inline, add events (SKU, EDLP, new event, quick event, copy), delete events and (sandbox only) change event status. The component `PromoEvents.tsx` is shared with 2.7 (Promotional Calendar and Promotional Management drill-downs), which render it read-only with `showView`, `viewBrandId`, `showPromotionType`, `onSelectionChange` and `selectionResetToken`. Actions are gated by the route's module: `canCreate` / `canUpdate` / `canDelete` / `canExport` props from `can(promoSlug, action)` in `TradeSpendDetails.tsx`.
- **User flow:**
  1. The grid loads from the detail response (`tradeSpend.events`), narrowed by the Select Promo Options drawer (months, SKUs, categories, banners, SKU status, event names, add fees, event status, fees).
  2. Inline edit: double-click a cell, then Save; the row is sent as an upsert with the promotion ID (`save` in `PromoEvents.tsx`); start and end date must be in one year unless the row is EDLP.
  3. "Edit All" / "Edit Selected" open bulk edit; "Add" dropdown offers Add SKU (`AddSKUModal`), Add EDLP Event (`AddEDLPModal`), Add New Promo Event (`AddNewEventModal`), Add Promo Event (Quick) (`AddQuickPromoEventModal`); "Copy" opens `PromoEventCopy`. All append through the same upsert with `id` set. The Add dropdown is disabled while any add modal is open (`disableAdd`).
  4. Delete: row trash icon (Popconfirm) or delete selected.
  5. Sandbox only: "Update Status" applies a `PromotionEventStatus` to selected events.

- **Business rules:**
