Gap: no backend test for `UpdateEventsStatusRequest` or `DeleteTradeSpendPromoEventsRequest`.

  - Status changes do not touch `LastModifiedOn` (see 2.6.2 out-of-date gap).

#### 2.6.7 Feature: EDLP events

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** EDLP (every day low price) events are all-year events carrying an Everyday Allowance (EDA) per banner and SKU. They are created by the stepper's EDLP toggle (an "EDLP only" promotion) or added to an existing promotion with "Add EDLP Event"; their EDA is copied onto the regular events of the same banner and SKU. Same permissions as 2.6.5 and 2.6.6.
- **User flow:**
  1. Stepper: toggle EDLP on the Events step; dates default to the plan year; Metrics requires EDA > 0 on every row; submit goes to `/edlp` with `year` and `skuActiveDate` per row.
  2. Detail: Add > Add EDLP Event opens `AddEDLPModal` (uses `AddEDLPStepper`), which posts to `/edlp` with the promotion `id`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest.cs` | Sandbox EDLP create, update, EDA propagation |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/TradeSpend/UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest.cs` | Brand Approved EDLP create, update |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/promo-create/{AddEDLPStepper,add-edlp/AddEDLPModal}.tsx` | EDLP add flow |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/promo-create/planYear.helpers.ts` (`buildEdlpDefaultRange`) | Default all-year dates |

- **Data:** EDLP event row: `PromotionType = EdlpOnly`, `Month = 0`, `StartDate = Jan 1`, `EndDate = Dec 31` of `Year`, `EventLift = 0`, `EveryDayAllowance`. Payload `EDLPPromoEvent` {id?, eventName, year, retailerID, distributorID, bannerID, productID, categoryID, bannerACV, numberOfStores, status (SKU status), skuActiveDate, averageUnitVelocity, everyDayAllowance, comments, scanPercentage, isSubmitted} (Brand Approved variant also accepts regular rows via `promotionType`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/edlp` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, View)`; handler demands Create or Update | `UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest` {id?, promoName, categoryIDs, events[]} / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` {id, familyID} | `Modules.TradeSpendSandbox...UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/edlp` | `RequireModule(approved-promotions, approved-promotions, View)`; handler demands Create or Update | `UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest` / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` | `Modules.TradeSpend...UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Sandbox: an Active SKU whose `SkuActiveDate` is after Jan 1 of the year is rejected ("SKU Active Date ... must be earlier than or equal to Event Start Date").
  - Brand Approved: year, event name, retailer, distributor, banner, product and category are required per row; a row with `promotionType = Regular` is saved as a regular event with its own month and dates.
  - Per-unit price from the price list valid on Jan 1 of the year, else 0.
  - Store count over banner door count is rejected.
  - Calculation: an EDLP event alone produces non-promo cases for the SKU's effective year and TPR spend = non-promo cases x total case allowance; regular events without an EDLP sibling have EDA forced to 0 in calculations (`PromotionDTOBuilder.GetPromotionSKUs`).
  - Same quota and name rules as 2.6.5 on create.
- **Dependencies:** Product Specs SKU status and active date, CRM door counts, 2.6.11.
- **Errors & edge cases:** missing fields 400 "Please select ... for the Product X" (Brand Approved); duplicate name 400 "Promo name you entered already exists".
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Upsert/UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `TradeSpend.Application.Test/TradeSpend/PromotionQuotaCreatePathsTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/TradeSpendDetailsAddModals.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Both EDLP handlers load the whole events table (`_eventRepository.ListAsync(cancellationToken)`) and filter by ID in memory on update; IDs are not checked against the promotion or brand.
  - Sandbox EDLP update (via `/edlp` or the main upsert) rewrites EDA on regular siblings only when a value is sent; Brand Approved EDLP does not propagate EDA to existing regular events.

#### 2.6.8 Feature: Promotion fees

- **Status:** Active (sandbox create, view and delete; Brand Approved view). Fee edit is Partial: `PUT .../promotion-fees/{id}` exists but `PromotionFeesPanel.tsx` never sets `editingFee` to a row (only resets it to null), so the edit mode of `PromotionFeeModal` is unreachable.
- **What it does:** Adds promotion-level fees on top of event allowances: Lump Sum (amount split across banners and SKUs), Coupon (per-unit value times redemption rate over the coupon window, plus an optional coupon lump sum) and Prime Membership Allowance (per-unit and membership allowance times redemption on selected events). Fees feed the SKU summary and totals. Created and deleted in the sandbox; Brand Approved receives them by push or duplicate and shows them read-only.
- **User flow:**
  1. Sandbox detail "Promotion Fees" panel lists fees with their computed value; "Add Promotion Fee" opens `PromotionFeeModal` (type, name, banners, products, events for Prime, type-specific fields).
  2. View icon opens `PromotionFeeViewModal` (`GET` single fee, sandbox or Brand Approved route by mode).
  3. Delete icon (sandbox, Popconfirm) soft-deletes the fee.
  4. The options drawer can include, exclude or narrow fees by name (`promotionFees`, `excludeAllPromotionFees`; Brand Approved `brandApprovedPromotionFees`, `excludeAllBrandApprovedPromotionFees`).
  5. Brand Approved: panel is read-only and hidden when there are no fees.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/{InsertPromotionFeeRequest,UpdatePromotionFeeRequest,DeletePromotionFeeRequest,GetPromotionFeeRequest}.cs` | Sandbox fee CRUD, `PromotionFeePayloadValidator<T>` |
| `.../DTOBuilder/PromotionFeeCalculator.cs` | Allocation per (banner, SKU) and per event |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/TradeSpend/GetBrandApprovedPromotionFeeRequest.cs` | Brand Approved single fee |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/DTOBuilder/BrandApprovedPromotionFeeCalculator.cs` | Brand Approved allocation (mirror of the sandbox calculator) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/tradeSpend/TradeSpendDetailsContents/{PromotionFeesPanel,PromotionFeeModal,PromotionFeeViewModal}.tsx` | Panel, create form, view |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`useCreatePromotionFeeSandbox`, `useUpdatePromotionFeeSandbox`, `useDeletePromotionFeeSandbox`, `useGetPromotionFee`) | Data layer |

- **Data:** `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionFees`, `TradeSpend.BrandApprovedPromotionFees`; payload `PromotionFeePayload` {type, name, bannerIDs, productIDs, eventIDs, couponStartDate, couponEndDate, lumpSumAmount, couponRedemptionRate, couponValue, couponLumpSum, primePerUnitAllowance, primeMembershipAllowancePerUnit, primeRedemptionPercentage}; responses `PromotionFeeResponseDTO` {id, message}, `PromotionFeeDetailDTO`, `BrandApprovedPromotionFeeDetailDTO`; summaries `PromotionFeeSummaryDTO` {id, name, type, typeLabel, value}.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{promotionId}/promotion-fees/{id}` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, View)` | / `PromotionFeeDetailDTO` | `GetPromotionFeeRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{promotionId}/promotion-fees` | same, Create | `PromotionFeePayload` / `PromotionFeeResponseDTO` | `InsertPromotionFeeRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{promotionId}/promotion-fees/{id}` | same, Update | `PromotionFeePayload` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdatePromotionFeeRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{promotionId}/promotion-fees/{id}` | same, Delete | / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePromotionFeeRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespends/{promoID}/brand-approved-promotion-fees/{id}` | `RequireModule(approved-promotions, approved-promotions, View)` | / `BrandApprovedPromotionFeeDetailDTO` | `GetBrandApprovedPromotionFeeRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Name and at least one banner required; Lump Sum needs amount >= 0; Coupon needs start, end (>= start), redemption >= 0, value >= 0, optional lump sum >= 0; Prime needs per-unit allowance >= 0 and redemption >= 0, optional membership allowance >= 0 (`PromotionFeePayloadValidator`).
  - Fields not belonging to the chosen type are stored as null; `EventIDs` are kept only for Prime.
  - Lump Sum: amount / banner count / products of that banner present in the (event-scoped) events.
  - Coupon: per (banner, SKU), promo cases prorated by day overlap with the window plus non-promo cases in the window, times case pack, redemption % and coupon value; coupon lump sum only when the window overlaps the selected events.
  - Prime: per candidate event, promo cases x case pack x (per-unit + membership) x redemption %; also reported per event.
  - Fee delete is soft; version delete hard-deletes fees.
  - Web: Add and Delete shown only in the sandbox and only with `canCreate` / `canDelete`.
- **Dependencies:** 2.6.11 (cases), 2.6.3 (push copies fees, translating Prime event IDs), 2.6.9 (duplicate shifts coupon dates), 2.6.2 (version copy clones fees).
- **Errors & edge cases:** fee of another brand or promotion 404 "Promotion Fee not found."; promotion not found 404.
- **Tests:** web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/tradeSpend/PromotionFeesPanelGating.test.tsx`. Gap: no backend tests for fee requests or either fee calculator.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** two near-identical calculators (`PromotionFeeCalculator`, `BrandApprovedPromotionFeeCalculator`) must be kept in step; Brand Approved fees have no create, update or delete endpoint, so they can be changed only by re-pushing.

#### 2.6.9 Feature: Duplicate (year roll-forward)

- **Status:** Partial. Sandbox duplicate is offered in the list kebab but the web sends the family ID where the backend expects a version ID (see Gotchas). Brand Approved duplicate has a backend endpoint and hook but no UI entry (the list's "Duplicate" item is hidden with `hide: !isSandbox || !canAdd` in `PromoListing.tsx`).
- **What it does:** Copies a promotion into a new promotion for a chosen year: same products, banners and allowances, every event moved to the same month and day in the new year (day clamped to the month length), fees copied with coupon dates shifted. In the sandbox the copy is a new family, not a new version. Needs `trade-spend-sandbox` / `approved-promotions` Create and passes through the quota.
- **User flow:**
  1. Sandbox list row kebab "Duplicate" opens `DuplicatePromo` with name "{name} - Copy" and the row's year.
  2. User edits name and year; submit posts `{promoName, year, promotionID: row.id}`.
  3. Success toast "Promotion(s) duplicated successfully!" and list refresh.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/Requests/DuplicateSandboxPromotionRequest.cs` | Sandbox duplicate into a new family |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/TradeSpend/DuplicateTradeSpendRequest.cs` | Brand Approved duplicate |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/DuplicatePromo.tsx` | Dialog |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` (`useDuplicateTradeSpendSandbox`, `useDuplicateTradeSpend`) | Mutations |

- **Data:** new `PromotionFamily` + `Promotion` (sandbox) or `TradeSpendPromo` (keeps `EntryType` of the source); new events with `SandboxEventID = null`; fees copied, Prime `EventIDs` remapped by position.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/duplicate` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-sandbox, trade-spend-sandbox, Create)` | `DuplicateSandboxPromotionRequest` {promotionID (version ID), year, promoName?} / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DuplicateSandboxPromotionRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/duplicate` | `RequireModule(approved-promotions, approved-promotions, Create)` | `DuplicateTradeSpendRequest` {tradeSpendPromoID, year, promoName} / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` {id} | `DuplicateTradeSpendRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Target year must be >= the start year of the first event returned for the source (`GetPromoEventsByPromoIDSpec` has no ordering), else 400 "Please select a year that is equal or later...".
  - Name uniqueness: sandbox checks family names only when a name is given; Brand Approved always checks.
  - Event `Status`, `IsSubmitted`, prices and allowances are copied as-is (prices are not re-looked-up for the new year).
  - Quota: `EnsureWithinLimitsAsync` first, then `RunAsync` around the insert.
- **Dependencies:** 2.6.12 quota, 2.6.8 fees.
- **Errors & edge cases:** source not found or another brand 404; a source with no events creates nothing yet returns success (Brand Approved returns `id = Guid.Empty` with "Promotion copied successfully.").
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Duplicate/DuplicateSandboxPromotionRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `TradeSpend.Application.Test/TradeSpend/PromotionQuotaCreatePathsTests.cs`. No web test for `DuplicatePromo`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - ID mismatch: `DuplicatePromo.tsx` sends `promotionID: promo.id`, and the sandbox list row `id` is the family ID (`GetPromotionsRequest` selects `f."ID"`), while the handler loads `IRepository<Promotion>` by that ID. It works only for families created by the versioning migration (family ID = version 1 ID); for families created after 2026-09-13 it returns 404 "Promotion not found! Please try again.". It also always copies the version whose ID matches, not the reporting version.
  - Sandbox duplicate without a name reuses the source version's name as the new family name without a uniqueness check.
  - `DuplicateTradeSpendRequestHandler` dereferences `request.PromoName!` before the null fallback, so an omitted name throws.
  - Year check uses only the first event's start date; events that start in an earlier year than the first are not checked.
  - `DuplicatePromo.tsx` logs the promo and form data to the console.

#### 2.6.10 Feature: Simple Promotion

- **Status:** Active (create grid, detail, inline edit, event delete, remove). Partial: add-lines and server-side validate endpoints have no UI (see 2.6.10.4); the `/simple-entries` list route is reachable only by URL (see 2.6.10.6).
- **What it does:** A calendar-only Brand Approved promotion (`EntryType = Simple`) entered in a spreadsheet grid: one row per (retailer, banner, product) from the brand's APL, an optional EDLP group, and twelve month groups (event name, start date, end date, OI %, MCB %, Scan $, TPR $, Ad/TPR Fees $, comments). It carries no velocity, store or lift inputs, so it is excluded from Monthly Report and roll-ups and cannot be pushed to the sandbox, but it appears on both promotional calendars. Gated by `approved-promotions` (route `simple-entries` maps to that slug in `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`); create needs Create, edit Update, delete Delete, export Export.
- **User flow:**
  1. Brand Approved list "Add Simple Promotion" opens `/{brandID}/simple-entries/create` (`SimpleEntryCreate`).
  2. The grid is built from `POST api/v1/retailers/for-promo` (all retailers) then `POST api/v1/banners/skus/for-promo` (all banners) (`useSimpleEntryRows`); identity columns are read-only and frozen.
  3. User types a Promotion Title and Plan year (2000 to 2100), fills month groups (date picker on Start/End Date cells, unit rewrite to `%` / `$`), optionally the EDLP group (Y/N, event name, Everyday Allowance), uses Filter (scopes the submission), "Copy events to other months", Export / Import (2.6.10.2), and the product-cell "Set price" for unpriced SKUs.
  4. Validate marks issue cells and lists issues from the rules register (2.6.10.1); Submit validates, confirms what filtered-out rows or months will be dropped, then `POST api/v1/tradespends/simple`.
  5. On success `router.replace` to `/{brandID}/simple-entries/{id}`; the Brand Approved list and calendars are invalidated (`invalidateAfterSimpleEntryCreate`).
  6. Detail (2.6.10.3): filterable events table, Edit (inline), Export, Remove promotion, delete selected events.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/SimplePromo/Requests/CreateSimplePromotionRequest.cs` | Create: quota, reference data, validation, promotion + events |
| `.../SimplePromo/Helpers/SimplePromotionGridValidator.cs` | Title, plan year, row and month rules |
| `.../SimplePromo/Helpers/SimplePromotionEventFactory.cs` | Rows to `TradeSpendPromoEvent`s (EDLP month 0 + month events) |
| `.../SimplePromo/Helpers/{SimplePromotionReferenceDataLoader,SimplePromotionReferenceData,SimplePromotionPriceLookup,SimplePromotionIssueReporter,SimplePromotionGuard}.cs` | APL lookup, prices, error keys, Simple-only guard |
| `.../Services/EventNameParser.cs`, `.../SimplePromo/Helpers/SimplePromoOptions.cs` | Parses dates out of `eventNameAndDates` using configured patterns |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/SimpleEntryCreate.tsx` | Create page |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/{SimpleEntryGrid,SimpleEntryGridInner}.tsx` | FortuneSheet wrapper (dynamic import, stable hooks) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/simpleEntrySheet.ts` | Sheet layout, read back (`sheetToSimpleEntryGrid`), copy months, issue marking, scroll |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/simpleEntry.helpers.ts` | `gridToPayload`, date parsing, month splitting, line packing, unit formatting |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/simpleEntryRules.ts` | Rules register (`SIMPLE_ENTRY_RULES`, `ALLOW_CROSS_MONTH_EVENTS`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/{simpleEntryFilters,SimpleEntryFilterPanel,SimpleEntryFilterButton}.ts(x)` | Filter drawer and submission scope |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/{SimpleEntryDatePicker,simpleEntryDateCell,searchDialog}.ts(x)` | Cell date picker; FortuneSheet find dialog fixes |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/simpleEntry.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/simpleEntries.ts` | Data layer |

- **Data:** `TradeSpendPromo` with `EntryType = Simple` and `CategoryIDs` from the rows; one `TradeSpendPromoEvent` per EDLP line (`Month 0`, `PromotionType EdlpOnly`, `EveryDayAllowance`) and per filled month (`PromotionType Regular`; `PromotedCaseAllowanceOI` = OI %, `PromotedCaseAllowanceMCB` = MCB, `PromotedUnitScanAllowance` = Scan $, `UnitSRP` = TPR $, `LumpSumProposed` = Ad/TPR Fees, `Comments`; EDA copied from the row when the line is EDLP), `PerUnitPrice` nullable (null when unpriced), `Status Active`, `IsSubmitted false`. Request `CreateSimplePromotionRequest` {promoName, planYear, rows: `SimplePromotionRowPayload` {retailerID, bannerID, categoryID, productID, isEdlp, everydayAllowance, eventNameAndDates (EDLP name), months: `SimplePromotionMonthPayload` {month, eventNameAndDates, oiPercentage, mcb, scanAmount, tprDollars, adTprFees, comments}}}. Web `ISimplePromotionCreateRequest`, `ISimplePromotionRow`, `ISimplePromotionMonthEntry` (adds `startDate`, `endDate`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/simple` | `RequireModule(approved-promotions, approved-promotions, Create)` | `CreateSimplePromotionRequest` / `UpsertPromotionResponseDTO` {id, message "Promotion created successfully with N event(s)."} | `CreateSimplePromotionRequestHandler` |

  Detail, edit, delete and add endpoints in sub-features.
- **Business rules (backend, working branch):**
  - Title required and unique among Brand Approved names; plan year 2000 to 2100; at least one row and one event.
  - Each row's (retailer, banner, product) must be in the brand's APL reference data: live `BannerSKUs` joined to live banner, retailer, a brand `DistributorBanners` row, product and category of the brand; else "no longer on your APL". A non-empty `categoryID` must match the product's category.
  - Per line: a month 1 to 12 only once; a month with any value needs `eventNameAndDates`.
  - Event dates come from `EventNameParser.Parse` on `eventNameAndDates`; without configured patterns the whole text is the event name and the dates are the month (or the year for EDLP).
  - `PerUnitPrice` from the price list for (category, distributor from `DistributorBanners`, product) valid at the start date, else null.
  - Up to 20 issues are returned as one validation error keyed "Row N, Month - Field (k)", plus "More".
  - Quota as an approved promotion (2.6.12).
- **Business rules (web):** client rules register in `simpleEntryRules.ts` (cell, event, row, grid stages); cross-month events allowed (`ALLOW_CROSS_MONTH_EVENTS = true`) and split into one month entry per month covered (`splitEventSpanByMonth`); overlapping events on one row refused, two events in one month packed onto separate lines (`packMonthEntriesIntoLines`); EDLP line sends the EDLP name on the row and its month groups as ordinary months (`toEdlpWireRow`); filtered-out rows and months are dropped from the request after a confirmation.
- **Dependencies:** CRM (`retailers/for-promo`, `banners/skus/for-promo`, `DistributorBanners`), Product Specs price list and "Set price" (`AddPricingList`, `POST api/v1/pricelists/create`), 2.6.12 quota, 2.7 calendars, `@fortune-sheet/react` 1.0.4, `xlsx`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 400 with per-cell keys; 409 limit reached; a grid row whose banner has no `DistributorBanners` row for the brand appears in the grid (built from `banners/skus/for-promo`) but is rejected server-side as not on the APL.
- **Tests:** backend `TradeSpend.Application.Test/SimplePromo/{CreateSimplePromotionRequestHandlerTests,SimplePromotionGridValidatorTests,SimplePromotionEventFactoryTests,SimplePromotionReferenceDataLoaderTests,SimplePromotionReferenceDataTests,EventNameParserTests}.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/simple-entries/{SimpleEntryCreate,SimpleEntryGridInner,SimpleEntryDatePicker,SimpleEntryFilterButton,simpleEntry.helpers,simpleEntryRules,simpleEntrySheet,simpleEntryDateCell,simpleEntryFilters,searchDialog}.test.*`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/simpleEntry.service.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/simpleEntriesInvalidation.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Contract skew with this backend branch: the web sends `startDate` / `endDate` on each month entry (CS-1774), but `SimplePromotionMonthPayload` on `feature/CS-1770-iam-service-broker-workspace` has no such fields and still parses dates from `eventNameAndDates`. No `SimplePromo` section exists in any appsettings file, so no patterns are configured: the event is saved with the whole text (for example "Big Book 1/15-1/31") as its name and the full month as its dates. `origin/master` (commit `f1c6fb5b`, CS-1774) adds `StartDate`/`EndDate` on month entries and event updates, adds `SimplePromotionEventDates` validation (both or neither, inside the event's month and plan year, end not before start) and removes `EventNameParser`, `SimplePromoOptions` and `EventsWithParsedDates`.
  - Promotion row and events are not saved in one transaction (events are bulk-inserted after the quota insert).
  - `CreateSimplePromotionRequestHandler` keeps an unused `ThrowForIssues` / `BuildIssueKey` pair duplicated by `SimplePromotionIssueReporter`.
  - The backend does not require EDA on an EDLP line; the web rules do.

##### 2.6.10.1 Sub-feature: Grid validation rules

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Every client rule is defined once in `SIMPLE_ENTRY_RULES` (title, summary, message, stage) keyed by `SimpleEntryIssueCode`; the sheet reader raises cell-stage issues (`sheetToSimpleEntryGrid`) and `gridToPayload` raises event, row and grid issues. Validate tints issue cells red, focusing an issue scrolls to it (`resolveScrollToCell`) and deepens its tint.
- **Business rules:** dates readable and inside the plan year; a start date inside its column's month; end date not before start and not past Dec 31; dates without a name are "orphan values"; EDLP flag Y needs an EDLP event name and EDA; numbers may not carry the other unit's sign; a row whose product is disabled server-side is unavailable; an unpriced product is allowed (`noPricing` only offers "Set price").
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/simple-entries/simpleEntryRules.test.ts`, `simpleEntry.helpers.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** marks are cleared by sweeping the committed sheet for the two issue tints (`findIssueTintedCells`) because FortuneSheet getters read the last render while writers are queued.

##### 2.6.10.2 Sub-feature: Excel export and import of the grid

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Export writes the grid's own layout (hidden key column, identity, EDLP, twelve month groups) as `.xlsx` (`buildSimpleEntryWorkbook`, `downloadSimpleEntryWorkbook`); Import reads a file (`readFileBytes`, `readWorkbookAoa`), refuses it on any header mismatch (`findSimpleEntryLayoutMismatch`), matches rows by key or a unique (banner, UPC) pair (`planSimpleEntryImport`), confirms, then writes contiguous blocks (`groupSimpleEntryWriteBlocks`) and re-validates after the commit.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.web/src/components/simple-entries/simpleEntryWorkbook.ts`, `SimpleEntryCreate.tsx` (`handleExport`, import confirm).
- **Business rules:** identity is never read from the file; a blank cell in the file clears the grid cell; rows the file does not mention are untouched; skipped file rows are named.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/simple-entries/simpleEntryWorkbook.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** any column layout change (for example the CS-1777 EDLP name column) makes older exported files unimportable by design.

#### 2.6.11 Feature: Trade spend calculation engine

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Server-side formulas that turn a Standard promotion's events, SKU data (case pack, distributor markup, SKU status, active and disco dates), banner ACV and door counts, and price list into cases, revenue, spend and rates. Used by the sandbox and Brand Approved detail endpoints and reused by the Report module (roll-ups, forecasts, Monthly Report). No user-facing controls; results appear in the detail summary tables, rates chart and Promo Events grid.
- **User flow:**
  1. A detail request (2.6.1, 2.6.4) loads events with joined product, banner and pricing data (`PromotionDTOBuilder.GetQuery`, `TradeSpendDTOBuilder`).
  2. Events are filtered by the options drawer, split into calculable (Active, Pending, RetailerApproved, Completed) and display-only statuses.
  3. Per banner and SKU: effective weeks from the SKU lifecycle, non-promo cases per month, promo cases per event, revenue and spend; fees allocated (2.6.8); SKU summary, event-name statistics, SKU rates graph, POD.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/TradeSpendCalculation/TradeSpendCalculator.cs` | Static formulas |
| `.../TradeSpendCalculation/SKULifecycleCalculationHelper.cs` | Effective date range and weeks from SKU active and disco dates; lifecycle-aware non-promo and promo cases |
| `.../TradeSpendCalculation/MonthSelectionHelper.cs` | Month filter selection, day-overlap factors, non-promo period slicing by month |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/DTOBuilder/PromotionDTOBuilder.cs` | Sandbox detail assembly (`GetPromotionSKUs`, `GetNonPromoCasesPerMonth`, `GetNonPromoRevenue`, `GetSKUSummaryDTO`, `GetSKUStatistics`, `MergeEvents`, `ProcessEvents`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Application/DTOs/PromotionalEventDTO.cs` | Computed properties per event (case cost, markup, total case allowance, retailer net case, net unit cost, retailer profit, total spend) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/DTOBuilder/TradeSpendDTOBuilder.cs` | Brand Approved mirror |

- **Data:** reads events plus `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications` (case pack, SKU status, active and disco dates), distributor markup, `CRM.Banners` (door count), banner ACV, price list (`GetPriceListOfBrandAsync`). Output DTOs: `PromotionDTO` / `TradeSpendPromoDTO`, `PromotionSKUSummaryDTO`, `PromotionSKUStatisticsDTO`, `PromotionEventNameStatisticsDTO`, `PromotionSKUsRatesStatisticsDTO`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** none of its own (consumed by `POST /api/v1/tradespendssandbox/{id}` and `POST /api/v1/tradespends/{id}`).
- **Business rules (formulas in `TradeSpendCalculator`):**
  - Weeks of an event = (end - start in days + 1) / 7; non-promo weeks = 52.143 (or lifecycle weeks) minus promo weeks, floored at 0.
  - Case cost = case pack x per-unit price; book cost = case cost x 1.45; case cost markup = case cost x (1 + distributor markup %).
  - Total case allowance = scan x case pack + case cost x OI % + book cost x MCB % + EDA x case pack.
  - Retailer net case = case cost markup - total case allowance; net unit retailer cost = net case / case pack; retailer profit % = (SRP - net unit cost) / SRP x 100.
  - Non-promo cases = stores x ACV % x non-promo weeks x avg weekly sales / case pack (lifecycle variant uses effective weeks); promo cases = weekly baseline x event weeks x (1 + lift %), lift below 0 treated as 0.
  - Promo revenue = (case cost - total case allowance) x promo cases; TPR spend = total case allowance x promo cases; total revenue = LSF revenue + spend; TPR % and add-fee % of total revenue.
  - EDLP-only SKU: TPR spend = non-promo cases x total case allowance, no promo cases; regular events have EDA zeroed when the SKU has no EDLP event.
  - Events outside the SKU's active-to-disco window are shown with zero figures (`AdjustEventDatesForSKULifecycle`).
  - POD = max number of stores x number of distinct SKUs.
  - Simple promotions never enter calculations (`PromotionCalculationEligibility` excludes `EntryType != Standard` in report queries; the Standard detail refuses them).
- **Dependencies:** Product Specs (SKU data, prices), CRM (banners), Report module (reuses the calculator and month helpers).
- **Errors & edge cases:** missing case pack yields null case cost and 0 revenue; missing price gives `PerUnitPrice = 0` on Standard events (set at save time); zero SRP yields null retailer profit.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Report.Application.Test/Report/MonthSelectionHelperTests.cs`. Gap: no unit tests for `TradeSpendCalculator`, `SKULifecycleCalculationHelper`, `PromotionDTOBuilder` or `TradeSpendDTOBuilder`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Sandbox and Brand Approved builders are parallel copies (about 1,100 to 1,250 lines each) that must change together.
  - Per-unit price is captured on the event at save time and later rewritten by price-list writes (`UpdatePromoEventsPerUnitPrice`) and the admin "sync per-unit price" cleanup (`POST api/v1/admin/data-cleanup/sync-per-unit-price` -> `SharedDataService.SyncPerUnitPriceAsync`), owned by other modules.
  - Constants 1.45 (book cost) and 52.143 (weeks per year) are hard-coded.

#### 2.6.12 Feature: Promotion limits enforcement

- **Status:** Active (no limit is enforced until a value is set: both settings default to unlimited, `ModuleSettingCatalogSeedData`).
- **What it does:** Applies the brand's `promotion-planning` quota settings "Promotions per person" (`max-promotions-per-user`) and "Promotions for the whole Brand" (`max-promotions-per-brand`) to every create path. Sandbox families and directly created Brand Approved promotions (Standard or Simple) share one pool; pushed Brand Approved copies are not counted. Support access bypasses the limit and writes a `quota.bypassed` audit row.
- **User flow:**
  1. A platform admin sets the values through the module settings screens (owned by the module settings feature).
  2. On create, the API answers 409 `LimitReachedException` with `messages.Limit` ("This brand has reached its limit of N promotions. Contact Caboodle to raise it." or "You have reached your limit of N promotions on this brand...").
  3. The web shows a "Limit reached" warning through `showErrorNotification` (`isLimitReached`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/apiError.helper.ts`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Settings/PromotionQuota.cs` | Pool, rules and messages; `ForApprovedPromotion`, `ForSandboxPromotion` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Settings/QuotaGuard.cs` | `EnsureWithinLimitsAsync` (cached settings, early refusal), `RunAsync` (advisory lock, re-read from DB, count, insert) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Settings/PromotionPoolCounter.cs` | Brand and person counts |
| Create paths: `UpsertTradeSpendPromoRequest.cs`, `Modules.TradeSpend...UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest.cs`, `DuplicateTradeSpendRequest.cs`, `CreateSimplePromotionRequest.cs`, `UpsertPromotionRequest.cs`, `Modules.TradeSpendSandbox...UpsertEDLPOnlyPromotionRequest.cs`, `DuplicateSandboxPromotionRequest.cs` | Call the guard on create only (not on update with an ID, version creation, or push) |
- **Data:** counts live rows of `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionFamilies` plus `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromos` with `SandboxPromotionFamilyID IS NULL`, by `BrandID` (and `CreatedBy` for the person rule).
- **APIs/interfaces:** applied inside `POST /api/v1/tradespends`, `/tradespends/edlp`, `/tradespends/duplicate`, `/tradespends/simple`, `/tradespendssandbox`, `/tradespendssandbox/edlp`, `/tradespendssandbox/duplicate` when no ID is sent. Errors: 409 `LimitReachedException` key `Limit`.
- **Business rules:** a limit counts as reached when count + 1 > maximum; the lock is `pg_advisory_xact_lock(pool, organization)` and the insert runs in the same transaction; the brand's values apply to brokers working on that brand.
- **Dependencies:** module settings (`IModuleSettings`), IAM audit (`IIamAuditService`), access context (`IsSupportAccess`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Not verified.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Settings/{QuotaGuardTests,PromotionPoolCounterTests}.cs`, `TradeSpend.Application.Test/TradeSpend/PromotionQuotaCreatePathsTests.cs`, `TradeSpendSandbox.Application.Test/Access/PromotionQuotaHandlersTests.cs`, test doubles `RecordingQuotaGuard.cs` in both test projects.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Version creation is limited separately by `max-versions-per-family` (2.6.2), not by this pool.
  - A deleted pushed copy does not change the count; deleting the sandbox family does.
  - Only the promotion row is inside the quota transaction; events are inserted afterwards.

#### 2.6.13 Feature: Exports from promotion details

- **Status:** Active

### 2.7 Module: Promotional Calendars & Management

- **Purpose:** Read and bulk-update surfaces over Brand Approved promotion events (`TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents`). Brands get the "Promo at a glance" calendar (one row per banner, twelve month columns of event-name chips) plus a free-text notes grid. Brokers get "Promotional Management": the same calendar across every brand they can access (one row per brand x distributor x banner x category x promotion type), a read view of the brands' notes, and their own spreadsheet-like custom note tabs ("Promo Tabs"). All calendars support a chip drill-down, bulk event-status and submission-status writes, a synchronous chip CSV and an asynchronous whole-calendar CSV export job.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/TradeSpend/TradeSpendsController.cs` (region "Promo At a Glace", routes `promos-at-a-glance*`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` (promotional-management routes and broker notes routes), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/PromotionalManagementNotesController.cs` (Promo Tabs, own route `api/v{version}/brokers/promotional-management-notes`).
  - Backend handlers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/` (brand calendar, brand notes, broker read of notes), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/PromotionalManagement/` (broker calendar), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/PromotionalManagement/Notes/` (Promo Tabs), helpers `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/PromoTab*.cs`.
  - Backend domain: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Domain/TradeSpend/TradeSpendPromoEvent.cs`, `.../TradeSpendPromoNote.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Domain/Broker/PromoTab.cs`, `PromoTabColumn.cs`, `PromoTabRow.cs`, `PromoTabCell.cs`.
  - Web brand: `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(promotional-calendar)/` (layout, `promotional-calendar/`, `promotional-notes/`), `caboodle.web/src/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromoAtAGlanceFilter.tsx`, `PromoNotes.tsx`, `PromoNotesFilter.tsx`, `usePromoAtAGlanceExport.ts`.
  - Web broker: `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/promotional-management/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/PromotionalMangementFilter.tsx`, `PromotionalMangementNotesFilter.tsx`, `PromoEventChipSummary.tsx`, `promotionalManagement.helpers.ts`, `usePromotionalManagementExport.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromoNotesTabs.tsx`, `PromoNotesForBroker.tsx`, `PromoTabGrid.tsx`, `PromoTabCell.tsx`, `PromoTabColumnModal.tsx`, `PromoTabFilterPanel.tsx`, `promoTabs.helpers.ts`, `promoNotes.helpers.ts`.
  - Web data layer: `caboodle.web/src/service/promotional-management.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/promoTabs.service.ts`, the promos-at-a-glance methods of `caboodle.web/src/service/promo.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promotional-management.ts` (promo part), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promo-tabs.service.ts`, promos-at-a-glance hooks in `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts`, models `caboodle.web/src/models/promotional-management.interface.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/models/promoTabs.interface.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/models/promo.interface.ts`.
  - Admin: none found (no reference to these routes or modules in `caboodle.admin/src`).
- **Shared data models:**
  - `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents` (`TradeSpendPromoEvent`): `BrandID`, `TradeSpendPromoID`, `RetailerID`, `DistributorID`, `BannerID`, `ProductID`, `CategoryID`, `EventName`, `Month` (int, 0 for EDLP), `StartDate`, `EndDate`, `PromotionType?` (`Regular = 1`, `EdlpOnly = 2`), `Status` (`PromotionEventStatus`: 1 Active, 2 Cancelled, 3 Pending, 4 Did Not Run, 5 Declined, 6 Retailer Approved, 7 Completed), `IsSubmitted`, `CreatedBy`, money fields. Owned by 2.6; this module reads it and writes only `Status`, `IsSubmitted` and the audit stamps.

Appended to every read, export and status write in this module.

  - CRM and Product Specs: visibility rule and facet joins (retailers, banners, distributor banners, banner SKUs, regions, products, categories).

#### 2.7.1 Feature: Brand Promotional Calendar (Promos at a Glance)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A brand-scoped calendar of Brand Approved promotion events for one year: one row per banner, twelve month columns, each cell a list of chips grouped by event name and event status, with a count badge and a green "submitted" tag. EDLP events (`Month = 0`) appear in every month column. Used by Brand organizations (module `promotional-calendar-view`, brand slug, broker slug `null`); a Brokerage acting on a connected brand route passes the same brand slug (`AccessContext.ModuleRefusal`, `brokerageUsesBrandSlug: true`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Nav "Promotional Planning > Promotional Calendar" opens `/{brandID}/promotional-calendar` (gate `promotional-calendar-view`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts`, `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES` in `caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts`). The layout titled "Promo at a glance" shows two tabs: Promotional Calendar and Notes (`PromotionalCalendarLayout.tsx`).
  2. Year starts at the current calendar year and snaps back to it when cleared (`resolvePromoCalendarYear`); other filters live in a drawer (2.7.1.1). Filters are debounced before querying.
  3. Grid loads `POST promos-at-a-glance` with paging on the query string; `rowKey` is `bannerID`; a `PaginationComponent` pages banners.
  4. Clicking a chip opens the drill-down modal (2.7.1.2) with status update (2.7.1.3) and chip CSV.
  5. Toolbar: Submit and Revoke (`update` action) open a scope menu then a confirmation (2.7.1.4); Export (`export` action) starts the async job (2.7.1.5). Controls are hidden while access loads and when the action is missing.
  6. Empty states: a banner with no chips still renders as a row (the handler emits every banner on the page).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/TradeSpend/TradeSpendsController.cs` | `GetPromosAtAGlanceRequestAsync` and the other `promos-at-a-glance*` actions; all carry `[BrandIDHeader]` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/GetPromosAtAGlanceWithPagingRequest.cs` | `GetPromosAtAGlanceRequest` + handler: pages distinct banners, then loads chip groups for those banners |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/PromosAtAGlanceEventFilter.cs` | Shared filter joins/conditions for calendar, chips, submission and export |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(promotional-calendar)/PromotionalCalendarLayout.tsx` | Header + section tabs (calendar, notes) |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(promotional-calendar)/promotional-calendar/PromotionalCalendar.tsx` | Grid, chips, legend, drill-down modal, toolbar, confirmations |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(promotional-calendar)/promotional-calendar/promotionalCalendar.helpers.ts` | Scope list, scope-to-request builders, confirmation copy, chip CSV error parsing |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` | `usePromotAtAGlance`, `usePromotAtAGlanceFilter`, `usePromoAtAGlanceEvents`, `useSubmitPromoAtAGlance`, `useUpdatePromoAtAGlanceEventStatus` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/promo.service.ts` | `PromoService.getPromoAtAglance` and the other promos-at-a-glance calls, each with a `BrandID` header from the `[brandID]` route param |

- **Data:** reads `TradeSpendPromoEvents` joined to `CRM.Banners`; response `PagedData<PromoAtaGlanceDTO>` (`BannerID`, `BannerName`, `January` to `December` as `List<EventGroupDTO>` with `EventName`, `Count`, `IsSubmitted`, `EventStatus`). Web types `IPromoAtAGlanceFilters`, `IPagedPromoAtAGlanceRows`, `IPromoAtAGlanceRow`, `IPromoEventGroup` (`caboodle.web/src/models/promo.interface.ts`, `promotional-management.interface.ts`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, View)`, `BrandID` header | Body `GetPromosAtAGlanceRequestPayload` (`months`, `retailerIDs`, `distributorIDs`, `bannerIDs`, `categoryIDs`, `regionIDs`, `createdBy`, `year`); query `pageSize`, `currentPage` / `PagedData<PromoAtaGlanceDTO>`; web `IPagedPromoAtAGlanceRows` | `GetPromosAtAGlanceRequestHandler` |

  Other endpoints of this feature are listed under its sub-features.
- **Business rules:**
  - Brand comes from `IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync` (the `BrandID` header), never from the body.
  - Only events with `Deleted = FALSE`, `PromotionType IS NOT NULL` and passing `PromoEventVisibility` count.
  - A month filter always adds month 0 so EDLP events survive it; EDLP chips are copied into every month column that the month filter allows (`GetEventsForEDLP`).
  - `year` matches when the event's start or end year equals it; omitted year merges all years into the twelve columns (the web always sends one).
  - Distributor filter matches `COALESCE(parent.ID, d.ID)`, the same value the facet returns; category filter matches the event's own `CategoryID`; region filter inner-joins `CRM.RetailerRegions` + `CRM.Regions`.
  - Banner paging orders by banner name then id; final rows are re-sorted by banner name.
- **Dependencies:** 2.6 (event data), CRM (banners, regions, distributors), Product Specs (categories), IAM module gate, `PagingHelper.GetDataRange` (`pageSize -1` = all).
- **Errors & edge cases:** A user without the module gets 403 from the policy; the web hides the nav item and `ModuleRouteGuard` redirects. Chips are keyed by `eventName + eventStatus`; one event name can produce several chips per month.
- **Tests:** backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/PromosAtAGlance/GetPromosAtAGlanceRequestTests.cs`, `PromosAtAGlanceEventFilterTests.cs`, `BrandBrokerParityTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/PromotionalManagement/PromoEventVisibilityTests.cs`, `SimplePromotionCalendarVisibilityTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/promotional-calendar/PromotionalCalendarGating.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/promotionalCalendar.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/promoAtAGlance.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - SQL fragments interpolate GUID and month lists into the query string (`PromosAtAGlanceEventFilter.BuildCondition`); safe only because the values are typed `Guid`/`Month`.
  - `PromotionalCalendarLayout.tsx` leaves a `console.log(pathname...)` and shows both tabs regardless of module access; the route guard enforces the notes gate on navigation.
  - Legacy region name "Promo At a Glace" (typo) in the controller.

##### 2.7.1.2 Sub-feature: Brand chip drill-down and chip CSV

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Clicking a chip lists every event behind it (SKU, retailer, dates, allowances, status) in the shared `PromoEvents` AG Grid (documented in 2.6); "Export promo event" downloads the same rows as CSV.
- **User flow:** chip click stores `{bannerID, month, eventName, eventStatus, year}` (year from the applied filters); the drill-down query runs with `pageSize -1`; the modal is `destroyOnClose`; export uses a raw `fetch` (`fetchWithMock`) with `authorization` + `BrandID` headers and `downloadHelper`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/events` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, View)`, `BrandID` header | Query `bannerID`, `month`, `eventName`, optional `year`, `eventStatus`, `pageSize`, `currentPage` / `PagedData<TradeSpendPromoDataModel>`; web `IPagedPromoSameNameEvents` | `GetEventsWithSameEventNameRequestHandler` (`.../PromosAtAGlance/GetEventsWithSameEventNameRequest.cs`) |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/events/export` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, Export)`, `BrandID` header | Same query without paging / CSV file (`FileExportDTO` streamed), name `"{eventName} Promotional Events"`, rows `PromotionEventsExportDTO` | `ExportEventsWithSameEventNameRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** match on brand, event name, banner, and `Month = @Month OR PromotionType = EdlpOnly`; `year` and `eventStatus` are applied only when sent (omitting either returns a superset). The drill-down does not require `PromotionType IS NOT NULL` (it returns `COALESCE(PromotionType, 0)`). Validators require banner, month and event name.
- **Errors & edge cases:** CSV with no rows throws a 400 "No promotional events found."; the web shows it as an info "Nothing to export" (`isPromoCalendarNoEventsError`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/PromosAtAGlance/EventsWithSameEventNameTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The drill-down subquery pages without an `ORDER BY` (`GetEventsWithSameEventNameRequest.GetQuery`), so any page size other than -1 is non-deterministic. `DistributorID`/`DistributorMarkup` come from `CRM.DistributorBanners` matched on banner + brand only, so with several distributors on one banner a `DISTINCT ON` picks one arbitrarily, not necessarily the event's own distributor (same pattern in the CSV, which inner-joins `DistributorBanners` and uses the product's category).

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Sets `PromotionEventStatus` on the drill-down rows the user ticked. Picker options come from the enum; a confirmation states count and target status; the outcome is reported as success, partial warning, or info on 404.

##### 2.7.1.4 Sub-feature: Brand submission status (Submit / Revoke)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Sets `IsSubmitted` true (Submit) or false (Revoke) on every event matching a chosen scope: All data (year only), Filtered data (current filters), Current page (current filters + `bannerIDs` of the banners on screen).
- **User flow:** pick Submit or Revoke, pick a scope (disabled with a reason when Filtered has no filters or the page is empty), confirm in a modal whose copy is built by `buildPromoCalendarSubmissionConfirm`, then the calendar refetches.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PATCH | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/submission-status` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, Update)`, `BrandID` header | `UpdateBrandSubmissionStatusRequest` (filter keys + `isSubmitted`, no paging) / `ResponseMetaDTO`; web `IUpdatePromoAtAGlanceSubmissionRequest` | `UpdateBrandSubmissionStatusRequestHandler` (`.../PromosAtAGlance/UpdateBrandSubmissionStatusRequest.cs`) |

- **Business rules:** matching ids come from the same `PromosAtAGlanceEventFilter` SQL and visibility rule; a single `UPDATE` sets `IsSubmitted`, `LastModifiedBy`, `LastModifiedOn` scoped to the header brand. "Current page" is expressed as `bannerIDs` because a brand row is exactly one banner (`buildPromoCalendarSubmissionFilters`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** the response message is the same whether zero or all rows changed; the web never patches optimistically and relies on the invalidated calendar (`useSubmitPromoAtAGlance`, which also calls `showErrorNotification`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/PromosAtAGlance/UpdateBrandSubmissionStatusRequestTests.cs`; web `promotionalCalendar.helpers.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** "All data" keeps the selected year on purpose; the year is context, not a filter.

| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/export` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, Export)`, `BrandID` header | Body `GetPromosAtAGlanceRequestPayload`; optional query `pageSize`, `currentPage` / `ExportJobInitiatedDto` (`jobId`, `moduleType`, `message`) | `ExportPromotionEventsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/export/{jobId}/status` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-view, null, Export)`, `BrandID` header | `jobId` / `ExportJobStatusDto` (`status` 5 Pending, 10 Running, 15 Done, 20 Failed, 25 Cancelled; `totalRows`, `rowsExported`, `fileName`, `fileSize`, `downloadUrl`, `errorMessage`) | `GetPromosAtAGlanceExportStatusRequestHandler` |

  Background job: Hangfire `IExportJobService.ExecuteExportAsync(jobId, brandId, userId, BrandPromotionalManagementExport)`. S3 object as above.
- **Business rules:** paging is applied only when both `pageSize > 0` and `currentPage` are sent (`BuildBannerPageCondition`); the web omits both for All/Filtered (`buildPromoCalendarExportPaging`). Status lookup requires the job's module type, active brand and creator to match the caller, else 404 "Record not found."
- **Errors & edge cases:** zero matches completes with `Promotional_Events_Empty.csv`, no S3 key and no download URL (web `isAsyncExportEmptyResult`); exceptions mark the job Failed with the message. Web treats 404 (clears stored id) and 403 as terminal and resumes polling after a reload only once a session token exists.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/PromosAtAGlance/ExportPromotionEventsRequestTests.cs`, `PromosAtAGlanceExportQueryTests.cs`, `GetPromosAtAGlanceExportStatusRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/asyncExportJob.helpers.test.ts`. No dedicated test for `usePromoAtAGlanceExport`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** the whole CSV is built in a `MemoryStream` before upload (memory grows with row count). The row projection inner-joins `CRM.DistributorBanners` on banner + brand only and takes the category from the product (`ct.ID = p.CategoryID`), unlike the filters (event category) and the broker export.

#### 2.7.2 Feature: Brand Promotional Notes

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A brand's free-text planning grid: each note has a Title, a Year, twelve month text cells and an `IsSubmitted` flag. Brand users edit cells inline; the same notes are read cross-brand by brokers in 2.7.4. Module `promotional-calendar-notes` (brand slug only; actions View, Create, Update, Delete, Export).
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/promotional-notes` (Notes tab of the "Promo at a glance" layout; route gate `promotional-calendar-notes` in `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`).
  2. Grid loads `GET promos-at-a-glance/notes` sorted by Title ASC, page size `PAGE_SIZE`; a year picker and a filter drawer (`PromoNotesFilter.tsx`: title search, submitted, months) narrow it.
  3. "Add New Note" (Create) immediately POSTs an empty note; editing a cell (Update) POSTs the whole row with its `id`.
  4. "Delete" per row (Delete) asks a `Popconfirm`, then DELETEs that id.
  5. Export (Export) downloads "Promo Notes.csv".
  6. Without Update the grid renders read-only columns; without Delete the Action column is dropped (`PromoNotes.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/GetPromoAtaGlanceNotesRequest.cs` | Paged list for the header brand |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/UpsertPromoAtaGlanceNoteRequest.cs` | Create or update one note |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/DeletePromoAtaGlanceNotesRequest.cs` | Soft delete by ids |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/PromosAtAGlance/ExportBrandPromotionalNotesRequest.cs` | CSV export |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(promotional-calendar)/promotional-notes/page.tsx` | Route |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromoNotes.tsx` | Editable antd table, toolbar, gating |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromoNotesFilter.tsx` | Filter drawer |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promos.ts` | `usePromoAtAGlanceNotes`, `useUpsertPromoAtAGlanceNote`, `useDeletePromoAtAGlanceNote` |

- **Data:** `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoNotes` (`TradeSpendPromoNote`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Domain/TradeSpend/TradeSpendPromoNote.cs`); created in migration `20230913052803_BrokerMarketOverviewAndPromoNotesTableCreation`, `IsSubmitted` added in `20240613070336_SubmittedColumnAddedInPromoNotesTable`, `Year` in `20240730043746_YearColumnAddedInPromoNoteTable` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrations/`). DTO `TradeSpendPromoAtaGlanceNoteDTO`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/notes` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-notes, null, View)`, `BrandID` header | Query `title`, `isSubmitted`, `months[]`, `years[]`, `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `PagedData<TradeSpendPromoAtaGlanceNoteDTO>` | `GetPromoAtaGlanceNotesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/notes` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-notes, null, View)` + handler `DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)`, `BrandID` header | `UpsertPromoAtaGlanceNoteRequest` (`id?`, `year?`, `title`, `january`..`december`, `isSubmitted`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertPromoAtaGlanceNoteRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/tradespends/promos-at-a-glance/notes` | `RequireModule(promotional-calendar-notes, null, Delete)`, `BrandID` header | Body `DeletePromoAtaGlanceNotesRequest` (`iDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (declared as `TradeSpendPromoAtaGlanceNoteDTO`) | `DeletePromoAtaGlanceNotesRequestHandler` |

  Export endpoint: see 2.7.2.1.
- **Business rules:**
  - Upsert: Create is demanded when `id` is absent, Update when present (the route attribute only checks View); an id that is missing, deleted or belongs to another brand returns 404 "Promo note not found"; all text is trimmed; `Year` defaults to the server's current year (`DateTime.Now.Year`).
  - List: `title` is `ILIKE %title%`; `months` returns only the selected month columns and keeps notes with at least one of them non-blank; `years` is `Year IN (...)`; `sortingOrder` falls back to ASC; `sortKey` must name a `TradeSpendPromoNote` property (case-insensitive), else `Title`.
  - Delete: soft delete (`Deleted`, `DeletedBy`, `DeletedOn`) limited to the header brand; empty `iDs` returns 400 "Please select a record to delete from the list".
- **Dependencies:** 2.7.4 (brokers read these rows), IAM gate, React Query invalidation of `QueryKeys.getPromoAtAGlanceNotes`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** failed upsert/delete show `showErrorNotification`; the success toast of upsert is commented out in `useUpsertPromoAtAGlanceNote`.
- **Tests:** backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/TradeSpend/PromotionCreateBrandTests.cs` (upsert takes the brand from access), `TradeSpendUpsertAccessTests.cs` (Create/Update demanded), `BrandScopedWritesTests.cs` (delete scoped to brand); web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromoNotes.test.tsx`. No backend test for the list or export queries.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Upsert success messages are swapped: an update returns "Promotion Note created successfully" and a create "Promotion Note updated successfully" (`UpsertPromoAtaGlanceNoteRequestHandler`).
  - `sortKey` is validated case-insensitively but inserted verbatim into a quoted identifier (`t."{SortKey}"`), so a lower-case key such as `title` would reference a non-existent column. The web always sends capitalised keys.
  - Delete reports success even when zero rows matched (only singular vs plural depends on the count).
  - "Add New Note" persists an empty note before the user types anything.

#### 2.7.3 Feature: Broker Promotional Management calendar

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A broker's cross-brand calendar of Brand Approved events. One row per (brand, distributor, banner, category, promotion type) group; columns Brand, Distributor, Banner, Category plus twelve month columns of chips (event name, event status dot, count, submitted tag). Scope is every brand on which the caller holds `promotional-management-events` with the needed action (`AccessContext.BrandsInScope`), optionally narrowed by `brandIDs`. Used by Brokerage organizations (broker slug `promotional-management-events`, `CrossBrand = true`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Nav "Strategy > Promotional Management" or the broker dashboard tile opens `/promotional-management` (route and nav gate on the parent slug `promotional-management`, `BROKER_ROUTE_MODULES` and `buildBrokerNavItems`).
  2. The page shows the notes tab strip (2.7.4, 2.7.5) above the calendar card.
  3. Filters start empty (no year, so all years share the twelve columns) and are debounced; while a change waits for the debounce the grid shows its loading state over the previous rows.
  4. Toolbar: Submit, Revoke (shown when `anyBrandCan(promotional-management-events, "update")`), Export (when `export`), Filter drawer (`PromotionalMangementFilter.tsx`), status legend, `PaginationComponent`.
  5. A chip (antd `Tag` with `role="button"`, keyboard Enter/Space) opens the "Promo Events" modal: `PromoEventChipSummary` header, status control and "Export promo event", then the `PromoEvents` grid with `showPromotionType` and `viewBrandId` set to the row's brand.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` | Promotional management actions (no `BrandID` header documented) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/PromotionalManagement/GetPromotionalManagementEventsRequest.cs` | Groups page + per-group chips |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/PromotionalManagement/PromotionalManagementEventQuery.cs` | Accessible brands, brand intersection, shared filter SQL, `BuildGroupPageCondition` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/promotional-management/page.tsx` | Page: calendar, toolbar, scope menus, confirmations, drill-down modal |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/promotionalManagement.helpers.ts` | Scopes (`PROMO_ACTION_SCOPES`), `buildPromoScopedFilters`, `buildPromoScopedPaging` (`PROMO_ALL_ROWS_PAGE_SIZE = -1`), confirm copy, error readers, `buildPromoGroupRowKeys` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/PromoEventChipSummary.tsx` | Drill-down summary (event, status, submitted, brand, banner, distributor, category, month, count) |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/promotional-management.service.ts` | `PromotionalManagementService` (never sends `BrandID`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promotional-management.ts` | `useGetPromotionalManagement`, `useGetPromotionalManagementFilters`, `useGetPromotionalManagementSameNameEvents`, `useUpdatePromotionalManagementSubmissionStatus`, `useUpdatePromotionalManagementEventStatus` |

- **Data:** reads `TradeSpendPromoEvents` joined to `Brand.Brands`, `CRM.Distributors` (and parent), `CRM.Banners`, `ProductSpecs.Categories`. Response `PagedData<PromoGroupDTO>` (`BrandID/Name`, `DistributorID/Name` (parent name when the distributor has a parent), `BannerID/Name`, `CategoryID/Name`, `January`..`December` of `EventGroupDTO`). Web `IPagedPromoGroups`, `IPromoGroup`, `IPromoFilters` (`caboodle.web/src/models/promotional-management.interface.ts`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-events` | `RequireModule(null, promotional-management-events, View, CrossBrand)` | Body `GetPromotionalManagementEventsRequestPayload` (`months`, `brandIDs`, `retailerIDs`, `distributorIDs`, `bannerIDs`, `categoryIDs`, `regionIDs`, `createdBy`, `year`); query `pageSize`, `currentPage` / `PagedData<PromoGroupDTO>`; web `IPagedPromoGroups` | `GetPromotionalManagementEventsRequestHandler` |

  Other endpoints are listed under the sub-features.
- **Business rules:**
  - Brand set = `BrandsInScope(promotional-management-events, View)` intersected with `brandIDs` when sent; an empty set returns an empty page, never an error.
  - Groups are `GROUP BY BrandID, DistributorID, BannerID, CategoryID, PromotionType`, ordered by brand name then ids, paged with `PagingHelper`.
  - Filter semantics match the brand side (month 0 kept, year on start or end, distributor via `COALESCE(parent.ID, d.ID)`, category on the event column, region via `RetailerRegions`), plus `PromotionType IS NOT NULL` and `PromoEventVisibility`.
  - Regular groups take chips for their month; EDLP groups get all their chips in every month column the month filter allows.
  - Web row key is a composite of displayed identity (brand, distributor, banner, category, id or name fallback, blanks kept), with a positional `row-N` key for repeats (`buildPromoGroupRowKeys`), so a filter change replaces rows instead of appending them.
- **Dependencies:** 2.6 events and Simple Promotions (their invalidation sets refresh `QueryKeys.getPromotionalManagement` and `getPromotionalManagementEvents`), CRM, Product Specs, IAM cross-brand access, module catalog dependencies (`promotional-management-events` requires `approved-promotions`, `trade-spend-sandbox`, `product-spec`, `distributors` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/Configuration/Seeding/ModuleCatalogSeedData.cs`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** no accessible brands gives an empty grid; broker filters are all optional. Chip drill-down 403 shows "You don't have access to this brand's events."; other errors show the server text.
- **Tests:** backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/PromotionalManagement/GetPromotionalManagementEventsRequestTests.cs`, `PromotionalManagementGroupPagingTests.cs`, `PromoEventVisibilityTests.cs`, `SimplePromotionCalendarVisibilityTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/promotionalManagement.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/promo-at-a-glance/PromotionalManagementRows.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/promotionalManagementGrid.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/promotionalManagement.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The route is gated on the parent catalog slug `promotional-management`, while every endpoint checks the child slugs; a payload that grants only the children would hide the page (see questions).
  - The calendar section is rendered for anyone who reaches the route; only the action buttons are gated. A user without events View gets the server's 403 on the list.
  - Groups include `PromotionType`, but the ordering keys do not, so two groups differing only by type have no stable relative order across pages.
  - Default broker filters carry no year, unlike the brand calendar which always sends one.

##### 2.7.3.2 Sub-feature: Broker chip drill-down and chip CSV

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Lists the events behind a chip and exports them as CSV ("{eventName} Promotional Management").
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/events-with-same-name` | `RequireModule(null, promotional-management-events, View, CrossBrand)` | Query `brandID`, `distributorID`, `categoryID`, `bannerID`, `month`, `eventName`, optional `year`, `eventStatus`, `pageSize`, `currentPage` / `PagedData<TradeSpendPromoDataModel>`; web `IPagedPromoSameNameEvents` | `GetEventsWithSameNameRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/export-events` | `RequireModule(null, promotional-management-events, Export, CrossBrand)` | Same query without paging / CSV stream (`PromotionalManagementEventsExportDTO` rows) | `ExportPromoEventsWithSameNameRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** validators require brand, banner, category, distributor, a valid month and a non-blank event name (400 texts such as "Brand is required."). Brand must be in the accessible set: the list returns an empty page, the CSV throws 400 "No promotional management events found.". Match is on the four ids, event name, and `Month = @month OR (EDLP AND Month = 0)`; `year` and `eventStatus` only when sent. The CSV reuses `PromotionalManagementExportQuery.BuildExportQueryForEventIds` so its columns equal the async export's. The web serialises both calls through one `toSameNameQuery` and omits absent `year`/`eventStatus`.

- **Gotchas / tech debt:** the drill-down key has no retailer or region, so a chip can list events from other retailers or regions of the same group. The CSV projection joins `CRM.DistributorRetailers` on retailer + brand without distributor, so `DistributorMarkup` in the file can differ from the drill-down (which matches the distributor). The CSV is fetched with raw `fetch` (`fetchWithMock`) and a hand-built `authorization` header.

#### 2.7.5 Feature: Promo Tabs (broker custom notes tabs)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Spreadsheet-like tabs owned by a brokerage organization, shown after "Brand's Notes" in the Notes tab strip on `/promotional-management`. Each tab starts with twelve Text month columns; users add typed columns (Text, Number, Currency, Percent, Date, CustomList, Checkbox), add rows, edit cells inline, filter per column (value checklist + condition), sort, page and export to CSV. Module `promotional-management-notes` checked at organization level (`RequireModule(..., OrganizationLevel = true)`, the brokerage's company access); actions View, Create, Update, Delete, Export. A Brand organization is refused (`PromoTabOwnership.GetOwnerAsync` throws "This module is not available to your organization.").
- **User flow:**
  1. `PromoNotesTabs.tsx` reads `useAccess()`; tabs render only when the company access grants `view` (`canUsePromoTabs`), and each control follows `resolvePromoTabPermissions` (`caboodle.web/src/helper/promoTabsPermissions.helper.ts`), which denies everything while access loads.
  2. "New tab" (create) POSTs with no name; the server names it "New Tab N" and the new tab opens (the created tab is written into the tabs cache before the refetch).
  3. Tab kebab: Rename (update), Delete (delete) via a modal outside the dropdown; tabs drag to reorder (delete action, `PUT tabs/order`).
  4. Inside a tab (`PromoTabGrid.tsx`): "+ Column" opens `PromoTabColumnModal.tsx` (type locked when editing; disabled at 20 columns); header menu sorts, filters (`PromoTabFilterPanel.tsx`), renames, inserts and deletes columns; headers drag to reorder (update).
  5. "Add row" (create) appends an empty row to the cached page; cells edit inline by type (`PromoTabCell.tsx`: Input, InputNumber, DatePicker, Select for CustomList, Checkbox); saving is optimistic with rollback on error (`useSavePromoTabCell`).
  6. Row delete via `Popconfirm` (delete); Export (export) downloads `{tab name}-{yyyyMMdd-HHmm}.csv`.
  7. If the open tab disappears (deleted here or by a teammate), the strip falls back to "Brand's Notes" once the tabs refetch settles.

|---|---|

A brokerage set above 20 cannot add columns 21+ from the UI; one set below 20 sees an enabled button that the server rejects.

##### 2.7.5.3 Sub-feature: Rows and cells

- **Status:** Active
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-notes/tabs/{tabId}/rows/list` | `RequireModule(null, promotional-management-notes, View, OrganizationLevel)` | `GetPromoTabRowsRequest` (`currentPage`, `pageSize`, `sortColumnID?`, `sortingOrder`, `filters`) / `PagedData<PromoTabRowDTO>` (`id`, `createdOn`, `createdByName`, `lastModifiedOn`, `lastModifiedByName`, `cells` keyed by column id) | `GetPromoTabRowsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-notes/tabs/{tabId}/rows` | same, `Create` | none / `PromoTabRowDTO` (empty cells) | `CreatePromoTabRowRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-notes/rows/{rowId}/cells/{columnId}` | same, `Update` | `UpdatePromoTabCellRequest` (`value` as JSON) / `PromoTabRowDTO` | `UpdatePromoTabCellRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-notes/rows` | same, `Delete` | `DeletePromoTabRowsRequest` (`iDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeletePromoTabRowsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** default order is newest row first; with `sortColumnID` blanks sort last in both directions, then creation order. `pageSize -1` returns all rows. A blank cell is the absence of a row in `PromoTabCells` (omitted from `cells`); null, empty string or an unticked checkbox clears the cell. Parsing per type: Text max 1000 chars; CustomList must match an option (case-insensitive); numbers accept JSON numbers or invariant strings without symbols; dates accept `yyyy-MM-dd` or `M/d/yyyy`-style; checkbox accepts booleans or "true"/"false". Dates are returned as `MM/dd/yyyy`. Saving a cell always stamps the row's `LastModifiedBy/On`. Row delete is all-or-nothing: any unknown, deleted or foreign id returns 404 listing the ids and nothing is deleted.
- **Errors & edge cases:** the web writes the typed value into the cached rows in `onMutate`, restores the snapshot on error, and replaces it with the server row on success.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** two concurrent first writes to the same empty cell can both try to insert and hit the unique index `IX_PromoTabCells_RowID_ColumnID` (unhandled `DbUpdateException`, not verified at runtime).

##### 2.7.5.5 Sub-feature: Column filters and value checklist

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Per-column filter panel: a checklist of distinct values (with counts, search, a separate blank count) in Include or Exclude mode, plus an optional condition (operator by type), applied to rows list, values and export alike.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/promotional-management-notes/tabs/{tabId}/columns/{columnId}/values` | `RequireModule(null, promotional-management-notes, View, OrganizationLevel)` | `GetPromoTabColumnValuesRequest` (`search?`, `currentPage`, `pageSize` default 200, `filters`) / `PromoTabColumnValuesDTO` (`data` of `value`, `displayValue`, `count`; `meta`; `blankCount`) | `GetPromoTabColumnValuesRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** filters for different columns are ANDed; within a column the checklist and condition are ANDed and `includeBlanks` (default true) ORs in rows with no cell. `mode` must be 5, 10 or 15 or omitted; any other int is 400 (guards against silently inverting to Exclude). Exclude uses `IS NULL OR <> ALL(...)`. Operators: Contains/DoesNotContain on text types, Equals on all, GreaterThan/LessThan on numeric, Between on numeric and date (start must not exceed end), After/Before on date. LIKE metacharacters are escaped. The values query drops the column's own filter so a value can always be ticked back; search matches the display form (date as `MM/DD/YYYY`, checkbox as Yes/No).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `mode: Include` with an empty `values` list degrades to "has any value"; the web blocks Apply in that state (`isPromoTabFilterDraftEmptySelection`). The web offers no condition operators for Checkbox columns (only the checklist).
