#### 2.7.6 Feature: Shared async export job lifecycle (calendar exports)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** One client hook and one server pattern for the two calendar exports (2.7.1.5 brand ModuleType 38, 2.7.3.5 broker ModuleType 35): start returns a job id, the client polls status every 2500 ms, and a Done job carries a pre-signed S3 download URL.
- **User flow:**
  1. `start(scope, thunk)` calls the module's start endpoint, stores the job id in `sessionStorage` under the module's key and begins polling.
  2. On reload the hook resumes polling the stored job once a session token exists (a status call without a token would 401 and the interceptor would sign the user out).
  3. Terminal states: Done (download link, or empty-result note when Done with no URL), Failed, Cancelled; HTTP 404 clears the stored id; 403 (another user's job or the other module's route) stops polling.
  4. The interval is cleared on unmount.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/useAsyncExportJob.ts` | Lifecycle: start, persist, resume, poll, terminal handling; injected `storageKey`, `getStatus`, error readers and messages |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/asyncExportJob.helpers.ts` | `ASYNC_EXPORT_STATUS` (5, 10, 15, 20, 25), `isAsyncExportTerminal`, `isAsyncExportEmptyResult`, `resolveAsyncExportProgress` (percent from `rowsExported/totalRows` only when `totalRows > 0`), error readers |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/ExportStatusUI.tsx` | Progress/result panel (shared app-wide) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs` | `ExecuteExportAsync` dispatch by `ModuleType`; the two promo cases page event ids with a keyset cursor (`ID > @lastProcessedEventId`, batch 10000), widen each batch to CSV rows, update `RowsExported`, upload, `Complete` or `Fail` |

- **Data:** `DataHub` `ExportJob` (`BrandID`, `ModuleType`, `RequestJson`, `Status`, `TotalRows`, `RowsExported`, `FileName`, `FileSize`, `S3Key`, `ErrorMessage`, `StartedOn`, `CompletedOn`, `CreatedBy`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** the four start/status endpoints are listed in 2.7.1.5 and 2.7.3.5. Background: Hangfire job `IExportJobService.ExecuteExportAsync`. S3 prefixes `exports/promos-at-a-glance/{brandId}/` and `exports/promotional-management/{userId}/`.
- **Business rules:** the id cursor advances from the id page, not from the returned rows, so a batch whose rows are dropped by joins cannot end the export early (`PromosAtAGlanceExportQuery` and `PromotionalManagementExportQuery` summaries). The filters are frozen in `RequestJson` at start.
- **Dependencies:** Hangfire (`IJobService`), `IFileStorageService` (S3 upload and URL), CsvHelper.
- **Errors & edge cases:** no cancel endpoint exists for either promo export; the hook exposes none.
- **Tests:** web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/asyncExportJob.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/usePromotionalManagementExport.test.tsx`; backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Export/ExportJobServicePromotionalManagementExportTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Both CSVs are written into a `MemoryStream` before upload; very large exports hold the whole file in API memory.
  - The background CsvWriters and `FileExportHelper.ConvertToCsvFile` (used by the chip and notes CSVs) set no CsvHelper injection escaping, so free text (event names, comments, notes) that starts with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` reaches the spreadsheet unescaped; only the Promo Tab export (`PromoTabCsvBuilder`) escapes it.

### 2.8 Module: Category Review & Brand Report

- **Purpose:** Lets a brokerage keep a catalog of retailer Category Reviews (region, retailer, category, review month, review start/end and reset dates), push them onto brands' Category Review Calendars, and track each (brand, review) pair as a **Brand Report** with five admin-defined status columns, notes, notify/re-notify emails, email history and an audit trail. Brand companies see their own reviews plus the catalog reviews of connected brokerages, their own calendar, and a read-only status summary of the Brand Reports about them. Platform admins manage the status option catalog.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` (all `category-reviews*` routes, prefix `api/v1/brokers`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrandReportController.cs` (prefix `api/v1/brandreport`), plus `POST api/v1/brands/users` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs`.
  - Backend application: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/` (root = list/CRUD/import/export/due dates; `Calendar/`; `BrandReport/`; `BrandReport/Settings/`; `Filter/`), helpers in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/`, DTOs in `.../Modules.Broker.Application/DTOs/` (`CategoryReviewDTO.cs`, `BrandReportListDTOs.cs`, `BrandReportAnalyticsDTOs.cs`, `BrandReportEmailLogDTO.cs`, `BrandReportAuditLogDTOs.cs`, `BrandReportRecipientsDTO.cs`, `BrandReportStatusOptionDTO.cs`), payloads in `.../Modules.Broker.Application/Payload/CategoryReviewPayloads.cs`.
  - Backend domain: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Domain/Broker/{CategoryReview,CategoryReviewCalender,CategoryReviewCalenderDateAssignment,CategoryReviewEmailLogger,BrandReport,BrandReportNoteEntry,BrandReportEmailLog,BrandReportStatusOption,BrandReportStatusSettings}.cs`.
  - Backend workers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Import/ImportJobService.cs` (`ExecuteCategoryReviewFileImportAsync`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs` (`ExecuteBrandReportExportAsync`), mail in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Mailing/SmtpMailService.cs`.
  - Web routes: `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/(category-review)/{layout.tsx,category-review/page.tsx,category-review-calendar/page.tsx}`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/brand-report/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/(category-review)/{layout.tsx,category-review-brand/page.tsx,category-review-calendar-brand/page.tsx}`, stub `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(data upload)/category-review.tsx/page.tsx`.

  - Admin: `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/brand-report-status-options/page.tsx`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/BrandReport/`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/brandReport.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/services/brandReport.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/helper/brandReport.helper.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/interface/brandReport.interface.ts`.
- **Shared data models:** (all tables in schema `Broker`, mapped in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs`)
  - `CategoryReviews` (`CategoryReview`): `ID`, `BrandID?` (null = brokerage catalog review), `BrokerageOrganizationID?` (owner brokerage of a catalog review), `Region`/`Retailer`/`Category` (free text) with normalized `RegionKey`/`RetailerKey`/`CategoryKey`, `ReviewMonth` (display string, e.g. "March" or "Open Review"), `SubmissionDueDate` (shown as "Review Start"), `ReviewDate` (shown as "Review End"), `ResetDate`, `AdditionalNotes`, audit columns. Hard-deleted (`DELETE`), not soft-deleted.
  - `CategoryReviewCalender` (`CategoryReviewCalender`): one row per (brand, review) placed on a brand calendar: `BrandID`, `CategoryReviewID`, `BrokerageOrganizationID?`.

Soft-deleted. Unique filtered index `IX_BrandReports_CategoryReview_Brand` on (`CategoryReviewID`, `BrandID`) where `Deleted = FALSE`.
  - `BrandReportEmailLogs` (`BrandReportEmailLog`): `To`/`Cc`/`Bcc` (comma-joined strings), `Subject`, `Body`, `SendType` (5 Initial / 10 Resend), `Method`, `BrandReportIds` (jsonb list).
  - `BrandReportStatusOptions` (`BrandReportStatusOption`): `ColumnType` (5 MeetingStatus shown as "Submission Status", 10 BrandResponse, 15 WaitingOn, 30 NextAction, 35 ReviewResult), `Name`, `NameKey` (unique per column type among non-deleted), `DisplayOrder`, `IsActive`, `DefaultsInMethods` (jsonb int list of `BrandReportMethod`), `Color`.
  - `BrandReportStatusSettings`: single row `SingletonId = bae677b4-1eb4-4f89-86b9-40004871434d` with five booleans (`SubmissionStatus`, `BrandResponse`, `WaitingOn`, `NextAction`, `ReviewResult`) enabling analytics cards.
  - Audit trail rows live in `"Auditing"."AuditTrails"` with `TableName = "BrandReport"` (`AuditEntityTypes.BrandReport`), written through `IAuditLogService`; actions in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Auditing/AuditActions.cs` (`Created`, `Updated`, `Resent`, `ContactsNotified` = `AssigneesNotified`, `NoteCreated`, `NoteUpdated`, `NoteDeleted`).
  - Enums: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/Enums.cs` (`CategoryReviewMonth` 0 Open Review, 1 to 12; `CategoryReviewDateType`; `BrandReportStatusColumnType`; `BrandReportMethod`; `BrandReportEmailSendType`; `BrandReportNoteType` 1 Internal / 2 External; `AssigneeSource` 5 Owner / 10 SubUser / 15 Contact; `ModuleType.CategoryReviewFileImport = 32`, `ModuleType.BrandReportExport = 33`).
- **Shared services:**
  - `CategoryReviewArea` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/CategoryReviewArea.cs`): resolves which reviews, calendar entries and Brand Reports a request works on (see 2.8.1). Used by every live Category Review and Calendar handler.
  - `BrandReportScope` (`.../Helper/BrandReportScope.cs`): brokerage-only scope for Brand Report handlers (see 2.8.1).
  - `CategoryReviewFilterConditionBuilder` / `IBrokerCategoryReviewFilter` (`.../CategoryRerview/CategoryReviewFilterConditionBuilder.cs`): one WHERE builder for list, export, calendar group and both facet endpoints.

  - `BrandPeopleSql` (`.../Helper/BrandPeopleSql.cs`): a brand's people from IAM memberships (Brand Admin role = owner, other active members = sub-users).

#### 2.8.1 Feature: Access model (areas and scopes)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Two helpers decide, per request, which rows a caller may read or change. `CategoryReviewArea` covers Category Reviews and Calendar; `BrandReportScope` covers Brand Reports. They replaced the role-based `CategoryReviewAccessHelper` in the IAM (CS-1770) branch. Module slugs: `category-review`, `category-review-calendar`, `brand-report` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/ModuleSlugs.cs`).
- **User flow:**
  1. The `RequireModule` attribute is checked first (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Modules/ModuleAuthorizationHandler.cs`): `OrganizationLevel = true` uses company access (`AccessContext.OrganizationModuleRefusal`), `CrossBrand = true` allows a missing `BrandID` header as long as any brand grants the module, otherwise a `BrandID` header is required.
  2. `CategoryReviewArea.ResolveAsync` picks the area: a "brand page" when a valid `BrandID` header is sent (`AccessContext.ActiveBrandId`) or when the caller is a Brand company (its own org id is its brand); otherwise a Brokerage's own catalog.
  3. Brokerage on a brand page: also demands the broker module on that brand (`DemandModuleAsync(null, slug, action)`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/CategoryReviewArea.cs` | `ReadCondition`, `WriteCondition`, `CalendarCondition`, `BrandReportCondition`, `CanRead`, `CanWrite`, `OwnsImportJob`, `ResolveAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/BrandReportScope.cs` | `ResolveAsync` (brokerage only), `ForBrandPage`, `Condition`, `Owns`, `DemandReportAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs` | `BrandsInScope`, `ModuleRefusal`, `OrganizationModuleRefusal`, `HasOrganizationModule` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextService.cs` | `DemandModuleAsync`, `DemandOrganizationModuleAsync`, `DemandCatalogModuleAsync`, `GetActiveBrandIdAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/CategoryReviewAccessHelper.cs` | Legacy role-based context (only used by admin-gated unused endpoints) |
| `caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts` | `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`, `BROKER_ROUTE_MODULES`, `BROKER_COMPANY_LEVEL_ROUTES` (category-review is company-level) |

- **Data:** `CategoryReviews.BrandID` / `BrokerageOrganizationID`, `Organization.BrandConnections` (`Status = Active`), `BrandReports.BrokerageOrganizationID`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** None of its own; applied by every endpoint below.
- **Business rules:**
  - Brand page read: `cr.BrandID = brand OR (cr.BrandID IS NULL AND cr.BrokerageOrganizationID IN connected brokerages)`. Brand page write: `cr.BrandID = brand` only. Brokerage catalog read and write: `cr.BrandID IS NULL AND cr.BrokerageOrganizationID = caller's brokerage`.
  - On a brand page, `CatalogOwnerIds` is `[caller's brokerage]` for a brokerage and every brokerage with an Active `BrandConnections` row for a Brand company.
  - Calendar rows: `crc.BrandID IN CalendarBrandIds AND ReadCondition`; `CalendarBrandIds` is the page's brand, or `BrandsInScope(slug, action)` for a brokerage off a brand page.
  - Brand Report rows: a Brand company sees every brokerage's reports on its brand; a brokerage sees only reports it owns (`br.BrokerageOrganizationID = brokerage`).
  - `BrandReportScope.ResolveAsync` throws Access denied ("This module is not available to your organization.") for any non-Brokerage org, so all Brand Report endpoints except `analytics/{brandId}` are brokerage-only.
  - Out-of-scope ids answer as 404 ("not found"), never 403, for single-row operations.
- **Dependencies:** IAM access context and `BrandConnections`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A Brand company without a resolvable brand gets Access denied. A brokerage user on a brand route whose header brand lacks the broker module gets 403 from `DemandModuleAsync`.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/Helper/CategoryReviewAreaTests.cs`, `.../Helper/BrandReportScopeTests.cs`, `.../CategoryReview/CategoryReviewAccessHelperTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Access/ModuleAuthorizationTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Many request types still carry a `BrandId` body or query field (`CategoryReviewQueryProperties.BrandId`, `GetCategoryReviewDueDatesRequest.BrandId`, `StartCategoryReviewFileImportRequest.BrandId`, chunk `brandId` query) that the IAM handlers ignore; only the `BrandID` header decides the area.
  - `caboodle.backend/docs/features/brand-report.md` still describes the legacy role model (for example "any authenticated caller" for `analytics/{brandId}`, notify not filtering inactive users); the code no longer matches it.
  - master (pre-IAM) has CS-1791 / CS-XXXX changes to `CategoryReviewAccessHelper` (a shared `BrandBrokerParentResolver` for sub-broker parents). On this branch that helper is reachable only from admin-gated unused endpoints, so the fix has no effect here, but the merge will touch the file.

#### 2.8.2 Feature: Category Review list and editing

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A paged, sortable, filterable grid of Category Reviews with add, edit, remove-selected and delete-all-matching actions. Brokerage members use `/category-review` (their catalog, company-level `category-review` module); brand companies and brokerages on a brand page use `/[brandID]/category-review-brand` (the brand's own reviews plus connected brokerages' catalog rows, which are read-only). Actions are gated per module action (`create`, `update`, `delete`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Open the list. The grid posts the filter body to `category-reviews/list` with paging, sort and the `BrandID` header on a brand page. Default sort `RegionName ASC` (`caboodle.web/src/store/categoryReviewFilterStore.ts`).
  2. Filter through the drawer (`CategoryOverviewFilter`); facets come from `category-reviews/filter` (2.8.2.1). "Created By" is held in component state (`createdByFilter`) and layered onto the list body only.
  3. "Actions" menu: Add Category Review (modal `AddOrEditCategoryReview`), Upload (2.8.4), Export (2.8.3), Remove Selected, Delete All Matching.
  4. Edit pencil per row; disabled with a tooltip when `isEditable` is false (a brokerage catalog row seen on a brand page).
  5. Broker route also shows "Notify Brands" (2.8.8) and the Submission Due Dates card (2.8.5). Brand route shows "Add To Calendar" (2.8.6.1).
  6. Filters persist while switching to the Calendar tab and reset when the section layout unmounts.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/GetCategoryReviewListRequest.cs` | Resolves area, delegates to brand or broker query |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/GetCategoryReviewsForBrandRequest.cs` | Brand-page SQL; `IsEditable = (cr.BrandID = page brand)`; `CreatedByName` = user name |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/GetCategoryReviewForBrokerRequest.cs` | Catalog SQL; `IsEditable = TRUE`; `CreatedBy`/`CreatedByName` = brand when `BrandID` set |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/UpsertCategoryReviewRequest.cs` | Create or update with duplicate check and name normalization |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/QueryHelper.cs` | `CategoryReviewColumns` sort keys |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewTable.tsx` | Grid, toolbar, gating, modals (shared by brand and broker routes) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/AddOrEditCategoryReview.tsx` | Add/edit form (free-text Region/Retailer/Category, Review Month select, three dates, notes) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewFilter.tsx` | Filter drawer shared with the calendar (`isCalendar`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/category-overview.service.ts` | `useGetCategoryOverviews`, `useCreateCategoryReview`, `useDeleteCategoryReview`, `useBulkDeleteCategoryReview` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/categoryOverview.service.ts` | `getCategoryOverviews`, `createCategoryReview`, `deleteCategoryReview`, `bulkDeleteCategoryReview` |
| `caboodle.web/src/store/categoryReviewFilterStore.ts` | Non-persisted Zustand store, `listFilter` and `calendarFilter` slices |

- **Data:** `Broker.CategoryReviews`; join `Identity.Users` on `CreatedBy` (INNER JOIN, so a review whose creator row is missing disappears); broker query LEFT JOINs `Brand.Brands`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/list` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, View, OrganizationLevel)` | Body `CategoryReviewListQueryProperties` (regions, retailers, categories, reviewMonth[] strings, resetMonth[], resetYear[], from/toResetDate, submissionDueMonth[], from/toSubmissionDueDate, from/toReviewEndDate, categoryReviewIds, createdBy, brandId ignored); query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `PagedData<CategoryReviewDTO>` (web `ICategoryReviewDTO`, `ICategoryOverviewResponse`) | `GetCategoryReviewListRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, View, OrganizationLevel)`; handler demands org module `Create` (no `id`) or `Update` | `UpsertCategoryReviewRequest {id?, brandID?, region, retailer, category, reviewMonth (int 0..12), submissionDueDate?, reviewDate?, resetDate?, additionalNotes?}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertCategoryReviewRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Validator: Region, Retailer, Category required.
  - New review: `BrandID = page brand`, `BrokerageOrganizationID = brokerage` only off a brand page, `CreatedBy = caller`. A brokerage creating on a brand page creates a brand-owned review.
  - Duplicate rule: same `RegionKey`, `RetailerKey`, `CategoryKey`, `ReviewMonth` and all three dates (null-safe) among the rows the area can read raises "A record with the same values already exists."
  - Display names: Region and Retailer take the canonical spelling from `CRM.Regions` and `CRM.Banners`/`CRM.Retailers` when the normalized key matches; Category takes the first existing review's spelling for that key.
  - `ReviewMonth` is stored as the enum description string; the list returns strings.
  - Update: row must exist, not deleted, and pass `area.CanWrite`, else 404 "Something went wrong! Please try again."
  - Sort key must be one of `RegionName, RetailerName, CategoryName, ReviewMonth, SubmissionDueDate, ReviewDate, ResetDate, AdditionalNotes`; empty falls back to `RegionName`.
  - Web: `canCreate`/`canUpdate`/`canDelete` read `useModuleAccess().can` on a brand route and `hasCompanyModule` on the broker route; controls are hidden while access loads.
- **Dependencies:** 2.8.1, CRM name tables, IAM.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A brand page passes `brandId` in the body as well as the header; only the header matters. Edit form prefers the record's own `brandId` (`AddOrEditCategoryReview.onFinish`) but the backend ignores body `BrandID`.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/{UpsertCategoryReviewRequestHandlerTests,UpsertCategoryReviewRequestValidatorTests,GetCategoryReviewListRequestIsEditableTests,GetCategoryReviewListRequestCreatedByFilterTests,GetCategoryReviewListRequestReviewEndDateFilterTests,GetCategoryReviewListRequestCategoryReviewIdsFilterTests,CategoryReviewFilterConditionBuilderTests,CategoryReviewTextHelperTests}.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/{CategoryOverviewTableGrid,CategoryOverviewTablePagination,CategoryOverviewTableCreatedBy,CategoryOverviewTableCardsRemoved}.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/categoryOverview.service.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/store/categoryReviewFilterStore.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/categoryReviewInvalidation.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The upsert route is declared with `ModuleActions.View`; the real Create/Update check happens in the handler (`DemandOrganizationModuleAsync`).
  - On a brand page a Brokerage passes the attribute on its company access but the handler checks the broker module on the header brand; the two scopes can disagree.
  - `caboodle.web/CLAUDE.md` says reads use a singular `api/v1/broker/category-reviews` route; the code calls plural `brokers` for every route.
  - `AddOrEditCategoryReview.tsx` imports unused hooks (`useGetDistributorDC`, `useGetSKUs`, `useStores`).
  - master (CS-1792) wraps the update in `CategoryReviewUpdateService`, copying review fields onto Brand Reports and calendar rows in one transaction; this branch has no copy columns (see 2.8.7 gotchas).

##### 2.8.2.1 Sub-feature: List filter facets

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Returns, per facet, only the values present in the readable reviews, narrowed by every other selected filter (a facet never narrows itself). Web issues one query per facet (`useGetCategoryOverviewsFilterField`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/filter` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, View, OrganizationLevel)` | `GetCategoryReviewFilterPropsRequest` (list filters + `propertyName?`) / `CategoryReviewFilterOptionsResult` (regions, retailers, categories, reviewMonth, resetMonth, resetYear, submissionDueMonth, createdBy as `{label,value}`; resetDate, submissionDueDate, reviewEndDate as `{min,max}`); web `ICategoryReviewFilterOptionsBody` / `ICategoryReviewFilterProperties` | `GetCategoryReviewFilterPropsRequestHandler` (`.../CategoryRerview/Filter/GetCategoryReviewFilterPropsRequest.cs`) |

- **Business rules:** Unknown `propertyName` is a 400 "Unrecognized filter property." With `propertyName` set only that facet is populated; others come back empty.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/GetCategoryReviewFilterPropsRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewFilter.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Web deliberately does not send `categoryReviewIds` to this endpoint (`buildCategoryReviewFilterOptionsBody`), so the due-dates restriction does not narrow facets. Review Month, Reset Month, Submission Due Month and Reset Year controls are still hard-coded on the web, not fed by these facets.

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, Delete, OrganizationLevel)` | `DeleteCategoryReviewsRequest {iDs}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteCategoryReviewsRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/bulk` | same | `BulkDeleteCategoryReviewsRequest` (shared filter fields + `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `BulkDeleteCategoryReviewsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Only rows passing `area.WriteCondition` are deleted; others are skipped silently ("No category review deleted." when none). Bulk selects ids with `CategoryReviewQueryHelper.BuildSelectIdsQuery` then deletes them; `pageSize: -1` means every match. The bulk body has no `categoryReviewIds`/`createdBy`, so those web-only restrictions never reach it.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `DELETE` is a physical delete; `BrandReports` and `CategoryReviewCalender` rows for the review are not removed by this code (no cascade in the handler). Their lists join `CategoryReviews` (INNER JOIN in calendar group, LEFT JOIN in Brand Report list), so orphans vanish from the calendar and show blank retailer/category in Brand Report.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/{DeleteCategoryReviewsRequestTests,CategoryReviewQueryHelperTests}.cs`.

- **Business rules:** Export reads with `area.ReadCondition`, so a brand page export includes connected brokerages' catalog rows. Filters and paging compose; any `pageSize` other than -1 exports one page.

#### 2.8.4 Feature: Category Review chunked import

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Uploads a CSV in chunks to S3, starts a Hangfire job that validates each row and bulk-inserts valid reviews, and reports progress, an `outcome` and an error file. Uses the shared chunked-import framework (provider `category-review`). Gated by `category-review` `import`.
- **User flow:**
  1. Actions > Upload Category Review opens `CategoryReviewImport` inside a modal; template link downloads the sample.
  2. `useChunkedImport` posts chunks (`import/chunk`), then `import/start`, then polls `import/{jobId}/status`.
  3. While a job is active the modal cannot be closed (no X, no Esc, mask click off) and Dismiss is disabled (CS-1457).
  4. On completion the page invalidates list, due dates and facets (`invalidateAfterCategoryReviewImport`); a clean import closes the modal, a partial one stays open to show the error-file link.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/UploadChunkForCategoryReviewImportRequest.cs` | Creates/continues `ImportJob` (`ModuleType.CategoryReviewFileImport`, `BrandID = area brand or Guid.Empty`), S3 multipart upload |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/StartCategoryReviewFileImportRequest.cs` | Validates job state, enqueues `IImportJobService.ExecuteCategoryReviewFileImportAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/GetCategoryReviewImportJobStatusRequest.cs` | Status with presigned `errorFileUrl` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Import/ImportJobService.cs` | `ExecuteCategoryReviewFileImportAsync`, `ValidateCategoryReviewImportRecord` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/CategoryReviewImportDTOs.cs` | CSV columns: `[*] Region`, `[*] Retailer`, `[*] Category`, `[*] Review Month`, `Review Start Date(MM/DD/YYYY)`, `Review End Date(MM/DD/YYYY)`, `Reset Date(MM/DD/YYYY)`, additional notes |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryReviewImport.tsx` | Upload UI, outcome banner, error link |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/chunked-import.service.ts` | `PROVIDER_BASE_PATH["category-review"]`, `startCategoryReviewImport`, chunk `brandId` query |
- **Data:** `DataUpload` `ImportJob` (status 5 Pending, 7 Uploading, 10 Processing, 15 Done, 17 PartiallyDone, 20 Failed, 25 Cancelled), S3 objects for the upload and the error file, `Broker.CategoryReviews`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/import/chunk` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, Import, OrganizationLevel)`, `BrandIDHeader` | Query `brandId?` (ignored), `fileName`, `chunkIndex`, `chunkMax`, `uploadId?`, `prevETags?`, `key?`, `jobId?`; raw body / `ImportChunkUploadDto` | `UploadChunkForCategoryReviewImportRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/import/start` | same | `StartCategoryReviewFileImportRequest {importJobId, brandId?}` / empty 200 | `StartCategoryReviewFileImportRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/import/{jobId}/status` | same | / `ImportJobStatusDto` (status, statusText, rows, `outcome` 5 Failed / 10 Success / 15 PartialSuccess / null in flight, `errorFileUrl`) | `GetCategoryReviewImportJobStatusRequestHandler` |

  Background job: `IImportJobService.ExecuteCategoryReviewFileImportAsync(importJobId, brandId, userId, brokerageOrganizationId, catalogOwnerIds)` (Hangfire). S3: uploaded CSV at the job's `S3Key`; error CSV via `GenerateAndUploadErrorFileAsync`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Only the job's creator (or Platform Admin) on the same page (same `BrandID`, or `Guid.Empty` for a catalog) may continue, start or poll a job (`CategoryReviewArea.OwnsImportJob`); otherwise 404.
  - Start requires status Pending and an `S3Key`; Uploading gives "File upload is not complete...".
  - Row rules: Region, Retailer, Category required; Review Month must parse to a month name or "Open Review"; dates must parse (`TryParseImportDate`); duplicates against existing rows (same key set as upsert) or earlier rows in the file are rejected with "[Row = n] A record with the same column values already exists."
  - Imported catalog rows get `BrokerageOrganizationID`; brand-page rows get `BrandID`.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Any exception fails the job with a plain message. Web treats `outcome`, not `status`, as the result (`status 17` with zero successes is Failed).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/CategoryReviewImportRequestsTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Import/ImportJobServiceCategoryReviewTests.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/CategoryReviewImport.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewTableImportRefresh.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The handler starts the job (`importJob.Start()`) before enqueueing and the worker calls `Start()` again only if still Pending. The web chunk call sends both a `brandId` query param and the header; only the header counts.

#### 2.8.5 Feature: Submission Due Dates card (Category Review list)

- **Status:** Active (broker route only)
- **What it does:** Scans `SubmissionDueDate` across readable reviews inside a date window and shows them in urgency bands; clicking the count, a band or a review restricts the list to those review ids (`categoryReviewIds` on the list body). Brokerage `category-review` `view`.
- **User flow:**
  1. On the broker list the card requests one page (`CATEGORY_REVIEW_DUE_DATE_PAGE_SIZE = 200`) for a window 30 days back to 120 days ahead (`buildCategoryReviewDueDateWindow`), bare `YYYY-MM-DD`.
  2. Bands: Urgent 7 Days, Soon 14 Days, Within 30, Within 60, 60 Days or More; at most 5 entries inline, "Show all" opens a modal.
  3. A restriction is held in `dueDatesSync` (window or selection), shown as a pill with a clear button, and resets the page and selection; an empty match withholds the list request.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/GetCategoryReviewDueDatesRequest.cs` | Scan query, date validation |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryReviewDueDatesCard.tsx` | Card UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/categoryReview.helpers.ts` | `CATEGORY_REVIEW_DUE_DATE_BUCKETS`, `applyCategoryReviewDueDateSync`, `isCategoryReviewDueDateSyncEmpty` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewTable.tsx` | Wiring, `{!brandID && ...}` mount |
- **Data:** `CategoryReviews.SubmissionDueDate`; response cells `CategoryReviewDateRangeCellDTO {columnName "SubmissionDueDate", date, categoryReviewId, brandID?}`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/due-dates` | `RequireModule(category-review, category-review, View, OrganizationLevel)` | Query `startDate?` (default today UTC), `endDate` (required), `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `brandId` (ignored) / `PagedData<CategoryReviewDateRangeCellDTO>` (web `ICategoryReviewDueDatesParams`, `ICategoryReviewDueDatesResponse`) | `GetCategoryReviewDueDatesRequestHandler` |
- **Business rules:** `endDate` missing is 400 "Please provide an end date."; end before start is 400. End is extended to the end of its day. Order is `Date DESC, CategoryReviewId ASC`; the web re-sorts soonest first within the fetched page and reports truncation.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Not verified.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/GetCategoryReviewDueDatesRequestTests.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/{CategoryReviewDueDatesCard,CategoryOverviewTableDueDatesSync}.test.tsx`.

#### 2.8.6 Feature: Category Review Calendar

- **Status:** Active (several sub-flows feature-flagged off, see sub-features)
- **What it does:** A twelve-month grid of the reviews placed on brand calendars, one row per (Retailer, Category) group, with "Open Review" and month columns holding clickable Review and Reset pills. Brokerages use `/category-review-calendar` across all brands granting `category-review-calendar` `view`; a brand page (`/[brandID]/category-review-calendar-brand`) is scoped to that brand and adds KPI status cards and an external-notes drawer (2.8.6.8). Remove from Calendar needs `category-review-calendar` `update`.
- **User flow:**
  1. The grid posts the filter body to `calender/group` (page size from the store, default sort `RetailerName ASC`). On a brand route the body always carries `brands: [brandID]`.
  2. Each month cell shows a Review pill when the review's `ReviewMonth` names that month and a Reset pill in the month of `ResetDate`; "Open Review" reviews show a marker in the Open Review column (`getCalendarMonthPills`, `getCalendarCellPills`). The legend lists only Review and Reset (`CALENDAR_LEGEND_DATE_TYPES`).
  3. Clicking a pill opens `MilestoneDetailsModal` (2.8.6.4).
  4. Selecting rows and "Remove from Calendar" removes those reviews from the caller's calendars (2.8.6.2).
  5. Filter drawer (`CategoryOverviewFilter` with `isCalendar`) reads facets from `calender/filter`; the Brands facet shows only on the broker route.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/Calendar/GetCategoryReviewCalenderByGroup.cs` | Loads every calendar row in scope, groups by (Retailer, Category) in memory, places month cells, attaches Brand Reports, sorts and pages in memory |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/CategoryOverviewCalendar.tsx` | Grid, toolbar, KPI mount (brand route), milestone modal |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/categoryReview.helpers.ts` | Pill derivation, `collectCategoryReviewIdsFromCalenderRows`, status filter helpers |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/category-overview.service.ts` | `useGetCategoryOverviewsCalendarGroup`, `useRemoveCategoryReviewToCalendar`, `useAddCategoryReviewToCalendar` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/(category-review)/layout.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/(category-review)/layout.tsx` | Tabs (list and calendar), store reset on unmount, broker "Go to Brand Report" link |

- **Data:** `CategoryReviewCalender` joined to `CategoryReviews` (INNER) and `Brand.Brands` (INNER, non-deleted). Response `CategoryReviewCalenderByGroupDTO {retailer, category, regions[], brands[{id,name}], openReview[], january..december[] of DataModel{id = CategoryReviewID, region, reviewMonth, resetDate}, brandReports[]}` (web `ICategoryReviewCalenderByGroupDTO`).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/category-reviews/calender/group` | `RequireModule(category-review-calendar, category-review-calendar, View, CrossBrand)`, `BrandIDHeader` | Body `CategoryReviewCalenderByGroupQueryProperties` (shared filters + `brands[]`, `year?`, `categoryReviewIds`, `createdBy`); query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder` / `PagedData<CategoryReviewCalenderByGroupDTO>` (web `ICategoryReviewCalenderGroupBody`, `ICategoryReviewCalenderByGroupResponse`) | `GetCategoryReviewCalenderByGroupRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Only Review Month and Reset Date produce cells; Submission Due Date and Review Date stay on the list (`ApplyReviewToDto`). `year`, when sent, limits Reset cells to that year (the web type allows it; no web caller sets it).
  - Duplicate cells within a month are collapsed by (region, reviewMonth, dates) (`AddIfUnique`).
  - `sortingOrder DESC` sorts Retailer descending then Category; ASC sorts Retailer only. The `sortKey` the web sends is ignored.
  - Nested `brandReports`: a Brand company sees every brokerage's report about the shown pairs with internal notes blanked; a brokerage sees only its own reports with both note lists.
  - Empty `CalendarBrandIds` returns an empty page.
- **Dependencies:** 2.8.1, 2.8.7 (nested Brand Report fields).
- **Errors & edge cases:** A Brand company with no brand id is refused by the area. Reviews with null Retailer/Category group under "Unknown Retailer"/"Unknown Category".
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/CategoryReview/{GetCategoryReviewCalenderByGroupRequestTests,GetCategoryReviewCalenderByGroupRequestCategoryReviewIdsFilterTests}.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/{CategoryOverviewCalendarGating,CategoryOverviewCalendarPagination,CategoryOverviewCalendarStatusCards}.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The whole in-scope calendar is loaded and grouped in memory on every request; paging happens after grouping, so cost grows with the calendar, not the page.
  - `DataModel.ID` is the Category Review id, not the `CategoryReviewCalender` row id (`CreateDataModel`); `caboodle.web/CLAUDE.md` (2026-07-24 note) says otherwise.
  - The Brand column is commented out on both routes in `CategoryOverviewCalendar.tsx` (CLAUDE.md says the broker route keeps it).
  - master (CS-1792) reads Retailer, Category and dates from copies on `CategoryReviewCalender` instead of joining `CategoryReviews`; this branch still joins, so a deleted review's calendar row disappears.

#### 2.8.7 Feature: Brand Report grid

- **What it does:** The broker-only `/brand-report` screen lists every Brand Report the brokerage owns on brands granting `brand-report` `view`, with header filters per column, sortable headers, inline status selects, a "Hide statuses" exclusion, KPI analytics cards (2.8.14), Upcoming Reviews (2.8.15), notes and history row actions, and toolbar actions (Add Brand, Email Brands, Delete, Export, Email Activity). #### 2.8.8 Feature: Notify Brands (create Brand Reports and email)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** From the broker Category Review list, a brokerage picks one or more catalog reviews and brands and the backend creates missing Brand Reports (method NotifyBrand), places the pairs on the brands' calendars and emails the brands' people. Needs `brand-report` `create` (and, through the internal push, `category-review-calendar` `update` on the same brands).
- **User flow:**
  1. Select rows on `/category-review`, click "Notify Brands" (button shown when `canNotifyBrands`; the row mail icon is hidden by `SHOW_ROW_NOTIFY_ACTION = false`).
  2. `NotifyBrandsModal` lists every brand of the current org (`useAccessibleBrands`), loads people per brand (`POST brands/users`) grouped Owner / Sub Users / Contacts, and pre-reads existing reports (`list` with `categoryReviewIds`, `pageSize -1`) to name brands that already have a report.
  3. Compose (collapsed by default): subject seeded for one review and required for several, CC seeded with the sender's email, message (rich text).
  4. One review sends `notify`; several send `notify/batch` with the same selection cloned per review (`buildNotifyBatchRequest`). Submit is disabled when every selected pair already exists.
  5. On success the wider Brand Report invalidation set and calendar keys refresh.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/BrandReport/NotifyBrandReportsRequest.cs` | Single-review notify, assignee resolution, defaults |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/BrandReport/NotifyBrandReportsBatchRequest.cs` | Multi-review notify, duplicate-pair check |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/BrandReport/BrandReportNotifyEmailJob.cs`, `IBrandReportNotifyEmailJob.cs` | Hangfire job: send and bulk-insert `BrandReportEmailLog` rows |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/Brands/GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequest.cs` | People picker source (`POST brands/users`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/NotifyBrandsModal.tsx` | Modal (calls `BrandReportService` directly) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/brand-report/brandReport.helpers.ts` | `partitionBrandsForNotify`, `previewNotifyBatch`, `buildNotifyBatchRequest`, `findDuplicateNotifyPair`, assignee value encoding |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/categoryReview.helpers.ts` | `buildAssigneeOptions` (sectioned picker) |

- **Data:** Creates `BrandReports` (default Submission Status and Brand Response options whose `DefaultsInMethods` contains 5), internal note "Created via Notify Brand", `CategoryReviewCalender` rows, `BrandReportEmailLogs` (SendType Initial), `Created` audit entries with recipient names.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/notify` | `RequireModule(null, brand-report, Create, CrossBrand)` | `NotifyBrandReportsRequest {categoryReviewId, brandIds[], assigneeEmails?[{email, source 5/10/15}], subject?, message?, cc?, bcc?}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` (web `INotifyBrandReportsRequest`) | `NotifyBrandReportsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/notify/batch` | same | `NotifyBrandReportsBatchRequest {notifications: NotifyBrandReportsRequest[]}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` (web `INotifyBrandReportsBatchRequest`) | `NotifyBrandReportsBatchRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brands/users` | `RequireModule(null, category-review, View, CrossBrand)`; query `includeInactive` | `GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequest {brandIds}` / `List<BrandUsersGroupDTO>` (owner, sub users, contacts per brand; web `IBrandUsersGroup`) | `GetBrandOwnersAndSubUsersRequestHandler` (Brand module) |

  Email: `EmailModule.BrandReportNotify` template via `SmtpMailService.SendBrandReportNotifyEmailAsync` (placeholders reporter, note, created time, retailer, category, region, review month, submission due date, review end date, brands, submission status, brand response, view URL `AppUrls:BaseUrl` + `/brand-report`); a blank subject uses the template subject.
- **Business rules:**
  - Every brand must be in scope for `Create`; the review must be a catalog review of the caller's brokerage (`BrandID IS NULL AND BrokerageOrganizationID = scope`), else 400 "Category review not found."
  - Recipients: with no `assigneeEmails`, every active owner and sub-user of each brand (contacts excluded); with a list, each (email, source) must exist in that brand set or the whole call is 400 ("One or more selected assignees do not belong to the selected brands."); inactive people are dropped either way.
  - An already-reported (brand, review) pair creates nothing and sends nothing; the response message is the same either way.
  - One email per new report (per brand), never merged across brands.
  - Batch: every item needs a review and at least one brand; the same (review, brand) twice is a 400; calendar push runs once per review.
- **Dependencies:** 2.8.6.1 (push via `ISender`), IAM memberships, CRM contacts, mail, Hangfire.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A new report with no resolvable recipients logs a warning and queues no email. The notify job has no try/catch per payload: one SMTP failure aborts the remaining sends and the log insert for that job run (Hangfire retry policy applies; no `AutomaticRetry` override on this job).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/BrandReport/{NotifyBrandReportsRequestTests,NotifyBrandReportsBatchRequestTests,BrandReportNotifyEmailJobTests}.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/{NotifyBrandsModal,CategoryOverviewTableNotify}.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/brand-report/brandReportNotifyBatch.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/brandReportNotifyResend.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Notify calls `PushCategoryReviewRecordsIntoCalenderRequest` through MediatR, which re-checks the `category-review-calendar` `Update` grant; a brokerage with Brand Report create but no calendar update on a brand fails with "You do not have access to one or more selected brands." after the reports are already inserted.
  - The web brand picker is every brand of the org, not filtered by the `brand-report` `create` grant; one disallowed brand rejects the whole call.
  - `NotifyBrandsModal` and `EmailBrandsModal` call services directly instead of through hooks, against the repo convention.

#### 2.8.11 Feature: Email logs and resend

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Every notify, re-notify and resend email is logged in `BrandReportEmailLogs`. The toolbar "Email Activity" opens the unscoped log for all the brokerage's reports; a row's History modal has an "Email History" tab scoped to that report. Selected logs can be resent verbatim. View needs `brand-report` `view`; resend needs `create`.
- **User flow:**
  1. Open Email Activity or History > Email History (`BrandReportEmailLogsPanel`); filter by send type, method and date range; grid reads send `includeBody: false`.
  2. Preview a body: the panel re-runs the same page query with `includeBody: true` and renders the HTML in an `iframe` with an empty `sandbox` attribute.
  3. Resend one or many logs after a confirmation; controls are disabled when `resendRecipientCount` is 0.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/BrandReport/GetBrandReportEmailLogsRequest.cs`, `.../ResendBrandReportEmailLogsRequest.cs`, `.../BrandReportResendEmailJob.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Helper/BrandReportEmailRecipientHelper.cs`, `caboodle.web/src/components/brand-report/BrandReportEmailLogsPanel.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/brand-report/BrandReportEmailLogsModal.tsx`.
- **Data:** `BrandReportEmailLogs`; `Identity.Users.IsActive` for recipient filtering.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/email-logs/list` | `RequireModule(null, brand-report, View, CrossBrand)` | `GetBrandReportEmailLogsRequest {brandReportIds?, sendType?, method?, fromDate?, toDate? (date-only), includeBody (default true), pageSize, currentPage}` / `PagedData<BrandReportEmailLogDTO>` (to/cc/bcc comma strings, subject, body, sendType, method, brandReportIds, createdBy, createdOn, resendRecipientCount) (web `IBrandReportEmailLogListRequest`, `IBrandReportEmailLogListResponse`) | `GetBrandReportEmailLogsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/resend` | `RequireModule(null, brand-report, Create, CrossBrand)` | `ResendBrandReportEmailLogsRequest {logIds[]}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` (web `IResendBrandReportEmailLogsRequest`) | `ResendBrandReportEmailLogsRequestHandler` |

  Job: `IBrandReportResendEmailJob.ProcessAsync(logIds, callerUserId)` resends `Subject`/`Body`/`Cc`/`Bcc` with `SendCustomEmailAsync` and inserts new logs with SendType Resend.
- **Business rules:**
  - A log is listed only when every report id in it is in scope (`NOT EXISTS` any report outside the brands or brokerage); order fixed `CreatedOn DESC`.
  - Resend is all-or-nothing before queuing: unknown log ids give 404; any referenced report outside scope gives 404.
  - `To` addresses matching an inactive `Identity.Users` row are dropped; addresses with no user (contacts) stay. A log with no remaining `To` is skipped. `resendRecipientCount` in the list uses the same rule.
  - A `Resent` audit entry per report is written when the request is accepted, before the job sends.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Per-log send failures are caught and logged in the job; the API still returned success.

#### 2.8.15 Feature: Upcoming Reviews (Brand Report due dates)

- **Status:** Active (broker Brand Report screen)
- **What it does:** The right-most card scans Review Start, Review End and Next Action Due Date cells, keeps Review Start cells only, and buckets them into Current, Next 30 Days, 60-90 Days and 4-6 Months (day-based, CS-1725). Clicking a bucket or a date writes a Review Start range filter on the grid.
- **User flow:** `fetchAllBrandReportDueDates` requests the window (365 days back to 6 months ahead) with `pageSize: -1`, then pages on if the server ignores it (up to `UPCOMING_REVIEW_MAX_PAGES = 50`); counts come from client-side bucketing; at most 5 dates inline per bucket with "Show all".
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/CategoryRerview/BrandReport/{GetBrandReportDueDatesRequest,BrandReportDueDatesConditionBuilder}.cs`, `caboodle.web/src/components/brand-report/BrandReportDueDatesCard.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/brand-report/brandReport.helpers.ts` (`UPCOMING_REVIEW_BUCKETS`, `buildUpcomingReviewWindow`, `buildDueDatesFilter`).
- **Data:** Not verified.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/due-dates` | `RequireModule(null, brand-report, View, CrossBrand)` | `GetBrandReportDueDatesRequest` (analytics filters + `startDate?`, `endDate` required, `pageSize`, `currentPage`) / `PagedData<BrandReportDateRangeCellDTO {columnName ReviewStart/ReviewEnd/NextActionDueDate, date, brandReportId, brandID, categoryReviewID}>` (web `IBrandReportDueDatesParams`, `IBrandReportDueDatesResponse`) | `GetBrandReportDueDatesRequestHandler` |
- **Business rules:** Same date validation as 2.8.5. The window ANDs with column range filters. Order `Date DESC, BrandReportId ASC`. The web drops `brandReportIds`, `fromReviewStart`/`toReviewStart`, paging and sort from the scan body so the card never filters itself.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Not verified.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/BrandReport/GetBrandReportDueDatesRequestTests.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/brand-report/{BrandReportDueDatesCard,BrandReportUpcomingReviews}.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The OpenAPI text says Brand and Sub-brand users may call it; the handler uses `BrandReportScope.ResolveAsync`, which refuses non-Brokerage orgs.
  - The Next Action branch LEFT JOINs `CategoryReviews` to survive a deleted review, but the shared Retailer/Category filters still compare `cr` columns, which drops those orphan cells whenever either filter is set.
  - Two condition builders (`BrandReportFilterConditionBuilder`, `BrandReportDueDatesConditionBuilder`) duplicate the same filter chain.

- **Data:** `DataHub` `ExportJob` (`ModuleType.BrandReportExport = 33`, `BrandID = Guid.Empty`, `RequestJson` holds filters plus `AccessibleBrandIds` and `BrokerageOrganizationId` captured at request time); CSV uploaded to S3 as `BrandReport_Export_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv`, columns BrandName, Retailer, Category, ReviewStart, ReviewEnd, Method, IsCompleted, CreatedOn, NextActionDueDate and five status names.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/list` with `export: true` | `RequireModule(null, brand-report, View, CrossBrand)`; handler demands `Export` | `GetBrandReportListRequest` / `ExportJobInitiatedDto {jobId, moduleType 33, message}` (web `IBrandReportExportJobInitiated`) | `GetBrandReportListRequestHandler.StartExportAsync` |

| POST | `/api/v1/brandreport/export/{jobId}/cancel` | same | / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `CancelBrandReportExportJobRequestHandler` |

  Job: `IExportJobService.ExecuteExportAsync(jobId, Guid.Empty, userId, ModuleType.BrandReportExport)`.
- **Business rules:** `pageSize -1` exports every match in id-ordered batches with progress updates; any other size exports one page using the grid sort. Zero rows completes with `BrandReport_Export_Empty.csv` and no file. Only the creator or a Platform Admin can read or cancel a job (`ExportJobOwnership`); other ids answer 404.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Not verified.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/BrandReport/BrandReportExportJobRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Export/ExportJobServiceBrandReportExportTests.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/brand-report/brandReportExportScope.helpers.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Cancel only flips the status to Cancelled; the worker never reads it and its own `Start()`/`Complete()` overwrite it, so a cancelled job can still finish as Done. The export runs with the scope captured at request time, not re-checked when the job runs.

| PUT | `/api/v1/brandreport/settings/status-options` | `MustHavePermission(Update, BrandReportStatusOption, Broker)` | `UpdateBrandReportStatusOptionRequest {id, name, displayOrder, isActive, defaultsInMethods?, color?}` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdateBrandReportStatusOptionRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Name required, max 200, must contain a letter or digit; unique per column type on `NameKey` (normalized). Colour must be `#RGB` or `#RRGGBB`, or is auto-picked away from the column's existing colours. `defaultsInMethods` values must be valid `BrandReportMethod`s; setting a method removes it from every other option of the same column, so at most one default per (column, method). Column type cannot change on update. Delete nulls the option on every non-deleted Brand Report, then soft-deletes it; deleting an unknown id still returns success. New reports take defaults only for Submission Status and Brand Response.
- **Dependencies:** Platform permissions (`CaboodlePermissions`), 2.8.7 and 2.8.14 consumers.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Reorder has no bulk endpoint or transaction; partial success is possible.

Admin: no Jest tests found for this screen.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The web app's `useGetBrandReportColumnTypes` hook has no consumer. Option reads are refused for Brand companies (`DemandCatalogModuleAsync` with no brand slug), which is why the brand calendar takes option names and colours from `analytics/{brandId}` instead.

### 2.9 Module: Market Overview & APL Reports

- **Purpose:** Broker-facing field intelligence and authorized-product-list (APL) reporting. Brokers log what they saw or presented at retail ("Market Overview" logs: region, retailer, banner, store, SKU, SKU status, presentation date, comment), report on those logs, and maintain or read three different APL views. Brands read the logs their brokers created ("Broker Market Activities") and their own retail item status ("Retail Reports"). The broker landing dashboard (`/dashboard`) is the tile hub that links into these and sibling broker screens.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/MarketOverviewsController.cs` (class `MarketOverviews`, route `api/v1/marketoverviews`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/BrokersController.cs` (route `api/v1/brokers`; APL, retail-apl and lookup actions), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Brand/BrandsController.cs` (route `api/v1/brands`; `apl*` actions), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Report/ReportsController.cs` (legacy `brand-market-overview*` and `retail-report*` actions).
  - Backend handlers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/`, `.../Reports/GetMarketOverviewsReportRequest.cs`, `.../Reports/RetailApl/`, `.../APL/`, `.../Broker/` (lookups), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Brand/Modules.Brand.Application/Requests/Reports/{APL,Activities}/`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/{Report,ImportExport}/` (legacy brand MO and retail-report handlers), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/CRM/Modules.CRM.Application/Banners/GetRegionRetailerBannersRequest.cs`.
  - Background export: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs` (`ExecuteRetailAplExportAsync`).
  - Web routes: `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/{dashboard,market-overview,market-overview-report,distributor-apl,retail-apl}/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/{brand-market-overview-report,retail-report,apl-report,apl-activity}/`.
  - Web components: `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/` (Market Overview files: `MarketOverviewTable.tsx`, `AddMarketOverview.tsx`, `EditMarketOverview.tsx`, `MarketOverviewReport.tsx`, `MarketOverviwesReportFilter.tsx`, `MarketOverviewLogSummary.tsx`, `marketOverview.helpers.ts`, `marketOverviewLocation.helpers.ts`, `useMarketOverviewLocationOptions.ts`), `caboodle.web/src/components/Apl/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor-apl/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/retail-apl/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/retail-report/` (unused), `caboodle.web/src/components/DashboardComponent.tsx`.
  - Web services/hooks: `caboodle.web/src/service/market-overview.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/apl.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/retailApl.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/report.service.ts` (Distributor APL, brand MO legacy, retail-report legacy, `apl-total-count`, `brands/apl/filter-options`), `caboodle.web/src/hooks/market-overview.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/apl.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/retailApl.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/reports.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promotional-management.ts` (brand MO parent/child/filter hooks live here).
  - Web models: `caboodle.web/src/models/{market-overview,apl,distributorApl,retailApl,retail-report}.interface.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/sort-keys/market-overview.ts`.
  - Admin: no live screen in this module (see 2.9.8).
- **Shared data models:**
  - `Broker.MarketOverviews` (`MarketOverview`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Domain/Broker/MarketOverview.cs`): `ID`, `RegionID`, `RetailerID`, `BannerID`, `StoreID?`, `DCID?` (optional since migration `20260916105755_MarketOverviewDCIDMadeOptional`), `BrandID`, `BrokerageOrganizationID?`, `SKUID`, `SkuStatus` (int, `SkuStatus` enum 1 Active, 2 Pending, 3 NotActive, 4 Declined, 5 Discontinued, 6 Approved, 7 Commit; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/Enums.cs`), `DateTime` (presentation date), `Comment` (HTML from the rich text editor), `Training`, `CaseStack`, `LaunchDate?`, audit fields. Indexes on each FK plus `(BrokerageOrganizationID, BrandID)` (`MainDbContextModelSnapshot.cs`). A `BEFORE INSERT` trigger `TR_MarketOverviews_StampBrokerageOwner` fills `BrokerageOrganizationID` when null (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrations/20261007113558_AddOrganizationManagement.cs`).
