Global table: no brand or brokerage column; brand reach is derived by joining `UPCNumber` to `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications`.
  - `CRM.BannerSKUs` (owned by CRM, 2.4): the source of both Retail APL (broker) and Retail Reports (brand); Market Overview create/update writes into it.
  - `DataHub.ExportJobs` (`ExportJob`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Domain/Export/ExportJob.cs`): Retail APL background export rows (`ModuleType.RetailAplExport = 34`).
  - Read-only joins: `CRM.Regions`, `CRM.Retailers`, `CRM.Banners` (`DoorCount` = Number of Stores), `CRM.DistributorDcs` (`Warehouse`), `CRM.RetailerRegions`, `CRM.DistributorBanners`, `CRM.Stores`, `CRM.BannerActivities`, `DataHub.StoreListEntries`, `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications`, `ProductSpecs.Categories`, `Brand.Brands`, `Identity.Users`.
  - **The three APL contracts (never interchangeable):**

| | Brand Retail Reports ("Brand APL") | Distributor APL | Broker Retail APL ("Brand Retail Item Status") |
|---|---|---|---|
| Route | `POST api/v1/brands/apl` (+ `apl/filter-options`, `apl/export`, `apl-total-count`, `apl-activities*`) | `api/v1/brokers/apl*`, `apl-property-values` | `api/v1/brokers/retail-apl*` |
| Data | `CRM.BannerSKUs` of one brand | `Broker.DistributorAPLs` (DC + UPC + costs) | `CRM.BannerSKUs` of many brands |
| Access | `RequireModule(retail-reports, null, View)`; `BrandID` header required | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, ...)`, cross-brand | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, ...)`, cross-brand |
| Brand scope | Active brand from header | `BrandsInScope(distributor-apl, action)`, rows whose UPC belongs to a product of those brands | `BrandsInScope(retail-apl, action)` intersected with the optional `brands` body filter |
| Filter options | One call, all five facets, server self-excludes; no `propertyName` | One call or one facet (`propertyName` optional); self-excludes; adds numeric ranges | `propertyName` required, one facet per call, no self-exclusion (client strips the facet's own key) |
| Sort | `sortKey` query (`RetailerName` default, also secondary `BannerName`) | Fixed `Warehouse ASC` | `sortKey` query; empty = `RetailerName`, invalid = `BrandName` |
| Export | Synchronous CSV (`POST apl/export`) | Synchronous CSV (`POST apl/export`), `isSampleFile` | Background job (`export: true` on the list body) + status/cancel |
| Row ids | None (display fields only) | `ID`, `DCID`, `BrandID`, `CategoryID` | `BrandID` only |

- **Shared services:**
  - `MarketOverviewScope` (`.../MarketOverview/MarketOverviewScope.cs`): broker writes and reads are limited to `BrandsInScope(market-overview, action)` AND `BrokerageOrganizationID = caller's organization` (`Condition` constant); `ResolveRequestedBrands` refuses named out-of-scope brands.
  - `MarketOverviewFilterConditionBuilder` + `MarketOverviewFilterRequestBase` (`.../MarketOverview/MarketOverviewFilterConditionBuilder.cs`): one filter contract (`IMarketOverviewFilter`, 22 fields) shared by list, filters, report and export.
  - `AplBrandScope` and `AplFilterConditionBuilder` (`.../APL/`): Distributor APL brand reach via UPC and the shared filter contract `IAplFilter`.
  - `ExportJobOwnership.DemandOwnJobAsync` (`.../Helper/ExportJobOwnership.cs`): another user's job answers 404 (platform admin exempt).
  - `ISharedDataService.PushMarketOverviewChangesIntoCRM` / `PushMarketOverviewUpdatesIntoCRM` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs`): copy a logged SKU status into `CRM.BannerSKUs`.
  - `FileExportHelper.ConvertToCsvFile` (CSV responses), `PagingHelper.GetDataRange` (`pageSize: -1` = all rows).
  - Web: `TableWithHeaderAction`, `TableHeaderActionButtons` (export scope menu), `SearchField`, `SelectFilterGroup` + `FilterComponent` (Retail APL), `useModuleAccess` (`anyBrandCan`), `downloadHelper`, `fetchWithMock` for CSV downloads, `useDebouncedValue`.
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - IAM / module access (`RequireModule`, `IAccessContext`, `/me/access`, `useModuleAccess`): slugs `market-overview`, `broker-market-activities`, `distributor-apl`, `retail-apl`, `retail-reports`.
  - CRM (2.4): regions, retailers, banners, retailer-regions, distributor banners, DCs, stores, banner SKUs (read and, for Market Overview, written), banner activities.
  - Product Specs: products (`SKUID`, UPC matching), categories.
  - DataHub: `StoreListEntries` (store names on Market Overview reads), `ExportJobs`, Hangfire job service.
  - Organization: `BrokerageOrganizationID` ownership and the stamp trigger.
  - Admin data cleanup: `SyncMarketOverviewWithCRM` is called from `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/DataCleanup/BannerSKUDataCleanupRequest.cs`.

#### 2.9.1 Feature: Broker Market Overview logs

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A brokerage's log of retail visits and presentations: one row per (brand, retailer, banner, region, optional store, optional DC, SKU) with a SKU status, presentation date, launch date, training and case-stack flags and a rich-text comment. The `/market-overview` grid lists, filters, sorts, exports, adds, edits and removes the brokerage's own rows. Used by Brokerage members with the broker module `market-overview` (View, Create, Update, Delete, Export) on at least one connected brand; a Brand company is refused at the policy (`RequireModule(null, market-overview, ...)` has no brand slug).
- **User flow:**
  1. Broker opens Management > Market Overview > Details (`/market-overview`, nav entry in `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts`, route gated on `market-overview` by `BROKER_ROUTE_MODULES` in `caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts`).
  2. Grid loads `POST marketoverviews/list` (default `sortKey: RegionName`, `ASC`, page size `PAGE_SIZE`); search box (`SearchField`) writes `query`; drawer filters write the rest; all filter state is debounced (`useDebouncedValue`) and resets to page 1.
  3. Column headers sort server-side through `SortingOrderTitle` (keys `RegionName`, `RetailerName`, `BannerName`, `StoreName`, `BrandName`, `SKUName`, `SkuStatus`, `DoorCount`, `DC`, `CreatedBy`, `DateTime`). Sort keeps the page.
  4. Row actions: View comment (only when the row has one) and Edit log (when `anyBrandCan(market-overview, update)`). Toolbar: Export (scopes), Add Log, Remove Log (needs selection), Filter.
  5. An inverted date, launch-date or store-count range is caught client-side (`getMarketOverviewRangeErrors`); the list request is withheld and the reason shown in the drawer.
  6. After a delete that empties the last page, the grid steps back one page (`isLastPage` uses the live page size).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/market-overview/page.tsx` | Route; renders `MarketOverviewTable` in `Suspense`, `force-dynamic` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/MarketOverviewTable.tsx` | Grid, toolbar, permission gates, export, delete, modals |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/marketOverview.helpers.ts` | Body builders (`buildMarketOverviewFilterBody`, `buildMarketOverviewListBody`, `buildMarketOverviewExportBody`), export scopes, range checks, facet label memory |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/MarketOverviewLogSummary.tsx` | Read-only summary shown in the comment and edit modals |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/market-overview.ts` | `useGetMarketOverviews`, `useCreateMarketOverview`, `useUpdateMarketOverview`, `useDeleteMarketOverview`, filter hooks, option hooks |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/market-overview.service.ts` | `MarketOverviewService` axios and fetch calls |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/market-overview.interface.ts` | `IMarketOverview`, `IMarketOverviewListBody`, `IMarketOverviewExportBody`, `IMarketOverviewFilterOptions` and option types |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Broker/MarketOverviewsController.cs` | Endpoints |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewsRequest.cs` | List query, sort-key map, validators |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/{Create,Update,Delete}*Request.cs` | Writes |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/MarketOverviewScope.cs` | Brokerage + brand scope |

- **Data:** `Broker.MarketOverviews` (see module). Response `BrokerMarketOverviewDTO` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/DTOs/BrokerDTOs.cs`): ids and names for brand, retailer (`CorporateName`), banner, region, store (`DataHub.StoreListEntries.StoreName`), DC (`Warehouse`), `NumberOfStores` (`Banners.DoorCount`), SKU (`ProductSpecifications.Name`), `SkuStatus`, `DateTime`, `Comment`, `Training`, `CaseStack`, `LaunchDate`, `CreatedBy` (first + last name). Web type `IMarketOverview`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/list` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, View, CrossBrand)` | `GetMarketOverviewsRequest` (filter base + `PageSize` (-1 or > 0), `CurrentPage`, `SortingOrder`, `SortKey`) / `PagedData<BrokerMarketOverviewDTO>`; web `IMarketOverviewListBody` | `GetMarketOverviewsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Create, CrossBrand)` | `CreateMarketOverviewsRequest { Overviews: BrokerMarketOverviewPayload[] }` / `ResponseMetaDTO`; web `{ overviews: IMarketOverviewRequest[] }` | `CreateMarketOverviewsRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/marketoverviews` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Update, CrossBrand)` | `UpdateMarketOverviewRequest { ID, Status (SkuStatus), DateTime, Comment }` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpdateMarketOverviewRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/marketoverviews` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Delete, CrossBrand)` | `DeleteMarketOverviewsRequest { IDs }` (web sends `iDs` under axios `data`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteMarketOverviewsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/filters` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, View, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.1.4 | `GetMarketOverviewFiltersRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/report/export` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Export, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.1.5 | `ExportMarketOverviewRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/options/search` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Create, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.1.1 | `GetMarketOverviewLocationOptionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/options/stores/search` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Create, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.1.1 | `GetMarketOverviewStoreOptionsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Every read and write is limited by `MarketOverviewScope.Condition`: `BrandID = ANY(brands in scope for the action)` AND `BrokerageOrganizationID = caller's organization` (`MarketOverviewScope.cs`). A brokerage never sees another brokerage's rows on a shared brand.
  - List `SortKey` must be one of the mapped keys or the request fails with `SortKey: Invalid Sort Key provided`; empty sorts by brand name; ties broken by `mo.ID` (`GetMarketOverviewsRequest.GetOrderByColumn`).
  - Validators: `PageSize` is -1 or > 0; `FromDate <= ToDate` (`DateTimeRange`), `FromLaunchDate <= ToLaunchDate` (`LaunchDateRange`), `MinNumberOfStores <= MaxNumberOfStores` (`NumberOfStoresRange`); each is a 400.
  - Text filters (`Query`, `Warehouse`, `Comment`, `Sku`, `UpcNumber`) are trimmed and wrapped as `%value%` `ILIKE`; `Query` searches brand, retailer, banner, region, store, DC, SKU name, UPC, comment and creator name (`MarketOverviewFilterConditionBuilder.BuildCondition`).
  - Web gates every toolbar and row control on `anyBrandCan(market-overview, action)`, hidden while access loads (`MarketOverviewTable.tsx`).
- **Dependencies:** CRM regions/retailers/banners/DCs, DataHub `StoreListEntries`, Product Specs, Identity users (`INNER JOIN` on `CreatedBy`), IAM module access, CKEditor-based `RichTextEditor` for comments.
- **Errors & edge cases:**
  - The list uses `INNER JOIN` on region, retailer, banner, brand, user and product (with `p.BrandID = mo.BrandID`); a row whose referenced record is missing or deleted disappears from the grid without error.
  - Web wire-name quirk: `skuIDs` and `dcIDs` must be sent as `skuiDs` and `dciDs` (System.Text.Json camelCase of `SKUIDs`/`DCIDs`); a wrong spelling binds nothing and returns unfiltered data (`buildMarketOverviewFilterBody`).
  - Delete returns `No Market overview deleted.` with 200 when nothing matched (out-of-scope ids are skipped silently).
  - Mutations invalidate only `QueryKeys.getMarketOverviews`; the drawer facet queries and the report key are not invalidated (`hooks/market-overview.ts`).
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/MarketOverview/{GetMarketOverviewsRequestTests,MarketOverviewWriteRequestsTests,MarketOverviewScopeTests,MarketOverviewFilterConditionBuilderTests}.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/MarketOverviewTablePagination.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/MarketOverviewLogSummary.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/marketOverview.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/marketOverview.service.test.ts`. Gap: no test drives the grid's sort or delete flow end to end.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Delete is a hard `DELETE` from `Broker.MarketOverviews` although the entity has `Deleted` audit fields, and it does not revert the CRM banner SKU status that the row wrote (`DeleteMarketOverviewsRequest.cs`).
  - `SortingOrder` is interpolated into the list SQL without `ValidateSortingOrder` (`GetMarketOverviewsRequest.GetQuery`); other MO handlers validate it.
  - `IMarkerOverviewTable` / row mapping reads `item.distributorName`, which the DTO does not return.

##### 2.9.1.1 Sub-feature: Add Log form and location options (CS-1299)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The Add Log modal creates one log per selected SKU per selected store (or one per SKU with `storeID: null` when no store is picked). Region, Retailer, Banner and Store are independent pickers fed by two option endpoints; a value is auto-filled when the user's other picks determine it.
- **User flow:**
  1. Modal opens; the hook fetches `options/search` once with `{ pageSize: -1, currentPage: 1 }` (`LOCATION_OPTIONS_BODY`) and `options/stores/search` for the current location picks.
  2. User picks any of Region / Retailer / Banner; only picked values narrow the other lists (`listLocationChoices`), derived values are recomputed (`resolveSelection`), and a field with exactly one candidate is filled. A `null` region (banner not mapped to a region) counts as a candidate so it is never auto-replaced.
  3. Store is a multi-select; "Select all" appears only when Retailer and Banner are set; stores not in the fresh store result are pruned after the refetch (`pruneStoreSelection`, gated on `!isPreviousData`).
  4. Brand comes from `useAccessibleBrands`; picking it clears SKU and DC. SKUs come from `GET api/v1/banners/skus` with the `BrandID` header and `pageSize: -1` (CRM); DCs from `POST api/v1/distributioncenter/distributor/dcs/search` filtered by region (`useGetDistributorDC`).
  5. SKU Status, Distribution center (optional), Presentation Date (required), Launch Date, Training, Case Stack, Comment; Submit posts the payload array. With "continue" checked, the modal stays open, completed SKUs are excluded from the picker and the SKU field clears.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/AddMarketOverview.tsx` | Form, payload fan-out (`onFinish`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/useMarketOverviewLocationOptions.ts` | Selection state, both option queries, synchronous form mirroring |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/marketOverviewLocation.helpers.ts` | Pure selection rules, `formatDistributionCenter` (em dash for null DC) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewLocationOptionsRequest.cs` | Retailer/region/banner/brand combinations |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewStoreOptionsRequest.cs` | Stores of accessible banners |

- **Data:** `MarketOverviewLocationOptionDTO` (`RetailerID`, `RetailerName`, `RegionID?`, `RegionName?`, `BannerID`, `BannerName`, `BrandID`, `BrandName`) from `CRM.DistributorBanners` joined to banners, retailers, brands and `LEFT JOIN CRM.RetailerRegions/Regions`. `MarketOverviewStoreOptionDTO` (`StoreID`, `StoreName`, `RetailerID`, `RegionID`, `BannerID`) from `CRM.Stores` whose banner is in the accessible brands' `DistributorBanners`. Web: `IMarketOverviewOptionsRequest`, `IMarketOverviewLocationOption`, `IMarketOverviewStoreOption`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/options/search` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Create, CrossBrand)` | `GetMarketOverviewLocationOptionsRequest { BrandIDs?, RegionIDs?, RetailerIDs?, BannerIDs?, PageSize, CurrentPage }` / `PagedData<MarketOverviewLocationOptionDTO>` | `GetMarketOverviewLocationOptionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/options/stores/search` | `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Create, CrossBrand)` | `GetMarketOverviewStoreOptionsRequest` (same fields) / `PagedData<MarketOverviewStoreOptionDTO>` | `GetMarketOverviewStoreOptionsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Brand scope uses the Create action; `ResolveRequestedBrands` throws `BrandIDs: You don't have access to the following brand(s): ...` for any named brand outside it; omitted = all brands in scope.
  - Create handler keeps only payload rows whose `BrandID` is in the Create scope; if none remain it throws `Market Overview: We're sorry, but we can't create market overviews ...`; rows for other brands are dropped silently when at least one is valid (`CreateMarketOverviewsRequestHandler`).
  - Create stamps `BrokerageOrganizationID`, trims `Comment` (empty string when blank), sets audit fields and bulk-inserts.
  - Web sends `dcid: values.dcid ?? null` explicitly (DC optional since CS-1299).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Store options read `CRM.Stores`, while every Market Overview reader resolves `StoreID` against `DataHub.StoreListEntries` (CS-1693); unless the ids coincide, a store picked here shows no store name in the grid, report and exports (see questions). An out-of-scope id in the option filters returns an empty 200.
- **Tests:** Backend `.../Broker.Application.Test/MarketOverview/{GetMarketOverviewLocationOptionsRequestTests,GetMarketOverviewStoreOptionsRequestTests}.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/AddMarketOverview.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/broker-dashboard/marketOverviewLocation.helpers.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `onFinish` writes `launchDate` from `values.dateTime` (the presentation date), not from the Launch Date field (`AddMarketOverview.tsx`).
  - The backend does not validate that `RegionID`, `RetailerID`, `BannerID`, `SKUID` exist or belong together; a bad id is inserted and then hidden by the readers' `INNER JOIN`s.
  - Legacy cascade hooks `useGetRetailersByRegions`, `useGetBannerByRetailer`, `useStores` are imported but never called by `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/AddOrEditCategoryReview.tsx`; kept as dead code.
  - `console.log` calls remain in `onFinish`.

##### 2.9.1.3 Sub-feature: Remove logs

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Bulk-deletes the selected rows after `DeleteComponent` confirmation.
- **Business rules:** SQL `DELETE ... WHERE ID = ANY(@IDs) AND <MarketOverviewScope.Condition>` with Delete-action brands; message reports zero, one or many.

##### 2.9.1.4 Sub-feature: Cascading filter panel

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The Filter drawer (`MarketOverviwesReportFilter`, shared with 2.9.2) shows nine facets (Brands, Retailers, Banners, Stores, Regions, DCs, SKUs, Statuses, Created By) plus text, date, launch-date, store-count and yes/no filters. Each facet is its own query to `POST marketoverviews/filters` with `propertyName`.
- **User flow:** Opening the drawer fires nine facet requests (`useGetMarketOverviewsFilterField`), each narrowed by the other selections; a value that vanishes from its own facet stays selected and is shown with ` (not in current results)` (`mergeSelectedOptions`); Reset clears everything, remounts the search box and returns to page 1.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.web/src/components/broker-dashboard/MarketOverviwesReportFilter.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/market-overview.ts` (`useGetMarketOverviewsFilter`, `useGetMarketOverviewsFilterField`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewFiltersRequest.cs`.
- **Data:** `GetMarketOverviewFiltersRequest` (filter base + `PropertyName?`) / `MarketOverviewFilterOptionsResult` (`Brands`, `Retailers`, `Banners`, `Stores`, `Regions`, `Dcs`, `SKUs` (JSON `skUs`), `Statuses`, `CreatedBy`, each `List<FilterModel { Label, Value }>`).
- **Business rules:**
  - Server self-excludes: each facet's query drops its own field (`PickListExcludeFields`); the client must not strip it again.
  - With `PropertyName` set, only that list is filled and the rest stay empty; an unknown name is a 400 `PropertyName: Unrecognized filter property.` (web logs it with `console.error`).
  - `Statuses` labels are the enum names (`NotActive`), values the integers as strings; the web converts back to numbers (`toNumericOptions`).
  - Same range validators as the list.
- **Tests:** Backend `GetMarketOverviewFiltersRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/MarketOverviwesReportFilter.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `useMarketOverviewFacetOptions` in `hooks/market-overview.ts` has no caller.

##### 2.9.1.5 Sub-feature: Market Overview CSV export

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Downloads the brokerage's logs as `Market Overview.csv` from the grid (and `Market Overviews Report.csv` from 2.9.2) with three scopes: All data (no filters, `pageSize: -1`), Filtered data (filters, `-1`; disabled when nothing is filtered), Current page (filters, grid page size and page).
- **Code map:** `MarketOverviewTable.handleExport`, `MarketOverviewService.exportMarketOverview` (raw `fetchWithMock`, `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: text/csv`, hand-set `authorization`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/ExportMarketOverviewRequest.cs`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** `POST /api/v1/marketoverviews/report/export`, `RequireModule(null, market-overview, Export, CrossBrand)`, `ExportMarketOverviewRequest` (filter base + `PageSize`, `CurrentPage`, `SortingOrder`) / CSV stream (`FileExportDTO`, name `Market Overview Report`, columns from `MarketOverviewExportDTO`: Brand, Retailer, Banner, Region, Store, DC, Number of Stores, SKU, SKU Status, Date, Comment (HTML tags stripped by `regexp_replace`), Training, Case Stack, Launch Date, Created By).
- **Business rules:** Scope comes only from `PageSize` (-1 = all); ordering is always brand name ASC; `SortingOrder` is accepted and ignored.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A non-OK response shows "Export failed"; the button is disabled when `totalCount === 0` or a range is invalid.
- **Tests:** Backend `ExportMarketOverviewRequestTests.cs`; web `marketOverview.helpers.test.ts`, `marketOverview.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** "Current page" exports page N in brand-name order while the grid's page N is in the grid's sort order (default `RegionName`), so the file can hold different rows than the screen.

##### 2.9.1.6 Sub-feature: CRM banner SKU status sync

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Creating or editing a log copies the logged SKU status (and Active date or Discontinued date) into `CRM.BannerSKUs` for the (brand, banner, product), creating the banner SKU when missing.
- **Code map:** `SharedDataService.PushMarketOverviewChangesIntoCRM` (create) and `PushMarketOverviewUpdatesIntoCRM` (update) in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataService.cs`; `SyncMarketOverviewWithCRM` (bulk resync, called by the admin data cleanup).
- **Business rules:** An existing banner SKU that is Active or Discontinued is never changed. Otherwise a status only moves "forward": Approved is not overwritten by Commit or Pending, Commit not by Pending, and so on; Active sets `ActiveDate = DateTime`, Discontinued sets `DiscoDate = DateTime`, other statuses clear both dates.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The create path takes brand, banner, status and date from `marketOverviews[0]` only and applies them to every product in the batch, so a batch spanning several banners or brands updates only the first banner (the web form always sends one brand and one banner per submit, so only a direct API call hits this) (`PushMarketOverviewChangesIntoCRM`). Deleting a log never reverts the banner SKU.

#### 2.9.2 Feature: Broker Market Overview report

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A read-only, paginated report over the same brokerage-scoped logs as 2.9.1, always ordered by brand name, with a pinned Comment column and the same filter drawer and export scopes. Used by Brokerage members with `market-overview` View (Export for the download).
- **User flow:**
  1. Broker opens Management > Market Overview > Report (`/market-overview-report`, gated on `market-overview`).
  2. Grid loads `POST marketoverviews/report` with the debounced filter body and page (`buildMarketOverviewReportBody`); there is no sort UI.
  3. Search box, Filter drawer (2.9.1.4) and Items-per-page footer (`showPageSizeSelector`) drive the request; inverted ranges withhold it.
  4. "View comment" opens a 640px modal with `MarketOverviewLogSummary` and a read-only editor.

#### 2.9.3 Feature: Brand Market Overview report ("Broker Market Activities")

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Lets a brand see the Market Overview logs that brokers recorded for it, grouped by (retailer, banner, region, store, DC) with an expandable child table of individual logs, plus a CSV export. A Brand company sees every brokerage's rows for its brand; a Brokerage viewing a connected brand sees only its own rows (`ViewerBrokerageId`). Gated on the brand module `broker-market-activities` (a brokerage is checked on that brand slug for the brand in the `BrandID` header).
- **User flow:**
  1. Brand user opens Reports hub > "Broker Market Activities" (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/report/page.tsx`) or `/{brandID}/brand-market-overview-report` (route gated on `broker-market-activities` by `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`).
  2. Page loads parent groups with `pageSize` from the URL or `-1` (all groups, no pager rendered), sort key from `marketOverviewReportParentSortKeys` (default `RetailerName`).
  3. `TableToolbar` offers sort and facet filters built from one unfiltered `filters/for-brand` call (regions, retailers, banners, stores, SKUs, DCs, statuses, created by); selections are added to the parent body.
  4. Expanding a group fetches `report/child-props` for that group (page 10, child sort keys), with the parent filters plus the group's retailer, banner, region, store and DC ids.
  5. Export (`ActionButtons`) posts the current filters to `report/export/for-brand` ("all" = `pageSize: -1`, otherwise current page) and saves `Market Overview.csv`.
- **Code map:**

|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/brand-market-overview-report/page.tsx` | Page, filter state, toolbar, export |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/brand-market-overview-report/MarketOverviewReportTable.tsx` | PrimeReact parent rows with disclosure, `ExpandedTemplate` child table, comment modal |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/promotional-management.ts` | `useGetMarketOverviewsParent`, `useGetMarketOverviewsChild`, `useGetMarketOverviewsFilterForBrand` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/market-overview.service.ts` | `getMarketOverviewsParent`, `getMarketOverviewsChild`, `getMarketOverviewsFilterForBrand`, `exportMarketOverviewBrand` (all send `BrandID` from the route param) |
| `caboodle.web/src/sort-keys/market-overview.ts` | Parent and child sort keys |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewReportRequest.cs` | Parent groups |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewReportChildPropsRequest.cs` | Child rows |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/GetMarketOverviewFiltersForBrandRequest.cs` | Facets |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/MarketOverview/ExportMarketOverviewReportForBrandRequest.cs` | CSV |

- **Data:** `MarketOverviewReportParentPropertyDTO` (`RetailerID/Name`, `BannerID/Name`, `RegionID/Name`, `StoreID?/StoreName`, `DCID?/DistributionCenter`, `NumberOfStores` = 1 when the group has a store, else banner `DoorCount`). `MarketOverviewReportChildPropertyDTO` (`DateTime`, `Comment`, `ProductID`, `ProductName`, `SkuStatus`, `LaunchDate`, `Training`, `CaseStack`, `CreatedBy`). Export `MarketOverviewReportExportDTO` (status as text, HTML stripped from comment, header "Presentation Date"). Web `MarketOverviewParent`, `MarketOverviewChild`, `IMarketOverviewFilterOptions`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/report/parent-props` | `RequireModule(broker-market-activities, null, View)`, `BrandID` header | body `GetMarketOverviewReportPayload { Retailers, Banners, Regions, Stores, SKUs, Dcs, Statuses, FromDate, ToDate, CreatedBy, IsCaseStack, IsTraining }`; query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `PagedData<MarketOverviewReportParentPropertyDTO>` | `GetMarketOverviewReportRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/report/child-props` | same | same body and query / `PagedData<MarketOverviewReportChildPropertyDTO>` | `GetMarketOverviewReportChildPropsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/filters/for-brand` | `RequireModule(broker-market-activities, null, View)`, `BrandID` header | `GetMarketOverviewFiltersForBrandRequest` (filter base + `PropertyName?`) / `MarketOverviewFilterOptionsResult` | `GetMarketOverviewFiltersForBrandRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/marketoverviews/report/export/for-brand` | `RequireModule(broker-market-activities, null, Export)`, `BrandID` header | same body and query / CSV `Market Overview Report` | `ExportMarketOverviewReportForBrandRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Brand from `GetActiveBrandIdAsync` (header required; a foreign or invalid `BrandID` is refused by `BrandRefusal`); rows `mo.BrandID = @BrandID AND (@ViewerBrokerageId IS NULL OR mo.BrokerageOrganizationID = @ViewerBrokerageId)`.
  - Parent and export sort keys are validated against `QueryHelper.MarketOverviewReportParentColumns`, child against `MarketOverviewReportChildColumns`; an unknown key falls back to the first entry; sorting order is validated to ASC/DESC.
  - Parent groups by `(RetailerID, BannerID, RegionID, StoreID, DCID)`.
  - Facets self-exclude as in 2.9.1.4.
- **Dependencies:** IAM (brand slug fallback for brokerages), CRM, DataHub `StoreListEntries`, Product Specs, PrimeReact `DataTable`, `TableToolbar`, `ActionButtons`.
- **Errors & edge cases:**
  - Expanding a group whose store or DC is null sends `stores: []` / `dcs: []`, which the child query reads as "no filter", so the child table lists logs of every store and DC of that retailer, banner and region (`MarketOverviewReportTable.ExpandedTemplate`).
  - The facet call sends an empty body, so facet lists do not narrow as filters are picked.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/MarketOverview/{MarketOverviewForBrandRequestsTests,GetMarketOverviewFiltersForBrandRequestTests}.cs`. Web: none found for this page.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `DateTime` is offered as a parent sort key (web `marketOverviewReportParentSortKeys`, backend `MarketOverviewReportParentColumns`) but the grouped query does not select or group by it; `ORDER BY "DateTime"` on the grouped query is expected to fail in PostgreSQL (not verified at runtime).
  - Parent, child and export build filter SQL by string-joining typed values (`IN ('guid', ...)`, inline dates and booleans) rather than parameters; not injectable because the values are typed, but date formatting depends on server culture.
  - Export ignores the grouped view: one CSV row per log, `SELECT DISTINCT`.
  - The export button is not gated on `broker-market-activities` Export in the UI (`ActionButtons` defaults `showExport` to true); the server refuses instead.
  - `useGetMarketOverviewsChild` and `useGetMarketOverviewsFilterForBrand` run without a session check (commented `enabled`).

#### 2.9.4 Feature: Distributor APL

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A broker-maintained authorized product list per distribution center: which UPC a DC carries, under which distributor item code, at which wholesale case and unit cost. The grid joins each row to the product (brand, description, category, case pack, size, UOM) by UPC and to the DC's region. Brokerage members with the broker module `distributor-apl` (View, Create, Update, Delete, Import, Export) see and change only rows whose UPC belongs to a product of a brand in their scope; a Brand company is refused at the policy.
- **User flow:**
  1. Broker opens Strategy > Distributor APL (`/distributor-apl`, gated on `distributor-apl`); dashboard tile "Distributor APL" links here.
  2. Grid loads `POST brokers/apl/list` with a debounced body built from the drawer (`buildDistributorAplFilterRequest`); there is no column sort (server orders by warehouse).
  3. Filter drawer (`DistributorAPLFilter`) shows five facets (Regions, Brands, Categories, UPCs, DCs) and four Min/Max ranges (case pack, size, wholesale case cost, wholesale unit cost) from one `POST brokers/apl/filter-options` call, plus a search box; an inverted Min/Max withholds the list and filter requests with an inline message.
  4. Toolbar (each gated on `anyBrandCan(distributor-apl, action)`): Remove (Popconfirm, selection), Export (three scopes), Upload (CSV import modal with sample download), Add, Filter. Row action: Edit.
  5. Add/Edit modal (`DistributorAPLAddOrEdit`) loads DCs and the caller's products from `GET brokers/apl-property-values`, resolves the DC id from the picked warehouse + region, and posts `POST brokers/apl` (with `id` on edit).
- **Code map:**

|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/distributor-apl/page.tsx` | Route shell |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor-apl/DistributorAPLTable.tsx` | Grid, toolbar, export, delete, upload modal |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor-apl/DistributorAPLFilter.tsx` | Drawer (uses `.cb-filter-drawer` geometry, `SearchField bigHeight`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor-apl/DistributorAPLAddOrEdit.tsx` | Add/Edit form |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/distributor-apl/distributorApl.helpers.ts` | Body builders, facets, export scopes, range checks, cost formatting |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/reports.ts` | `useGetDistributorAPL`, `useGetDistributorAPLFilterOptions`, `useGetDistributorAPLPropertyValues`, `useSetDistributorAPL`, `useDeleteDistributorAPL`, `useGetFileForDistributorAPL` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/report.service.ts` | `getDistributorAPL`, `getDistributorAPLFilterOptions`, `getDistributorAPLPropertyValues`, `setDistributorAPL`, `deleteDistributorAPL`, `exportDistributorAPL` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/sampleFile.service.ts` | `getSampleFileForDistributorAPL` (same export route with `isSampleFile: true`) |

- **Data:** `Broker.DistributorAPLs` (module). `APLDTO`: `ID`, `DCID`, `Warehouse`, `RegionID`, `RegionName`, `DistributorItemCode`, `UPCNumber`, `ProductDescription`, `BrandID`, `BrandName`, `CategoryID?`, `CategoryName?`, `CasePack`, `Size?`, `UOM?`, `WholesaleCaseCost`, `WholesaleUnitCost`. Joins (`AplFilterConditionBuilder.Joins`): `CRM.DistributorDcs` and `CRM.Regions` (inner), `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications` on `UPCNumber` (inner), `Brand.Brands` (inner), `ProductSpecs.Categories` (left).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/list` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` | `GetDistributorAPLsRequest` (`IAplFilter`: `DCs`, `Brands`, `Categories`, `Regions`, `UPCs`, `Query`, `Warehouse`, `DistributorItemCode`, Min/Max `CasePack`, `Size`, `WholesaleCaseCost`, `WholesaleUnitCost`; `PageSize`, `CurrentPage`, `SortingOrder`) / `PagedData<APLDTO>` | `GetDistributorAPLsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/filter-options` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.4.3 | `GetAplFilterOptionsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/apl-property-values` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` | none / `APLPropertyValuesDTO { DCData: [{DCID, Warehouse, RegionName}], Products: [{Product, UPC}] }` | `GetDistributorAPLPropertyValuesRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` plus in-handler `DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)` | see 2.9.4.2 | `UpsertDistributorAPLRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brokers/apl` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, Delete, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.4.2 | `DeleteDistributorAPLRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/import` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, Import, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.4.1 | `ImportDistributorAPLRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/export` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` plus in-handler Export (or Import for the sample) | see 2.9.4.3 | `ExportDistributorAPLsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Brand reach: `AplBrandScope.GetBrandIdsAsync` = `BrandsInScope(distributor-apl, action)`; every query adds `b."ID" = ANY(@AssignedBrandIds)` through the UPC-to-product join (`AplFilterConditionBuilder.BuildCondition`).
  - List ordering is fixed to `dc."Warehouse" ASC`; `SortingOrder` is normalised but unused.
  - Text filters (`Query`, `Warehouse`, `DistributorItemCode`) are `ILIKE %value%`; `Query` searches warehouse, item code, UPC, product name, brand and category.
  - No validator rejects inverted ranges here (they return zero rows), which is why the web withholds the request (`getDistributorAplRangeErrors`).
  - No `BrandID` header on any call.
- **Dependencies:** CRM DCs and regions, Product Specs (UPC is the join key), IAM, `UploadComponent`/`BulkUploader`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** A UPC shared by products of several brands produces one row per matching product. The table has no brand or brokerage column, so rows are shared across brokerages: a broker with a brand owning the UPC can edit or delete a row another brokerage also relies on.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/APL/{GetDistributorAPLsRequestTests,AplBrandScopeTests,AplFilterConditionBuilderTests,GetDistributorAPLPropertyValuesRequestTests}.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/DistributorAPLTable.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/DistributorAPLFilter.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/distributorApl.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/distributorApl.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `GET apl-property-values` returns every DC in the system (not scoped); only the product list is scoped.
  - The policy attributes on `POST apl` and `POST apl/export` say View; the real Create/Update/Export/Import checks are in the handlers (`DemandModuleAsync`), so reading the controller alone understates the requirement.
  - Distributor APL web code lives in `report.service.ts` / `hooks/reports.ts`, not in `apl.service.ts` / `hooks/apl.ts` (those serve the brand Retail Reports).

##### 2.9.4.1 Sub-feature: CSV import

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Uploads a CSV (`[*] Warehouse`, `[*] Distributor Item Code`, `[*] Product` (UPC), `[*] Wholesale Case Cost`, `[*] Wholesale Unit Cost`) that inserts new (DC, UPC) rows and updates existing ones; failures come back as a downloadable CSV.
- **User flow:** Upload > modal (`UploadComponent` with `showUploadStatus`, so progress and the result box render in the modal) > optional "sample" download (`POST apl/export` with `isSampleFile: true`, an empty CSV with the import headers) > upload to `POST brokers/apl/import` > list and filter options invalidated.
- **APIs/interfaces:** `POST /api/v1/brokers/apl/import`, multipart `file` / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO { Success, Message, File }` (failed-records CSV "Distributor APL Failed Records", rows `APLFailedRecordDTO` with `[Row = n] message`).
- **Business rules (per row, `ImportDistributorAPLRequestHandler`):** warehouse required and matched case-insensitively to `CRM.DistributorDcs.Warehouse`; UPC required, leading zeros and hyphens stripped for the lookup, and must belong to a product of a brand in the Import scope ("Product not found with given UPC"); item code required; costs required, `$` and `,` stripped, must parse and be > 0. Existing (DC, UPC) row is updated, otherwise inserted; a later duplicate in the same file replaces the earlier one. Bulk insert and bulk update at the end.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `Success` is false when any row failed; valid rows are still saved.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/APL/ImportDistributorAPLRequestHandlerTests.cs` (21 cases).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The stored UPC and the existing-row match use the raw cell text, while the scope check uses the normalised UPC, so `0012345` and `12345` can create two rows for one product. The handler loads the whole `DistributorAPLs` table into memory.

##### 2.9.4.2 Sub-feature: Add, edit and remove rows

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Single-row upsert from the modal and bulk soft-delete from the toolbar.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl` | View on the attribute; Create (no `ID`) or Update (`ID`) demanded in the handler | `UpsertDistributorAPLRequest { ID?, DCID, DistributorItemCode, UPCNumber, WholesaleCaseCost, WholesaleUnitCost }` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `UpsertDistributorAPLRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/brokers/apl` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, Delete, CrossBrand)` | `DeleteDistributorAPLRequest { IDs }` (web sends `iDs` in axios `data`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteDistributorAPLRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Upsert validates the DC and UPC exist (`GetDistributionCenterAsync`, `GetProductByUPCAsync`) and that the UPC belongs to a brand in scope (404 "Product not found with the given UPC" otherwise); an edit of a row whose current UPC is outside scope answers 404. Delete is a soft delete (`Deleted`, `DeletedBy`, `DeletedOn`) limited to rows whose UPC belongs to the caller's Delete-scope brands; other ids are skipped and the message says how many were removed.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/APL/DistributorAplWriteRequestsTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** No uniqueness check on (DC, UPC) in the upsert path; the import path is the only one that de-duplicates.

##### 2.9.4.3 Sub-feature: Filter options and CSV export

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** One call returns every facet and range narrowed by the other filters; export downloads `Distributor APL.csv` with three scopes (All data = no filters and `pageSize: -1`; Filtered data = filters and `-1`, disabled when nothing is filtered; Current page = filters with the grid page).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/filter-options` | `RequireModule(null, distributor-apl, View, CrossBrand)` | `GetAplFilterOptionsRequest` (`IAplFilter` + `PropertyName?`) / `AplFilterOptionsResult { Brands, Categories, DCs, Regions, UPCs: FilterModel[]; CasePack, Size, WholesaleCaseCost, WholesaleUnitCost: {Min, Max} }` (JSON `dCs`, `upCs`) | `GetAplFilterOptionsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/apl/export` | View on the attribute; Export (or Import when `IsSampleFile`) in the handler | `ExportDistributorAPLsRequest` (`IAplFilter` + `IsSampleFile`, `PageSize`, `CurrentPage`, `SortingOrder`) / CSV (`ExportAPLDTO` columns: Distribution Center Name, Distributor Item Code, Region Name, Unit UPC, Brand Name, Product Description, Category, Case Pack, Size, UOM, Wholesale Case Cost, Wholesale Unit Cost) | `ExportDistributorAPLsRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Facets self-exclude (`PickListExcludeFields`, `RangeExcludeFields`); an unknown `PropertyName` is a 400; `UPCs` facet value is the UPC and label the product name. Export pins `pageSize: -1` for the unpaged scopes (`EXPORT_ALL_ROWS_PAGE_SIZE`); `isSampleFile` must travel in the body.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Export reads JSON error bodies and shows the server message (`saveExportResponse` in `DistributorAPLTable.tsx`); the export button is disabled when `totalCount === 0` or a range is invalid.
- **Tests:** Backend `.../APL/{GetAplFilterOptionsRequestTests,ExportDistributorAPLsRequestTests}.cs`.

#### 2.9.5 Feature: Broker Retail APL ("Brand Retail Item Status")

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A cross-brand read of `CRM.BannerSKUs` for every brand the brokerage member can use: which item each brand has at which retailer and banner, with its status, UPC and category. Searchable, filterable by brand, retailer, banner, product, category and status, sortable on seven columns, exportable as a background CSV job. Display name is "Brand Retail Item Status"; every route, module slug, endpoint and code identifier stays `retail-apl`. Used by Brokerage members with the broker module `retail-apl` (View, Export); a Brand company is refused at the policy.
- **User flow:**
  1. Broker opens Strategy > Brand Retail Item Status (`/retail-apl`, gated on `retail-apl`) or the dashboard tile.
  2. Grid loads `POST brokers/retail-apl` with the filter body (every key always sent, `[]` when unselected, `buildRetailAplFilterBody`) and paging/sort in the query (default `RetailerName` ASC).
  3. `SearchField` (placeholder "Search brand retail items") sets `searchKeyword`; drawer `SelectFilterGroup` loads one facet per `POST brokers/retail-apl/filter-options` call with `propertyName` (Brand, Retailer, Banner, Product, Category, Status); `FilterComponent` strips the requested facet's own key from the body.
  4. Headers sort through `SortingOrderTitle` (`BrandName`, `RetailerName`, `BannerName`, `UPCNumber`, `CategoryName`, `ProductName`, `Status`); page size via the footer.
  5. Export (green, gated on `anyBrandCan(retail-apl, export)`) offers All data / Filtered data / Current page; it starts a job, polls status every 2500 ms, shows progress in `ExportStatusUI`, offers Cancel, and links the S3 download when done (2.9.5.1).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/retail-apl/page.tsx` | Route shell |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/retail-apl/RetailAplTable.tsx` | Grid, toolbar, filter drawer, export UI |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/retail-apl/retailApl.helpers.ts` | Body builders, export scopes and params, row identity and keys, error reader |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/retail-apl/useRetailAplExport.ts` | Start, poll, cancel, `beforeunload` guard |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/retailApl.ts` | `useGetRetailApls`, `useGetRetailAplFilterData` |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/retailApl.service.ts` | `getRetailApls`, `startRetailAplExport`, `getRetailAplExportStatus`, `cancelRetailAplExport`, `getRetailAplFilterOptions` |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/retailApl.interface.ts` | `RetailAplSortKey`, `RetailAplFilterProperty` (closed unions), `IRetailApl`, `IRetailAplResponse`, `IRetailAplExportJobStatus` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Reports/RetailApl/GetRetailAplRequest.cs` | List and export start |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/Payload/RetailAplPayload.cs` | Body contract |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Broker/Modules.Broker.Application/DTOs/RetailAplDTO.cs` | Row, response, filter option DTOs |

- **Data:** Source `CRM.BannerSKUs` joined to `Brand.Brands`, `CRM.Banners`, `CRM.Retailers`, `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications` (same brand) and `LEFT JOIN ProductSpecs.Categories`. `RetailAplDTO`: `BrandID`, `BrandName`, `RetailerName`, `BannerName`, `ProductName`, `Status` (`SkuStatus`), `UPCNumber`, `CategoryName?` (no retailer, banner or product id). `RetailAplListResponseDTO` = `PagedData<RetailAplDTO>` + `JobId?`, `ModuleType?`, `Message?`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl` | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, View, CrossBrand)`; with `export: true` the handler demands Export | body `RetailAplPayload { Brands, Retailers, Banners, Products, Categories, Status (int[]), SearchKeyword, Export }`; query `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` / `RetailAplListResponseDTO` | `GetRetailAplRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/filter-options` | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, View, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.5.2 | `GetRetailAplFilterOptionsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/export/{jobId}/status` | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, Export, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.5.1 | `GetRetailAplExportJobStatusRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/export/{jobId}/cancel` | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, Export, CrossBrand)` | see 2.9.5.1 | `CancelRetailAplExportJobRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Brands = `BrandsInScope(retail-apl, View or Export)` intersected with the requested `Brands` (empty = all in scope; `Guid.Empty` ignored). No accessible brand returns an empty page (and, for export, `Message: "No accessible Retail APL records to export."` with a null `JobId`).
  - `sortKey` empty becomes `RetailerName` in the controller; a non-empty unknown key falls back to `BrandName` (`ValidateSortKey` returns the first column); `RetailerName` also sorts by `BannerName` second.
  - `SearchKeyword` (trimmed, `%..%` `ILIKE`) searches product, retailer, banner, UPC, category and brand names.
  - No `BrandID` header is sent or read.
- **Dependencies:** CRM banner SKUs (the same rows Market Overview writes and the brand Retail Reports read), IAM, DataHub export jobs, Hangfire, S3 (`IFileStorageService`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** Rows carry no unique id, so the web builds a composite display identity and disambiguates repeats with `row-N` keys (`buildRetailAplRowIdentity`, `buildRetailAplRowKeys`); duplicate keys previously left stale rows mounted.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/Reports/GetRetailAplRequestTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/RetailAplTable.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/RetailAplTableRows.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/retailApl.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/retailApl.service.test.ts`. Gap: no test for `useRetailAplExport`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `caboodle.backend/docs/Broker-Retail-APL-FE.md` still says the scope is "brands linked via `BrandBrokers`"; the code uses the access context's `retail-apl` grants (CS-1770). The module slug `retail-apl` was introduced by CS-1770 (commit `bae3ef25`); before that the screen borrowed `distributor-apl` (comment in `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts`).

##### 2.9.5.1 Sub-feature: Background CSV export job

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `export: true` on the list body queues a Hangfire job that writes a CSV to S3; the client polls status and downloads from a signed URL.
- **User flow:** Pick scope > `POST retail-apl` with `export: true` (All data drops filters, both unpaged scopes send `pageSize: -1`, Current page sends the grid page and sort; `buildRetailAplExportBody`, `buildRetailAplExportParams`) > response carries `jobId` and `moduleType: 34` > poll `GET .../status` every 2500 ms > Done shows the download link; Done with no URL means zero rows; Cancel posts `.../cancel` then re-polls.
- **Data:** `DataHub.ExportJobs` row with `BrandID = Guid.Empty`, `ModuleType = RetailAplExport (34)`, `RequestJson` = `RetailAplExportFilterDto` (resolved `BrandIds`, filters, `PageSize` default -1, `CurrentPage`, validated `SortKey`/`SortingOrder`), `Status` Pending > Running > Done/Failed/Cancelled, `TotalRows`, `RowsExported`, `S3Key`, `FileName`, `FileSize`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/export/{jobId}/status` | `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, Export, CrossBrand)` | route `jobId` / `ExportJobStatusDto` (`JobId`, `ModuleType`, `Status`, `TotalRows`, `RowsExported`, `FileName`, `FileSize`, `ErrorMessage`, `StartedOn`, `CompletedOn`, `DownloadUrl` when Done) | `GetRetailAplExportJobStatusRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/export/{jobId}/cancel` | same | route `jobId` / `ResponseMetaDTO` "Export job cancelled." | `CancelRetailAplExportJobRequestHandler` |

  - Job: `IJobService.Enqueue<IExportJobService>(ExecuteExportAsync(jobId, Guid.Empty, userId, RetailAplExport))` > `ExportJobService.ExecuteRetailAplExportAsync` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs`). Full export streams batches of 10,000 by keyset on `bs."ID"` (ordered by row id, not by the grid sort); page export runs one ordered page. S3 object `exports/retail-apl/Brand_Retail_Item_Status_Export_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv`; zero rows completes as `Brand_Retail_Item_Status_Export_Empty.csv` with an empty key. CSV columns from `RetailAplExportDTO` (Brand Name, Retailer Name, Banner Name, Product Name, UPC Number, Category, Status as the enum name).
- **Business rules:** Status and cancel answer 404 for an unknown job, a deleted job, a job of another module type, or another user's job (`ExportJobOwnership.DemandOwnJobAsync`; platform admin exempt). Cancel only changes Pending or Running jobs.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Any exception marks the job Failed with the message. The web treats 403 and 404 on status as terminal.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/Reports/RetailAplExportJobRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Export/ExportJobServiceRetailAplExportTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Cancel only flips the database status; the running job never re-reads it, so it keeps exporting and `Complete()` overwrites `Cancelled` with `Done`. The whole CSV is built in a `MemoryStream` before upload. The web copy for 403 ("limited to whoever started it") never shows because the backend answers 404 for someone else's job.

##### 2.9.5.2 Sub-feature: Filter options

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** One facet per call for the drawer's six selects.
- **APIs/interfaces:** `POST /api/v1/brokers/retail-apl/filter-options`, `RequireModule(null, retail-apl, View, CrossBrand)`, `GetRetailAplFilterOptionsRequest` (`RetailAplPayload` + required `PropertyName` in `Brand|Retailer|Banner|Product|Category|Status`) / `List<RetailAplFilterOptionDTO { Label, Value }>`.
- **Business rules:** Empty `PropertyName` is a validator 400 "Invalid Filter Property!"; an unlisted name is a 400 "Filter property name not found". Values come from one `STRING_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(...))` query, de-duplicated by value and sorted by label; Status labels use the enum `Description` ("Not Active"). `SearchKeyword` is not applied. The server does not exclude the requested facet's own selection; the web removes it before sending.
- **Tests:** Backend class `GetRetailAplFilterOptionsRequestTests` inside `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Broker.Application.Test/Reports/GetRetailAplRequestTests.cs`.

#### 2.9.6 Feature: Brand Retail Reports (Brand APL) and APL activities

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The brand's own view of its retail item status: every banner SKU of the brand (retailer, banner, product, category, status, UPC) in an infinite, virtualised list with cascading filters and CSV export, plus an Activities tab listing CRM banner activities (retailer, banner, date, notes) with a date and retailer/banner filter and CSV export. Used by Brand companies, and by a Brokerage on a connected brand, with the brand module `retail-reports` (View, Export); `BrandID` header required.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens Reports hub > "Retail Reports" or `/{brandID}/retail-report` (gated on `retail-reports`); deep links add `?productID=` (product detail page, brand dashboard `CategoryProductStatusReport`) or `?status=`, which pre-select and lock that facet.
  2. Products tab (default; `?tab=Products|Activities` kept in the URL): pages of 50 (`APL_REPORT_PAGE_SIZE`) load from `POST brands/apl` as the user scrolls the virtual body (`useInfiniteAplReports`); rows are flattened and de-duplicated by display identity (`flattenAplReportPages`).
  3. Filter drawer (`SelectFilterGroup`) shows Retailer, Banner, Product, Category, Status from ONE `POST brands/apl/filter-options` call (CS-1510); a change restarts the list at page 1 and scrolls to the top.
  4. Export offers All data, Filtered data (disabled without filters) and Loaded rows (the N rows scrolled so far, sent as one page of size N); the file is `APL Report.csv`.
  5. Activities tab (2.9.6.2).

- **Business rules:**
  - Brand from `GetActiveBrandIdAsync`; no brokerage-ownership filter (banner SKUs belong to the brand).
  - Sort keys `RetailerName` (default, secondary `BannerName`), `BannerName`, `ProductName`, `CategoryName`, `Status`, `UPCNumber`; unknown falls back to `RetailerName`; order validated.
  - `SearchKeyword` (backend) searches product, retailer, banner, UPC and category; the web never sends it (no search box on this screen). The web also sends no `sortKey` (only `sortingOrder`, `APlService.getAllAplReports`), so the list is always retailer then banner.
  - Filter options self-exclude per facet and always return all five; Status labels use the enum description.
  - The web pages by `allPages.length + 1`, stops on `hasNextPage` false or an empty page, and guards concurrent fetches with a ref (`getNextAplReportPageParam`, `isFetchingPageRef`).
- **Dependencies:** CRM banner SKUs and banners/retailers, Product Specs, IAM (brand slug; brokerages fall back to the brand slug for a connected brand), antd virtual `Table` via `TableWithHeaderAction` (`virtual`, `onScroll`, `footer`, `listItemHeight`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** The endpoint's default ordering is not a total order, so rows near a page boundary can repeat; the web drops repeats and the "N duplicates hidden" footer note is off (`SHOW_DUPLICATE_NOTICE = false`, `AplReport.tsx`), so the loaded count can sit below `meta.totalCount`.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Brand.Application.Test/Requests/Reports/APL/{GetAplRequestTests,GetFilterOptionsRequestTests}.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Brand.Application.Test/Requests/Reports/RetailReportsActiveBrandTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/Apl/AplReport.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/Apl/aplReport.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/ReportsHubPage.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `GET apl-total-count` is fetched on both tabs but every badge that rendered it is commented out (`AplReport.tsx`, `AplActivityTable.tsx`), so it is a wasted request.
  - Export and drawer controls are not gated on `retail-reports` Export in the UI; the server refuses instead.
  - `isReportFilterSelected` / `onResetReportFilter` in `AplReport.tsx` read and write `filter` while the drawer writes `searchFilter`, so they do nothing useful (recorded in web `CLAUDE.md`).
  - `useGetAplReports` and `useGetAplActivities` use copy-pasted cache keys (`getBrandUsers`, `getBrokerSubUser`), sharing namespaces with unrelated queries.

#### 2.9.7 Feature: Broker landing dashboard tiles

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** The brokerage home page (`/dashboard` in the `(broker)` group): a grid of destination cards for Market Overview, Promotional Management, Category Review, Brand Report, Distributor APL, Brand Retail Item Status and Files, each hidden unless the session has the module. No backend endpoint of its own; it reads `/me/access` through `useModuleAccess` / `useAccess`.
- **User flow:**
  1. A Brokerage member lands on `/dashboard` (root redirect in `caboodle.web/src/app/page.tsx`); the page shows the "Dashboard" title band.

  3. Tiles: Market Overview (`market-overview`), Promotional Management (`promotional-management`), Category Review (`category-review`, company level), Brand Report (`brand-report`), Distributor APL (`distributor-apl`), Brand Retail Item Status (`retail-apl`), Files (`files`, company level). Brand-scoped tiles use `hasModule` (off a brand route: the action on any brand); company-level tiles use `hasCompanyModule`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/dashboard/page.tsx` | Tile list and hide rules |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/DashboardComponent.tsx` | Loading, setup-pending and brokerage-only rendering; `DashBoardType` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/DestinationCard.tsx` | `DestinationCard`, `DestinationGrid` |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/moduleAccess.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/access.ts` | Access reads |

#### 2.10.1 Feature: Chunked async import engine

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Uploads a large CSV in pieces to S3 multipart storage, tracks it as an `ImportJob`, runs the import in a Hangfire background job, and lets the client poll progress, counts, an outcome and an error-file link. Used by KeHE (2.10.2), UNFI (2.10.3), SPINS Stores Insight (2.10.5) and the Distributor Sales Report file (2.10.6); Monthly Report actuals, Store List and Category Review reuse the same `ImportJobService` from other modules. Access is the provider's module `Import` action.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens the upload modal and picks a `.csv` file (client rejects other extensions: `useChunkedImport.startUpload`).
  2. Client slices the file into 5 MB pieces (`DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE`) and posts chunk 1 with `fileName`, `chunkIndex=1`, `chunkMax`, `fileSize` (whole file, first piece only) and the raw bytes as body.
  3. Server creates the `ImportJob` (status 7 Uploading) on the first piece and returns `jobId`, `uploadId`, `key`, `etags`; later pieces send them back.
  4. Each failed piece is retried up to 3 times with 1 s, 2 s backoff on network or 5xx errors (`uploadChunkWithRetry`).
  5. On the last piece the server completes the S3 object, checks its real size, sets status 5 Pending and (KeHE, UNFI, SPINS) enqueues `IImportJobService.ExecuteImportAsync`; the Distributor Sales flow instead calls a separate start endpoint (2.10.6.1).
  6. Client polls the status endpoint every 2 s (every 4 s while status 10 Processing) until a terminal status (15, 17, 20, 25).
  7. On 15 or 17 the hook raises a green "Import completed" toast (unless `suppressCompletionNotification`) and calls `onCompleted` with a result snapshot; on 20 or 25 it raises an error toast.
  8. The modal shows upload and processing bars, row counts, and a "Download error file" link when `errorFileUrl` is present and `failedRows > 0` (`ChunkedImportUpload.tsx`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Requests/KeHE/ImportExport/UploadChunkForKeHEImportRequest.cs` | Reference chunk handler (UNFI, SPINS and DSR copies differ only in S3 prefix, `ModuleType` and enqueue step) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/DTOs/ImportJobDtos.cs` | `ImportChunkUploadDto`, `ImportJobStatusDto` (computed `StatusText`, `ProgressPercent`, `Outcome`) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Services/IImportJobService.cs` | Background job contract |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Import/ImportJobService.cs` | `ExecuteImportAsync` dispatch, per-provider runners, `GenerateAndUploadErrorFileAsync`, `FailIfStoreCleanupRunningAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Domain/Import/ImportJob.cs` | Job entity and state transitions (`MarkUploadComplete`, `Start`, `Complete`, `Fail`, `UpdateProgress`) |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/chunked-import.service.ts` | `ChunkedImportService.uploadChunk`, `getImportStatus`, `startDistributorReportImport`; `PROVIDER_BASE_PATH` |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useChunkedImport.ts` | Slicing, retries, polling, outcome, toasts, `hasChunkedImportFailures` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/ChunkedImportUpload.tsx` | Upload modal body for KeHE, UNFI, SPINS Stores Insight |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/BulkUploader.tsx` | File picker shell used with `customUploadHandler` + `statusContent` |

- **Data:** `ImportJob` (see module models). S3 objects: uploaded file under `imports/kehe/{brandId}/`, `imports/unfi/...`, `imports/spins...`, `imports/distributor-report/{brandId}/`; error CSV under `imports/errors/{brandId}/{Prefix}_Import_Errors_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv` (`ImportJobService.ErrorFileBucketPath`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** endpoints are listed under each provider (2.10.2, 2.10.3, 2.10.5, 2.10.6). Common contract:

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/{kehe,unfi}/import/chunk`, `/api/v1/spins/import-stores-insight/chunk`, `/api/v1/distributorsalesreports/import/chunk` | `RequireModule({slug}, null, Import)`, `DisableRequestSizeLimit`, `BrandIDHeader` | Query: `fileName`, `chunkIndex`, `chunkMax`, `uploadId?`, `prevETags?`, `key?`, `jobId?`, `fileSize?`; body: raw bytes / `ImportChunkUploadDto` (`jobId`, `uploadId`, `key`, `eTags`, `isCompleted`, `status`, `message`) | `UploadChunkFor*RequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/{kehe,unfi}/import/{jobId}/status`, `/api/v1/spins/import-stores-insight/{jobId}/status`, `/api/v1/distributorsalesreports/import/{jobId}/status` | `RequireModule({slug}, null, Import)` | `ImportJobStatusDto` (`status`, `statusText`, `totalRows`, `processedRows`, `successRows`, `failedRows`, `skippedRows`, `progressPercent`, `outcome`, `errorFileUrl`, `errorMessage`) | `Get*ImportJobStatusRequestHandler` |

  Background job: `IImportJobService.ExecuteImportAsync(jobId, brandId, userId, moduleType)` via `IJobService.Enqueue` (Hangfire).
- **Business rules:**
  - Chunk validators (`UploadChunkFor*ImportRequestValidator`: `.csv` extension, `chunkIndex >= 1`, `chunkMax >= 1`, `chunkIndex <= chunkMax`) do not run: validation is MVC auto-validation of bound parameters only (`AddFluentValidation()` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Program.cs`, no MediatR validation behavior found), and the controllers build these requests by hand. `DataUploadSizeGuard.ReadPieceAsync` says so in a comment and re-checks `fileSize >= 0`. The `.csv` rule is enforced only by the web client.
  - A new job starts only when `chunkIndex == 1` and no `jobId`; a later piece must name a job of the same brand and `ModuleType`, else 404; neither case is a 400 "Invalid request".
  - Outcome (`ImportJobStatusDto.Outcome`): `null` while Pending/Uploading/Processing/Cancelled; Failed if status 20 or 0 success with failures; Success if 0 failures (including 0/0); PartialSuccess otherwise. `ImportJob.Complete` sets 17 PartiallyDone whenever `failedRows > 0`, so 17 can mean "every row failed".
  - `errorFileUrl` is a presigned URL returned only when `FailedRows > 0` and an error file exists.
  - Status endpoints 404 a job of another brand or module type (`GetKeHEImportJobStatusRequestHandler`).
  - KeHE and UNFI runners fail the job with `StoreCleanupSyncGuard.CleanupRunningMessage` when a store clean-up is running (`FailIfStoreCleanupRunningAsync`); SPINS does not check.
- **Dependencies:** S3 (`IFileStorageService.UploadChunkAsync`, `GetObjectByKey`, `DownloadAsync`, `UploadStreamAsync`, `GetFileUrl`), Hangfire, CsvHelper, `IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync` (BrandID header, brand required), module setting 2.10.1.1.
- **Errors & edge cases:**
  - Runner exceptions are caught and stored as `ErrorMessage` via `ErrorMessageHelper.ExtractPlainMessage`; the Hangfire job itself does not fail, so Hangfire default retries do not apply in practice.
  - S3 download failure fails the job with "Failed to download file from S3".
  - `useChunkedImport.getErrorMessage` reads ProblemDetails (`detail`, `title`, `errors`) and this API's `{ error: { messages } }` envelope, else "Something went wrong.".
  - The hook's success toast fires for 17 PartiallyDone too (statusText "PartiallyDone"), even when no row was imported; consumers that care read `outcome`.
- **Tests:** backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/ImportJobs/ImportChunkRequestTests.cs`, `.../ImportJobs/ImportJobStatusRequestTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/DTOs/ImportJobStatusDtoOutcomeTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Import/ImportJobServiceCleanupGuardTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/useChunkedImport.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/chunkedImport.fileSize.service.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/BulkUploader.test.tsx`. Gap: no test for `ChunkedImportUpload.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `IImportJobService.GetImportJobStatusAsync` and `CancelImportJobAsync` have no caller (grep of `Modules` and `Hosts`); each provider has its own copy of the status mapping and there is no cancel endpoint.
  - UNFI and SPINS status handlers do not copy `SkippedRows` (`GetUNFIImportJobStatusRequestHandler`, `GetSPINSStoresInsightImportJobStatusRequestHandler`).
  - `ModuleType` names reuse "Export" for imports (`KeHEExport`, `UNFIExport`, `SPINSExport`).
  - The four chunk handlers are near copies; a fix must be applied to each.

##### 2.10.1.1 Sub-feature: Brand data upload size limit

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Enforces the brand setting "Largest data upload" (`data-upload-reporting` / `max-file-size-mb`, default no limit, 1 to 2048 MB) on KeHE, UNFI, SPINS and Distributor Sales uploads.
- **Business rules:** Checked three times (`DataUploadSizeGuard`): the declared `fileSize` and the first piece before any job or object exists; a running total on `ImportJob.FileSize` per piece; the real S3 object size on the last piece (object deleted, job failed). A refusal is a 400 keyed `File` with "Each KeHE, UNFI, SPINS or Distributor Sales file can be up to N MB." (`DataUploadSizeLimit.Message`). With no limit set, pieces are streamed without buffering. SPINS Item Ranking single-shot import checks `file.Length` via `DemandSizeAsync` (`ImportSPINSItemsRankingRecordsRequestHandler`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Helper/DataUploadSizeGuard.cs` | `ReadPieceAsync`, `CountPieceAsync`, `DemandUploadedSizeAsync`, `DemandSizeAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Helper/DataUploadSizeLimit.cs` | Reads the module setting, message |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/chunked-import.service.ts` | Sends `fileSize` only with chunk 1 |

- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Helper/LargestUploadSetting.cs` (fixture) used by `ImportChunkRequestTests.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/chunkedImport.fileSize.service.test.ts`.

#### 2.10.2 Feature: KeHE data and reports

- **Status:** Active (raw records list and the sync exports are Partial, see sub-features)
- **What it does:** Lets a brand upload KeHE monthly sales CSVs and view KPI cards, charts and nine report grids built from the raw `KeHeRecords` table, filtered by DC, retailer, product, state, city, category, sub-category, store and date range. Brand route `/{brandID}/kehe`, module slug `kehe` (`View`, `Import`, `Delete`; `Export` through the async export job). Brand companies and brokerages with the module on that brand (brokerage falls back to the brand slug, `AccessContext.AudienceRefusal`).
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens Reports hub, "Data Upload Reporting", KeHE (or `/{brandID}/kehe`); `ModuleRouteGuard` checks slug `kehe`.
  2. Page loads Total Sales Dollars / Total Cases cards, a sales chart and DC chart, then sections: DC Cases Sold, Sales Report (by month), Sales by Product, Chain (retailer), Store, Details, State, City, Warehouse, Velocity, Store Void.
  3. Filter drawer: cascading multi-selects (`SelectFilterGroup` over `POST kehe/filter-data`, each facet excludes its own selection client-side) plus From/To date pickers; every report re-queries with the filter.
  4. "Upload KeHE" opens the chunked upload (2.10.2.1) with a sample-file link (`GET kehe/format`).
  5. "Export KeHE" and per-section Export buttons start an async export job (2.10.7); a status strip shows progress and a download link.
  6. "Remove" opens a confirmation and deletes KeHE rows matching the current filter (2.10.2.3), then invalidates all queries.
  7. Store Void report fetches only when at least one category is selected (`useGetKeHEStoreVoidReport` `enabled`).
