- **Business rules:**
  - Brand is `IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync` (BrandID header, must be accessible) for every `RequireModule` handler; legacy import and sync exports use `ICurrentUser.GetBrandID()` (raw header) instead.
  - `filter-data` property allowlist (case-insensitive): `Dc`, `RetailerName`, `ProductDescription`, `CustomerStateCode`, `CustomerCity`, `ProductCategory`, `ProductSubCategory`, `CustomerName`; anything else is a 400 "Filter property name not found" (`GetKeheFilterOptionsRequestHandler`).
  - Velocity divides per-store totals by a week count summed over the distinct month numbers in the data (31-day months 4.43, 30-day 4.29, February 4) (`GetVelocityPerStoreReportRequestHandler.CalculateTotalWeeks`).
- **Dependencies:** 2.10.1 import engine, 2.10.7 async export, 2.14 DataHub mapping and store clean-up guard.
- **Errors & edge cases:** a filter value with a single quote is escaped by `ReplaceSingleQuote` before being inlined into SQL; an empty filter on DELETE deletes every KeHE row of the brand.
- **Tests:** no backend tests target KeHE handlers by name except `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Import/ImportJobServiceKeHeSkipTests.cs` and `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Helpers/KeHeQuantityRuleTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs` covers active-brand resolution across handlers (not verified per handler). Web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/exportFilters.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/SelectFilterGroupOptions.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/FilterComponent.test.tsx`. Gap: no test for `KeheComponent` or its report sections.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Reports read raw `KeHeRecords`, not `KeHeMapped`; retailer/store names on screen are the file's raw text, while the Distributor Sales Report (2.10.6) shows mapped names for the same upload.
  - KeHE/UNFI/SPINS filters are string-built SQL with quote escaping (`QueryHelper`, `DeleteKeHeRecordsRequest.GetSearchCondition`), unlike the parameterized DSR filters.
  - No action-level gating in the web page: Upload, Export and Remove buttons render for anyone who can open the route (`KeheComponent.tsx` has no `useModuleAccess` call); the server refuses missing actions.
  - Many `console.log` calls in `KeheComponent.tsx` (date pickers, invalidate).

##### 2.10.2.1 Sub-feature: KeHE chunked import

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** `UploadChunkForKeHEImportRequest` stores the file under `imports/kehe/{brandId}/` and enqueues `ExecuteImportAsync(..., ModuleType.KeHEExport)`; `ImportJobService.ExecuteKeHEImportAsync` parses `KeHEImportDTO` rows, groups them by month, and per month creates a `DataSyncRun` (`Trigger = Manual`), deletes that brand-month's KeHE raw, mapped, unmapped and DSR rows (`SharedDataHubService.DeleteSyncDataAsync`), then inserts through `SaveKeHeWithUnmappedHandlingAsync`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Rows whose Current Year QTY is blank, zero or negative (accounting `(5)` and `$0.00` read as numbers) are skipped before type checks and counted in `SkippedRows`, never in the error file (`KeHeQuantityRule.ShouldSkip`).
  - Missing UPC fails the row ("UPC not found"); type checks (`ValidateKeHERecord`): Current/Prior Year QTY Int32, YoY % Double, Current/Prior Year Cost Float, Month DateTime, Product Size Float; message format `[Row = n] Column: Invalid Type. Expected: T` (row = index + 2).
  - Re-uploading a month replaces that month for the brand (delete then insert). A row with an unparseable month falls into a sentinel month (`SentinelMonth`, year 2000) group.
  - Fails immediately when a store clean-up is running (2.10.1).
- **Code map:** `UploadChunkForKeHEImportRequest.cs` (path in 2.10.1); `caboodle.web/src/components/data-upload/kehe/KeheComponent.tsx` mounts `<ChunkedImportUpload provider="kehe">` with `getSample` from `useGetSampleFileForKeHe` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/sampleFilesHook.ts`, `GET kehe/format`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Import/ImportJobServiceKeHeSkipTests.cs`.

##### 2.10.2.2 Sub-feature: KeHE legacy single-shot import

- **Status:** Partial (no web caller: the web uses only the chunk route; `caboodle.web/src/service/dataUpload.service.ts` has no POST to `/kehe`)
- **What it does:** `POST /api/v1/kehe` (platform-admin permission) parses the whole file and bulk-inserts valid rows into `KeHeRecords` only; returns failed rows as a CSV in `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** inserts raw rows only, so no mapped, unmapped or DSR rows and no month replacement (`ImportKeHERequestHandler`); the `SaveBannerSKUs` call is commented out; `Message` is "KeHE Data uploaded successfully" only when there ARE invalid rows (inverted condition).

##### 2.10.2.3 Sub-feature: KeHE delete

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** "Remove" sends `DELETE /api/v1/kehe` with the drawer filter as query string and a body `{ iDs, isAllDelete }` (`DataUploadService.deleteKeheData`). The handler hard-deletes from `KeHeRecords` where `BrandID` matches and the bound filters match.
- **Business rules:** only `dcs`, `retailers`, `products`, `cities`, `states`, `months`, `years` are bound (`DeleteKeHeRecordsRequest`); the body is ignored.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - The drawer's category, sub-category, store and date filters are not part of the delete, so Remove can delete more rows than the screen shows; with only those filters set it deletes every KeHE row of the brand.
  - The confirmation text says "remove all the items" (`DeleteComponent` with `allDelete`), but the request carries filters.
  - Only raw `KeHeRecords` are deleted; `KeHeMapped`, unmapped and `DistributorSalesRecords` rows from the same upload remain, so the Distributor Sales Report still shows them.

##### 2.10.2.4 Sub-feature: KeHE raw records list

- **Status:** Partial (backend `GET /api/v1/kehe` works; the web table `KeheRowTableData` is commented out in `KeheComponent.tsx`)

##### 2.10.2.5 Sub-feature: KeHE synchronous exports

- **Status:** Partial (endpoints exist; `DataUploadService.exportKehe` and `exportKeheReport` have no caller; the screen uses the async job, 2.10.7)
- **What it does:** `GET /kehe/export` (raw rows CSV) and `POST /kehe/export-report` (one report as CSV by `KeHEReportType`) under platform-admin permission `MustHavePermission(Export, MasterDataUpload, DataUpload)`, so a brand user receives 403.

- **What it does:** Same shape as KeHE for UNFI sales files: upload, KPI cards, charts and report grids over the raw `UnfiRecords` table, filtered by warehouse, chain, store, state, city, category, product and date range. Route `/{brandID}/unfi`, module slug `unfi` (`View`, `Import`, `Delete`; `Export` via 2.10.7).

  4. "Upload UNFI" opens `<ChunkedImportUpload provider="unfi">` with sample `GET unfi/format`.

#### 2.10.4 Feature: SPINS Item Ranking

- **Status:** Active (export is wired to the wrong dataset, see Gotchas)
- **What it does:** Brand uploads SPINS Item Ranking CSVs (period rows per UPC and geography/channel) and views a time-periods (monthly) table, an Item Ranking report, a Brand Ranking report and charts, with list filters and numeric range filters (ARP, Dollars, Units, % changes). Routes `/{brandID}/spins` (landing with two tiles) and `/{brandID}/spins/item-ranking-report`; module slug `spins` (catalog child `item-ranking-report` exists but the API checks only `spins`).
- **User flow:**
  1. `/{brandID}/spins` shows two tiles, Item Ranking Report and Stores Insight Report; each report page carries an antd card tab bar that `router.replace`s between the two routes.
  2. Item Ranking page loads the time-periods table (`GET spins/time-periods-report`), Item Ranking and Brand Ranking grids (sortable, paged), numeric filter bounds (`GET spins/items-ranking-numeric-filters-data?report=`).
  3. Filter drawer uses `POST spins/items-ranking-filter-data` facets plus range sliders (`RangeComponent.tsx`).
  4. "Upload" opens `UploadComponent` (single request to `POST spins/import-items-ranking`, sample `GET spins/format/true`); the response's failed-rows CSV can be downloaded (`isErrorFileExportable`).
  5. "Delete" deletes rows matching current filters (`DELETE spins/items-ranking`).
  6. "Export" starts the async SPINS export (2.10.7).

| GET | `/item-ranking-report` | `RequireModule(spins, null, View)` | same + `sortKey` (required), paging / `ItemRankingReportDTO` | `GetItemRankingReportRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/brand-ranking-report` | `RequireModule(spins, null, View)` | same + `sortKey`, paging / `BrandRankingReportDTO` | `GetBrandRankingReportRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/items-ranking-filter-data` | `RequireModule(spins, null, View)` | `GetItemsRankingFiltersRequest` (`propertyName` + selections) / `IList<FilterDataModel>` | `GetItemsRankingFiltersRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/items-ranking-numeric-filters-data` | `RequireModule(spins, null, View)` | `report` (`ItemsRankingReports` 1 Monthly, 2 Item, 3 Brand) / `IList<MinMaxFilterDTO>` | `GetMinMaxFilterValuesRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:**
  - Time Period must match `N Week(s) Ending mm/dd/yy` ("End" is rewritten to "Ending" first); else the row fails with "Invalid Time Period Format. Expected Format : '# Week End mm/dd/yy'" (`ExtractValues`). Empty Time Period fails "Time Period is empty".
  - Type checks: Rank, Rank Yago Int32; Dollars, % changes, Units, ARP, SPM, Promo, SPP Double; Dol Shr and Max % ACV Float; the first failing column is reported.
  - Filter facet allowlist: `TimePeriod`, `UPC`, `GeographyChannel`, `Channel`, `SubCategory`, `Brand`, `Description`, `Year`, `Month`, `Week`.
  - The file-size limit applies (`DemandSizeAsync` with `file.Length`, 2.10.1.1).
- **Dependencies:** 2.10.7 export, 2.10.1.1 size limit.
- **Errors & edge cases:** the import is synchronous inside the HTTP request; a valid file is inserted in full while invalid rows are returned as a CSV.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/SPINS/ImportSPINSItemsRankingRecordsRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/BulkUploader.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/bulkUploader.helpers.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Export uses `ExportModuleTypeEnum.SPINS` (21) with `reportType: "ItemRanking"` (`SpinsItemRankingReportComponent.handleExport`), but `ExportJobService.ExecuteSPINSExportAsync` always exports `SPINSStoresInsight` and `SPINSExportFilterDto` has no Item Ranking fields, so the Item Ranking "Export" downloads Stores Insight rows.
  - Imports append: re-uploading the same file duplicates rows; there is no per-period replacement.
  - The SPINS landing tiles carry wrong `title` attributes ("Market Overview", "Category Review") in `spins/page.tsx`.
  - `console.log(searchFilter)` on every render of `SpinsItemRankingReportComponent.tsx`; the upload `invalidate` callback body is commented out, so reports do not refresh after an upload.

#### 2.10.5 Feature: SPINS Stores Insight

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Brand uploads SPINS store-level weekly files (large, chunked) and views a void report per banner and product, a banner weekly unit sales table, and a bump chart, with cascading filters. Route `/{brandID}/spins/stores-insight-report`, slug `spins`.
- **User flow:**
  1. Open the Stores Insight tab; filters drawer uses `POST spins/stores-insight-filter-data`.
  2. Void report: user picks a banner; products for that banner load from `GET spins/banner/product?bannerName=` (hook `enabled` only with a banner); report from `POST spins/void-report`.

  5. "Delete" removes rows matching filters (`DELETE spins/stores-insight`); "Export" starts the async SPINS export (2.10.7).

#### 2.10.6 Feature: Distributor Sales Report

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Combined KeHE + UNFI sales reporting over the mapped `DistributorSalesRecords` table (one row per mapped sale line, with Store List link `StoreListEntryId`). Brand uploads a distributor file for a chosen month, year and provider; the screen shows totals, a monthly chart, DC chart and ten report grids, each with its own CSV export. Route `/{brandID}/distributor-sales-report`, slug `distributor-sales-report` (`View`, `Import`, `Export`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Page opens with the filter preset to the rolling 12 months (`getRolling12MonthsRange`: first day 11 months back to end of the current month).
  2. Cards (Total Sales Dollars Shipped, Total Cases Shipped), chart (`retail-sales-report` monthly totals + `dc-report`), then DC Cases Sold, Sales by Product, Chain, Store, Details, State, City, Warehouse, Velocity, Store Void.
  3. Filter drawer: Source (All, UNFI, KEHE) plus cascading facets from `DISTRIBUTOR_SALES_FILTER_PROPERTIES` (distribution center, retailer, banner, Stores by Store List ID, ...); each facet calls `POST distributorsalesreports/filter-data`.
  4. "Refresh" invalidates every query whose key starts with `get-distributor-sales-`.
  5. "Upload Distributor Report" opens the import form (2.10.6.1).
  6. Each section's Export button posts `export-report` with its `reportType` (1 to 9), `pageSize=-1`, and downloads `distributor-{label}-{YYYYMMDD}.csv` (`useExportDistributorSalesReport`).
  7. Store Void loads only after at least one category is chosen (`useGetDistributorSalesStoreVoidReport` `enabled`).

- **Business rules:**
  - All filters are parameterized `= ANY(@...)` fragments (`DistributorSalesRecordsQueryHelper.GetSearchCondition`); `storeIds` filters `StoreListEntryId`; dates compare `ReportDate` by day.
  - Store identity (store counts, Sales by Store lines, void report stores) is the Store List ID, else lower-cased trimmed customer name plus ZIP5; a row with no name is not a store (`StoreIdentitySql`).
  - Store filter options (`propertyName = StoreListEntryId`) list only Store List stores the brand's rows are linked to, labelled store name then address, city and state, sorted by label; rows not linked have no option.
  - `filter-data` allowlist: `Source`, `Banner`, `DistributionCenter`, `RetailerName`, `ProductDescription`, `City`, `State`, `Category`, `SubCategory`, `CustomerName`, `StoreListEntryId`, `Region`; the facet SQL includes the facet's own selection (the web drops it client-side via `excludeProperty`).

- **Dependencies:** 2.14 DataHub (Store List, mapping, store clean-up), 2.5 Product Specs (CasePack for cases), 2.10.1.
- **Errors & edge cases:**
  - `useExportDistributorSalesReport.onError` reads `json.error.messages[0]`, but `messages` is an object keyed by field, so the server's text is not shown (falls back to "Failed to export report").
  - Store Void returns every matching row with no paging (`GetStoreVoidReportRequestHandler`).
- **Tests:** backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/DistributorSalesRecords/**` (filter options, export by type, FilteredReports, SalesByStore, SalesDetails, StoreVoid, VelocityForPromotion, StoreCount), `.../DistributorSalesRecords/{ExportDistributorSalesReportByTypeRequestWarehouseReportTests,GetWarehouseReportRequestHandlerTests,WarehouseReportHelperTests}.cs`, `.../Helper/DistributorSalesRecordsQueryHelperTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/DataUpload/{ExportDistributorSalesReportByTypeRequestHandlerTests,GetDcReportRequestHandlerTests}.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/{DistributorSalesByStore,DistributorSalesDetails,DistributorSalesReportImport}.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/distributorSalesReport.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/distributorSalesReport.service.test.ts`. No controller-level test of `export-report` binding.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `DistributorSalesReportsController.ExportReportsAsync` copies `payload.Stores` but not `payload.StoreIds` into `ExportDistributorSalesReportByTypeRequest`, and the web sends only `storeIds` (`buildPayload`), so every CSV export ignores the Stores filter while the grid above it applies it.
  - Store-ID filtering and store counts (commit `3b3eb92c` CS-1718) exist on the working branch only; `origin/master` `PayloadHelper.cs` has no `StoreIds`.
  - No delete for DSR rows from this screen; KeHE/UNFI raw deletes (2.10.2.3, 2.10.3.2) leave DSR rows behind.
  - Week count uses distinct month numbers, so 12 months spanning two calendar years with repeated months (for example Jan 2025 and Jan 2026) count those weeks once.

##### 2.10.6.1 Sub-feature: Distributor report file upload

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Upload of a KeHE "Full POD Vendor Report" or UNFI "Sales Details" file for one month: chunk upload (`imports/distributor-report/{brandId}/`, `ModuleType.DistributorReportFileUpload`, not auto-queued), then `POST import/start` with month, year and provider queues `IImportJobService.ExecuteDistributorReportFileUploadAsync`.
- **User flow:** pick Provider (UNFI or KEHE), Month and Year (1900 to 2100; current year preselected), choose CSV, upload; when the last chunk completes the hook calls `startDistributorReportImport` (`onUploadComplete`), then polls status. The tab warns on page leave while active (`beforeunload`). On completion it invalidates the `get-distributor-sales-` queries. No sample file is offered.
- **Business rules:**
  - Start validator: `importJobId` required, year 1900 to 2100, provider KEHE or UNFI (`StartDistributorReportFileImportRequestValidator`); start refuses a job of another brand (403), wrong module type, still Uploading, not Pending, or without `S3Key` (400) (`StartDistributorReportFileImportRequestHandler`).
  - The runner computes a SHA-256 of the file, creates a `DataSyncRun` (`Trigger = FileUpload`, source file URL and hash), deletes the brand-month for that provider (raw, mapped, unmapped, DSR) and inserts through `SharedDataHubService` (`ExecuteDistributorReportKeHEFileAsync` / `ExecuteDistributorReportUNFIFileAsync`).
  - KeHE rows: zero-quantity rule (2.10.2.1), "UPC not found", type checks; UNFI rows: "Product/UPC is required" plus type checks.
  - `ExecuteImportAsync` refuses this module type ("must be started through the start-import API").
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Requests/DistributorSalesRecords/ImportExport/{UploadChunkForDistributorReportFileImportRequest,StartDistributorReportFileImportRequest,GetDistributorReportImportJobStatusRequest}.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/components/data-upload/distributor-sales-report/DistributorSalesReportImport.tsx`; `ChunkedImportService.startDistributorReportImport`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** `ExecuteDistributorReportFileUploadAsync` returns without failing the job when the provider is neither KEHE nor UNFI (unreachable through the validator); the start call sets status 10 before queuing.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/DistributorSalesReportImport.test.tsx`.

##### 2.10.6.2 Sub-feature: Velocity per store for promotion

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Supplies per-UPC units and dollars per store per week for one banner to the promotion product stepper (`caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(promo)/(trade-spend)/promo-create/product-stepper/BannerSKUs.tsx` via `useGetVelocityPerStoreForPromotion`).
- **Business rules:** resolves the banner's distributor through `CRM.DistributorBanners` for the brand (parent distributor name when present); source is KEHE if the name contains "kehe", UNFI if "unfi", otherwise an empty result; excludes rows whose customer name contains "confidential"; `PercentageOfSalesQuantity` is the UPC's share of the banner total. Access: approved-promotions or trade-spend-sandbox `View` (not the DSR module).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/DistributorSalesRecords/Reports/GetVelocityPerStoreReportForPromotionRequestTests.cs`.

##### 2.10.6.3 Sub-feature: Full DSR rebuild and product name sync

- **Status:** Active (triggered from DataHub endpoints, platform admin)
- **What it does:** `SyncDistributorSalesRecordsRequest` deletes every `DistributorSalesRecords` row (all brands) and rebuilds it from `KeHeMappedRecords` and `UNFIMappedRecords`, keeping only UPCs present in the brand's product specs and computing cases from product `CasePack` (fallback UNFI feed `Pack`). `SyncMappedProductNameAndCategoryRequest` refreshes mapped product names and categories. Both live in this module (`Requests/Report Sync/`) but are exposed as `POST /api/v1/datahub/report-sync/distributor-sales-records` and `POST /api/v1/datahub/report-sync/product-name-category` with `MustHavePermission(Upsert, EntityResolution, DataHub)` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataHub/DataHubController.cs`), owned by 2.14.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** loads all mapped rows of all brands into memory (`ListAsync`) and uses the first record's brand for the CasePack lookup (`brandId` from `keHeRecords.FirstOrDefault()`), so CasePack resolution is correct only for that one brand. It rounds cases to whole numbers, while the upload path (`SaveKeHeWithUnmappedHandlingAsync`) rounds to 2 decimals, so a rebuild changes `CasesShipped` values.

#### 2.10.7 Feature: Async export jobs for data uploads

- **Status:** Active (DSR module type 27 has no web caller; SPINS type 21 always exports Stores Insight)
- **What it does:** Queues a background CSV export of a brand's raw rows (KeHE 19, UNFI 20, SPINS 21, Distributor Sales 27; Monthly Report 26 shares the endpoint, see 2.11), stores the file on S3 and returns a presigned download link through polling. Used by the KeHE, UNFI and SPINS pages' Export buttons. Access: the module's `Export` action for the active brand.
- **User flow:**
  1. User clicks Export; the page builds a filter object (`buildKeheExportFilters` / `buildUnfiExportFilters` / `buildSpinsExportFilters`) and calls `useExportJob.start(moduleType, filtersJson)`.
  2. `POST /api/v1/export/start` returns `jobId`; the hook polls `GET /api/v1/export/{jobId}/status` every 2.5 s until 15, 20 or 25.
  3. `ExportStatusUI` shows progress (`rowsExported` / `totalRows`), then a download link (`downloadUrl`) or the error; Export buttons are disabled while a job runs (`isRunning`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|

| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Application/Export/Helpers/BrandExportModules.cs` | Module type to slug map: 19 kehe, 20 unfi, 21 spins, 26 monthly-report, 27 distributor-sales-report |

| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs` | `ExecuteKeHEExportAsync`, `ExecuteUNFIExportAsync`, `ExecuteSPINSExportAsync`, `ExecuteDistributorSalesReportExportAsync` (keyset batches of 10000 by `ID`) |

| `caboodle.web/src/helper/exportFilters.ts` | Filter JSON builders (PascalCase keys) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/shared-components/ExportStatusUI.tsx` | Progress and download UI |

- **Data:** `ExportJob` rows; S3 `exports/{brandId}/{KeHE|UNFI|SPINS_StoresInsight|...}_Export_{yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}.csv`; a zero-row export completes with an `*_Export_Empty.csv` name and no file.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/export/start` | `Authorize`, `BrandIDHeader`; handler `DemandModuleAsync(slugFor(moduleType), null, Export)` | `StartExportRequest` (`moduleType`, `filtersJson`) / `ExportJobInitiatedDto` (`jobId`, `moduleType`, `message`) | `StartExportRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/export/{jobId}/status` | `Authorize`, `BrandIDHeader`; handler checks brand, supported type and module `Export` | / `ExportJobStatusDto` (`status`, `statusText`, `totalRows`, `rowsExported`, `progressPercent`, `fileName`, `fileSize`, `downloadUrl`, `errorMessage`) | `GetExportJobStatusRequestHandler` |

  Background job: `IExportJobService.ExecuteExportAsync(jobId, brandId, userId, moduleType)` (Hangfire).
- **Business rules:** unsupported module types are a 400 listing supported types; status 404s a job of another brand or of a type not in `BrandExportModules`; the export reads raw `KeHeRecords`, `UnfiRecords`, `SPINSStoresInsight` or `DistributorSalesRecords` with the filter DTO.
- **Dependencies:** 2.14 DataHub (controller, `ExportJob` entity), S3, Hangfire.
- **Errors & edge cases:** a failed start or poll stops polling and shows `error`; `useExportJob` requires a token and brand id or it sets "Not authenticated or brand not selected.".
- **Tests:** web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/exportFilters.test.ts`. Gap: no test for `useExportJob` or the KeHE/UNFI/SPINS export executors (backend export tests found cover Brand Report and DSR report export only).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - KeHE and UNFI per-section Export buttons send `reportType`, `sortKey`, `pageSize`, `currentPage` (`handleExportReport`), but `KeHEExportFilterDto` / `UNFIExportFilterDto` have none of these, so every section downloads the same raw-rows CSV, not the section's report.
  - SPINS Item Ranking export returns Stores Insight data (2.10.4).
  - `buildDistributorSalesExportFilters` (module 27) has no caller; DSR exports use the synchronous `export-report` (2.10.6).
  - `useExportJob` has no unmount cleanup for its `setInterval` (no `useEffect` in `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useExportJob.ts`).
  - The whole CSV is built in a `MemoryStream` before upload, so memory grows with export size.

#### 2.10.8 Feature: Master data bulk import and export (admin)

- **Status:** Active (KeHE, UNFI and store master routes have no admin caller; two routes are commented out)
- **What it does:** Platform admins import CRM and product spec reference data from CSV (create or update by name/ID, failed rows returned as a CSV) and export the same entities as CSV from the admin CRM screens. All routes require platform-admin permissions `Import Data` / `Export Data` (`MustHavePermission(Import|Export, MasterDataUpload, DataUpload)`), which only the admin permission set contains (`CaboodlePermissions.Admin`; `Broker`/`SubBroker` sets include only `Broker` module permissions, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Authorization/CaboodlePermissions.cs`). No BrandID header; data spans all brands.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin opens a CRM screen (for example `/banners`), uses Upload (admin `UploadComponent` posting multipart `file` to `/api/v1/masterdataupload/{entity}`), optionally downloads a sample (`GET masterdataupload/sample-file?fileCategory=`).
  2. The response lists failures; a failed-rows CSV is offered.
  3. Export posts or gets the export route with the grid's filters and saves the CSV (`caboodle.admin/src/helper/helper.ts` shared CSV export helper).

#### 2.10.9 Feature: Data mappings (admin)

- **Status:** Active (admin page reachable by URL only; no runtime consumer of the mapping table, see Gotchas)
- **What it does:** Platform admins keep a table of external entity names (as written in a provider file) and the Caboodle entity each one maps to (`EntityID` within a `FileCategory`, optional `Provider`). The admin screen lists mapped and unmapped names, edits an unmapped name's target, removes rows, and imports/exports mappings as CSV. Permission `Data Mapping` (`MustHavePermission(Create, DataUpload, DataUpload)`), platform admin only.
- **User flow:**
  1. Admin opens `/upload-data-map` (no sidebar entry; `SELECTED_KEY_ALIASES` in `caboodle.admin/src/component/Layout/Sidebar/navConfig.tsx` highlights Mapped Data when there).
  2. A Mapped / Unmapped radio switches `isMapped`; the grid shows Caboodle System ID, Entity Name, Entity Module (`FileCategory`), Provider; filters by provider (0 = none) and module.
  3. Unmapped rows offer "Edit Entity" (`EditMappedData`: pick the target entity from the matching CRM list) and every row "Remove Entity" (soft delete).
  4. Upload asks for a file category (Retailer, Distributor, Banner, Region, SubDistributor: `FileCategoryForMappedData`) and optional provider, then posts the CSV to `datamappings/import`; a sample CSV is available.
  5. Export downloads the filtered list.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataUpload/DataMappingsController.cs` | 8 endpoints |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Requests/Mapping/**` | CRUD, filters, import, export, sample |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Domain/Mapping/DataMapping.cs` | Entity |
| `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/(crm)/upload-data-map/page.tsx` | Route |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/Tables/DataMapTable.tsx` | Grid, toggles, upload, export |
| `caboodle.admin/src/component/DataMapComponent/EditMappedData.tsx` | Edit form |
| `caboodle.admin/src/services/dataMap.service.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/dataMap.ts` | API and hooks |

- **Data:** `DataUpload.DataMappings` (`EntityName`, `EntityID` null = unmapped, `Provider`, `FileCategory`, soft delete).
- **APIs/interfaces:** (prefix `/api/v1/datamappings`, all `MustHavePermission(Create, DataUpload, DataUpload)`)

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `` (root) | as above | `isMapped`, `entityNames`, `providers`, `modules`, paging / `PagedData<DataMappingDTO>` | `GetDataMappingsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/{id}` | as above | / `DataMappingDTO` | `GetDataMappingRequestHandler` |
| POST | `` (root) | as above | `UpsertDataMappingRequest` (`id?`, `entityName`, `entityID?`, `provider?`, `fileCategory`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` (declared `DataMappingDTO`) | `UpsertDataMappingRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `` (root) | as above | `DeleteDataMappingsRequest` (`iDs`) / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteDataMappingsRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/import` | as above | multipart `file`, query `provider`, `fileCategory` / `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO` | `DataMappingsImportRequstHandler` |
| GET | `/export/sample-file` | as above | / CSV | `ExportDataMappingSampleFileRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/export` | as above | same filters as list / CSV | `ExportDataMappingsRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/filter-data` | as above | `isMapped` / `DataMappingFilterDTO` (entity names, file categories, providers incl. "N/A") | `GetDataMappingFiltersRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** entity name required and unique (case-insensitive) on upsert; `EntityID`, when sent, must exist in the table for its `FileCategory` (else 404); import rejects names already present ("Already exist in the system.") and entity IDs that do not exist; delete requires at least one id and is a soft delete (`DapperQueryBuilder.Delete`).
- **Dependencies:** CRM entity tables for ID validation; admin CRM hooks for the edit pickers.
- **Errors & edge cases:** list query sorts by `EntityName` only; an unknown sorting order falls back to ASC.
- **Tests:** none found (backend or admin).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - No import or report reads `DataMappings` today: the only writer outside this feature, `SharedDataService.SaveBannerSKUsDataFromProvider`, is reached only from the commented-out `SaveBannerSKUs` calls in `ImportKeHERequest` and `ImportUNFIRecordsRequest`; `GetMappingDataSpecification` has no caller. Name resolution for uploads now uses DataHub aliases (2.14).
  - List, filter and import SQL inline values with quote escaping (`GetDataMappingsRequest.GetQuery`).
  - `DeleteDataMappingsRequest` SQL inlines GUIDs and the user id (`DapperQueryBuilder.Delete`).

### 2.11 Module: Reports & Dashboards

- **Purpose:** Read-only analytics for a single brand: the Trade Spend Roll-Up (revenue and trade spend per banner and promotion), the Monthly Report (planned vs actual cases and revenue per month, with actuals import and export), the Sales Tracker (item status counts per banner by region), the Product Report (promo vs non-promo cases per month), the brand Reports hub and brand Dashboard landing page, plus the broker landing tiles. It also hosts every remaining `api/v1/reports/*` endpoint (brand Market Overview report, legacy retail report, sandbox forecast CSV).
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Report/ReportsController.cs` (11 actions, route `api/v{version}/reports`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Dashboard/DashboardController.cs` (2 actions, route `api/v{version}/dashboard`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/TradeSpend/TradeSpendsController.cs` region `Monthly Report` (13 actions, route `api/v{version}/tradespends/monthly-report*`). Route prefix comes from `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/VersionedApiController.cs` (`[Route("api/v{version:apiVersion}/[controller]")]`).
  - Backend modules: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/` (Report, MonthlyReport, DTOs, DTOBuilder, ImportExport), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Dashboard/Modules.Dashboard.Application/`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Application/MonthlyReport/`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpend/Modules.TradeSpend.Domain/MonthlyReport/BrandApprovedMonthlyReport.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/TradeSpendSandbox/Modules.TradeSpendSandbox.Domain/MonthlyReport/SandboxMonthlyReport.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Requests/MonthlyReport/`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/MonthlyReport/MonthlyReportRefreshJobService.cs`, monthly report branches of `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Import/ImportJobService.cs` and `.../Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs`, shared calculators in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/TradeSpendCalculation/`.
  - Web: routes `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/{banner-report,monthly-report,product-report,report,sales-tracker}/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/dashboard/*`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/dashboard/page.tsx`; components `caboodle.web/src/components/banner-report/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/monthly-report/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/product-reports/`, `caboodle.web/src/components/DashboardComponent.tsx`; service `caboodle.web/src/service/report.service.ts`; hooks `caboodle.web/src/hooks/reports.ts`; store `caboodle.web/src/store/monthlyReportFilterStore.ts`; script `caboodle.web/scripts/generateMonthlyReportUserFlowDoc.js`.
  - Admin: none found (grep of `caboodle.admin/src` for monthly report, backfill, roll-up, reports endpoints returned no callers).
- **Shared data models:**
  - Promotion source tables read by every trade spend calculation: Sandbox `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionalEvents` + `TradeSpendSandbox.Promotions` + `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionFamilies` (only the family's `ReportingVersionID` counts) and `TradeSpendSandbox.PromotionFees`; Brand Approved `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents` + `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromos` (Standard `EntryType` only) and `TradeSpend.BrandApprovedPromotionFees`. Joined to `CRM.Retailers`, `CRM.Banners`, `CRM.DistributorBanners`, `CRM.BannerSKUs`, `ProductSpecs.ProductSpecifications`, `ProductSpecs.Categories`, `ProductSpecs.PriceList` (see `GetQuery` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/Report/GetTradeSpendRollUpReportRequest.cs`).
  - Monthly report fact tables: `TradeSpend.BrandApprovedMonthlyReport` and `TradeSpendSandbox.SandboxMonthlyReport` (identical shape: `BrandID`, `Distributor`, `Retailer`, `Banner`, `Product` as names not ids, `Year`, `Type` = `MonthlyReportDependentType`, `Source` = `MonthlyReportSource` 1 Planned / 2 Actual, `January` to `December` decimals, `LastRefreshedAt`), mapped in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs`.
  - Calculation DTOs: `BannerReportResponseDTO`, `BannerReportPromoDTO`, `BannerReportDTO`, `CalculationPropertiesDTO` (`GrossRevenue`, `NetDollar`, `TPRSpend`, `AddFee`, `TPRAddFeePercentage`, get-only `TotalSpend = TPRSpend + AddFee`) and `RollUpReportForDashboardDTO` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/TradeSpendDTOs.cs`.
  - Enums in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/Enums.cs`: `MonthlyReportParentType` (1 Case, 2 Revenue, 3 SRP, 4 Lift), `MonthlyReportDependentType` (1 NonPromoCase to 9 RevenueTotal), `MonthlyReportSource`, `SkuStatus` (1 Active to 7 Commit), `ModuleType.MonthlyReportActualImportTradeSpend = 24`, `ModuleType.MonthlyReportExport = 26`.
- **Shared services:**
  - `TradeSpendCalculator`, `SKULifecycleCalculationHelper`, `MonthSelectionHelper` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/TradeSpendCalculation/` (case, revenue, spend formulas; SKU active/disco window; month slicing).
  - `PromotionCalculationEligibility.BuildCondition` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Helper/PromotionCalculationEligibility.cs`): appends `EntryType = Standard`, which excludes Simple Promotions from every Brand Approved calculation.
  - `IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync` / `DemandAnyModuleAsync` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/`), the brand scope for every handler.
  - Web: `useModuleAccess` / `ModuleGate` / `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES` (`caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts`), `HeaderWithBack`, `DestinationCard`, `ExportStatusUI`.
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - 2.6 Trade Promotion Planning (Sandbox and Brand Approved promotions, events, fees, versions): sole input of the roll-up, product report, forecast export and planned monthly rows.
  - 2.4 CRM (banners, banner SKUs, retailers, regions, distributor-banner links): joins and Sales Tracker counts.
  - 2.5 Product Specifications (products, categories, price list).
  - 2.10 Data Uploads (`DataUpload.DistributorSalesRecords` feeds monthly actuals on Refresh; chunked import pipeline and `ImportJob`).
  - 2.14 DataHub export jobs (`StartExportRequest`, `GET api/v1/export/{jobId}/status`).
  - 2.2 Organizations & Access Control (module slugs `trade-spend-roll-up`, `trade-spend-roll-up-report`, `monthly-report`, `sales-tracker`, `enhanced-reporting`, `banner-count-graph`, `reports`, `dashboard`; platform permission `MonthlyReportBackfill`).
  - 2.9 Market Overview & APL Reports (owns the screen that calls `reports/brand-market-overview*`).

#### 2.11.1 Feature: Trade Spend Roll-Up (banner report)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Computes, for one brand and one year, Gross Revenue, Net Dollars, TPR Spend, Ad/TPR Fees, Total Spend and fee percentage per promotion and banner, per banner, and in total, from either the Sandbox (reporting version of each family) or Brand Approved promotions. Users can untick banners or promotions to remove them from the figures and filter by creator and months. Used by Brand organizations (and brokerages on connected brands) holding module `trade-spend-roll-up` action View.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens `/{brandID}/banner-report` (from the Reports hub card "Trade Spend Roll Up" or the dashboard "Trade spend roll-up" card link). Route gated by `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES["banner-report"] = trade-spend-roll-up`.
  2. Filters hydrate from `sessionStorage` key `banner-report-filters:{brandID}` (Source, Created by, Year, Months); defaults are Brand Approved, current year, all months.
  3. The page fires two `POST reports/roll-up/{source}` calls: one with the deselected banners and promotions excluded (KPI row, pies, charts) and one without exclusions (tree table, so unticked rows stay visible).
  4. Source is a `Segmented` (Sandbox / Brand Approved); switching changes endpoint; loaders read `isFetching`.
  5. Tree table: banner rows with promotion child rows. Unticking a banner or promotion re-queries with that id in the exclusion list. A promotion row links to `/{brandID}/trade-spend-sandbox/{promotionID}` or `/{brandID}/promo-planning/{promotionID}`.
  6. "Reset filters (N)" clears Created by and Months and returns Year to the current year; Source is kept.
  7. Empty result: backend returns an empty `BannerReportResponseDTO`; KPI tiles show em-dashes for missing figures.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Report/ReportsController.cs` | `GetBannersReportAsync`, `GetBrandApprovedPromotionsRollUpReportAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/Report/GetTradeSpendRollUpReportRequest.cs` | Sandbox roll-up handler: event query, SKU lifecycle, promo and non-promo cases, fee allocation, aggregation |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/Report/GetBrandApprovedPromotionsRollUpReportRequest.cs` | Brand Approved copy of the same handler on `TradeSpend` tables (diff limited to tables, fee table and Standard-only filter) |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/TradeSpendCalculation/MonthSelectionHelper.cs` | Month filter applied after the full-year calculation |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/TradeSpendDTOs.cs` | Response DTOs, `TotalSpend` getter |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/banner-report/page.tsx` | Route, renders `BannerReportComponent` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/banner-report/BannerReportComponent.tsx` | Filters, sessionStorage persistence, two queries, layout |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/banner-report/BannerReportSelectedTable.tsx` | Tree table, checkbox deselection, composite row keys |

| `caboodle.web/src/components/banner-report/RollUpPromotionName.tsx`, `InfoHint.tsx` | Promotion name plus version pill; column info hints |

| `caboodle.web/src/models/genericModel.ts` | `IRollUpReportResponse`, `IRollUpPromotion`, `IRollUpBannerFigures`, `IRollUpCalculations` |

- **Data:** Reads only (Dapper). Event status kept: Active, Pending, RetailerApproved, Completed (`GetPromotionEvents`). Sandbox reads only the version referenced by `PromotionFamilies.ReportingVersionID`; `PromoName` = family name, `VersionName` = version name. Brand Approved: `PromoName` / `VersionName` columns of `TradeSpendPromos`, Standard entry type only.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/reports/roll-up/sandbox-promotions` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-roll-up, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | `GetTradeSpendRollUpReportRequest` (`Year?`, `PromoName?`, `BannerIDs[]?`, `PromotionIDs[]?`, `CreatedBy[]?`, `Months[]?` ints 1 to 12) / `BannerReportResponseDTO` (`BannerReportDTOs[]`, `PerBannerTotalCalculations[]`, `TotalReportCalculations`); web `IRollUpReportResponse` | `GetTradeSpendRollUpReportRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/reports/roll-up/brand-approved-promotions` | `RequireModule(trade-spend-roll-up, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | `GetBrandApprovedPromotionsRollUpReportRequest` (same fields) / `BannerReportResponseDTO` | `GetBrandApprovedPromotionsRollUpReportRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/tradespendssandbox/filter-properties` | owned by Trade Promotion Planning | Created by options for the filter bar (`createdBy`) | see owning module |

- **Business rules:**
  - `BannerIDs` and `PromotionIDs` are EXCLUSION lists (`e.BannerID NOT IN`, `pr.ID NOT IN` in `GetQuery`); the web sends the deselected rows there. `CreatedBy` is an inclusion list.
  - Year filter matches events whose start or end year equals `Year`.
  - Months are applied after the whole year is calculated (`MonthSelectionHelper`), because the promo case baseline uses whole-year non-promo weeks; multi-month events are prorated by day; EDLP periods are split by month.
  - SKU lifecycle: events are clipped to the banner SKU active date and the day before its disco date; out-of-range events are reported with zero revenue (`AdjustEventDatesForSKULifecycle`).
  - Promotion fees (lump sum, coupon, prime) are allocated per banner and SKU and folded into `AddFee` (`ComputeFeesPerBannerSku`, `AllocateLumpSum`, `AllocateCoupon`, `AllocatePrime`).
  - Banner `NetDollar` = promo revenue (with allowance) + non-promo revenue; `GrossRevenue` = promo revenue without allowance + non-promo revenue; `TPRAddFeePercentage` from `TradeSpendCalculator.GetAddFeePercentage`; `TotalSpend` = `TPRSpend + AddFee` (getter).
  - Web: `months` must be integers; empty array means whole year (`ReportService.getAllBannerReports`). Reset never changes Source.
- **Dependencies:** Trade Promotion Planning data (2.6), CRM banners and banner SKUs, Product Specs price list; web ECharts (`echarts-for-react`), antd `Table` tree rows, `sessionStorage`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** No events: empty DTO (all zeros, empty lists). Unknown Created by or excluded everything: empty DTO. A promotion deselected under one banner is removed from the whole report (exclusion is by promotion id, no banner dimension). Shared promotions under several banners use row key `banner:{bannerID}::promotion:{promotionID}` to avoid duplicate React keys.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Report.Application.Test/Report/GetTradeSpendRollUpReportRequestTests.cs`, `GetBrandApprovedPromotionsRollUpReportRequestTests.cs`, `RollUpReportCalculationPathTests.cs`, `RollUpReportMonthFilterTests.cs`, `RollUpReportPromotionFeeTests.cs`, `SimplePromotionExclusionTests.cs`, `MonthSelectionHelperTests.cs`, `ActiveBrandHandlersTests.cs`, `StagingCrossCheck/RollUpReportStagingCrossCheckTests.cs`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/banner-report/*` (component, selected table, rows, charts, pie, promotion name, helpers, filter bar styles) and `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/rollUpReport.service.test.ts`. Gap: no test for the exclusion (`NOT IN`) semantics end to end from the web.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Two near-identical ~1,570-line handlers (Sandbox and Brand Approved), plus a third copy for the dashboard (2.11.6.2) and a fourth in the forecast export (2.11.7.3); any formula fix must be applied to all.
  - GUID lists are interpolated into SQL text (`string.Join(", ", ids.Select(x => $"'{x}'"))`); safe only because the values are typed `Guid`.
  - Web query key `[getBannerReports, isSandbox, year, brandIds, promotionIDs, createdBy, months]` omits `brandID` (`useBannerReport` in `caboodle.web/src/hooks/reports.ts`), so a brand switch can show the previous brand's cached figures until the refetch lands.
  - Sandbox promotion links omit the `?family=` param; the roll-up DTO carries only the version id (`BannerReportPromoDTO.PromotionID`), so the Sandbox detail screen opens without its family versions.
  - The web body key is `bannerIds`; the C# property is `BannerIDs` (works through case-insensitive binding). `PromoName` exists on the request but the web never sends it.
  - `CalculationPropertiesDTO.TotalSpend` is a get-only property and should serialize; web code treats it as possibly absent (see questions).

##### 2.11.1.1 Sub-feature: Month filter

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Restricts the report to selected months without recalculating the year (slice after calculation).
- **Business rules:** `MonthSelectionHelper.BuildSelection` returns null for null or empty input (whole year). Unfiltered, monthly slices are merged back into whole events (`MergeEvents`); filtered, each selected slice is reported on its own (`SelectEventSlicesForMonths`). Non-promo revenue in a month with no event is still reported (`reportableKeys` union).
- **Tests:** `RollUpReportMonthFilterTests.cs`, `MonthSelectionHelperTests.cs`.

##### 2.11.1.2 Sub-feature: Banner and promotion deselection (tree table)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Checkbox column on banner and promotion rows; unticked ids are sent as exclusions on the first query only, so totals and charts drop them while the table keeps showing them.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.web/src/components/banner-report/BannerReportSelectedTable.tsx` (`rowKey`, `isPromotionRow`, expand column sizing), `BannerReportComponent.tsx` (`removeDeselectedBannersFromBannerReport`).
- **Tests:** `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/banner-report/BannerReportSelectedTable.rows.test.tsx`, `BannerReportSelectedTable.test.tsx`.

##### 2.11.1.3 Sub-feature: KPI row and charts

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Six KPI tiles, two donuts ("Net Dollars vs trade spend", "What Total Spend is made of") and two ranked banner bar charts (top N with a stated cap).
- **Code map:** `RollUpKpiRow.tsx`, `RollUpCompositionPie.tsx`, `RollUpBannerChart.tsx`, `rollUpCharts.helpers.ts` (`selectTopBanners`, `MEASURE_COLORS`, `formatMeasure`).
- **Business rules:** Missing figure renders as an em-dash, a real 0 as `$0`. No donut total is drawn because the three measures do not sum to Gross Revenue in real data.
- **Tests:** `RollUpBannerChart.test.tsx`, `RollUpCompositionPie.test.tsx`, `rollUpCharts.helpers.test.ts`.

#### 2.11.2 Feature: Monthly Report

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Month-by-month planned (forecast) cases and revenue per Distributor, Retailer, Banner and Product, compared with actual cases and revenue, with derived Plan Case Total, Plan Revenue Total and Variance rows. Planned rows are precomputed into fact tables (one per source: Sandbox and Brand Approved) by Refresh and by promotion deletes; actuals come from Distributor Sales Records on Refresh or from a CSV import. Supports aggregation by any subset of the four dimensions, single and multi-year views, grand totals, YOY and an async CSV export. Used by Brand organizations (and brokerages on connected brands) with `monthly-report` actions View, Import, Export; backfill is platform-admin only.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens `/{brandID}/monthly-report` from the Reports hub ("Enhanced Reporting" section). Route gated `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES["monthly-report"] = monthly-report`.
  2. Header actions (`MonthlyReportHeaderActions`): Refresh (always offered) and Import Actuals (only when `can(monthly-report, "import")`).
  3. Section "Item Monthly Report" (`MonthlyReportPlanMergedSection`): filter drawer (years, distributors, retailers, banners, products, created by, data source Sandbox or Approve Promo), Type and dependent-type pickers, aggregation dimensions, list or graph view, sort, page size 200, totals by top dimension, grand totals table, Export button (only with `export` action).
  4. One year selected: `POST monthly-report` + `POST monthly-report/grand-totals`. Several years: `POST monthly-report/multi-year` + `POST monthly-report/multi-year/grand-totals` (columns `Jan-YYYY` to `Dec-YYYY`).
  5. Section "Planned Monthly Cases by Item" (`MonthlyReportSecondaryTable`): single year, aggregated by Product, all rows (`pageSize -1`), bar chart or per-month line chart.
  6. Section "YOY Report" (`YearOverYearReport`): defaults to previous and current year, aggregated by Product, multi-year call; needs at least two years or no request is sent.
  7. Each section owns its own filters (`useMonthlyReportFilters` local state); changing filters in one section does not change the others.
  8. Refresh: `GET monthly-report/refresh` recomputes planned rows for both sources and upserts actuals, then the page bumps `refreshTick` to refetch.

  Jobs: `IImportJobService.ExecuteImportAsync` enqueued through `IJobService.Enqueue` when the last chunk lands; `ExportJobService.ExecuteMonthlyReportExportAsync` started by Data Hub `StartExportRequest`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Planned computation keeps events in status Active, Pending, RetailerApproved, Completed; Sandbox uses only family reporting versions; Brand Approved uses Standard entry type only.
  - Refresh is synchronous inside the GET: replaces planned rows for Sandbox and Brand Approved (all years), then upserts ActualCase / ActualRevenue from `DataUpload.DistributorSalesRecords` (banner matched by trimmed lower-case name to `CRM.Banners`, then to `CRM.DistributorBanners` for the brand, grouped by distributor name, retailer, banner, product description, year, month).
  - Deleting promotions also recomputes planned rows: `DeletePromotionsRequest` (Sandbox, plus Brand Approved when pushed copies are affected) and `DeleteTradeSpendPromotionsRequest` call `IMonthlyReportRefreshJobService.ExecuteRefreshAsync` with `year: null`.
  - `MonthlyReportPlannedRowWriter.ReplaceAsync` deletes existing planned rows even when the new set is empty, so a brand with no promotions loses its old plan.
  - Filters on Distributor, Retailer, Banner, Product are `ILIKE ANY('%value%')` substring matches; CreatedBy is exact (`= ANY`).
  - Aggregation: fewer than 4 dimensions triggers `SUM` with `GROUP BY`; empty dimension list means all four. Paging happens in memory after derived rows are inserted; `PageSize -1` returns all.
  - Sort validation (`GetMonthlyReportRequestValidator`): `SortColumn` must be a selected dimension, a month name (single year) or `Mon-YYYY` key (multi-year), or `GrandTotal`; month and GrandTotal sorts require `SortDependentTypes`; dimension sorts forbid them.
  - Grand totals: `AggregationDimension` must be one of Distributor, Retailer, Banner, Product (validator exception otherwise).
  - Filter properties: a facet never narrows itself; only Years is returned until at least one year is selected; CreatedBy labels come from `Identity.Users`.
  - Type options: only Case and Revenue are offered (SRP and Lift are commented out and return empty dependent lists).
  - Export: no years means `1 = 0` (empty file named `MonthlyReport_Export_Empty.csv`); module gate re-checked by `StartExportRequest` via `BrandExportModules` (`monthly-report`, Export).
- **Dependencies:** Trade Promotion Planning, Data Upload distributor sales, Data Hub import and export jobs, S3 (`IFileStorageService`), Hangfire (`IJobService`), CRM name propagation; web antd, ECharts, PrimeReact.
- **Errors & edge cases:** No years on multi-year read: empty response with empty `MonthColumnKeys`. Sandbox data source: Actual rows are always empty placeholders (no actual rows exist in `SandboxMonthlyReport`), so Variance is null. Export failure marks the job failed with the exception message. Import errors produce an error CSV with a reason per row.
- **Tests:** Backend `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/TradeSpend.Application.Test/MonthlyReport/RefreshMonthlyReportRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `MonthlyReportPlannedRowWriterTests.cs`, `GetMonthlyReportsBySourceSpecTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/CRM.Application.Test/MonthlyReport/GetMonthlyReportFilterPropertiesRequestTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/MonthlyReport/MonthlyReportRefreshJobServiceTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/DataUpload.Application.Test/Requests/MonthlyReport/MonthlyReportImportJobTests.cs`; propagation tests in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/Shared/Propagation/`. Web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/monthly-report/MonthlyReportGating.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/hooks/useMonthlyReportHooks.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/helper/monthlyReportUtils.test.ts`, `monthlyReportPlanMerged.test.ts`, `monthlyReportSecondary.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/monthlyReportFilterProperties.service.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/store/monthlyReportFilterStore.test.ts`. Gaps: no backend tests for `GetMonthlyReportRequest`, multi-year, grand totals, validators, template, export job.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Two independent planned-row engines: `RefreshMonthlyReportRequest.ComputeMonthlyData` (own copy) and `ComputeMonthlyReportForecastRequest` (reuses `GetForecastDataRequestHandler.ComputeMonthlyData`); results can drift.
  - `GET monthly-report/refresh` writes data (bulk delete and insert) inside a GET and runs synchronously.
  - Rows are keyed by names; a renamed distributor or product (no propagation for those) splits history.
  - `BulkUpsertMonthlyReportActualAsync` loads every row of `BrandApprovedMonthlyReport` for all brands (`ListAsync` with no spec) and filters in memory.
  - A later Refresh overwrites imported actual values whose key matches distributor sales data; imported keys absent from sales data survive.
  - Import validation of Distributor, Retailer and Banner names is global (not brand scoped); only Product is brand scoped (`GetMonthlyReportValidLookupsAsync`).
  - The import UI sends an `isSandbox` query param and shows a Sandbox switch (`MonthlyReportImportUpload.tsx`), but the backend ignores it and always writes Brand Approved actuals.
  - The export payload sends `format`, `includeGrandTotal`, `currentPage`, `pageSize` (`buildExportPayload` in `monthlyReport.utils.ts`); `StartMonthlyReportExportPayload` has none of them, so the file is always CSV.
  - Default data source differs: `useMonthlyReportFilters` default `isSandbox: false`, drawer Reset sets `false`, but the unused `monthlyReportFilterStore` default is `true`.

##### 2.11.2.1 Sub-feature: Refresh (planned and actual recompute)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Recomputes planned rows for both sources and upserts actuals from distributor sales for the active brand.
- **Code map:** `RefreshMonthlyReportRequest.cs`, `MonthlyReportPlannedRowWriter.cs`, `MonthlyReportHeaderActions.tsx`, `useMonthlyReportRefresh` in `useMonthlyReportHooks.ts`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** No distributor sales rows: actual step returns early and leaves existing actual rows untouched.
- **Tests:** `RefreshMonthlyReportRequestHandlerTests.cs`, `MonthlyReportPlannedRowWriterTests.cs`.

##### 2.11.2.2 Sub-feature: Actuals import (chunked CSV)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Uploads a CSV of actual cases or revenue in chunks to S3, then a background job validates and upserts rows.
- **User flow:**
  1. Import Actuals (needs `import` action) opens a modal; user may download the template first.
  2. File is split into 5 MB chunks (`DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE` in `useMonthlyReportImport.ts`), each posted with `chunkIndex`; chunk 1 creates the `ImportJob`; later chunks pass `jobId`, `uploadId`, `key`, `prevETags`.
  3. Last chunk completes the multipart upload, marks upload complete and enqueues the job; status `Pending` returned.
  4. Web polls status (2 s, 4 s while Processing) until Done (15) or PartiallyDone (17), Failed or Cancelled; failed rows offer the error file.
- **Business rules:** CSV only (`.csv` extension), `ChunkIndex > 0`, `ChunkIndex <= ChunkMax`. Row rules: four names required and must exist; year 2000 to current year + 10; month values numeric; Type one of Case, Revenue, Actual Case, Actual Revenue (Case maps to ActualCase, Revenue to ActualRevenue). Upsert deletes existing actual rows with the same key and inserts new ones.
- **Data:** `ImportJob` with `ModuleType.MonthlyReportActualImportTradeSpend`; job lookup requires same brand and module type, else 404.
- **Tests:** `MonthlyReportImportJobTests.cs`.

##### 2.11.2.3 Sub-feature: Actuals import template

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Downloads a CSV with columns `[*] Distributor`, `[*] Retailer`, `[*] Banner`, `[*] Product`, `[*] Year`, Type and months, seeded with every current-year key that has planned or actual rows, two lines per key (Actual Case, Actual Revenue), prefilled with existing actual values when present.
- **Code map:** `ExportMonthlyReportActualImportTemplateRequest.cs`, `useDownloadImportTemplate` in `useMonthlyReportHooks.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Gated on the `export` action although it is part of the import flow; a user with Import but not Export cannot get the template.

#### 2.11.3 Feature: Sales Tracker

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** For the active brand, counts banner SKUs per banner by item status (Active, Pending, Not Active, Declined, Discontinued, Approved, Commit), one horizontal bar chart per CRM region. Module `sales-tracker` action View.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens `/{brandID}/sales-tracker` from the Reports hub card "Sales Tracker".
  2. The page loads all regions (`GET /api/v1/regions`, `pageSize -1`) and renders a PrimeReact accordion, one tab per region.
  3. Each tab calls `POST reports/sales-tracker` with `regionIDs: [region.id]` and draws stacked bars per banner.
  4. Clicking a bar opens `/{brandID}/banners/{bannerID}?showBack=true`.
- **Code map:**

|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/Report/GetSalesTrackerReportRequest.cs` | Counts per banner and status |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Report/Modules.Report.Application/DTOs/SalesTrackerReportDTOs.cs` | `SalesTrackerReportDTO`, `BannerGroupedStatusModel`, `CountModel` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(report)/sales-tracker/page.tsx` | Route, renders dashboard `SalesTracker` |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/dashboard/SalesTracker.tsx` | Region accordion |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/dashboard/SalesTackerByRegion.tsx` | Per-region chart and click navigation |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/reports.ts` (`useGetSalesTracker`), `caboodle.web/src/service/report.service.ts` (`getSalesTracker`) | Query layer |
| `caboodle.web/src/models/dashboard.interface.ts` | `BannerGroupedSKUStatusesData` |

- **Data:** `CRM.BannerSKUs` (brand scoped, `Status` 1 to 7) joined to `CRM.Banners` and `CRM.RetailerRegions` (on retailer and banner).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/reports/sales-tracker` | `RequireModule(sales-tracker, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | `GetSalesTrackerReportRequest` (`RegionIDs?`, `RetailerIDs?`, `BannerIDs?`) / `SalesTrackerReportDTO` (`BannerGroupedSKUStatuesData[]`) | `GetSalesTrackerReportRequestHandler` |

  - `console.log` calls in chart click handlers (`SalesTackerByRegion.tsx`).
  - The dashboard page keeps `<SalesTracker />` commented out; the component lives under the dashboard route folder but is only rendered by the sales-tracker route.

Status of those three endpoints: Deprecated from the UI side.

### 2.12 Module: Intelligence (Ask Caboodle)

- **Purpose:** Natural-language analytics for a brand ("Ask Caboodle"). A user question is screened, classified, routed to one of two query paths (distributor report data from KeHE/UNFI uploads, or internal CRM, Product Specs and Trade Spend data), turned into an LLM-written query plan, compiled to parameterised SQL by the server, executed read-only, and returned as a structured report (table, KPI, chart, insights, actions, follow-up suggestions). Conversations are persisted per user and brand, every turn is audited with token cost, and two admin-only tools exist (entity index rebuild, evaluation suite). A separate web "AI-Powered Dashboard" prototype uses a placeholder Next.js API route.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controller: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Intelligence/IntelligenceChatController.cs` (6 actions, route `api/v{version}/intelligencechat` from `VersionedApiController`).
  - Backend module: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Intelligence/Modules.Intelligence.Application/` (Chat, Claude, Configuration, DataContextClassification, DistributorReport, EntityResolution, Evaluation, Insight, IntentClassification, InternalData, Orchestration, Planner, Pricing, ReportResponse, Requests, DTOs; embedded prompt `.txt` files listed in `Modules.Intelligence.Application.csproj`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Intelligence/Modules.Intelligence.Domain/` (Chat, Audit, Pricing, EntityResolution, Catalog, Models, Enums). Registration `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/ModuleStartup.cs` (`AddIntelligenceModule`), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Program.cs`.
  - Web: `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/ask-caboodle/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/` (components, hooks, services, store, types); prototype `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/dashboard-ai/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/api/ai-message/route.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/components/DynamicVisualization.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useChat.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/models/chat.interface.ts`.
  - Admin: none found (no `caboodle.admin` caller for `intelligencechat`).
- **Shared data models:** Schema `Intelligence` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs`):
  - `ChatSessions` (`ChatSession`: `UserId`, `BrandId`, `Title` max 500, `ConstraintYear`, `ConstraintModule`, `ConstraintEntitiesJson` jsonb, `LastActivityAt`; index on `UserId, BrandId` and `LastActivityAt`).
  - `ChatMessages` (`ChatMessage`: `SessionId`, `Role` 1 User / 2 Assistant / 3 System, `Content`, `ResponseJson` jsonb (serialized `StructuredReportResponse`), `Intent`, `QueryPlanJson`, `GeneratedSqlHash`, `TokensUsed`, `ExecutionTimeMs`, `RowsReturned`).
  - `QueryAuditLogs` (`QueryAuditLog`: `UserId`, `BrandId`, `SessionId`, `Prompt`, `Intent`, `Model`, `TokensUsed`, `InputTokens`, `OutputTokens`, `EstimatedCost`, `QueryPlanJson`, `GeneratedSql`, `ValidationErrors`, `ExecutionTimeMs`, `RowsReturned`, `FailureType`, `FailureMessage`, `ResponseSummary`).

  - Enums `IntentType` (1 DataQuery, 2 EntityResolution, 3 Clarification, 4 Documentation, 5 Refuse) and `QueryFailureType` (0 None, 1 Validation, 2 Permission, 3 CostOrTimeout, 4 Transient, 5 Execution) in `Modules.Intelligence.Domain/Enums/IntelligenceEnums.cs`.
  - Migrations: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrations/20260225050405_IntelligenceTablesAdded.cs`, `20260228121749_NewTablesAddedInIntelligenceModule.cs`, `20260228131005_ResponseJsonColumnAddedInChatMessage.cs`, `20260302113638_MasterEntityTableAddedInIntelligenceModule.cs`.
