#### 2.12.1 Feature: Ask Caboodle chat (question to report)

- **Status:** Active (module `ask-caboodle`; the only in-app link, the dashboard ask box, is hidden when `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENVIRONMENT` is `Production`, see 2.11.6.1; the route stays reachable by URL)
- **What it does:** Answers one natural-language question per call with a structured report built from brand-scoped data. Used by Brand organizations (and brokerages on a connected brand) with module `ask-caboodle` action View.
- **User flow:**
  1. User opens `/{brandID}/ask-caboodle` (directly or from the dashboard ask box with `?prompt=`). The prompt in the query string is sent once on mount.
  2. `ChatContainer` loads the session list and shows the conversation; `ChatInput` sends `POST intelligencechat/chat` with `{ message, sessionId, explain }` and header `BrandID`.
  3. Server pipeline (`PathAwareOrchestrator.ProcessAsync`):
     1. Get or create the session; if it already holds `MaxSessionMessages` messages, reply Refuse "This conversation has reached the maximum of N messages" (not persisted).
     2. Prompt guard; blocked messages return Refuse with `ValidationFailure`.
     3. Intent classification; anything but Queryable stores the user message plus a fixed clarification reply.
     4. Data context classification: DistributorReport goes to path A, InternalData to the internal path, anything else (including SyndicatedReport) gets "I can help with distributor report queries (KeHE/UNFI sales data) or internal CRM data."
     5. Path runs plan, compile, execute, report build; the assistant message stores the headline as content and the report as `ResponseJson`.
     6. Any exception: Refuse "Something went wrong. Please try again." with `TransientFailure` and `ErrorDetail = ex.Message`.
  4. The web renders the reply with `AIReportRenderer` (blocks `kpi`, `chart`, `table`, `insights`, `actions`; `nextSuggestions` as clickable chips that send a new message).
  5. "New conversation" resets local state; the first reply's `sessionId` is stored and reused.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/Intelligence/IntelligenceChatController.cs` | `ChatAsync` |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Intelligence/Modules.Intelligence.Application/Requests/ChatRequest.cs` | Resolves active brand, calls orchestrator |
| `.../Orchestration/PathAwareOrchestrator.cs` | Pipeline, persistence, audit, cost |
| `.../Planner/PromptGuard.cs` | Input screening |
| `.../IntentClassification/*` | Intent LLM call and prompt |
| `.../DataContextClassification/*` | Data context LLM call and prompt |
| `.../DistributorReport/*` | Path A: planner, compiler, executor, column mapping |
| `.../EntityResolution/LlmEntityExtractor.cs`, `.../InternalData/MasterEntityResolutionService.cs` | Entity mentions and lookup |
| `.../InternalData/*` | Internal path: prompt builder, planner, SQL compiler, executor, enum mapper |
| `.../Insight/IdColumnFilter.cs` | Drops id-like columns before LLM and client |
| `.../ReportResponse/ReportResponseBuilder.cs`, `StructuredReportPrompt.txt` | Report blocks and LLM narrative |
| `.../Chat/*TitleGenerator.cs`, `SessionTitleGeneratorSelector.cs` | Session title |
| `.../Pricing/ModelPricingService.cs` | Token cost |
| `.../DTOs/IntelligenceDTOs.cs`, `StructuredReportDTOs.cs` | Contracts |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/ask-caboodle/page.tsx` | Route, `?prompt=` hand-off |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/components/ChatContainer.tsx`, `ChatInput.tsx`, `ChatMessageList.tsx`, `ChatMessageBubble.tsx`, `AIReportRenderer.tsx`, `ClarificationOptions.tsx` | Chat UI and report rendering |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/hooks/useAskCaboodleChat.ts` | Send flow, in-flight guard, thread-full flag |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/services/askCaboodleApi.ts` | `AskCaboodleService` (axios, `BrandID` header) |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/store/askCaboodle.store.ts` | Non-persisted Zustand store |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/types/askCaboodle.types.ts` | TS contracts |

- **Data:** Writes `ChatSessions`, `ChatMessages`, `QueryAuditLogs`; reads `MasterEntities`, `LlmModelPricings`, KeHE/UNFI tables, and allow-listed internal tables.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/intelligencechat/chat` | `RequireModule(ask-caboodle, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | `ChatRequest` (`Message`, `SessionId?`, `Explain`) / `ChatResponseDTO` (`SessionId`, `Intent`, `Message`, `TotalRows?`, `FailureType?`, `ErrorDetail?`, `StructuredReport?`); web `ChatRequest` / `ChatResponseDTO` | `ChatRequestHandler` then `PathAwareOrchestrator` |

  External calls per answered question (DistributorReport path): intent, data context, title (new session only), planner, report narrative. Internal path adds entity extraction. Data rows (up to 100, id columns removed) are sent to the configured LLM provider in the report prompt (`MaxRowsForPrompt`).
- **Business rules:**
  - Brand scope: `ChatRequestHandler` uses `IAccessContext.GetActiveBrandIdAsync`; every compiled query adds `BrandID = @brand` (distributor tables; internal tables in `TablesWithBrandId`).
  - Message limits: guard blocks empty text and more than 100 characters.
  - Session cap: `MaxSessionMessages` counts user and assistant messages (20 in Development and Staging config, so 10 exchanges).
  - Token cost is computed only when `PlannerProvider = Claude` (planner plus report tokens times `LlmModelPricings` for `ClaudeModel`); other providers log 0 tokens and 0 cost.
- **Dependencies:** LLM provider APIs and keys (`IntelligenceSettings`), PostgreSQL, `IMemoryCache`; web ECharts (`echarts-for-react`), antd.
- **Errors & edge cases:** LLM failure returns null content; classifiers then return `Unspecified`, which reads as non-queryable and yields the generic clarification text. Planner null: "I couldn't form a clear plan...". Compiler null: "I couldn't compile...". Query timeout: "Query execution timed out." Audit persistence errors are logged and swallowed.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Intelligence.Application.Test/Requests/ChatRequestTests.cs` (brand passed to orchestrator, refused caller never reaches the AI, evaluation brand), `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Intelligence.Application.Test/Helper/EngineBrand.cs`. No tests for the orchestrator, classifiers, compilers, guard or report builder. No web tests for `src/modules/ask-caboodle` (and `src/modules/**` is excluded from Jest coverage).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `DbChatContextStore.GetOrCreateAsync` loads a session by id without checking `UserId` or `BrandId`; a caller who knows another user's session id can append to it, and that session's history is fed into the LLM prompts. Get and Delete do check ownership.
  - `ErrorDetail = ex.Message` is returned to the client on any exception (including the "forbidden keyword" safety exception, which is thrown outside the executor's try block).
  - Web thread-full detection looks for the word "thread" in the reply (`useAskCaboodleChat.ts`); the backend says "conversation", so the input never locks.
  - Web has no 100-character limit; longer questions are refused by the server guard.
  - Web types expect `clarificationOptions` and render `ClarificationOptions`; the backend never returns that field. Web `FailureType` enum has `ProcessingError = 2` where the backend has `PermissionFailure = 2`.
  - Several options are read nowhere: `MaxTokens`, `Temperature`, `MaxQueryRows`, `MaxJoins`, `PlannerHistoryMessageCount` (each component uses its own constants).
  - `UpdateConstraintsAsync` is never called, so session constraints (year, module, entities) are always empty.
  - Non-Claude providers record zero tokens and zero cost in the audit log.

##### 2.12.1.1 Sub-feature: Prompt guard

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Regex and keyword screen before any LLM call.
- **Business rules:** Blocks: "ignore ... instructions", "reveal/show ... prompt", "show/list ... table|schema|column|database", whole-word SQL verbs `DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE|DELETE|INSERT|UPDATE|CREATE|GRANT|REVOKE`, `; SELECT` chains, `UNION SELECT`, role-play phrases, and the substrings `password`, `secret`, `token`, `apikey`, `api_key`, `connectionstring`, `encryption` (`PromptGuard.cs`).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Ordinary business words are blocked (for example "update", "delete", "create" as words, or "token"), with the message "contains a pattern that is not allowed".

##### 2.12.1.2 Sub-feature: Intent classification

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** LLM returns one of Queryable, Analysis, Clarification, Ambiguous, Refuse, Unspecified (`ConversationIntentType`) from `IntentClassificationPrompt.txt` with the full session history.
- **Business rules:** Only Queryable continues. Replies: Clarification "Could you clarify...", Ambiguous "I'm not sure which data...", Refuse "I can't help with that request.", Analysis "For deeper analysis, please ask a specific data question...", others a generic text. Max 64 output tokens, temperature 0.1.

##### 2.12.1.3 Sub-feature: Data context classification

- **Status:** Partial (`SyndicatedReport` is classified but has no execution path; it falls to the unsupported reply in `PathAwareOrchestrator.ProcessAsync`)
- **What it does:** LLM picks DistributorReport, SyndicatedReport, InternalData or Unspecified (`DataContextClassificationPrompt.txt`). KeHE/UNFI as data source means DistributorReport; KeHE/UNFI as a company means InternalData; "Monthly report" means InternalData.

##### 2.12.1.4 Sub-feature: Distributor report path (KeHE / UNFI)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** LLM produces a `DistributorReportPlan` (source KeHE, UNFI or Both; logical fields period, retailer_name, store, city, dc_warehouse, upc, product_description, sales_dollars, quantity; filters, dimensions, measures, year, month range, sort, limit). The compiler maps logical fields to physical columns (`ColumnMapping`), builds parameterised SQL per source against `DataUpload.KeHeRecords` / `DataUpload.UnfiRecords` with `Deleted = FALSE` and `BrandID`, and the executor runs it with timeout and transient retries, tagging rows with `Source` when both run.
- **Code map:** `DistributorReportLlmPlanner.cs`, `DistributorReportPlannerPrompt.txt`, `DistributorReportCompiler.cs`, `ColumnMapping.cs`, `DistributorReportExecutor.cs`.
- **Business rules:** Unknown source defaults to Both. Measure aggregations sum, avg, min, max, count (distinct optional). Default limit 100. KeHE `sales_dollars` maps to `CurrentYearCost`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `ColumnMapping` passes unknown logical names straight through as quoted identifiers, and measure `Name` from the LLM is interpolated into `AS "<name>"`; only a keyword blocklist (`ValidateSqlSafety`) stands between LLM output and SQL text. `plan.Limit` from the LLM is not capped. Queries run through the normal `IDapperRepository` connection (no read-only role found).

##### 2.12.1.5 Sub-feature: Internal data path (CRM, Product Specs, Trade Spend)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Extracts entity mentions (LLM, `EntityExtractionPrompt.txt`), resolves them against `Intelligence.MasterEntities` (exact or `ILIKE` contains, exact first), passes them as session context to the planner (`InternalDataBusinessPrompt.txt` plus `CrmSchema.txt`, `ProductSpecsSchema.txt`, `TradeSpendSchema.txt`, `TradeSpendSandboxSchema.txt`), which returns an intent and an `InternalDataQueryPlan` (dataset, joins, measures incl. `sum_months`, `sum_columns`, `derived`, conditional filter, dimensions, filters, time range, sort, limit, page). `InternalDataSqlCompiler` validates against an allow-list of 31 tables, adds `Deleted = FALSE` per alias and `BrandID` for brand-owned tables, caps limit at 1000, and maps enum columns back to labels (`InternalDataEnumMapper`).
- **Code map:** `LlmEntityExtractor.cs`, `MasterEntityResolutionService.cs`, `InternalDataPromptBuilder.cs`, `InternalDataLlmPlanner.cs`, `InternalDataQueryPlan.cs`, `InternalDataSqlCompiler.cs` (`AllowedTables`, `TablesWithBrandId`, `SafeColumnName`, `EnumColumnByTableColumn`), `InternalDataExecutor.cs`, `InternalDataEnumMapper.cs`.
- **Business rules:** Planner intents other than DataQuery return the planner's clarification question or message. Brand-owned tables include monthly report, promos, events, banner SKUs, contacts, pipelines, categories, products, price list; global tables (retailers, banners, distributors, regions, stores, DCs) carry no brand filter.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `MasterEntities` has no brand column, so a product or category of another brand can resolve as context (the SQL itself is still brand-filtered). `IdColumnFilter` drops any column whose name ends with "Id", "ID" or "Guid", which also hides legitimate columns with such endings.

##### 2.12.1.6 Sub-feature: Structured report response

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Always adds a table block from the rows (page size hint 15); asks the LLM (temperature 0.3, up to 12,000 output tokens) for headline, overview, insights, actions, next suggestions, and chart and KPI recommendations, then builds chart and KPI blocks from the real rows. Falls back to "Report, N rows returned." when the LLM output does not parse.
- **Code map:** `ReportResponseBuilder.cs`, `StructuredReportPrompt.txt`, `StructuredReportDTOs.cs`; web `AIReportRenderer.tsx`.

##### 2.12.1.7 Sub-feature: Session title generation

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** On the first data-query turn of a new session, the provider-specific generator writes a short title (`SessionTitleGeneratorSelector`). Sessions whose first turn was non-queryable keep a null title.

##### 2.12.1.8 Sub-feature: Audit log and token cost

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** One `QueryAuditLog` per request with intent, model name (`ActiveModelName`), tokens, cost, timing, rows, failure type and response summary. Cost = tokens / 1000 times the per-1K prices from `LlmModelPricings` (cached 30 minutes, `ModelPricingService`); `LlmModelPricingSeeder` (`ICustomSeeder`) seeds `gpt-4o`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `claude-sonnet-4-6` when missing.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** `GeneratedSql` and `QueryPlanJson` are never filled by the orchestrator (`SetExecutionResult(null, null, ...)`, `SetPlannerResult(..., null)`), so the audit cannot reproduce a query. The Staging model `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` has no seeded price.

#### 2.12.2 Feature: Chat sessions (history sidebar)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Lists the current user's conversations for the active brand, opens one with its messages and reports, and deletes one.
- **User flow:**
  1. `ChatSidebar` loads `GET sessions` on mount and after a new session id appears; the web sorts by `lastActivityAt` descending.
  2. Clicking a session loads `GET sessions/{id}` and maps messages, restoring each `structuredReport`.
  3. Delete calls `DELETE sessions/{id}`; a 404 is treated as already removed (info toast); other errors show the server message.

| `.../Requests/DeleteChatSessionRequest.cs` | Ownership check, delete messages then session |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/hooks/useAskCaboodleSessions.ts` | Load, open, delete |
| `caboodle.web/src/modules/ask-caboodle/components/ChatSidebar.tsx` | Sidebar UI |

- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/intelligencechat/sessions` | `RequireModule(ask-caboodle, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | none / `List<ChatSessionSummaryDTO>` (`Id`, `Title`, `LastActivityAt`, `MessageCount`) | `ListChatSessionsHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/intelligencechat/sessions/{sessionId}` | `RequireModule(ask-caboodle, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | none / `ChatSessionDetailDTO` (`Id`, `Title`, `LastActivityAt`, `ConstraintYear`, `ConstraintModule`, `Messages[]` of `ChatMessageDTO`) | `GetChatSessionHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/intelligencechat/sessions/{sessionId}` | `RequireModule(ask-caboodle, null, View)`, `BrandIDHeader` | none / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteChatSessionHandler` |
- **Business rules:** Get and Delete return 404 ("Chat session not found") unless the session belongs to the caller and the active brand. Delete needs only View.

- **Errors & edge cases:** Not verified.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Intelligence.Application.Test/Requests/ChatSessionRequestsTests.cs` (engine brand scoping for list, get, delete).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The list SQL has no `ORDER BY` and no limit, counts only user messages, and inner-joins messages, so a session with no user message is hidden. `ListSessionsForUserSpec` (limit 50) is unused by the list request. The controller's `NotFound()` branch is unreachable because the handler throws.

### 2.13 Module: File Repository

- **Purpose:** Stores and organizes documents in S3 behind a folder tree. Two separate areas exist: a brand's Files (brand page `/{brandID}/file-upload`, used by the brand company and its connected brokerages) and a brokerage's own File Repository (`/file-repository`, no brand). It owns folders, files, chunked uploads, presigned downloads, move/rename/delete, search, opaque share links with a public redirect endpoint, and the in-app preview.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/FileRepository/DirectoryController.cs`, `.../FilesController.cs`, `.../ShareController.cs`
  - Backend module: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/` (`Directory/`, `File/`, `Helper/`, `Common/`, `Specifications/`, `DTOs/`, `Startup.cs`) and `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Domain/` (`Directory/FileDirectory.cs`, `File/UserFile.cs`, `File/FileShareLink.cs`)
  - Storage: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Common/FileStorage/IFileStorageService.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageService.cs`, `.../AwsS3Provider.cs`
  - Path helper: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/Directory/DirectoryService.cs`
  - Web routes: `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(file-upload)/file-upload/page.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/file-repository/page.tsx`
  - Web UI: `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/*`, `caboodle.web/src/components/doc-viewer/DocsViewer.tsx`
  - Web data: `caboodle.web/src/service/directory.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/service/file-explorer.service.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/models/file.interface.ts`
  - Admin app: none (no admin screen calls `api/v1/directory` or `api/v1/files`).
- **Shared data models:**
  - `FileRepository.FileDirectories` (`FileDirectory`): `ID`, `BrandID?`, `Name`, `DirectoryType` (1 Root, 2 Subdirectory; every row created here is 2), `ParentDirectoryId?`, `UserId`, `PrivacyType` (1 Public, 2 Private), audit columns incl. `Deleted`/`DeletedOn`.
  - `FileRepository.UserFiles` (`UserFile`): `ID` (also the S3 file name), `UserId`, `BrandID?`, `DirectoryId?`, `Name`, `Size` (bytes, long), `Extension`, `Url` (legacy unsigned S3 URL), `Key?` (canonical S3 object key, added by migration `20260916102725_FileShareLinksAndUserFileKeyAdded`), `PrivacyType`.
  - `FileRepository.FileShareLinks` (`FileShareLink`): `UserFileID` (no FK), `Token` (unique index `IX_FileShareLinks_Token`), `ExpiresOn?`, `RevokedOn?`, `RevokedBy?`, `AccessCount`, `LastAccessedOn?`.
  - Ownership rule (`FileRepositoryArea`): brand rows carry `BrandID = brand` and `UserId = creator`; brokerage rows carry `BrandID = null` and `UserId = brokerage OrganizationId`.
- **Shared services:**
  - `FileRepositoryArea` (`.../Helper/FileRepositoryArea.cs`): resolves the area from the route (brand route uses the active brand, `broker/*` routes use the caller's brokerage), privacy rights, ownership checks, S3 prefix (`CaboodleFiles/{brandId}/` or `CaboodleFiles/Broker/{organizationId}/`).
  - `IDirectoryService.GetCurrentDirectoryRelativePath` (`DirectoryService.cs`): builds `Parent/Child/` from folder NAMES by walking `ParentDirectoryId`.
  - `IFileStorageService` / `AwsS3StorageService`: upload, multipart chunks, copy, move prefix, delete prefix, presigned URLs.
  - `IFileUploadGuard` / `FileUploadGuard`, `FileUploadRules`, `FileStorageQuota`, `FileStorageCounter` (`IQuotaCounter`): module-setting limits and storage quota.
  - `FileShareLinkRules`, `ShareTokenGenerator`, `UserFileKeyResolver`, `FileContentTypeResolver`.
  - Web: `useFilesActions` (gating), `useCopyShareLink`, `explorer.helpers.ts`, `shareLink.helpers.ts`, `copyFileUrl.ts`.
- **Cross-module dependencies:**
  - 2.2 Organizations & Access Control: `IAccessContext` (organization, brands, company modules, `files.private` org permission) decides area and privacy.
  - 2.2 module catalog and settings: module slug `files` gates every endpoint; Files module settings (`max-upload-size-mb`, `allowed-file-types`, `storage-quota-gb`, `allow-never-expiring-links`, `default-share-link-expiry`, `share-link-max-expiry-days`) via `IModuleSettings` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Settings/ModuleSettingKeys.cs`); quota lock via `IQuotaGuard`.
  - 2.15 Platform Administration: file key backfill fills `UserFiles.Key`; soft delete purge scans FileRepository tables.
  - AWS S3 (bucket from `AwsSettings.BucketSettings`), Google Docs viewer (web preview of office/PDF files).

#### 2.13.1 Feature: Repository areas and access rules

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Every handler resolves a `FileRepositoryArea` before touching data. Brand routes act on the brand in the `BrandID` header; `broker/*` routes act on the caller's own brokerage; "shared" read routes (`GET directory`, `directory/tree`, `directory/parent`, `directory/search`) take the area from the record or from the request. Used by Brand companies (own brand), brokerages on a connected brand route, and brokerages on their own repository (module slug `files`).
- **User flow:**
  1. Web route gate: `/file-upload` maps to slug `files` in `BRAND_ROUTE_MODULES`; `/file-repository` maps to `files` in `BROKER_ROUTE_MODULES` and `BROKER_COMPANY_LEVEL_ROUTES` (`caboodle.web/src/constants/moduleConstants.ts`).
  2. Header shortcut "Files" points at `/{brandId}/file-upload` or `/file-repository` (`buildNavActions` in `caboodle.web/src/helper/appNav.helper.ts`).
  3. Controls appear only when `useFilesActions` reports the action (`can(files, action)` on brand pages, `hasCompanyModule(files, action)` on the broker repository); all false while `/me/access` loads.
  4. Server: `RequireModule` policy, then `FileRepositoryArea.ResolveAsync` / `ForSharedRequest` / `ForRecord`, then `area.CanSee(record)` on every loaded row (404 when not visible).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/Helper/FileRepositoryArea.cs` | Area resolution, privacy, ownership, S3 prefix, specs per area |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Modules/RequireModuleAttribute.cs` | `OrganizationLevel` policy flag |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Access/AccessContext.cs` | `ModuleRefusal`, `OrganizationModuleRefusal`, `HasOrganizationModule` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/useFilesActions.ts` | `canCreate/canUpdate/canDelete/canExport` per area |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(file-upload)/file-upload/page.tsx` | Brand page, Public/Private tabs |
| `caboodle.web/src/app/(broker)/file-repository/page.tsx` | Broker page, Public explorer only |

- **Data:** `FileDirectories`, `UserFiles` ownership columns (`BrandID`, `UserId`), `PrivacyType`.
- **APIs/interfaces:** Access rule per endpoint is listed under each feature. Policy string format `module:{brandSlug}|{brokerSlug}|{action}|{crossBrand}|{organizationLevel}` (`ModuleRequirement.ToPolicy`).
- **Business rules:**
  - Brand area: `CanUsePrivate = access.OrganizationId == brandId && files.private` (only the brand company itself, never a connected brokerage).
  - Brokerage area: refused with 403 "This module is not available to your organization." unless the caller's organization is a Brokerage.
  - `ForRecord`: a record with `BrandID` is visible when the caller holds `files` View on that brand; a record without `BrandID` only to a Brokerage (then `Owns` checks `UserId == organization`).
  - `OrganizationLevel = true` routes check the company's own module grant (`HasOrganizationModule`); a Brand company is checked on its own brand.
  - `area.DemandPrivacy(Private)` without the right: 403 "You don't have access to the private repository."
- **Dependencies:** 2.2 access context and module slug `files`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Invalid `BrandID` header 400 "Invalid BrandID."; foreign brand 403; record outside area returns 404 (not 403) so existence is not revealed.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/FileRepository.Application.Test/Helper/FileRepositoryAreaTests.cs`, `.../Access/EngineFirstTests.cs`, `.../Helper/Callers.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/file-upload/FileExplorerGating.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/app/FileUploadPage.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Shared read routes are `OrganizationLevel = true`, while `GET directory/root` is not. A brokerage on a brand route therefore needs company-level `files` View to open a subfolder (`GET directory`, `tree`, `parent`, `search`) in addition to the brand grant that `ForRecord` checks; the root listing needs only the brand grant. See questions file.

##### 2.13.1.1 Sub-feature: Private repository (Brand company)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** A second, private tree for the brand company. The brand page shows Public/Private tabs only when `isBrandOrg && hasPermission(files.private)`; each tab mounts `FileExplorer` with `privacyType` 1 or 2.
- **Business rules:** Privacy is fixed per container: a folder's children are created with the folder's privacy (`GetFileDirectorySpec(id, privacyType)` on create/upload); a file cannot move into a folder of another privacy (`FileMoveRequestHandler`). Private files cannot be shared (2.13.7). Privacy is not part of the S3 key, so a public and a private root folder with the same name would share a prefix; the same-name check spans both privacies (`ChildDirectoriesSpecification` has no privacy filter).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The tab `onChange` pushes `/{brandID}/file-upload`, dropping any `directoryID`.

##### 2.13.1.2 Sub-feature: Brokerage private repository

- **Business rules:** `ForBrokerage` sets `CanUsePrivate = HasOrgPermission(files.private)`.

#### 2.13.2 Feature: Browsing and navigation

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Lists root folders and files, a folder's direct children, one level of the sidebar tree, and the breadcrumb path. Used by every user with `files` View in the area.
- **User flow:**
  1. No `directoryID` in the URL: `GET directory/root` (brand, `BrandID` header) or `GET directory/broker/root`.
  2. `?directoryID=` in the URL: `GET directory?directoryID=` (both areas) and `GET directory/parent` for breadcrumbs.
  3. Sidebar tree (`SubFileTree`) expands lazily: `GET directory/tree?directoryID=` per node (root uses `root` / `broker/root`).
  4. Opening a folder pushes `{rootPath}?directoryID={id}`; breadcrumbs collapse beyond 3 segments (`collapseBreadcrumbSegments`).
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/Directory/GetRootDirectoryTreeRequest.cs` | Root folders + root files of the area for one privacy |
| `.../Directory/GetDirectoryRequest.cs` | Folder children + files (Dapper) |
| `.../Directory/GetDirectoryTreeRequest.cs` | One level of subfolders via `IDirectoryService.ResolveSubdirectories` |
| `.../Directory/GetParentDirectoryRequest.cs` | Recursive CTE path, depth guard 1000 |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/FileExplorer.tsx` | Explorer shell, list/tile views, modals |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/SubFileTree.tsx` | Sidebar tree, drop target |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/explorer.helpers.ts` | Row building, sorting, sections, breadcrumbs |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts` | `useRootGetFilesAndFolders(ForBroker)`, `useGetFilesAndFolders(ForBroker)`, `useGetFolderTree(ForBroker)`, `useGetFolderPath` |

- **Data:** `DirectoryInfoDTO` (`ID?`, `ParentDirectoryID?`, `Name`, `CreatedOn`, `LastModifiedOn?`, `SubDirectories`, `Files`), `UserFileInfoDTO` (`ID`, `Name` = `name.ext`, `Size` string, `Url`, dates), `DirectoryTreeDTO` (`ID`, `Name`, `Meta?`, `SubDirectories`, `ParentDirectoryId?`) in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/DTOs/`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/directory` | `RequireModule(files, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | query `directoryID`, `sortingOrder` / `DirectoryInfoDTO` | `GetDirectoryRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/tree` | `RequireModule(files, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | query `directoryID`, `sortingOrder` / `DirectoryTreeDTO` | `GetDirectoryTreeRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/parent` | `RequireModule(files, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | query `directoryID` / `List<DirectoryTreeDTO>` root first | `GetParentDirectoryRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/root` | `RequireModule(files, files, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | query `privacyType`, `sortingOrder` / `DirectoryInfoDTO` (`Name = "Root"`) | `GetRootDirectoryTreeRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/broker/root` | `RequireModule(null, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | same, `IsBrokerageRepository = true` | `GetRootDirectoryTreeRequestHandler` |

- **Business rules:** Shared routes resolve the area from the loaded directory (`FileRepositoryArea.CanRead`). Lists are ordered by `Name ASC` in SQL; the web re-sorts client-side (`buildExplorerRows`, folders always first, sort by name or last modified).
- **Dependencies:** `IDirectoryService` (Modules.Shared); React Query keys `getFilesAndFolders`, `getFilesAndFoldersForBroker`, `getFolderTree`, `getFolderTreeForBroker`, `getFolderPath`, `getFolderPathForBroker`.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Unknown or invisible directory: 404 "Directory not found" / "Directory couldn't be found". A stale `directoryID` in the URL renders an empty folder with the 404 toast.
- **Tests:** backend `.../Directory/DirectoryReadRequestTests.cs`, `.../Directory/GetRootDirectoryTreeRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/file-upload/explorer.helpers.test.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/SubFileTree.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/FileExplorer.sidebar.test.tsx`, `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/components/file-upload/FileExplorer.list.test.tsx`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `sortingOrder` cannot produce DESC: handlers replace any value not equal to `Constants.SORTINGORDER` (which is `"ASC"`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Common/Models/Constants.cs`) with `"ASC"`; `GetDirectoryRequest` ignores it entirely.
  - `DirectoryService.ResolveSubdirectories` interpolates the parent GUID and the sorting order into SQL and returns one level only, despite the "tree" name; it does not filter `Deleted` (rows are hard-deleted, so no practical effect).
  - `GetDirectoryRequest` lists child folders and files without a privacy filter; children inherit privacy at creation, so this relies on that invariant.
  - DTO `Url` is the stored unsigned S3 URL (bucket and tenant path), returned in listings although the web never uses it for downloads.

#### 2.13.3 Feature: Folder management

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Create, rename, move (drag a folder onto a folder or the tree root) and delete folders, in both areas. Requires `files` Create, Update or Delete respectively.
- **User flow:**
  1. "New folder" opens `AddOrEditFolder`; the client blocks a name already on screen; server re-checks.
  2. Rename uses the same modal and sends `{directoryID, parentDirectoryID: currentDirectoryID, directioryName}`.
  3. Drag a folder onto another folder row, tile or tree node, confirm in a "Move folder" modal, then `PUT directory` with the new `parentDirectoryID` (null for root).
  4. Delete from the row menu, confirm, `DELETE directory?directoryId=`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/Directory/DirectoryCreationRequest.cs` | Create folder, same-name check |
| `.../Directory/DirectoryUpdateRequest.cs` | Rename and move: S3 prefix move, then SQL key rewrite |
| `.../Directory/DeleteDirectoryRequest.cs` | Delete S3 prefix, then recursive hard delete of folders and files |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/AddOrEditFolder.tsx` | Create/rename form (folders and files) |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/FolderRowActions.tsx` | Folder menu, delete confirm |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts` | `useCreateFolder(ForBroker)`, `useUpdateFolder(ForBroker)`, `useDeleteDirectory(ForBroker)` |

- **Data:** `FileDirectories`; `UserFiles.Key` rewritten on rename/move.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/directory` | `RequireModule(files, files, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `DirectoryCreationRequest` {`currentDirectoryID?`, `privacyType`, `name`} / `ResponseMetaDTO` {message} | `DirectoryCreationRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/directory/broker` | `RequireModule(null, files, Create, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same, `IsBrokerageRepository = true` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/directory` | `RequireModule(files, files, Update)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `DirectoryUpdateRequest` {`directoryID`, `parentDirectoryID?`, `directioryName`} / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DirectoryUpdateRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/directory/broker` | `RequireModule(null, files, Update, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/directory` | `RequireModule(files, files, Delete)` + `BrandIDHeader` | query `directoryId` / `ResponseMetaDTO` | `DeleteDirectoryRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/directory/broker` | `RequireModule(null, files, Delete, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |

  S3: `MoveFolderObjectAsync` (copy + delete each object under the old prefix), `DeleteObjectsWithPrefixAsync`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Name required (validators). Same-name check is exact-case (`x.Name == name`) among the destination parent's children, privacy ignored.
  - Rename/move: parent must exist, be visible, have the same privacy; moving a folder into itself or a descendant is refused ("A directory can't be moved into itself.", prefix comparison of relative paths).
  - `PUT` always sets `ParentDirectoryId = request.ParentDirectoryID`, so a null parent moves the folder to the root.
  - After the S3 move, one SQL `UPDATE` rewrites `Key` of every non-deleted file whose `Key` (or, for legacy rows, `Url`) contains the old prefix (`RewriteFileKeysAsync`). `Url` is not updated.
  - Delete: S3 prefix deleted first, then a recursive CTE hard-deletes all descendant folders and their files.
- **Dependencies:** `IDirectoryService` (paths from names), `IDapperRepository`, S3.
- **Errors & edge cases:** "A directory with the same name already exists." (400); "Invalid current directory" (400); "Directory couldn't be found" / "Parent Directory couldn't be found" (404); S3 errors on move surface as 400 `MoveFolderObject`.
- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/FileRepository.Application.Test/Directory/DirectoryCreationRequestTests.cs`, `.../DirectoryUpdateRequestTests.cs`, `.../DeleteDirectoryRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - `ProducesResponseType(typeof(DirectoryInfoDTO))` on `POST directory` and `POST directory/broker` is wrong; the handler returns `ResponseMetaDTO`.
  - S3 listing is not paginated (`ListObjectsV2` in `MoveFolderObjectAsync`, `ListObjects` in `GetObjectsWithPrefix`, single `DeleteObjects` call): folders with more than 1000 objects are partly moved or partly deleted, while the SQL key rewrite or row delete covers every row.
  - Move and delete are not transactional across S3 and the database.
  - Folder names become S3 path segments; no validation rejects `/` in a name (see questions).
  - Web rename sends `parentDirectoryID = currentDirectoryID` (`AddOrEditFolder.tsx`); a rename started from search results inside another folder may move the folder (see questions).
  - CS-1795 on `origin/master` (`f2637cb9`) solves the same key-sync problem differently: `MoveFolderObjectAsync` returns `IList<FileUploadResult>` and `DirectoryUpdateRequest` bulk-updates `Key` and `Url` per moved object (`GetFilesByIDsSpec`), with new tests `DirectoryMove/DirectoryUpdateRequestTests.cs`. The working branch rewrites `Key` with one SQL statement and leaves `Url` stale; the interface signature conflicts on merge.

##### 2.13.3.1 Sub-feature: Folder upload

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Dropping a folder into the upload dialog creates the whole folder tree in one call, then uploads each file by chunks into the created folder IDs.
- **User flow:**
  1. `DraggerFile.onDrop` walks `webkitGetAsEntry` entries (`traverseFileTree`), building `FolderTree` nodes with `meta = {tempId, type}`.
  2. `POST directory/tree` (or `broker/tree`) with `currentDirectoryId` = URL `directoryID`.
  3. The response echoes `meta`; files are mapped to created folder IDs by `parentTempId` and uploaded sequentially (2.13.4.1).
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/directory/tree` | `RequireModule(files, files, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `DirectoryTreeCreationRequest` {`currentDirectoryID?`, `privacyType`, `name`, `meta`, `subDirectories[]`} / `DirectoryTreeDTO` | `DirectoryTreeCreationRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/directory/broker/tree` | `RequireModule(null, files, Create, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |

- **Business rules:** All folders get the root's area and privacy; inserted with `IBulkRepository.BulkInsertAsync`.
- **Tests:** `.../Directory/DirectoryTreeCreationRequestTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** No same-name check (unlike `DirectoryCreationRequest`): uploading a folder whose name matches an existing sibling creates two folders sharing one S3 prefix, and deleting either deletes the other's objects. `DraggerFile.tsx` keeps several `console.log` calls.

##### 2.13.3.2 Sub-feature: Folder download as zip

- **Status:** Partial (backend only: no web or admin caller of `directory/download` or `directory/broker/download`; verified by grep of `caboodle.web/src` and `caboodle.admin/src`)
- **What it does:** Downloads every object under the folder prefix, rebuilds the tree on the API server's disk, zips it and streams `application/zip`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/download` | `RequireModule(files, files, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | query `directoryID` / file stream `{name}.zip` | `DirectoryDownloadRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/broker/download` | `RequireModule(null, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |

- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Uses a fixed working folder `AppDomain.BaseDirectory/FolderDownload` that is deleted in `finally`, so concurrent downloads interfere; the zip is read fully into memory; S3 listing capped at 1000 objects; `CreateSubdirectories` interpolates the GUID into SQL; any object without a matching `UserFiles` row raises a null reference that is reported as a 400 "Folder download".

#### 2.13.4 Feature: File upload

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Uploads files into the current folder of either area. The web always uses the chunked multipart route; a base64 single-request route also exists.
- **User flow:**
  1. "Upload" opens `DraggerFile` (antd `Dragger`, multiple files); files without a `.` in the name are dropped client-side.
  2. Files upload one after another in 6 MB chunks (`chunkSize = 1048576 * 6`); progress per file.
  3. On the last chunk the server completes the multipart upload, checks rules and quota, saves the row, returns `id`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/File/UploadChunkFileRequest.cs` | Chunk handler, key ownership check, rules |
| `.../File/UploadFileRequest.cs` | Base64 data-URL upload |
| `.../Helper/UploadDestination.cs` | Folder validation and S3 path |
| `.../Helper/FileUploadGuard.cs`, `FileUploadRules.cs`, `FileStorageQuota.cs`, `FileStorageCounter.cs` | Type, size, quota |
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageService.cs` | `UploadChunkAsync`, `UploadFileAsync` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/DraggerFile.tsx` | Chunk loop, folder upload |
| `caboodle.web/src/service/file-explorer.service.ts` | `uploadFileChunk`, `uploadFileChunkForBroker` |

- **Data:** new `UserFiles` row: `ID` parsed from the S3 key's file name, `Key`, `Url`, `Size` from S3 `GetObject` (chunk) or decoded bytes (base64), `UserId = area.RecordOwnerId(user)`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/files/upload/chunk` | `RequireModule(files, files, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | query `fileName`, `directory?`, `privacyType`, `chunkIndex` (1-based), `chunkMax`, `uploadId?`, `prevETags?`, `key?`, `fileSize?` (first chunk), raw body = chunk / `ChunkObjectDto` {`uploadId`, `key`, `eTag`, `isCompeleted`, `id`} | `UploadChunkFileRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/files/broker/upload/chunk` | `RequireModule(null, files, Create, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
| POST | `/api/v1/files/upload` | `RequireModule(files, files, Create)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `UploadFileRequest` {`fileName`, `privacyType`, `data` (data URL), `directoryID?`} / `UserFileInfoDTO` | `UploadFileRequestHandler` |
| POST | `/api/v1/files/broker/upload` | `RequireModule(null, files, Create, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |

  S3 objects: `CaboodleFiles/{brandId}/{folder path}{fileId}.{ext}` or `CaboodleFiles/Broker/{organizationId}/{folder path}{fileId}.{ext}`; multipart with `ContentType` from `FileContentTypeResolver`.
- **Business rules:**
  - Name = text before the first `.`, extension = text after the last `.` (`FileExportHelper.ExtractPartFromFileName`).
  - A continued chunk's `key` must start with the destination path and end in `{guid}.{ext}` (`IsKeyOf`), else 400 "The upload key doesn't belong to this upload."
  - Chunk route validation runs in the handler (the request is built from the query string): negative `fileSize` refused; type checked on every chunk; size and quota checked on chunk 1 when `fileSize` is sent; each chunk larger than the max file size refused.
- **Dependencies:** 2.13.4.3 rules; S3 multipart (`InitiateMultipartUpload`, `UploadPart`, `CompleteMultipartUpload`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** "Directory is not valid." (400); "File must have an extension." (validator, not run on the chunk route); S3 or chunk errors are rethrown as plain `Exception` "Chunk File Upload failed: ..." and reach the client as a generic 500; an abandoned multipart upload is never aborted.
- **Tests:** `.../File/UploadChunkFileRequestTests.cs`, `.../File/UploadFileRequestTests.cs`, `.../File/FileContentTypeResolverTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** A file named `Q1.Report.v2.pdf` is stored as name `Q1`, extension `pdf`. ETags travel as a comma string `part,etag,part,etag` in the query (`prevETags`).

##### 2.13.4.1 Sub-feature: Chunked multipart upload

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** See parent. The client sends `fileSize` only with chunk 1 and stops at the first error (`showErrorNotification`, row marked failed).

##### 2.13.4.2 Sub-feature: Single base64 upload

- **Status:** Partial (backend only: `FileExplorerService` has no caller of `files/upload` or `files/broker/upload`)
- **Business rules:** Size estimated from the base64 length before upload (`FileUploadRules.DecodedSize`); real size re-checked in `SaveAsync`.

##### 2.13.4.3 Sub-feature: Upload rules and storage quota

- **Status:** Active (no-ops until an organization has values: "With no values every file is allowed, as before", `FileUploadRules.cs`)
- **What it does:** Applies the area organization's Files module settings: allowed file types (`jpeg` aliased to `jpg`), maximum file size in MB, and a storage quota in GB per area.
- **Business rules:**
  - Settings read for `area.OwnerId` (the brand, or the brokerage), so brokers uploading to a brand count against the brand's quota.
  - `EnsureAllowedAsync` checks type, size, and quota without a lock before S3; `SaveAsync` re-checks size and runs the insert under `IQuotaGuard.RunAsync` (advisory lock, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Settings/IQuotaGuard.cs`); on refusal the S3 object is removed.
  - Usage = `SUM(Size)` of non-deleted `UserFiles` where `BrandID = org` or (`BrandID IS NULL AND UserId = org`) (`FileStorageCounter.AreaSql`).
- **Errors & edge cases:** "Only these file types can be uploaded: PDF, CSV." (400); "Each file can be up to N MB." (400); quota: `AppLimitReachedException` (409) "There isn't enough storage space left for this file. ..."
- **Tests:** `.../Helper/FileUploadGuardTests.cs`, `FileUploadRulesTests.cs`, `FileStorageQuotaTests.cs`, `RecordingQuotaGuard.cs`, `FilesSettings.cs`.

#### 2.13.5 Feature: File operations (download, rename, move, delete)

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Opens or downloads a file through a 6-hour presigned URL, renames it (extension locked), moves it between folders by drag and drop, and deletes it. Requires `files` View, Update or Delete.
- **User flow:**
  1. Click a file name: `GET files/download` returns the URL, which opens the preview modal (2.13.8). "Download" in the menu fetches the same URL and clicks a temporary anchor.
  2. Rename: modal shows the base name; the extension is re-appended; `PUT files/rename`.
  3. Move: drag a file onto a folder row, tile or tree node; confirm; `PUT files/move` {`directoryID`, `fileId`}.
  4. Delete: menu, confirm, `DELETE files/{id}`.
- **Code map:**

| Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/File/FileDownloadRequest.cs` | Presigned URL from `Key` (or decoded `Url`) |
| `.../File/UpdateFileRequest.cs` | Rename (DB only) |
| `.../File/FileMoveRequest.cs` | S3 copy + delete, set `DirectoryId`, `Url`, `Key` |
| `.../File/DeleteFileRequest.cs` | S3 delete then SQL hard delete |
| `.../Common/UserFileKeyResolver.cs` | `Key` first, else `S3KeyHelper.ExtractKeyFromUrl(Url)` |
| `caboodle.web/src/components/file-upload/FileRowActions.tsx`, `DraggableFile.tsx` | File menus (Download, Copy URL, Rename, Delete) |
| `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts` | `useDownload(ForBroker)`, `useRenameFile(ForBroker)`, `useMoveFile(ForBroker)`, `useDeleteFile(ForBroker)` |
- **Data:** `UserFiles`.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/files/download` | `RequireModule(files, files, View)` + `BrandIDHeader` | query `fileId` / string (presigned URL) | `FileDownloadRequestHandler` |
| GET | `/api/v1/files/broker/download` | `RequireModule(null, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
| PUT | `/api/v1/files/rename` | `RequireModule(files, files, Update)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `UpdateFileRequest` {`fileID`, `fileName`} / `UserFileInfoDTO` {`id`, `name`} | `UpdateFileRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/files/broker/rename` | `RequireModule(null, files, Update, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
| PUT | `/api/v1/files/move` | `RequireModule(files, files, Update)` + `BrandIDHeader` | `FileMoveRequest` {`directoryID?`, `fileId`} / `ResponseDto` (400 when `IsSuccess` false) | `FileMoveRequestHandler` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/files/broker/move` | `RequireModule(null, files, Update, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/files/{id:guid}` | `RequireModule(files, files, Delete)` + `BrandIDHeader` | path `id` / `ResponseDto` (400 when `IsSuccess` false) | `DeleteFileRequestHandler` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/files/broker/{id:guid}` | `RequireModule(null, files, Delete, OrganizationLevel)` | same | same |
- **Business rules:**
  - Download URL: `attachment` disposition, file name `name.ext`, content type from extension, lifetime 6 hours (`DefaultDownloadUrlLifetime`).
  - Rename refuses a changed extension ("You can't update file extension"); the S3 key does not change (it is the file ID).
  - Move target must exist, be visible, not deleted, and have the file's privacy; `DirectoryID = null` moves to the root.
  - Delete removes the S3 object at the path computed from the current folder chain, and only then deletes the row; `responseValue != 1` gives 400.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** 404 "File not found!" / "File not found"; "Stored file location is invalid." when no key can be derived; `CopyObjectAsync` S3 errors become `InvalidOperationException` (500).
- **Tests:** `.../File/FileDownloadRequestTests.cs`, `FileMoveRequestTests.cs`, `UpdateFileRequestTests.cs`, `DeleteFileRequestTests.cs`, `.../Share/UserFileKeyResolverTests.cs`; `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageServiceTests.cs` (content-type override).
- **Gotchas / tech debt:**
  - Delete is a hard SQL delete; `UserFiles` rows never become soft-deleted by this module (comment in `FileStorageCounter.cs`).
  - Delete derives the S3 path from folder names rather than the stored `Key`; if they diverge (2.13.3 pagination gap), the object stays in S3.
  - CS-1795 on master sets `existingFile.Key = fileUploadresult.Key` in `FileMoveRequest`; the working branch sets `existingFile.Key = destinationPath` (same value).
  - The web `downloadRow` calls `window.URL.revokeObjectURL` on an https URL (no effect).

#### 2.13.6 Feature: Search

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Name search (case-insensitive `ILIKE`, `%` and `_` escaped) over folders and files of the current area and privacy, optionally limited to the subtree of the folder being viewed (CS-1494).
- **User flow:**
  1. Search box submits; the URL gets `searchString` (and keeps `directoryID`).
  2. `GET directory/search?name=&privacyType=&directoryID=` with `BrandID` header on brand pages, none on the broker page.
  3. Results show a "Location" column linking to the parent folder ("My Drive" for root).
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/Directory/GetDirectoriesAndFilesByNameRequest.cs`; `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts` (`useGetSearchedFilesAndFolders`); `caboodle.web/src/service/directory.service.ts` (`getSearchedFilesAndFolders`).
- **Data:** `SearchResponseDTO` {`directories: DirectorySummeryDTO[]` (ID, Name, ParentDirectoryID, ParentDirectoryName, dates), `files: FileSummeryDTO[]` (ID, `name.ext`, Size string, Url, DirectoryID, DirectoryName)}.
- **APIs/interfaces:**

| Method | Path | Access rule | Request / Response | Handler |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/directory/search` | `RequireModule(files, files, View, OrganizationLevel)` | query `name`, `privacyType`, `brandID?` (ignored), `directoryID?` / `SearchResponseDTO` | `GetDirectoriesAndFilesByNameRequestHandler` |
- **Business rules:** Area from `FileRepositoryArea.ForSharedRequest`: active brand, else a Brand company's own brand, else the brokerage. With `directoryID`, a recursive CTE scoped by the same ownership predicate limits results; the anchor folder itself is excluded from folder results, files directly inside it are included. A stale or foreign `directoryID` returns 200 with empty lists.
- **Dependencies:** Not verified.
- **Errors & edge cases:** Empty search text: 400 "Search field cannot be empty. Please provide a value."
- **Tests:** `.../Directory/GetDirectoriesAndFilesByNameRequestTests.cs`; web `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/service/directorySearch.service.test.ts`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The `brandID` query parameter is bound but unused (the web comment in `directory.service.ts` confirms). `FileSummeryModel.Size` is `int` while `UserFile.Size` is `long`. React Query key reuses `QueryKeys.getFilesAndFolders` with different parameters.

#### 2.13.7 Feature: Share links

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** "Copy URL" mints an opaque, revocable token link (`{ApiBaseUrl}/share/{token}`) instead of exposing a presigned S3 URL; anyone holding the link is redirected to a 15-minute presigned URL. Requires `files` Export (brand) or company-level `files` Export (brokerage). Public files only.
- **User flow:**
  1. Copy URL in the row menu, tile menu, or preview modal (shown only when `canCopyShareLink(privacyType) && canExport`).
  2. `POST files/share` (or `files/broker/share`) with `{fileID}` only (no expiry from the UI).
  3. `response.data.url` goes to the clipboard (`copyFileUrlToClipboard`), toast "Copied".

##### 2.13.7.1 Sub-feature: Create share link (Copy URL)

- **Status:** Active
- **Business rules:** A request without expiry reuses the file's active never-expiring link (`GetActiveFileShareLinkSpec`); a dated link is always new. The web never sends `expiresInDays` (`buildCreateShareLinkRequest` omits invalid values). No success toast from the mutation; the clipboard helper reports the outcome.

##### 2.13.7.2 Sub-feature: Revoke share link

- **Status:** Partial (backend and hooks only: `useRevokeShareLink` / `useRevokeBrokerShareLink` in `caboodle.web/src/hooks/directory.ts` have no component caller)
- **Business rules:** The caller must be able to see the linked file in the area (else 404 "Share link not found!"); an already revoked link returns 200 "Share link was already revoked."; sets `RevokedOn`, `RevokedBy`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** The web comment on `describeRevokeShareLinkResult` says an unknown token answers 200; the handler throws 404 for an unknown token.

##### 2.13.7.3 Sub-feature: Public share resolution

- **Status:** Active
- **Business rules:** Unknown, revoked, expired, deleted-file and now-private cases all answer 404 "This link is no longer available."; each resolve increments `AccessCount` and sets `LastAccessedOn`; disposition `inline` unless `?download=true`; presigned lifetime 15 minutes. The controller is outside the versioned prefix so links stay valid across API versions.

##### 2.13.7.4 Sub-feature: Share link expiry settings

- **Status:** Active (defaults apply when unset)
- **Business rules:** Settings of the area organization: `allow-never-expiring-links` (default true), `default-share-link-expiry` ("never" or days), `share-link-max-expiry-days` (default 3650). Requested expiry above the maximum: 400; no request and a default: `min(default, max)`; no default and never-expiring not allowed: the maximum.

#### 2.13.9 Feature: S3 storage layout and object keys

- **Status:** Active
- **What it does:** Defines where objects live and how a row points at its object. New rows store `Key`; legacy rows only have `Url` and are resolved by decoding the URL path (`S3KeyHelper.ExtractKeyFromUrl`) until the admin backfill (2.15.5) runs.
- **User flow:** Not verified.
- **Code map:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageService.cs`, `.../AwsS3Provider.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/S3KeyHelper.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/FileRepository/Modules.FileRepository.Application/Common/UserFileKeyResolver.cs`, `.../File/FileContentTypeResolver.cs`.
- **Data:** Key layout `CaboodleFiles/{brandId}/{FolderA}/{FolderB}/{fileId}.{ext}` and `CaboodleFiles/Broker/{organizationId}/...` (`Constants.CABOODLEFILES`, `CABOODLEBROKERFILES`).
- **APIs/interfaces:** Not verified.
- **Business rules:** `Url` is produced by `GetFileUrl(key, client)`: a 20-year presign with the query string stripped, i.e. an unsigned object URL. Presigned download URLs use HTTPS and `ResponseHeaderOverrides` for disposition and content type.
- **Dependencies:** `AwsSettings` (access key, secret, bucket, CDN URL); region hard-coded `RegionEndpoint.APNortheast1` in `AwsS3Provider`.

- **Tests:** `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Infrastructure.Test/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageServiceTests.cs`, `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/Admin.Application.Test/FileKeyBackfill/S3KeyHelperTests.cs`.
- **Gotchas / tech debt:** Folder names are part of every key, so renaming or moving a folder rewrites all keys under it (2.13.3). `LocalFileStorageService` exists but does not implement `IFileStorageService`. The static file middleware in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/Startup.cs` serves a local `Files` folder, unrelated to S3.

### 2.14 Module: DataHub

- **Purpose:** Platform-admin data quality and master data unification for distributor sales data (KeHE, UNFI; SPINS only partly). It pulls distributor files (crawler sync), maps every raw row on three dimensions (retailer, customer/store, UPC) into "mapped" sales tables or "unmapped" review tables, keeps the master Store List clean (geocoding, matching, merge, issues, multi-step clean-up), runs entity resolution (unified entities and aliases), stores distributor portal credentials, hosts the shared async export/import job tables, and offers destructive maintenance (brand data cleanup, KeHE zero-quantity cleanup). All UI is in `caboodle.admin`; the customer app only consumes its results (Store List IDs on sales rows) and the shared `Export` endpoints.
- **Key paths:**
  - Backend controllers: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataHub/DataHubController.cs` (91 endpoints, route `api/v1/datahub`), `EntityResolutionController.cs` (13, `api/v1/entityresolution`), `CredentialManagerController.cs` (6, `api/v1/credentialmanager`), `ExportController.cs` (4, `api/v1/export`). Route prefix comes from `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/VersionedApiController.cs` (`api/v{version}/[controller]`).
  - Store List CRUD/import handlers live in DataHub but are routed by the CRM controller `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/CRM/StoresController.cs` (`api/v1/stores/store-list*`).
  - Application: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Application/` (folders `AdminDashboard`, `BrandDataCleanup`, `CredentialManager`, `EntityResolution`, `Export`, `KeHeQuantityCleanup`, `MappedRecords`, `RetailerMatching`, `StoreCleanup`, `StoreList`, `StoreMatching`, `SyncMechanism`, `UpcMapping`; DI in `Startup.cs`).
  - Domain: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Domain/`.
  - Infrastructure that DataHub depends on but lives in Shared: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/DataSync/DataSyncJobService.cs`, `.../Services/SharedDataService/SharedDataHubService.cs` (row mapping), `.../Services/Export/ExportJobService.cs` and `AdminExportJobService.cs`, `.../Services/Import/ImportJobService.cs`, `.../Services/CredentialCrypto/CredentialCryptoService.cs`, EF mapping in `.../Persistence/MainDbContext.cs` (schema `DataHub`).
