## 3. Cross-Cutting Concerns

Paths are relative to the three repo folders. Secrets and configuration values are not reproduced; keys are named only.

### 3.1 Auth and permissions (pipeline only)

Detail of roles, `/me/access`, module gating and org permissions lives in modules 2.1 and 2.2. This section only shows where each check sits in the request path.

Backend request pipeline, in order (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Startup.cs` `UseInfrastructure`, then `MapEndpoints`):

| # | Stage | File | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `UseRequestLocalization` (+ `LocalizationMiddleware` when `MiddlewareSettings:EnableLocalization`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Localization/Startup.cs` | Default culture `en-US` |
| 2 | `UseStaticFiles`, `UseSecurityHeaders`, `UseFileStorage` (`/Files` from the `Files` folder) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/SecurityHeaders/Startup.cs`, `FileStorage/Startup.cs` | See 3.14 for a header binding defect |
| 3 | `ExceptionMiddleware` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/ExceptionMiddleware.cs` | Maps exceptions to status + error envelope (3.2) |
| 4 | `UseRouting`, `UseCors("CorsPolicy")` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Cors/Startup.cs` | Any origin, header, method |
| 5 | `UseAuthentication` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Startup.cs` | JWT bearer (`SecuritySettings:Provider` = `Jwt` in all environment files) or Azure AD when `Provider` = `AzureAd`. JWT: symmetric key, issuer/audience not validated, `ClockSkew` zero, `OnChallenge` throws a 401 envelope, token read from `?access_token=` only for `/notifications` (`Auth/Jwt/Startup.cs`) |
| 6 | `CurrentUserMiddleware` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/CurrentUserMiddleware.cs` | Loads the principal; parses `BrandID` header (invalid GUID is flagged, not rejected here) and `OrganizationID` header |
| 7 | `UseAuthorization` | policies from `PermissionPolicyProvider` | Runs `[MustHavePermission]` (`Auth/Permissions`), `[RequireOrgPermission]` (`Auth/OrgPermissions`, policy prefix `org:`), `[RequireModule]` (`Auth/Modules`, policy prefix `module:`). A refusal is rendered by `AccessForbiddenResultHandler` as 403 `PermissionDeniedException` under key `Access`, or 400 `ValidatorException` when the refusal is a bad request (missing/unparsable `BrandID`) (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/AccessForbiddenResultHandler.cs`) |
| 8 | `RequestLoggingMiddleware` (when `MiddlewareSettings:EnableHttpsLogging`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/RequestLoggingMiddleware.cs` | 3.3 |
| 9 | `BrandValidationMiddleware` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/BrandValidationMiddleware.cs` | For an authenticated request with a `BrandID` header: invalid GUID writes 400 `Invalid BrandID.`; `ADMIN` passes; otherwise the brand must be in the legacy role lists (BrandBrokers / Brands.UserID / BrandSubUsers) **or** in the caller's organization access (`IAccessContext`), else 403 `PermisionDeniedException` |
| 10 | Hangfire dashboard, Swagger UI | 3.7, 3.10 | |
| 11 | `MapControllers().RequireAuthorization()` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Startup.cs` `MapEndpoints` | Every controller action needs an authenticated user unless it carries `[AllowAnonymous]` |

Front ends:
- Web: NextAuth session (`caboodle.web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/options.ts`); the token is copied into `caboodle.web/src/httpClient/sessionToken.ts` by `SessionTokenSync` (in `AuthProvider`) and by `AxiosInterceptor({session})` in the `(brand)`, `(broker)` and `(company)` layouts. Server layouts call `serverSessionCheck` (`caboodle.web/src/helper/serverSession.helper.ts`). There is no `middleware.ts`. Route gating is client side: `AccessRedirectGuard` (no company to `/onboarding`, platform admin to `/use-admin-app`) and `ModuleRouteGuard` (silent redirect to the landing route) mounted in `caboodle.web/src/components/AppContainer.tsx`.
- Admin: `getServerSession` in `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/layout.tsx` redirects to `/` when there is no session or `session.error === "RefreshAccessTokenError"`; `AuthSessionWatcher` keeps the in-memory token and schedules refresh (`caboodle.admin/src/component/AuthSessionWatcher.tsx`).

### 3.2 Error handling

Backend exception to status mapping (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Middleware/ExceptionMiddleware.cs`):

| Exception | Status | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `AppValidationException`, `BadHttpRequestException` | 400 | Validation types carry a pre-serialized envelope as their message |
| `AppEntityNotFoundException`, `KeyNotFoundException` | 404 | |
| `AppUnauthorizeException`, `UnauthorizedAccessException` | 401 | |
| `AppForbiddenException` | 403 | |
| `AppConflictException`, `AppLimitReachedException` | 409 | |
| `CustomException` subclasses (`BadRequestException`, `NotFoundException`, `ConflictException`, `ForbiddenException`, `UnauthorizedException`, `InternalServerException` in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Common/Exceptions`) | the exception's `StatusCode` | Envelope built from the .NET type name and message |
| anything else | 500 | Generic `InternalServerException`, "Something went wrong. Internal server error." (message hidden) |

- The `App*` exceptions are thrown through `ErrorHelper` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Error/ErrorHelper.cs`): `ThrowValidatorException(key, msg)` (400 `ValidatorException`), `Throw404Exception`, `Throw401Exception`, `ThrowForbiddenException`, `ThrowAccessDeniedException(key, msg)` (403 `PermissionDeniedException`), `ThrowConflictException` (409 `ConflictException`), `ThrowLimitReachedException` (409 `LimitReachedException`). Each serializes the envelope into the exception message, which the middleware writes back verbatim.
- Envelope (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/DTOs/ErrorDTO.cs`): `{ error: { logID, statusCode, type, messages: { <Key>: <text> } } }`. Default key is `Generic`.
- Model validation: controllers use `AddFluentValidation()` with `InvalidModelStateResponseFactory = ValidationErrorHelper.ValidationResponse` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Program.cs`), so FluentValidation failures become 400 `ValidatorException` with one message per field, multiple messages joined by `, ` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Error/ValidationErrorHelper.cs`). Validators are registered per module with `AddValidatorsFromAssembly`. There is no MediatR pipeline behavior (no `IPipelineBehavior` in the solution): validators run at model binding, not inside `Mediator.Send`.
- `ErrorMessageHelper.ExtractPlainMessage` turns a serialized envelope back into plain text when a message is stored or shown to a user (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Error/ErrorMessageHelper.cs`).

Web (`caboodle.web`):
- `AxiosInterceptor.tsx` rejects with `error.response` (not the AxiosError), so callers read `error.data.error.messages`. A 401 gets one single-flight refresh through `getSession()` and one retry, then `signOut`; a 403 never signs out.
- `caboodle.web/src/helper/apiError.helper.ts`: `readApiError`, `apiMessageEntries`, `firstApiMessage`, `apiMessageFor`, `hasApiMessage`, predicates `isUnauthorized`, `isAccessDenied`, `isOrganizationSelectionRequired`, `isStaleOrganization`, `isNoOrganization`, `isLimitReached`, `isNotFound`, and `readFetchErrorMessage` for raw-`fetch` exports.
- `caboodle.web/src/helper/helper.ts` `showErrorNotification`: one toast per message key; 409 limit becomes a "Limit reached" warning; no messages gives `GENERIC_ERROR_TEXT`.
- `caboodle.web/src/helper/notification.helper.ts` `openNotification`: antd notification, `topRight`, top offset `TOAST_TOP` 76, `maxCount` 5, durations success 4 s, info 5 s, warning 7 s, error 10 s; a title equal to the type name is replaced by the message (`resolveToastContent`).
- `caboodle.web/src/hooks/useApiErrorHandler.ts` routes a stale company to a `/me/access` refetch and "no company" to `/onboarding`.

Admin (`caboodle.admin`):
- `caboodle.admin/src/httpClient/authErrorInterceptor.ts`: 401 triggers one single-flight refresh via `AuthClientService.triggerRefresh`, then replays; skips `/api/v1/admin/login`, `/api/v1/auth/refresh-token`, `/api/v1/auth/logout` and `/api/auth/*`; terminal failure calls `AuthSessionService.logout`.
- `caboodle.admin/src/helper/helper.ts` `showErrorNotification`, `getForbiddenReason`; `caboodle.admin/src/helper/notification.ts` `openNotification` (`topRight`, per-type durations).

### 3.3 Logging

- Bootstrap logger: `StaticLogger.EnsureInitialized` writes to Console until configuration loads (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Common/StaticLogger.cs`).
- Host logger: `builder.Host.UseSerilog(... WriteTo.Console().ReadFrom.Configuration(...))` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Program.cs`).
- Sinks from `Serilog:WriteTo` (sink names only): Development has `File` (JSON formatter, daily roll under `Logs/`, 5 files kept) and `Seq`; Staging and Production have `Seq` only. Console is always added in code. Enrichers: `FromLogContext`, `WithMachineName`, `WithProcessId`, `WithThreadId`, `WithHangfireContext`.
- Level filters (`Serilog:MinimumLevel`): Default `Information`; overrides `Microsoft` `Error`, `Microsoft.Hosting.Lifetime` `Information`, `System` `Information`, and `Hangfire` `Warning` (Development and Staging only; Production has no Hangfire override).
- Packages referenced but not configured in any environment file: `Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch`, `Serilog.Sinks.MSSqlServer`, `Serilog.Sinks.Async` (package list of `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Infrastructure.csproj`).
- Error logging: `ExceptionMiddleware` and `ValidationErrorHelper` call `LoggerHelper.SaveLog` with the user id, `logID` and stack trace (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Logger/LoggerHelper.cs`). The `logID` in the response matches the log line.
- Request logging (`RequestLoggingMiddleware`, on in all environments via `MiddlewareSettings:EnableHttpsLogging`): logs user id, path, method, query and headers. Headers `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Cookie` and query keys `access_token`, `token`, `refreshToken`, `code` are replaced with `[Redacted]`. The JSON body is buffered and read, but it is not written to the log (`requestBody` is never added to `RequestLogDTO`). `ResponseLoggingMiddleware` exists but its registration is commented out.
- Hangfire: `LogJobFilter` logs job creation, start, completion, state changes and failures through Hangfire's `LogProvider` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/LogJobFilter.cs`); `UseConsole()` enables Hangfire.Console output.
- EF Core: `BaseDbContext.OnConfiguring` calls `EnableSensitiveDataLogging()` unconditionally (TODO comment says development only) (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Context/BaseDbContext.cs`).
- Email audit: every outbound mail is stored in `Email.EmailLoggers`; one-time codes and links are masked in the stored copy (`SmtpMailService` `MaskSecrets`), and `EmailResendJob` refuses to resend a masked log.

### 3.5 Internationalization

- Backend: `JsonStringLocalizerFactory` reads `Localization/{culture}.json` from the working directory (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Localization/JsonStringLocalizer.cs`); 21 culture files ship in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Localization`. Request culture defaults to `en-US`. `IStringLocalizer<T>` is injected in only five places (`ExceptionMiddleware`, `UserService`, `TokenService`, `RoleService`, `CreateUserRequestValidator`); the files contain template keys such as `tenant.invalid`. Business messages in modules are hardcoded English. Status: inherited scaffolding, effectively English-only.
- Web and admin: no i18n library in either `package.json` and no locale files; all copy is inline English (web `CLAUDE.md` also states "There is no i18n in this repo"). `<html lang="en">` in both root layouts.

| Access snapshot | key `iam:access:{userId}`, 5 min, revalidated against per-organization version keys `iam:access-version:{organizationId}` (1 day, seeded with current ticks) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Access/AccessContextService.cs`, `AccessVersion.cs` |

| Web React Query | `new QueryClient()` with no default options in `AppContainer` and in the `(onboarding)` layout, so v4 defaults apply (retry 3, `staleTime` 0, refetch on focus) unless a hook overrides. ### 3.7 Background jobs

Setup (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/Startup.cs`):
- `AddHangfireServer` bound to `HangfireSettings:Server` (queues `default` and `notdefault`, `WorkerCount` 1 in all environment files). No job uses `[Queue]`, so everything runs on `default` with one worker per API process.
- Storage PostgreSQL via `UsePostgreSqlStorage` with `HangfireSettings:Storage:Options`; startup throws if provider or connection string is empty.
- `CaboodleJobActivator` creates a DI scope per job and restores the current user id from the job parameter `QueryStringKeys.UserId` when present. `CaboodleJobFilter` (which would stamp that parameter) is commented out of the registration, so jobs run without a current user unless the payload carries one.
- Global filter `LogJobFilter`; `UseConsole()`.
- Dashboard at `HangfireSettings:Route` (`/jobs` in all environment files) protected by `HangfireCustomBasicAuthenticationFilter` with `HangfireSettings:Credentials`.

Enqueue abstractions:
- `IJobService` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Application/Common/Interfaces/IJobService.cs`, `ITransientService`) implemented by `HangfireService` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/HangfireService.cs`): `Enqueue`, `Schedule`, `Delete`, `Requeue` wrappers over `BackgroundJob`.
- `IBackgroundJobDispatcher` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Application/Interfaces/IBackgroundJobDispatcher.cs`) implemented by `BackgroundJobDispatcher` (`.../Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/BackgroundJob/BackgroundJobDispatcher.cs`): one method, `CreateBannerSkus`, which enqueues `ISharedDataService.CreateBannerSkusAsync`; used by `UpsertProductSpecRequest` and `ImportProductsRequest`.
- `EmailResendJob` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/EmailResendJob.cs`) enqueued by `ResendEmailsRequest` (Admin).

Recurring jobs (complete list; found by searching for `RecurringJob.` and `IRecurringJobManager`):

| Job id | Schedule (UTC) | Target | Registered by | When registered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `soft-delete-purge-daily` | `{m} {h} * * *` from `SoftDeletePurgeSetting.ScheduleTimeUtc`, default 02:00 | `ISoftDeletePurgeJobExecutor.ExecuteAsync` (`[DisableConcurrentExecution(86400)]`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/SoftDeletePurge/SoftDeletePurgeJobRegistrar.cs` | On app start via hosted service `SoftDeletePurgeRecurringJobInitializer`, and again when settings change (`Settings/UpdateSoftDeletePurgeSettingsRequest.cs`) |

| `store-cleanup-nightly-relink` | `StoreCleanup:NightlyRelinkCron` (`0 7 * * *` in the files) | `IStoreCleanupNightlyRelinkJob.RunAsync` (`[AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 0)]`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Application/StoreCleanup/Nightly/StoreCleanupNightlyRelinkJobRegistrar.cs` via `StoreCleanupNightlyRelinkJobInitializer` | On start; removed when `NightlyRelinkEnabled` is false, which it is in all three environment files (**Feature-flagged, off**) |

### 3.8 Data access and migrations

| Piece | Detail | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `ApplicationDbContext : BaseDbContext : IdentityDbContext<ApplicationUser, ApplicationRole, ...>` | Identity tables + `AuditTrails`. `OnModelCreating` adds a global soft-delete filter `DeletedOn == null` for every `ISoftDelete`. `SaveChangesAsync` stamps `CreatedBy/LastModifiedBy/LastModifiedOn`, converts a delete of an `ISoftDelete` into an update of `DeletedOn/DeletedBy`, writes `Trail` audit rows, then publishes domain events | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Context/BaseDbContext.cs` |
| `MainDbContext : DbContext` | All module tables (about 121 `DbSet`s), explicit `ToTable(name, SchemaNames.X)`, partial indexes filtered on `"Deleted" = FALSE`. No `SaveChanges` override and no global query filter: soft delete is a `Deleted` boolean that handlers set (`Deleted = true` appears in 29 module files) and SQL filters (`"Deleted" = false`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs` |
| Entity base | `AuditableEntity` (`ID` from `NewId`, `CreatedBy`, `CreatedOn`, `LastModifiedBy`, `LastModifiedOn`, `DeletedOn`, `DeletedBy`, `Deleted`) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Domain/Common/Contracts/AuditableEntity.cs`, `BaseEntity.cs` |

### 3.9 File storage and email

File storage (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage`):
- `IFileStorageService` -> `AwsS3StorageService` (registered by the `ITransientService` scan): `UploadProfileImageAsync`, `UploadFileAsync`, `UploadStreamAsync`, `UploadChunkAsync` (chunked imports), `DownloadAsync`, `GetFileUrl` (presigned HTTPS GET with content disposition and expiry), `GetPublicCdnUrl` (`AwsSettings:BucketSettings:S3CdnUrl`), `CopyObjectAsync`, `GetObjectByKey`, `GetObjectsWithPrefix`, `RemoveAsync`, `DeleteObjectsWithPrefixAsync`, `MoveFolderObjectAsync`.
- Region fixed to `ap-northeast-1` in `AwsS3Provider`. Key helpers in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/S3KeyHelper.cs`.
- `LocalFileStorageService` exists but does not implement `IFileStorageService` and has no caller. `UseFileStorage` serves the API's local `Files` folder at `/Files`.
- Master drift (CS-1795): on `origin/master`, `MoveFolderObjectAsync` returns `IList<FileUploadResult>` and `AwsS3StorageService.cs` changed (11 lines) so a move keeps keys in sync; owner module 2.13 File Repository.

Email (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Mailing`):
- `IMailService` -> `SmtpMailService`: SMTP over SSL with `MailSettings`; headers for the email log id, environment and SES configuration set; every send logged to `Email.EmailLoggers` with secrets masked.
- Templates: `EmailTemplate` entity (`Name`, `Subject`, `Body`, `Module`) loaded by `EmailModule` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Domain/Email/EmailTemplate.cs`). `EmailModule` values 1 to 15: `ResetPassword`, `EmailVerify`, `InviteUserToCreateAccount`, `InviteBrandSubUserToCreateAccount`, `InviteBrokerSubUserToCreateAccount`, `AccountStatusUpdate`, `ActivityMention`, `InviteBrandOwnerToCreateAccount`, `BannerActivityMention`, `UserInvite`, `CategoryReviewCalenderAssigned`, `SoftDeletePurgeReport`, `BrandReportNotify`, `SignupVerificationCode`, `OrganizationInvitation` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/Enums.cs`). Template rows are inserted by migrations (bodies in `Migrator/Migrations/Templates/*.cs`). Some bodies are built inline (`SendDataSyncSummaryEmailAsync`).
- SES feedback: `POST /api/v1/webhooks/sns-email-events` (anonymous) -> `ProcessSnsEmailEventRequest` validates the SNS signature, confirms subscriptions by GET on `SubscribeURL`, and records events in `SnsEventLog` via `SesEmailEventProcessor` (which also checks `SnsSettings:AwsSendingAccountId`).
- `MailKit`/`MimeKit` are referenced but the send path uses `System.Net.Mail`.

### 3.10 API conventions

- Routes: controllers derive from `VersionedApiController` with `[Route("api/v{version:apiVersion}/[controller]")]` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/VersionedApiController.cs`); `AddRouting(LowercaseUrls = true)`; API versioning default 1.0, assumed when unspecified, versions reported (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Startup.cs` `AddApiVersioning`). Many controllers override `[Route]` (for example `webhooks/sns-email-events`). Handlers are invoked through `Mediator.Send` (`BaseApiController.Mediator`).
- JSON: System.Text.Json camelCase for responses; no `JsonStringEnumConverter`, so enums travel as integers. String enums appear only where a DTO declares string fields (the web notes the `/me/access` payload as the exception).
- Enum numbering: newer enums use spaced values 5/10/15 (for example `BrandReportStatusColumnType`, `ImportJobStatus` 5, 7, 10, 15, 17, 20, 25, `ImportOutcome` 5/10/15, `OrganizationBackfillMode` 5/10/15); older enums are sequential (`SkuStatus` 1 to 7, `ModuleType` 1 to 35+, `EmailModule` 1 to 15). `ModuleActions` is a bit flag set (View 1, Create 2, Update 4, Delete 8, Import 16, Export 32) (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Enums/OrganizationEnums.cs`).
- Paging: response `PagedData<T> { data, meta }` with `PagedMeta { totalCount, pageSize, currentPage, totalPage, hasPreviousPage, hasNextPage }`; `Paging` sets `totalPage` to 1 when `pageSize == -1` (all-rows sentinel) (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/DTOs/PagingDTOs.cs`). Requests carry `pageSize`, `currentPage`, `sortingOrder`, `sortKey` by convention.
- Write responses: `ResponseMetaDTO { message }`, `ResponseMessageDTO { id, message }`, `ResponseIdsDTO { message, ids }`, `FileUploadResponseMetaDTO { success, message, file }` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/DTOs/ResponseMetaDTO.cs`).
- Swagger / OpenAPI: NSwag (`AddOpenApiDocument`, `UseOpenApi`, `UseSwaggerUi3`) when `SwaggerSettings:Enable` (true in Development, Staging and Production); bearer security scheme (or OAuth2 PKCE for Azure AD); FluentValidation rules feed the schema (`ZymLabs.NSwag.FluentValidation`); `SwaggerHeaderAttribute` / `BrandIdHeaderAttribute` add header parameters (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/OpenApi/*`). NSwag default paths `/swagger` and `/swagger/v1/swagger.json` (no path override in code).
- CORS: one policy `CorsPolicy`, `AllowAnyOrigin().AllowAnyHeader().AllowAnyMethod()`; `WithOrigins(...)` and `AllowCredentials()` are commented out, so the `CorsSettings` origins are parsed and ignored (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Cors/Startup.cs`).
- Health: `GET /api/health`, anonymous, no checks registered (always healthy while the process answers).
- Headers: `BrandID` (single-brand routes), `OrganizationID` (selected company), `Authorization`.

CDN `<link>`s for Mapbox GL CSS and animate.css; CDN `<script>` for `ag-grid-community` (unversioned URL) |

Counts: 35 files import the interceptor instance, 21 import `httpClient`, 18 use `fetchWithMock` |

### 3.14 Security notes (verified)

| # | Finding | Evidence | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Real secrets are committed: the tracked `appsettings.Development.json`, `.Staging.json`, `.Production.json` hold non-empty AWS access/secret keys, JWT signing key, master password, SMTP password, credential encryption key, OTP HMAC key, Hangfire dashboard credentials, Geocoding key, LLM API keys (Dev/Staging) and database connection strings with passwords | `git ls-files caboodle/src/Hosts/API` lists all four files | High: anyone with repo access has production credentials |
| 2 | Front-end env files are tracked: all 6 web and 4 admin `.env.*` files; admin `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` is set in all four; web `NEXT_PUBLIC_JWT_SECRET` is set in all six and, as a `NEXT_PUBLIC_` value, would be inlined into the browser bundle if read (it is not read anywhere) | `git ls-files` in both repos | Medium |
| 3 | Web `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` exists only in `.env.dev.backend`; production builds use `.env.production`, which lacks it, while `options.ts` passes `secret: process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET` | `caboodle.web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/options.ts` | NextAuth v4 refuses to run without a secret in production, or the runtime environment must supply it; unverified which |
| 4 | CORS allows any origin (allow-list code commented out) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Cors/Startup.cs` | Medium (bearer tokens, no cookies, limits impact) |
| 5 | Security headers are not emitted: `SecurityHeaderSettings` binds `XFrameOptions` etc. at the section root, but every appsettings file nests them under `Headers`, so all values bind as null | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/SecurityHeaders/SecurityHeaderSettings.cs` vs appsettings shape | Medium |
| 6 | Swagger UI is enabled in Production (`SwaggerSettings:Enable` true) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/OpenApi/Startup.cs` | Low to medium (full API map public) |
| 7 | JWT validation does not check issuer or audience; `RequireHttpsMetadata = false` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Auth/Jwt/Startup.cs` | Low with one issuer |
| 8 | Seeded platform admin `admin@caboodle.com` created with a hardcoded weak password on any database that lacks it | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Initialization/ApplicationDbSeeder.cs` `SeedAdminUserAsync` | High on a fresh environment until changed |
| 9 | Anonymous endpoints beyond auth: `POST /api/v1/datahub/import/unified/retailer`, `POST /api/v1/datahub/import/unified/store` (file uploads), `POST /api/v1/datahub/health/crawler`, `POST /api/v1/datahub/validate-mapping-status`, plus the SNS webhook (signature checked) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataHub/DataHubController.cs`, `Webhooks/SnsEmailWebhookController.cs` | Medium (owner: DataHub module) |
| 10 | `EnableSensitiveDataLogging()` is always on for `ApplicationDbContext` | `BaseDbContext.OnConfiguring` | Low to medium (parameter values in EF logs) |
| 11 | Hangfire dashboard protected only by basic auth with committed credentials | `BackgroundJobs/Startup.cs`, finding 1 | Medium |
| 12 | Web `next.config.js` allows `next/image` from any HTTPS host (`domains: ["*"]`, `remotePatterns` `**`); admin allows any host on http and https | `caboodle.web/next.config.js`, `caboodle.admin/next.config.js` | Low to medium (image optimizer can be used as an open proxy) |
| 13 | Web root layout loads `ag-grid-community` from jsDelivr with no version and no integrity hash | `caboodle.web/src/app/layout.tsx` | Medium (supply chain) |
| 14 | `docker-compose.yml` commits default Postgres and pgAdmin passwords | `caboodle.backend/docker-compose.yml` | Low (local only) |
| 15 | Request logging redacts auth headers and token query keys; mail logs mask one-time codes | `RequestLoggingMiddleware`, `SmtpMailService` | Mitigation |
| 16 | A 670 MB database dump sits in the backend working tree root; it is excluded only through `.git/info/exclude` (local), not `.gitignore` | `caboodle.backend/caboodle_develop_backup_*.sql` | Medium if the local exclude is lost |

## 4. Feature Dependency Matrix

Rows depend on columns. `X` marks a direct code or data dependency (a module reads or writes the other module's tables, calls its services or endpoints, or reuses its components). Every module also depends on 2.1 (authentication) and 2.2 (authorization through `[RequireModule]`, `[RequireOrgPermission]` and `IAccessContext`); the 2.2 column is marked only where a module also uses 2.2 data or settings beyond request authorization (quotas, module settings, connections, memberships).

| Depends on: | 2.1 | 2.2 | 2.3 | 2.4 | 2.5 | 2.6 | 2.7 | 2.8 | 2.9 | 2.10 | 2.11 | 2.12 | 2.13 | 2.14 | 2.15 |

Notes on the main edges (detail and paths are in each module's "Cross-module dependencies" field):

| Edge | Why |
|---|---|
| 2.1 to 2.3 | Legacy invitations and sub-users read and write `Brand.Brands.UserID`, `Brand.BrandSubUsers`, `Brand.BrandBrokers` |
| 2.1, 2.2, 2.8 to 2.15 | All mail goes through `SmtpMailService`, which logs every send to `Email.EmailLoggers`; the SNS webhook updates delivery status |
| 2.2 to 2.3, 2.4 | A Brand organization creates its `Brand.Brands` row; the organization backfill reads legacy `BrandBrokers`; `BrandConnection.RegionID` references `CRM.Regions` |
| 2.3 to 2.10 | Brand CSV import and export run through `IMasterDataUploadService` |
| 2.4 to 2.6, 2.10, 2.11 | Banner unlink and SKU delete are blocked by promotion events; retailer and banner rename jobs update mapped data-upload records and monthly report rows |
| 2.5 to 2.6, 2.9, 2.10 | Price writes reprice promotion events; product force delete removes APL rows; product updates push names and case packs into data-upload tables |
| 2.6 to 2.10, 2.11 | The promotion product step pre-fills velocity from distributor sales; delete handlers trigger the monthly report refresh |
| 2.7 to 2.6 | Calendars read `TradeSpend.TradeSpendPromoEvents` and reuse the `PromoEvents.tsx` drill-down |
| 2.7, 2.8, 2.9, 2.10, 2.11 to 2.14 | Async exports and chunked imports use the shared `ExportJob` / `ImportJob` entities and job services |
| 2.8 to 2.3 | Notify Brands and Email Brands pickers call `POST /api/v1/brands/users`; access helpers still read `Brand.BrandBrokers` |
| 2.11, 2.12 to 2.6 | Roll-up, product report, forecast and monthly report read sandbox reporting versions and Brand Approved events; the AI internal-data path queries promotion tables |
| 2.14 to 2.10 | DataHub writes, re-links and deletes KeHE, UNFI and distributor sales records; data-upload imports call DataHub mapping and are refused during a store clean-up |
| 2.15 to 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.9, 2.13 | Admin data cleanup rewrites banner SKU dates from Market Overview logs and syncs per-unit prices into events; the file key backfill fills `FileRepository.UserFiles.Key` |

## 5. Common Change Recipes

Every path below was checked to exist on the documented branches. The worked examples point at real code you can copy.

### 5.1 Add a field to an existing entity, end to end

Worked example already in the code: `MasterPack` on product specifications.

| Step | File(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Entity property | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Domain/ProductSpec/ProductSpec.cs` | Entities derive from `AuditableEntity` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Domain/Common/Contracts/AuditableEntity.cs`) |
| 2. EF mapping | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Persistence/MainDbContext.cs` `OnModelCreating` (block for `ProductSpecifications`, `ToTable(..., SchemaNames.ProductSpecs)`) | Mapping is inline in `MainDbContext`, not in separate configuration classes. Only touch `ApplicationDbContext` for Identity tables |
| 3. Migration | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrations/<timestamp>_<PascalName>.cs` (+ `.Designer.cs`, `MainDbContextModelSnapshot.cs`), e.g. `20260702055635_MasterPackColumnAddedInProductTable.cs` | `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --context MainDbContext --project caboodle/src/Database/Migrator/Migrator.csproj --startup-project caboodle/src/Hosts/API/API.csproj`. Two contexts exist, so `--context` is required. Migrations apply automatically at API start (`InitializeMainDbAsync`) |
| 4. DTO | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/DTOs/ProductSpecsDTO.cs` | |
| 5. Request + validator + handler (write) | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/ProductSpecifications/UpsertProductSpecRequest.cs` | Request, `AbstractValidator`, and handler sit in one file. A PUT that overwrites the whole row must carry the new field or it is stored as null |
| 6. Dapper read SQL | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/ProductSpecifications/GetProductsSpecRequest.cs` (`p."MasterPack" AS "MasterPack"`) | Quote identifiers exactly; filter `"Deleted" = false` |
| 7. Import / export | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/ProductSpec/Modules.ProductSpecs.Application/ExportImport/{ImportProductsRequest,ExportProductsRequest}.cs` | Only if the entity is imported or exported |
| 8. Web model | `caboodle.web/src/models/product.interface.ts` | Use `number \| null` for optional numeric fields |
| 9. Web service / UI | `caboodle.web/src/service/product.service.ts`; UI `caboodle.web/src/app/(brand)/[brandID]/(product-specs)/products/ProductForm.tsx`, `ProductsRowTemplate.tsx`, `products/[productID]/ProductOtherInfo.tsx` | |
| 10. Admin (if the admin edits the entity) | `caboodle.admin/src/interface/productSpec.interface.ts`, `caboodle.admin/src/component/ProductSpec/AddProductSpec.tsx` | |
| Test | Backend: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/ProductSpecs.Application.Test/ProductSpecifications/`; web: `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/` (service or component suite) | Run `dotnet test caboodle.sln` and `yarn test` |

### 5.2 Add a backend endpoint

| Step | File(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Request + handler + validator | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/<Module>/Modules.<Module>.Application/<Feature>/<Verb><Thing>Request.cs` (pattern: `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataUpload/Modules.DataUpload.Application/Requests/KeHE/ImportExport/UploadChunkForKeHEImportRequest.cs`) | `IRequest<TResponse>`, `AbstractValidator<T>`, `IRequestHandler<,>`. Validators are discovered by each module's `AddValidatorsFromAssembly` (e.g. `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Admin/Modules.Admin.Application/Startup.cs`) and run at model binding (no MediatR behaviors). Throw errors with `ErrorHelper.Throw*` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Core/Shared/Helpers/Error/ErrorHelper.cs`) |
| 2. Controller action | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/<Area>/<Name>Controller.cs` deriving `VersionedApiController`; call `Mediator.Send(...)` | Route prefix `api/v{version}/<controller>` |
| 3. Authorization attribute | Exactly one of: `[RequireModule(brandSlug, brokerSlug, ModuleActions.X)]` with optional `CrossBrand = true` or `OrganizationLevel = true` (e.g. `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Modules/DataUpload/KeHeController.cs`), `[RequireOrgPermission(OrgPermissions.X)]` (e.g. `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/BrandAccessController.cs`), `[MustHavePermission(CaboodleAction, CaboodleResource, CaboodleModule)]` for platform endpoints (e.g. `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Controllers/Organizations/OrganizationRolesController.cs`), or `[AllowAnonymous]` | `MapControllers().RequireAuthorization()` makes auth the default. For a create-or-update action, gate with `View` and call `IAccessContext.DemandModuleAsync(..., Create or Update)` in the handler (backend `CLAUDE.md`) |
| 4. Authorization coverage test | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/API.Test/Authorization/EndpointAuthorizationCoverageTests.cs` and `bare-endpoints-baseline.txt` | The test fails if the new action has no rule or two rules, or if a platform controller lacks a platform permission. Do not add new lines to the baseline (it "only shrinks") |
| 5. Handler tests | `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/<Module>.Application.Test/` | xUnit + Moq |
| 6. Front end | web `caboodle.web/src/service/<domain>.service.ts` + `caboodle.web/src/hooks/<domain>.ts`; admin `caboodle.admin/src/services/*.service.ts` + `caboodle.admin/src/hooks/*.ts` | 5.9 |

### 5.10 Add an environment variable or configuration key

| Where | Steps |
|---|---|
| Backend | 1. Add the key to `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/appsettings.Development.json`, `appsettings.Staging.json`, `appsettings.Production.json` (or `appsettings.json` for shared values). 2. Add an options class with a `SectionName` constant (pattern `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/DataHub/Modules.DataHub.Application/StoreCleanup/StoreCleanupSettings.cs`) and `services.Configure<T>(config.GetSection(...))` in the module `Startup.cs` (pattern `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Startup.cs`). 3. Inject `IOptions<T>`. Environment variables override JSON (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/Configurations/Startup.cs`), using `__` for nesting. Do not commit secret values (3.14) |
| Web | 1. Add the variable to all six files `caboodle.web/.env.{development,dev.production,dev.backend,staging,qa,production}`. 2. Read it through `process.env.X`, ideally exported once from `caboodle.web/src/constants/appConstants.ts`. 3. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values are inlined at build time (Docker `ARG BUILD` picks the script, which picks the file), so a change needs a rebuild; anything without the prefix is server only (NextAuth `options.ts`) |
| Admin | Same, across `caboodle.admin/.env.{development,staging,production,backend}`; read from `caboodle.admin/src/appConstant/constant.ts` `appConfig`; never put a secret on `appConfig` (it is imported by client components) |
| Test | Backend: options binding tests in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/tests/<Module>.Application.Test/`. Web: no env test harness; a constants test such as `caboodle.web/src/__tests__/constants/themeConstants.test.ts` shows the style |

## 6. Open Questions & Unclassified

Items that could not be verified from code alone, contract mismatches, and suspected defects found while reading. Each names the path that raised it. Security items are collected again in 3.14.

### 6.1 2.1 Identity & Authentication

- Master password: is `SecuritySettings:MasterPassword` intended to stay set in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/appsettings.Production.json` (and Staging, Development)? It opens every account, including Platform Admins, and is not marked in the audit log (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Identity/TokenService.cs` `GetSignInFailureAsync`). Are production values overridden by deployment secrets? Not verifiable from the repo.
- Default admin seed: `ApplicationDbSeeder.SeedAdminUserAsync` creates `admin@caboodle.com` with a hard-coded weak password when missing (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Initialization/ApplicationDbSeeder.cs`). Is that account disabled or rotated in production?
- Web refresh window: the web NextAuth `jwt` callback refreshes 10 minutes before expiry on every session read, including `getServerSession` in server layouts (`caboodle.web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/options.ts`, `caboodle.web/src/helper/serverSession.helper.ts`). Server components cannot write the rotated refresh token back to the cookie; admin hit this exact failure and reduced its buffer to 60 s (`caboodle.admin/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/options.ts`, comment "IAM 01 AF2"). Does web see unexpected logouts once a session passes the 60 s grace window? Not verified at runtime.
- Server-side token leakage: `caboodle.web/src/components/AxiosInterceptor.tsx` (`"use client"`) seeds the module-level `caboodle.web/src/httpClient/sessionToken.ts` during render, which also runs during SSR in the Next.js server process. Does that module instance persist across requests on the server, and does the NextAuth route handler share it (it calls `CaboodleService.login` / `refreshAccessToken` through the same axios instance)? If so, server-side calls could carry another user's bearer token. Needs a runtime check of Next.js module bundling.
- `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` is only in `caboodle.web/.env.dev.backend`; `.env.development`, `.env.dev.production`, `.env.staging`, `.env.qa`, `.env.production` lack it and still define `NEXT_PUBLIC_JWT_SECRET`. Is the secret injected by the deployment pipeline?
- Web `serverSessionCheck` does not reject a session with `error: "RefreshAccessTokenError"` (admin's `(mainApp)/layout.tsx` does). Intended?
- `SignUpAsync` and `CreateAsync` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Identity/UserService.CreateUpdate.cs`) return success when `UserManager.CreateAsync` fails. Already listed as ONB-B11 in `caboodle.admin/iam-service-fe-guide/gaps.md`; is a fix scheduled?
- An invited email that already has an unverified self sign-up gets "already exists, log in" but cannot log in until it finishes the code flow (`CreateVerifiedUserAsync`). ONB-B8 in the same gaps file; decision pending?
- Rate limiting: only the per-code attempt limit and resend cooldown exist; no IP throttling for login, sign-up, verify, resend, forgot or reset. Accepted risk (ONB-A16)?
- Password policy is minimum length 6 with no complexity (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Identity/Startup.cs`). Intended for production?
- Reset password, change password and deactivation do not revoke refresh tokens or access tokens (`UserService.Password.cs`, `UserService.ChangeActiveStatusAsync`). Should they call the logout path?
- `POST /users/reset-password` returns 404 for an unknown email while `forgot-password` is enumeration-safe (`UserService.Password.cs`). Intended?
- Admin refresh uses `POST /auth/refresh-token`, which does not re-check the ADMIN role; app and admin tokens share key and claims (no audience). Should admin tokens be separated?
- `/all-users` "Platform Admin" tag cannot appear because `GET /users` removes the ADMIN role from `roles` in SQL (`UserService.GetListAsync` join condition) while `caboodle.admin/src/component/User/UsersTable.tsx` looks for role name "Admin". Which side should change?
- `POST /api/v1/users/invite/brand-sub-user` interpolates request emails into SQL (`UserService.ValidateInvitedBrandSubUser`, `GetInvitedBrandSubUserQuery`). Admin-only and no caller; should the legacy invite endpoints be removed?
- Legacy BrokerSubUser invite validation queries the broker's brands but never uses the result (`UserService.CheckValidationForInvitedUser`). Dead check or bug to fix before removal?
- Are the hidden admin routes `/users`, `/disable-users`, `/brand-owners`, `/invited-users`, `/brand-subusers`, `/broker-subusers` scheduled for deletion? `caboodle.admin/src/app/(mainApp)/invite-user/page.tsx` mentions "deleted in P5 step 2".
- `RoleService.UpdatePermissionsAsync` has no default-role guard (ADMIN permissions editable through `PUT /roles/{id}/permissions`). Intended?
- `UserAccountDeletion` does not clean `Identity.UsersHierarchy` or `Identity.InvitedUsers` rows linked to a deleted user (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Modules/Organization/Modules.Organization.Application/Helper/UserAccountSql.cs`). Orphans acceptable?
- Profile image URLs are 20-year S3 pre-signed URLs stored in `Identity.Users.ImageUrl` and in the JWT claim (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3StorageService.cs` `GetFileUrl`). Acceptable?
- `useUpdateUserProfile.onError` (`caboodle.web/src/hooks/profile.ts`) dereferences `error.response`, which the web interceptor never provides; a failed profile update throws instead of showing the message. Confirm and fix?
- Admin `UserService.exportUser` (`caboodle.admin/src/services/users.service.ts`) targets `GET /api/v1/masterdataupload/users`, which no backend route defines; dead code?
- Reset-token lifetime is the ASP.NET Identity default (no `DataProtectionTokenProviderOptions` found). Is a shorter lifetime wanted?
- origin/master commits `3e64c65a` (CS-XXXX) and `e48c24e0` (CS-1791) add `BrandBrokerParentResolver`, `RepairSubBrokerParentsRequest` and `SubBrokerParentRepairController` touching `Brand.BrandBrokers.ParentBrokerID`, which legacy sub-broker handlers read; behavior after merge not reviewed here.

Should one banner ever have two distributors for a brand? (`ConnectDistributorWithBannersRequest.cs` vs `ConnectDistributorWithBannerRequest.cs`)

**UI reachability**

- "All Retailers" export sends `searchKeyword` that `ExportRetailersRequest` ignores.

**Contracts**

Swagger consumers may be misled.

### 6.16 Cross-cutting, overview and change recipes

- How is the customer web app deployed today? Its Docker build and SSH deploy steps are commented out and only the coverage gate runs (`caboodle.web/bitbucket-pipelines.yml`). Manual deploy, another pipeline, or a hosting service?
- `caboodle.web/bitbucket-pipelines.yml` declares the top-level `pipelines:` key twice (lines 24 and 74). Which block does Bitbucket actually use? If the later one wins, the `staging`/`master` coverage gate never runs.
- Production NextAuth secret for the web app: `options.ts` reads `NEXTAUTH_SECRET`, which exists only in `caboodle.web/.env.dev.backend`. Is it injected at runtime on the hosts, or are production sessions currently failing or unsigned? (`caboodle.web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/options.ts`)
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_APP_URL` is read by `caboodle.web/src/components/onboarding/UseAdminAppNotice.tsx` but is in no `.env.*` file. Where is it set?
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_JWT_SECRET` is set in every web env file and read nowhere. Can it be removed (and rotated, since it is committed)?
- Are the secrets committed in `caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/Hosts/API/appsettings.{Development,Staging,Production}.json` the live ones, or are they overridden by host environment variables? The pipeline `docker run` passes only `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT`.
- Security headers: `SecurityHeaderSettings` binds properties at the section root while the JSON nests them under `Headers` (`caboodle.backend/caboodle/src/BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/SecurityHeaders/SecurityHeaderSettings.cs`). Confirm in a running instance that no `X-Frame-Options` etc. are emitted (reasoned from code, not observed).
- CORS allows any origin (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Cors/Startup.cs`); the `CorsSettings` origin lists are ignored. Intended?
- Is Swagger meant to be public in Production (`SwaggerSettings:Enable` true in `appsettings.Production.json`)?
- How many API containers run per environment? Cache is in-process memory (`CacheSettings:UseDistributedCache` false), so access-version invalidation and module-settings versions do not propagate across instances, and Hangfire `WorkerCount` 1 means one job at a time per process.
- S3 region is hardcoded to `ap-northeast-1` (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/FileStorage/AwsS3Provider.cs`) while production images and hosts are in `us-west-1`. Is the production bucket in Tokyo by design?
- The web crawler service (`http://webcrawler:8000`, `Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Services/DataSync/DataSyncJobService.cs`) is not in any of the three repos. Where is it defined and deployed (same `caboodle-network` Docker network?)
- SQS client (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Messages/*`) is registered but has no caller. Planned use or dead code?
- SignalR hub `/notifications` broadcasts data sync progress, but neither front end subscribes. Is a client planned?
- `CaboodleJobFilter` is commented out of the Hangfire setup (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/Startup.cs`), so `CaboodleJobActivator` never receives a user id parameter. Do jobs rely on `ICurrentUser` anywhere (it would read empty)?
- `MainDbContext` has no `SaveChanges` override, so `IAuditableEntity` stamping, `Trail` audit rows and domain-event dispatch from `BaseDbContext` apply only to `ApplicationDbContext`. Is that intended (handlers appear to stamp fields themselves)?
- `IRepository<T>` is registered for both `ApplicationDbRepository` and `MainDbRepository`; the second wins. Is any code relying on the Identity-context repository through `IRepository<T>`? (`BuildingBlocks/Infrastructure/Persistence/Startup.cs`, `Modules/Shared/Modules.Shared.Infrastructure/Configurations/Startup.cs`)
- `RequestLoggingMiddleware` buffers and reads JSON request bodies but never logs them. Intended (cost without benefit), or was the body meant to be logged with redaction?
- Seeded admin user `admin@caboodle.com` uses a hardcoded password (`ApplicationDbSeeder.SeedAdminUserAsync`). Has it been changed in every environment?
- Three backend test projects (`DataHub`, `TradeSpend`, `TradeSpendSandbox`) do not reference `coverlet.runsettings`; is their coverage collected with the intended include/exclude filters?
- Web `test-utils.tsx` sets `gcTime: 0`, which is a React Query v5 option; on v4.33 the equivalent is `cacheTime`, so the test client keeps the default cache time. Intended?
- Admin `next.config.js` contains Tailwind keys (`content`, `theme`, `plugins`); harmless or a copy error? Admin `eslint-config-next` 13.5.9 does not match `next` 16.2.11.
- Admin `package.json` scripts reference `scripts/generate-*.js` and `docs/data-mapping/...` which do not exist in the working tree.
- `caboodle.backend/deployments/deployment.tpl.yml` (Kubernetes, `saasms-complaintservice`) and `caboodle/src/Scripts/DefaultSalary` look like template leftovers. Safe to delete?
- Master drift in my scope (read-only check with `git diff HEAD...origin/master`): `IFileStorageService.MoveFolderObjectAsync` return type and `AwsS3StorageService.cs` changed (CS-1795), `CaboodlePermissions` gains `SubBrokerParentRepair` (CS-1791), two new `MainDbContext` migrations, and `ModuleStartup.AddTradeSpendModule` drops its `config` argument. None of these change the cross-cutting design; owners should record them.
- Exact NSwag UI path (`/swagger`) is the library default and was not observed on a running server.
- `DistributorSalesReports/import` in the web provider map uses a mixed-case path; routing is case-insensitive in ASP.NET Core, so it works, but confirm no proxy in front is case-sensitive.

### 6.19 Documentation scope limits

- The backend working branch is 45 commits behind `origin/master`. Master-only feature commits (CS-1774, CS-1792, CS-1791, CS-1795) are described in the affected modules (2.6, 2.8, 2.2, 2.13) but the rest of the document reflects the working branch.
- Nothing was run: no builds, tests or servers. Statements about runtime failures (for example invalid SQL or broken exports) come from reading code and are marked as unverified in the module questions above.
- Calculation results (trade spend, roll-up, monthly report) were traced through code but not checked against real data.
